To address this issue, we introduce the Semantic Preservation and Subspace Calibration (SPSC) framework, which first uses Object Mask Contrastive Regularization (OMCR) with object identity for backend training, and then constructs Subspace Candidate Gate (SCG) to achieve label-free semantic correction for target subjects during inference. Specifically, OMCR regularizes the conditioning space with object-level positive samples to preserve object-level feature neighborhoods within the reconstruction prior and low-level branch, while SCG exploits training image prototypes and batch statistics of unlabeled target EEG to select candidates for each task within subspaces of image prototypes. Under the leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) setting across ten subjects on the THINGS-EEG dataset, SPSC improves the cross-subject reconstruction from 0.552 to 0.713 on CLIP and from 0.612 to 0.745 on Alex.5. These significant gains indicate that the semantically calibrated conditions can better support generation for the target subjects under label-free inference.

title: A Bridge from Paste to Place: Physics-Guided One-Step Image Composition via Object-Scene Interaction
authors: Hongzhen Li, Youwei Pan, Yingfang Zhu, Sen Zhu, Fengjie Zhu, Leilei Cao
abstract: Realistic image composition must make a pasted object appear naturally present in a scene while preserving the fine details of both foreground and background. Reference-based insertion methods can change object pose and appearance, while foreground harmonization methods and shadow-specific synthesis methods each address only part of this task. An efficient, unified solution to this task remains an open challenge. We introduce Paste2Place, an end-to-end, physics-guided flow-based model that learns a direct, one-step latent bridge from pasted inputs to realistic composites, guided by explicit albedo-shading-residual decomposition and recomposition within the model. To support model training and evaluation, we develop a Blender rendering and validation pipeline to generate paired composites with physical annotations, and construct real-scene pairs from open-source object-removal data. This effort yields 86,273 training pairs and a 1,500-example benchmark. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that Paste2Place achieves substantial advantages in image composition quality and inference speed. Overall, our work provides a clear task definition and an effective solution for image composition, and fills a gap in large-scale, high-quality datasets and benchmarks for training and evaluating image composition.

title: Sensed but Not Told: Hidden Physiological Adaptation Shapes LLM Persuasion
authors: Xiaoyan Wei, Yutong Qu, Yutong Li, Haiyi Li, Wei Emma Zhang, Hsiang-Ting Chen
abstract: Wearable sensors, including those embedded in VR headsets, can provide LLM-based chatbots with physiological signals that users do not explicitly communicate. We tested whether such hidden input changes persuasion. In a $2\times2$ within-subjects study ($N=24$), a chatbot argued against participants' self-selected opinions with or without turn-level heart-rate and pupil-diameter features; sensing was disclosed halfway through the study. Before disclosure, sensing increased perceived persuasiveness by 1.42 points. Across the study, sensing was associated with a 0.57-point greater shift toward the chatbot's position and 3.20 times the odds of any movement toward it. Persuasiveness ratings were lower after disclosure, although disclosure was confounded with session order. Dialogue logs suggested a more declarative interaction style when sensing was on: chatbot replies contained question marks less often, and conversations contained fewer turns. These findings motivate making biosignal-driven adaptation inspectable and providing a genuinely non-sensed mode.

title: k-Volume: a Unified Active Learning Strategy
authors: Eliot Tron, Alain Celisse, Christophe Denis, Alice Le Brigant
abstract: In the classification context where revealing the label of a sample is costly, we propose a new Active Learning (AL) strategy named k-Volume (kVol). It randomly selects a sample to be labeled according to the volume of the smallest ball containing its k nearest neighbors. kVol is highly versatile: it can be applied either in the input space or in the output space, and it enjoys the desirable properties of the three main families of AL strategies: density, diversity, and (when performed in the output space) uncertainty. From a theoretical perspective, we establish that kVol is asymptotically equivalent to uniform sampling over the support of the (input or output) data distribution. Based on experiments on various synthetic and real-life tabular datasets and images, we observe that kVol is surprisingly stable: whatever the classifier or the experimental setup, it still lies among the best AL strategies unlike other competitors that fail dramatically. In particular, kVol outperforms state-of-the-art competitors such as CoreSet, TypiClust or Uncertainty on several real-life datasets, at a low computational cost.

title: Precedence Constraint Scheduling on a Fixed Number of Machines
authors: Klaus Jansen
abstract:
We give a deterministic exact algorithm for $P_m\mid\mathrm{prec},p_j=1\mid C_{\max}$ for every fixed $m\ge3$. The algorithm constructs an optimum schedule in $$
  O(L)+m^{O(m^2)}\, n^{6m^2+13m+1} \, {\log n} $$ elementary RAM operations, where $n \ge 2$ is the number of jobs and $L$ is the binary input length. Its word size is $O(m^2 \log n)$ bits. An implementation with a fixed number of tapes uses $O(L)+m^{O(m^2)} \, n^{12m^2+26m+2} \, \log^3 n$ steps. For three machines the respective polynomial degrees are $94$ and $188$, apart from the displayed logarithmic factors.

title: Tracybot: Preserving Developer Intent by Tracing Agent-Generated Code to Prompts
authors: Răzvan Albu, Aliaksei Khval, Maxine Orlova, Danis Music, Filipe Araújo Veras Rosa, Lirong Yi, Ranim Khojah
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are now widely used in software development, and LLM-based coding agents are given increasing autonomy. With coding agents, many design decisions are made in the conversation between the developer and the agent. Typically, the developer starts a conversation with an agent and states their intent, the agent proposes options if needed, and the developer plans the change accordingly. Then, the resulting code is committed. However, in such scenarios, the decisions and the intent behind the changes remain in the conversation, with no link to the code they produced. In this paper, we present Tracybot, an open-source tool that integrates with VS Code, Git, and coding agents to keep track of relevant conversations in an LLM-assisted development process. Tracybot captures each change as a Tasklet which consists of optional planning prompts used to plan a change, together with a build prompt that produces it. Tracybot has two main features: (i) it maps line-level code changes made by coding agents to the Tasklets that produced them, and (ii) it allows the developer to export a Tasklet as a decision record when needed, for example when the decision concerns the architecture of the project. We developed the tool over two iterations of a design science study, while focusing the evaluation on the usability and user-friendliness of the tool. In a focus group (7 participants) and a survey (24 participants), we found that Tracybot was perceived as useful for activities like code review, and most participants found our Tasklet design and presentation to be a clear way to represent the developer's intent. Tool: https://github.com/TracyTeam/tracybot. Video: https://youtu.be/Vg_a1F5eO04.

title: Causal graph fusion across incomplete cohorts and causal steering of tabular foundation models
authors: Yanke Li, Dhiyaa Al Jorf, Ayoube Ighissou, Anke Scheel-Sailer, Robert Riener, Diego Paez-Granados
abstract: Clinical data are split across incomplete cohorts with partially overlapping variables. Causal discovery under missing data and multi-source integration have developed separately, and tabular foundation models cannot take a causal graph without retraining. We make two contributions. First, causal graph fusion learns a partial ancestral graph on the shared variables, fuses it into each cohort's graph under temporal background knowledge and lets Markov blankets guide re-imputation, so missing data are handled inside discovery. Second, causal attention steering compiles the learned graph into the attention of a frozen tabular foundation model at inference. Against known ground truth, fusion dominates pooled and per-cohort baselines in every missingness and heterogeneity condition tested (p<0.001), and steering improves discrimination under distribution shift (p<10^{-5}), a gain that a random graph does not produce. In two spinal cord injury cohorts, fusion orients age, albumin and hemoglobin as ancestors of length of stay, a set no single cohort orients in full, and yields compact, temporally ordered predictor sets that match or exceed automatic feature selection on four of five outcomes.

title: Travel Cost Calibration for Multi-Agent Target Assignment and Pathfinding
authors: Yu Kumagai, Ryohei Banno, Keisuke Okumura
abstract: Target assignment and pathfinding (TAPF) is an appealing extension of classical multi-agent pathfinding (MAPF): each agent has a set of targets, and the planner must both assign a target to each agent and plan collision-free paths for them. A trivial approach is to compute an assignment that minimizes the total single-agent shortest-path distance over agent--target pairs, and then solve the resulting MAPF instance. However, this approach falls short because the shortest-path distance remains a proxy that ignores interference among agents. Assigning targets based on the costs agents actually pay, which depend on how every other agent is assigned and routed, would yield a better final outcome. To this end, we propose an iterative TAPF method that improves target assignments by calibrating travel cost estimates from fast, suboptimal MAPF feedback. Experiments show that our method produces solutions close to optimal on small instances and outperforms existing planners in solution quality on larger ones.

title: A Spiking Neural Model of the Mental Lexicon: Representations, Similarity Structure, and Associative Retrieval in Perception and Production
authors: Bernd J. Kröger
abstract: A neural account of lexical access requires an explicit distinction between the structure of lexical representations, the associations linking representational levels, and the activity generated during retrieval. This paper specifies a spiking neural implementation of the mental lexicon within the Neural Engineering Framework and Semantic Pointer Architecture. Conceptual and phonological form representations are constructed recursively from relational graphs, whereas lemma representations provide independent lexical identities. The implementation contains 613 lexical entries and supports two directed processing pathways: perception maps a phonological form to its associated concept via a lemma, whereas production maps a concept to its associated phonological form via a lemma. Each pathway combines two associative-memory variants, winner-take-all (WTA) selection (competition) and thresholded transfer, and uses 199,400 leaky integrate-and-fire neurons. We formalize within-level similarity, cross-level associative retrieval, and the interpretation of decoded activity. Simulations show successful retrieval of eight selected words from the lexicon in both processing directions, with retrieval evaluated against all 613 lexical entries. These simulations use complete phonological forms as input for perception and complete concepts as input for production, illustrating lexical retrieval through the corresponding processing pathways. This paper provides a transparent description of lexical representations and neural retrieval mechanisms, supported by accessible code, lexical data, and online simulation documentation.
comment: 28 pages, 3 figures; code, lexical data and recorded simulations available on GitHub; ancillary figure-generation scripts and provenance documentation

title: Uniqueness-Aware Feature Engineering for Representing Humans in Algorithmic Decision Making
authors: Theresa Elstner, Martin Potthast
abstract: Fairness analyses of algorithmic decision systems typically treat the feature representation of individuals as an a priori fixed input. How well a feature representation captures what is actually decision-relevant for different people and their unique backgrounds, however, is typically left unexamined. We address this gap by modeling feature engineering as a stochastic selection process over the pooled characteristics as candidate features for a finite training population. Based on this model, we develop a new framework for uniqueness-aware feature engineering which operates in two layers. The first layer measures population heterogeneity using a multivariate hypergeometric model of feature prevalence. It shows how well an individual is represented by any given input representation and which individual of the population is "least represented" compared to their personal, reference characteristics. The second layer acts on this assessment using set-similarity measures to search for an optimum between representational fit of the population and predictive accuracy. Without assuming prior knowledge about unseen individuals, our framework grants represented humans agency over what counts as decision-relevant in their case, gives deploying institutions accountability through a publishable representation fit report, and provides each person subject to a decision transparency about their personal representation fit. We operationalize our framework as a six-step pipeline and show a proof-of-principle using synthetic data. Our approach offers a blueprint for making algorithmic decision systems accountable for how well they represent individuals during development and in production.

title: PhyCAD: Physics-Aware Text-to-CAD Generation via Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
authors: Yuxin Cui, Weijie Zheng, Zhengyang Li, Han Wang, Wenjie Feng, Qiyu Kang
abstract: Language-driven computer-aided design (CAD) generation enables the creation of editable parametric models from text, yet geometric correctness alone does not ensure physical feasibility. We present PhyCAD, a framework for physics-aware Text-to-CAD generation that trains language models to produce executable CadQuery programs under geometric and physical constraints. To support this setting, we construct a Text-to-CAD dataset that links parametric CAD models with geometric specifications, loading conditions, and physical constraints. We further develop an automated CAD--CAE verifier that combines program execution, geometric checks, and finite element analysis to provide feedback for model training. A key learning challenge is to prioritize joint satisfaction of geometric and physical constraints while retaining informative feedback on partial progress. A flat aggregation of heterogeneous rewards can obscure this priority, allowing improvements in individual criteria to compensate for unmet design requirements. We therefore introduce a Hierarchical Balanced Advantage for Group Relative Policy Optimization, grouping candidates into levels according to their verification status and combining between-level progress with objective-wise peer ranking within each level. This formulation preserves cross-level priority in the training signal while providing fine-grained feedback for satisfying constraints and improving feasible designs. Experiments across multiple language models show that PhyCAD consistently improves joint geometric and physical constraint satisfaction. These results demonstrate the value of verifiable engineering feedback for advancing language-driven CAD generation beyond geometric reconstruction toward physics-aware design.

title: ROAM: Retrieval-Augmented Optimization for Feasible Multi-Day Itinerary Planning
authors: Ye Zihao, Lin Xiaoheng
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can draft plausible travel itineraries, but the plans they produce are frequently infeasible: attractions are grouped into days without regard for geography, opening hours are ignored, and a single generation pass cannot reliably organize a multi-day trip. We present ROAM, a retrieval-augmented agentic framework for spontaneous multi-day itinerary planning that couples semantic preference retrieval with explicit spatiotemporal optimization. ROAM embeds the natural-language request, retrieves a compact candidate set from a curated point-of-interest (POI) database, partitions candidates into day groups through maximal-clique analysis and K-means, orders each day with a quality-biased simulated-annealing TSP solver, and repairs hard opening-hour violations with greedy exchange. A spatiotemporal retrieval layer injects weather forecasts, real road distances and POI operating hours into the prompt, after which the LLM renders a structured, map-ready itinerary; an interactive ReAct-style replanning agent then supports natural-language edits while re-checking feasibility. Across four Chinese cities and 510 POIs, ROAM produces 27.5 POIs per three-day plan versus 19.3 for a bare LLM and 17.0 for a retrieval-only baseline (+42% and +62%), while reducing route dispersion from 2,101 to 677 (3.1x). Ablations show that spatial optimization is the dominant driver of route efficiency and that hard time-window repair prevents roughly 30% of attractions from violating operating hours.

title: Nothing Is Shared Until You Synchronise: Reinterpreting Java for Data-Race Freedom
authors: Luke Cheeseman, Elias Castegren, David Black-Schaffer, Erik Österlund, Tobias Wrigstad
abstract:
In mainstream shared-memory languages, programmers use synchronisation mechanisms such as locks to isolate shared data accesses across threads to avoid data races. Yet synchronisation enforces only a temporal ordering, while shared memory still communicates updates between threads at every ordinary read and write. To achieve isolation, programmers therefore need to understand the connection between ordering and communication, and to apply synchronisation correctly and consistently, while compilers and hardware optimise assuming they have. When programmers synchronise incorrectly, they lose isolation, and the semantics of their programs change without notice.
  We propose Sync-as-Share, a memory model built on isolation and communication rather than on the ordering of accesses to shared memory. We start from thread isolation, where each thread reads and writes a private view of memory, and reinterpret programs' existing synchronisation actions to also communicate updates explicitly. As nothing is communicated outside synchronisation actions, data races become impossible by construction. Instead, conflicting updates are detected at synchronisation points. Viewing synchronisation as explicit communication exposes the design decisions of what should be communicated, to whom, and what counts as a conflict. We propose two communication topologies with different trade-offs. We instantiate Sync-as-Share for Java by making the synchronisation actions already defined by its memory model the only points at which threads communicate, so Java programs can adopt Sync-as-Share unmodified. We formalise this instantiation as version-controlled memory, in which synchronisation actions push and pull updates between private views, and mechanise it in Rocq. We show that Java programs that are correctly synchronised under the Java memory model behave identically under shared memory and Sync-as-Share.

title: Future-Informed Actor-Critic
authors: Samy Mokeddem, Gaspard Lambrechts, Adrien Bolland, Damien Ernst
abstract: Actor-critic methods optimize a parametrized policy using a critic to estimate their policy gradient. Recent work has shown that conditioning the critic on features of future states, actions, or rewards can improve sample efficiency and even final return. However, existing methods are restricted to exogenous features (independent of actions), overlooking endogenous features (dependent on actions) that may be crucial for credit assignment. We introduce the future-informed value function, which can be conditioned on both exogenous and endogenous features of future states, actions, and rewards. Then, we express the policy gradient using this value function, yielding the future-informed policy gradient. Building on that, we propose the future-informed actor-critic algorithm. Empirical results show that this algorithm leveraging endogenous features of the future outperforms standard actor-critic algorithms in environments with noisy and sparse rewards.

title: MIRA: Mitigating Pole Geometry Bias in Recurrent Language Models
authors: Róisín Luo, Ihsan Ullah, Christian Gagné, Dong Li, Karyn Morrissey
abstract: We show that the Transformer's recurrent successors --- such as selective state-space models (SSMs), Receptance Weighted Key Value (RWKV), and Retentive Network (RetNet) --- can be characterized as infinite-impulse-response (IIR) systems. The zero--pole geometries of these IIR systems characterize the temporal modes they can represent. However, to trade parallelism, the algebraic structures of the parameterizations of these recurrent systems often give rise to poles constrained to the real axis, thereby inducing an architectural bias in their recurrent dynamics. To unify these recurrent architectures and eliminate their pole geometry bias, inspired by the lattice--ladder realization of general IIR systems, we present \textsc{Mira} (\textbf{M}odal \textbf{I}IR \textbf{R}ecurrent \textbf{A}rchitecture), a unified family of linear-time recurrent architectures for building large language models (LLMs) with a highly parallel algebraic structure. Each \textsc{Mira} block realizes a higher-order IIR system that represents temporal modes from token streams through a lattice--ladder structure, followed by a feed-forward network (FFN). This realization enables the model to represent the temporal modes associated with both real and complex-conjugate poles. We pretrain \textsc{Mira-S}, a 12-layer small-scale LLM with 0.14B parameters composed entirely of \textsc{Mira} blocks. Throughout the pretraining, \textsc{Mira-S} achieves lower perplexity than strong recurrent baselines, exhibits stronger context-window generalization beyond the training length, and attains higher throughput with a dedicated CUDA kernel.

title: Typed-Centrality Grounding for Agentic GraphRAG: A Symbolic Approach for Agentic Reasoning
authors: Rosario Napoli, Antonio Celesti, Massimo Villari, Maria Fazio
abstract:
Knowledge Graphs (KGs) and Large Language Models (LLMs) represent two approaches for knowledge representation and reasoning over heterogeneous data. Recent research has explored their integration through Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) systems, which use KGs to provide structured context to LLMs. However, existing GraphRAG approaches treat KGs as homogeneous graphs and rely on textual similarity between the input prompt and the context, rather than using it as a source of deterministic knowledge.
  This work proposes an agent-based GraphRAG system that introduces a symbolic layer to integrate deterministic reasoning alongside text similarities. This approach is based on the definition of typed centralities for KGs, where centrality measures are computed separately for each specific KG's class. This information is used to construct a symbolic representation that is provided to the LLM as a deterministic source. The proposed system was mathematically validated and evaluated on a real-world POLE (Person, Object, Location, Event) dataset, comparing reasoning and information retrieval with and without the symbolic layer. The results indicate that the our approach leads to responses that are more consistent with the context, improving the generated outputs.
comment: Preprint. 7 pages. Final version published in 2026 IEEE Symposium on Computers and Communications (ISCC), DOI: 10.1109/ISCC70364.2026.11739974

title: Improved Approximation and Hardness Bounds for $β$-TSP
authors: Paul Liu, Jack Spalding-Jamieson, Da Wei Zheng
abstract: The traveling salesman problem (TSP) asks for a minimum-length Hamiltonian cycle in a complete weighted graph. Its approximability depends on the edge lengths: unrestricted instances admit no constant-factor approximation unless $\mathrm{P}=\mathrm{NP}$, metric instances admit Christofides' $3/2$-approximation, and fixed-dimensional Euclidean instances admit a PTAS. We study $β$-TSP, where the edge lengths satisfy $ \ell_{uw}\leqβ(\ell_{uv}+\ell_{vw}) \qquad \forall\,u,v,w\in V\ \text{pairwise distinct}, \quad β\in\left[\tfrac{1}{2},1\right]. $ The condition arises naturally in various settings, for example, when metric travel times are combined with positive service times at the vertices. The previous best approximation algorithm, due to Böckenhauer et al., ranges from $1$ at $β=1/2$ to $3/2$ as $β$ approaches $1$. We obtain a strictly better guarantee for every $1/2<β<1$ by combining two simple constructions whose guarantees counterbalance each other. We also improve the best known approximation hardness bound for every $1/2<β<1$.

title: DeepRadio: A Human-Agent Workspace for Physical Radio Development
authors: Jiazhen Lei, Yuxin Sha, Sihan Wang, Wenhui Li, Jinyang Sun, Chengyu Lu, Xiaohua Tian
abstract: Agentic programming can automate software-defined radio (SDR) development, but decisions can propagate from software to hardware without sufficient user visibility or control. We present DeepRadio, a human-agent workspace embedded in GNU Radio Companion (GRC) for jointly constructing, verifying, and operating physical radio systems. DeepRadio uses a dynamic and state-driven workflow to coordinate a traceable radio specification, claim-oriented cross-layer verification, and mixed-initiative control. These mechanisms expose decisions, tie conclusions to available evidence, and return control to users before consequential hardware actions. Across seven atomic SDR tasks, DeepRadio completed nearly all runs while satisfying all prescribed software and radio-frequency constraints. In a 20-participant study, more participants achieved a verified physical deployment with DeepRadio than with Codex-assisted GRC. Participants reported stronger support for shared intent and understanding while retaining initiative and control. These results suggest that DeepRadio can make agent-assisted physical radio development more reliable, understandable, and controllable.

title: DataHelix: A CPU-GPU Co-Scheduling Data Plane for Multimodal Model Training
authors: Yuanhe Li, Jiazhen Wu, Dian Ding, Guangtao Xue, Yiming Zhang
abstract: Multimodal model training breaks the loose coupling between data loading and model execution assumed by conventional training pipelines. Large per-sample variation in decoding cost, token/latent count, and tensor size causes both CPU preprocessing time and GPU compute time to vary substantially across data-parallel ranks (training processes). In synchronous training, these two sources of heterogeneity interact tightly: GPU execution determines how long the input pipeline has to prepare the next batch, while delayed preprocessing in any rank in turn stalls all GPUs at synchronization. As a result, optimizing CPU throughput or GPU load balance in isolation cannot eliminate pipeline bubbles. We present DataHelix, a metadata-first CPU-GPU co-scheduling data plane for multimodal training. DataHelix jointly reasons about preprocessing demand and GPU execution progress, treating each GPU compute window as the readiness budget for the next batch and coordinating preprocessing across ranks to minimize deadline misses rather than CPU makespan. To avoid expensive data movement, placement is decided while samples remain lightweight descriptors, before decoding and collation amplify them into large tensors. Descriptor-level token-latent-aware batching performs coarse pre-balancing, while cost-gated collective rebalancing corrects residual skew only when its expected benefit exceeds transfer cost. Across 11 video and multimodal workloads on 8 Ascend 910B accelerators, DataHelix reduces mean deadline-miss rate by 67.8% and mean p95 input-wait latency by 87.0%, while achieving 2.72x geometric-mean throughput over rank-local DataLoaders and 1.82x over a Ray actor pool under the same CPU budget.

title: Robust & Scalable Website Fingerprinting via Minimal DRAM Traffic
authors: Shubham Roy, Samar Parwez, Biswabandan Panda
abstract: Website fingerprinting attacks infer websites visited by users and threaten their privacy. These attacks are classified as on-path, which monitor network traffic, and co-located, which exploit shared system resources. Existing co-located attacks, such as sweep-counting and loop-counting, achieve over 90% accuracy but suffer significant performance degradation on many-core systems. Loop-counting accuracy drops from 93% on 8 cores to 50% on 24 cores, while sweep-counting accuracy decreases from 84% to 45% across multiple Core Complex Dies (CCDs). To address these limitations, we propose memory-chasing, a scalable website fingerprinting attack that exploits DRAM traffic interference through pointer-chasing traversals with minimal interference. By counting DRAM accesses over fixed intervals, the attack generates distinctive traces for website classification. Evaluated on the top 50 websites, memory-chasing achieves 96% accuracy on a 24-core system, 86% across multiple CCDs, 80% across multiple sockets, and 97% in an open-world setting. Extensive evaluation across hardware configurations, browsers, operating systems, isolation mechanisms, system noise, and countermeasures demonstrates its robustness and scalability.

title: Agentic AI for Healthcare Claim Denial Analysis: A Policy-Grounded Framework for Privacy Preservation
authors: Sofia Campos, Carlos Martins, Pedro Pires, João Gama, Bruno Veloso, Pedro Santos
abstract: In the healthcare sector, claim denials impose significant financial and administrative burdens, emphasizing the need for automated and trustworthy decision-support systems. This paper proposes a modular Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) framework for healthcare claim denial analysis, integrating specialized agents for denial risk prediction, risk factor identification, diagnosis-procedure-medication code relationship analysis, and counterfactual analysis. The framework integrates predictive analytics, graph-based learning, a Hybrid Contextual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline grounded in healthcare policy documents, and a dedicated HIPAA Compliance Agent to support privacy protection. Evaluated on a synthetic healthcare claims dataset, the framework achieved 98% traceability of reported numerical findings, validated 214 of 216 policy citations, and removed all 280 identified sensitive identifiers without modifying the underlying analysis. These findings pave the way for further research into Agentic AI as a framework for explainable, policy-aware, and privacy-preserving healthcare claim denial management.
zh_title: 医疗索赔拒付分析的智能体AI：一种基于政策背景的隐私保护框架
translation: 在医疗领域，索赔拒付造成了巨大的财务和行政负担，凸显了对自动化且值得信赖的决策支持系统的需求。本文提出了一种用于医疗索赔拒付分析的模块化智能体人工智能（Agentic AI）框架，整合了用于拒赔风险预测、风险因素识别、诊断-诊疗-药物编码关系分析及反事实分析的专用智能体。该框架融合了预测分析、基于图的学习、基于医疗政策文档的混合上下文检索增强生成（RAG）管线，以及用于支持隐私保护的专用HIPAA合规智能体。在合成医疗索赔数据集上的评估表明，该框架对报告的数值结果实现了98%的可追溯性，验证了216个政策引用中的214个，并在不修改底层分析的情况下完全移除了所有280个已识别的敏感标识符。这些成果为进一步研究将智能体AI作为可解释、具政策感知且保护隐私的医疗索赔拒付管理框架开辟了道路。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合政策RAG和HIPAA合规智能体的模块化AI框架，用于实现可信、可追溯且保护隐私的医疗索赔拒赔分析。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于将模块化智能体AI与医疗政策RAG及HIPAA合规机制结合，不仅处理索赔拒赔的预测与因果反事实分析，还兼顾了医疗领域高度敏感的隐私保护要求。主要局限性在于目前实验仅在合成数据集上进行，其在真实复杂医疗数据和多变保单政策中的有效性与鲁棒性仍有待验证。
motivation: 医疗领域的索赔拒付给机构带来沉重的财务和行政负担，亟需自动化、高可信度且能保护隐私的决策支持系统。
method: 提出了一种模块化智能体AI框架，包含拒赔风险预测、风险因素识别、代码关系分析和反事实分析等专用智能体；集成了预测分析、基于图的学习、基于医疗政策文档的混合上下文检索增强生成（RAG）流程，以及专用的HIPAA合规智能体。
results: 在合成数据集上，该框架实现了报告数值98%的可追溯性，成功验证了216个政策引用中的214个，并在不影响底层分析的前提下完全移除了所有280个敏感标识符。
conclusion: 研究表明，基于智能体AI的框架能够有效实现具有可解释性、政策感知能力且兼顾隐私保护的医疗索赔拒赔管理，为该领域的深入研究奠定了基础。

title: MINE: Entropy-coded Memory-efficient Inference for Large Language Models
authors: Emil Schätzle, Markus Püschel
abstract: We present MINE (Memory-efficient INference Engine), a lossless entropy coding approach that accelerates single-stream inference of Large Language Models (LLMs), where existing lossless compression methods yield speedups only for specific data types such as \texttt{BF16} and under additional assumptions. Single-stream decoding is strongly memory-bound, since every weight must be streamed from memory once per generated token and requests cannot be batched in local or low-latency deployments. At the core of MINE is dtANS-LLM, a GPU entropy coding scheme adapted from the prior dtANS to the needs of LLM inference. It exploits the non-uniform distribution of weights, which persists even after quantization, and exposes hyper-parameters that trade compression ratio against decoding cost. We auto-tune these parameters for each tensor and GPU to obtain the Pareto front between model size and decoding latency. MINE integrates into vLLM as a plugin and selects the best kernel configuration for a given memory budget. On Llama~3.1~8B~Instruct with a 2.1-bit EntQuant checkpoint, MINE achieves speedups of 2.52$\times$ and 1.48$\times$ over the fastest baseline on an RTX~4060~Ti and an RTX~5090, at effective bitrates of 2.24 and 3.43~bits per weight. MINE is available as open source.
comment: Submitted to the 15th International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR), 2027. Artifact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23885927
zh_title: MINE：针对大语言模型的熵编码内存高效推理
translation: 我们提出了MINE（内存高效推理引擎），这是一种无损熵编码方法，用于加速大语言模型（LLM）的单流推理；而现有的无损压缩方法通常仅在特定数据类型（如BF16）和附加假设下才能实现加速。单流解码受到强烈的内存带宽限制，因为每个生成的token都必须从内存中完整流式传输一次权重，并且在本地或低延迟部署中请求无法进行批处理。MINE的核心是dtANS-LLM，这是一种根据LLM推理需求从现有dtANS改进而来的GPU熵编码方案。它利用了权重在量化后依然保持的非均匀分布特性，并提供了可在压缩率与解码开销之间进行权衡的超参数。我们针对每个张量和GPU自动调整这些参数，以获得模型大小与解码延迟之间的帕累托前沿。MINE作为插件集成到vLLM中，并能根据给定的内存预算选择最佳内核配置。在采用2.1比特EntQuant检查点的Llama 3.1 8B Instruct上，MINE在RTX 4060 Ti和RTX 5090上相比最快基线分别实现了2.52倍和1.48倍的加速，有效比特率分别为每权重2.24和3.43比特。MINE现已开源。
tldr: 本文提出了MINE引擎，通过GPU自适应熵编码无损压缩权重，有效打破了大语言模型单流推理中的显存带宽瓶颈，实现高达2.52倍的推理加速。
ai_comments: 该工作创新性地将GPU熵编码（dtANS）引入大模型推理流程，有效利用了量化权重的非均匀分布特性，精准击中了单流（低延迟/边缘设备）推理中显存带宽受限的痛点；作为插件与vLLM无缝集成展现了极高的工程实用价值。局限性在于该方法主要针对单流等访存密集型场景，在计算密集型的大batch推理场景下的效果未作提及。
motivation: 在本地部署或低延迟场景下，LLM单流推理无法进行批处理，每个生成的token都需要从显存中重新加载权重，导致推理严重受限于显存带宽；而现有的无损压缩加速方法通常仅适用于特定数据类型（如BF16）并依赖额外假设。
method: 提出了基于GPU的熵编码方案dtANS-LLM，利用量化后权重的非均匀分布特性进行无损压缩；开放超参数权衡压缩比与解码开销，针对不同张量和GPU进行自动调优以构建帕累托前沿；作为插件集成至vLLM框架中，在显存预算约束下自动选择最优内核配置。
results: 在采用2.1-bit EntQuant检查点的Llama 3.1 8B Instruct模型上，MINE在RTX 4060 Ti和RTX 5090上相比最快基线分别实现了2.52倍和1.48倍的加速，有效比特率分别为每权重2.24和3.43比特。
conclusion: MINE通过量化后熵编码与自适应内核配置，成功打破了单流LLM推理中的显存带宽瓶颈，在消费级硬件上实现了显著的端到端推理加速，且代码已开源。

title: EDP-PI-DOSnet: An Energy Dissipation Preserving Neural Solver for Two-Phase Flow Problems
authors: Jizu Huang, Yue Qian, Tao Zhou
abstract: Preserving the energy dissipation properties of gradient flow equations is important for the stability and reliability of numerical approximations, particularly in long-time simulations. In this paper, we propose a class of energy-dissipation-preserving physics-informed deep operator splitting networks (EDP-PI-DOSnets) for solving gradient flow equations. The proposed framework incorporates classical structure-preserving numerical schemes into neural network architectures, allowing the corresponding discrete energy dissipation laws to be preserved. In particular, suitable constraints are imposed on the convolution kernels to ensure that the learned discrete operators are symmetric and negative semidefinite. Furthermore, several network formulations are developed based on the Crank--Nicolson (CN), scalar auxiliary variable Crank--Nicolson (SAV/CN), and relaxed discrete variational derivative (R-DVD-1) schemes. Meanwhile, a physics-informed loss function based on the residuals of the governing equations is employed. Numerical experiments show that the predicted solutions are in good agreement with the reference solutions while satisfying the corresponding discrete energy dissipation laws. The results also suggest stable behavior during long-time recursive prediction and the potential applicability of the proposed framework to two-phase flow problems.
zh_title: EDP-PI-DOSnet：一种用于两相流问题的保能量耗散神经网络求解器
translation: 保持梯度流方程的能量耗散性质对于数值逼近的稳定性和可靠性至关重要，特别是在长时间模拟中。在本文中，我们提出了一类用于求解梯度流方程的保能量耗散物理信息深度算子分裂网络（EDP-PI-DOSnets）。所提出的框架将经典的保结构数值格式融入神经网络架构中，从而能够保持相应的离散能量耗散定律。具体而言，对卷积核施加了适当的约束，以确保学习到的离散算子是对称且半负定的。此外，基于Crank--Nicolson（CN）、标量辅助变量Crank--Nicolson（SAV/CN）以及松弛离散变分导数（R-DVD-1）格式开发了几种网络构建方案。同时，采用了基于控制方程残差的物理信息损失函数。数值实验表明，预测解与参考解吻合良好，同时满足相应的离散能量耗散定律。结果还表明该网络在长时间递归预测中表现稳定，并展示了该框架在两相流问题中的潜在适用性。
tldr: 本文提出了EDP-PI-DOSnet，通过将经典保结构离散格式与算子卷积核约束结合，构建了可严格保能量耗散且长时间稳定的物理信息神经网络求解器。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将经典保结构数值算法（如SAV/CN、R-DVD-1）与深度算子网络结构相融合，通过对卷积核引入对称半负定约束直接硬编码能量耗散性质，有效解决了传统PINN在梯度流及两相流长时间推演中易出现的数值失稳问题。
motivation: 在梯度流方程的长时间数值模拟中，保持能量耗散特性对于保证数值近似的稳定性和可靠性至关重要。
method: 提出了EDP-PI-DOSnet框架，将经典保结构数值格式（包括CN、SAV/CN和R-DVD-1格式）融入网络架构；对卷积核施加约束以确保学习到的离散算子为对称半负定；结合基于控制方程残差的物理信息损失函数进行训练。
results: 数值实验显示预测解与参考解高度一致，严格满足离散能量耗散定律，在长时间递归预测中表现出极佳的稳定性，并验证了其在两相流问题中的应用可行性。
conclusion: EDP-PI-DOSnet成功实现了将离散保能量耗散特性嵌入神经网络架构，在维持高精度的同时显著提升了长时间递归模拟的稳定性，展现出求解复杂两相流问题的良好潜力。

title: The Role Of Recurrent Refinement In Medical Image Segmentation
authors: Joao D.S. Marques, David Calhas, Arlindo L. Oliveira
abstract: While feed-forward segmentation networks perform well on large cohorts, they degrade in constrained clinical settings with few training samples and imaging artifacts. Human vision, by contrast, remains robust under these conditions, a property partly attributed to the recurrent and feedback connectivity of the visual cortex, which refines visual information over time. Inspired by this, we append lightweight recurrent refinement blocks to segmentation backbones, namely Conditional Random Fields (CRFs), modern Hopfield networks and convolutional GRUs, and study their behaviour as the number of iterations increases at test time (including beyond the training horizon). Evaluated on two open-source datasets, Kvasir- SEG and ARCADE, our recurrent blocks add less than 1.5% parameters and yield gains on clean data (up to 1.4 pp) and under noise (up to 17 pp) while reducing HD95. Code is available at https://github.com/joaodsmarques/recurrencehelpsegmentation .
zh_title: 循环细化在医学图像分割中的作用
translation: 尽管前馈分割网络在大型队列数据上表现优异，但在训练样本较少和存在成像伪影的受限临床场景中性能会出现退化。相比之下，人类视觉在这些条件下仍能保持鲁棒性，这部分归因于视觉皮层的循环和反馈连接，它们能随时间推移细化视觉信息。受此启发，我们在分割主干网络中添加了轻量级循环细化模块，即条件随机场（CRFs）、现代Hopfield网络以及卷积GRU，并研究了测试时迭代次数增加（包括超出训练迭代轮数）时的行为表现。在Kvasir-SEG和ARCADE两个开源数据集上的评估表明，我们的循环模块仅增加了不到1.5%的参数量，在干净数据上带来了性能增益（最高提升1.4个百分点），在噪声条件下表现提升更为明显（最高达17个百分点），同时降低了HD95指标。代码已开源：https://github.com/joaodsmarques/recurrencehelpsegmentation。
tldr: 受人类视觉启发，在医学分割网络中引入轻量级循环细化模块，参数仅增1.5%却大幅提升了噪声下的分割鲁棒性（最高提升17 pp）。
ai_comments: 该研究从人类视觉皮层的循环反馈机制中汲取灵感，针对临床小样本和成像伪影场景，为前馈分割网络引入轻量级循环细化模块。其创新点在于系统评估了CRF、现代Hopfield网络和ConvGRU在测试期迭代推理（包括超出训练步数）的表现，在仅增加不到1.5%参数的情况下显著提升了噪声环境下的鲁棒性（提升达17个百分点），具有很强的实用价值和理论启发。
motivation: 前馈分割网络在样本少、存在成像伪影的受限临床场景下性能明显下降；而人类视觉依赖视觉皮层的循环与反馈连接机制，能在该类条件下维持高度鲁棒性。
method: 在分割主干网络后接入轻量级循环细化模块（包括条件随机场CRF、现代Hopfield网络以及卷积GRU），并在测试时研究随着迭代次数增加（包括超出训练范围的迭代）模型的行为表现。
results: 在Kvasir-SEG和ARCADE两个开源数据集上的评估显示，所提循环模块仅增加不到1.5%的参数，在干净数据上使性能提升最高达1.4个百分点，在噪声干扰下提升最高达17个百分点，并降低了HD95指标。
conclusion: 在医学图像分割主干网络后附加轻量级循环细化模块，能够在参数量极低增长的前提下有效提升干净数据及噪声环境下的分割精度与鲁棒性。

title: DexDICE: Reconciling Safety and Performance via Dual-Expert Offline Imitation Learning
authors: Seokin Seo, Sung Kuk Shyn, Minji Seo, Yisoo Lee, Jongmin Lee, Hongseok Yang, Kee-Eung Kim
abstract: Ensuring high returns while providing strong safety guarantees in offline imitation learning (IL) is a fundamental challenge: existing approaches either rely on explicitly specified cost functions, which are difficult to design for complex real-world safety constraints, or require expert demonstrations that are both safe and high-performing, which are often too costly to collect. We introduce dual-expert imitation learning, which leverages two complementary data sources: (i) safety-compliant demonstrations that faithfully follow safety guidelines but may be suboptimal, and (ii) performance-oriented demonstrations that achieve high returns but may violate safety guidelines. To address this problem, we propose DexDICE (Dual-expert offline imitation learning via stationary DIstribution Correction Estimation). Instead of conventional distribution constraints, DexDICE combines DICE-style offline learning with safe support constraints, enabling agents to exploit high-return behaviors while remaining within safety-compliant regions. We prove that the ideal solution satisfying this constraint exactly has zero unsafe-region visitation with high probability. We evaluate DexDICE on a re-curated DSRL benchmark and validate it on a real-world mobile-robot navigation task trained directly from human teleoperation demonstrations, where it substantially outperforms baselines and remains robust to data scarcity and quality degradation.
zh_title: DexDICE：通过双专家离线模仿学习调和安全性与性能
translation: 在离线模仿学习（IL）中，确保高回报的同时提供强大的安全保障是一项根本性挑战：现有方法要么依赖于显式指定的代价函数（这在面对现实世界的复杂安全约束时极难设计），要么需要既安全又高性能的专家演示（此类数据收集成本通常过高）。我们引入了双专家模仿学习，该方法利用了两种互补的数据源：(i) 严格遵循安全指南但可能次优的安全合规演示；(ii) 获得高回报但可能违反安全指南的性能导向演示。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了DexDICE（基于平稳分布修正估计的双专家离线模仿学习）。DexDICE放弃了传统的分布约束，而是将DICE风格的离线学习与安全支撑集约束相结合，使智能体能够在保持在安全合规区域内的同时利用高回报行为。我们在理论上证明了完全满足该约束的理想解能够以极高概率实现零不安全区域访问。我们在重新整理的DSRL基准上对DexDICE进行了评估，并在直接由人类遥操作演示训练的真实移动机器人导航任务中对其进行了验证，实验表明其显著优于基线方法，并对数据稀缺和质量退化展现出鲁棒性。
tldr: DexDICE通过融合安全次优专家和高效非安全专家两类互补数据，结合DICE框架与安全支撑约束，在理论和实践中兼顾了强安全保证与高任务回报。
ai_comments: 该论文切中离线模仿学习中高回报与强安全数据难以兼备的现实痛点，创新性地将演示数据解耦为“安全合规但次优”与“高性能但可能不安全”两类互补数据。通过将DICE框架与安全支撑集约束相结合，从理论上提供了高概率零违规的安全保证，并在真实机器人遥操作任务中得到了验证，具有较强的理论创新与实际落地价值。
motivation: 在离线模仿学习中，现存方法要么依赖于现实复杂场景中极难人工设计的显式代价函数，要么依赖于数据采集成本极高的“既安全又高性能”的完美专家演示，难以平衡安全性与高回报。
method: 提出DexDICE算法，引入双专家模仿学习范式（分别利用安全合规但次优的演示，以及高性能但潜在不安全的演示），将DICE风格的平稳分布修正估计与安全支撑集约束（safe support constraints）结合，在理论上证明了理想解能以大概率实现零不安全区域访问。
results: 在重新构建的DSRL基准测试以及基于人类遥操作数据的真实移动机器人导航任务中，DexDICE均显著超越了基线方法，并对数据稀缺和数据质量退化表现出高度鲁棒性。
conclusion: DexDICE通过双专家离线模仿学习框架，成功调和了安全性与高性能之间的矛盾，为在没有显式代价函数和完美示范的情况下实现安全、高效的策略学习提供了坚实的理论与实践基础。

title: Incentive Pathologies in a Live LLM Agent Arena: An Empirical Study of Concentration, Reward-Rule Implementation Discrepancy, and Network Dilution
authors: Lei Zhenbing, Lei Chang
abstract: We audit one live LLM agent arena (AITRAP; 22 autonomous agent seats, ~96,000 reasoning nodes) over nine days (Oct 16-25, 2026), during which the platform deployed two bundled incentive changes: a progressive tax reform (V2.9.3, Oct 19) and a seed-inversion with explorer-side action update (V3.0, Oct 21). These serve as before-and-after markers, not cleanly isolated interventions. Four exploratory predictions are tested against ten data frames (F1-F10) using the Gini coefficient, Top-K concentration share, code-level reconstruction of the continuation-bonus mechanism, and the Mann-Kendall trend test. The Gini analysis is inconclusive at 95% confidence (bootstrap intervals straddle 0.7). The Top-4 node-activity-score share falls from 97.2% (Oct 19, pre-V2.9.3) to 49.4% (Oct 25, post-V3.0; 56.7% under a merge-seat assumption). The continuation bonus, announced as depth-based x10, resolves at code level to a four-condition anti-abuse gate paying x2.85 in the typical case and permanently blocking the self-continuation it superficially rewards; the gate was active ~40 hours before the V3.0 announcement. The events-per-node ratio declines significantly (Mann-Kendall S=-45, z=-3.94, p=8.3e-5) from 7.36 to 7.069. We discuss implications for incentive designers, the announcement-implementation gap, and public peer review as an event record.
comment: 29 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables; data available at Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23691548
zh_title: 真实在线LLM智能体竞技场中的激励病理：关于集中度、奖励规则实现偏差与网络稀释的实证研究
translation: 我们在九天内（2026年10月16日至25日）审计了一个真实的LLM智能体竞技场（AITRAP；包含22个自主智能体席位、约96,000个推理节点）。在此期间，该平台部署了两项打包的激励变更：累进税改革（V2.9.3，10月19日）以及带有探索端动作更新的种子反转（V3.0，10月21日）。这些变更作为前后对照标记，而非完全隔离的干预。我们利用基尼系数、Top-K集中度份额、继续奖励机制的代码级重构以及Mann-Kendall趋势检验，针对十个数据帧（F1-F10）测试了四个探索性预测。在95%置信度下，基尼系数分析未得出确定性结论（自助抽样区间跨越0.7）。Top-4节点活跃度得分份额从97.2%（10月19日，V2.9.3发布前）降至49.4%（10月25日，V3.0发布后；在合并席位假设下为56.7%）。官方宣布基于深度的10倍继续奖励，在代码层面上实际是一个四条件的防滥用门控，在典型情况下仅支付2.85倍，并永久阻止其表面上奖励的自我继续行为；该门控在V3.0发布前约40小时就已处于活动状态。每个节点的事件比率显著下降（Mann-Kendall S=-45, z=-3.94, p=8.3e-5），从7.36降至7.069。我们探讨了这对激励设计者、公告与实现差距以及将公开同行评审作为事件记录的启示。
tldr: 对在线LLM智能体竞技场的审计发现，激励改革虽打破了97%的头部垄断，但也导致了网络稀释，并揭露了官方规则宣传与底层代码实现之间的重大偏差。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地对真实运行中的多智能体竞技场进行了实证审计，重点揭示了机制设计公告与代码实际实现之间的严重偏差（如宣传10倍奖励实际仅约2.85倍且有防滥用门控），以及激励改革对中心化和网络稀释的双重影响。其局限在于观察周期较短（仅9天），且两次激励机制调整时间间隔较近并打包上线，属于前后对比而非严格隔离的因果干预实验。
motivation: 探讨真实在线LLM智能体竞技场在引入激励调整（累进税改革和种子反转更新）过程中的激励机制病态问题，包括中心化集中、公开奖励规则与代码实际实现的偏差，以及网络稀释现象。
method: 对包含22个智能体席位、约96,000个推理节点的在线竞技场（AITRAP）在9天内的数据（10个数据帧）进行审计；采用基尼系数、Top-K集中度份额、继续奖励机制的代码级重构分析以及Mann-Kendall趋势检验进行定量分析。
results: 基尼系数分析在95%置信度下未得出定论；Top-4节点活跃度份额从改革前的97.2%下降到改革后的49.4%（合并席位假设下为56.7%）；宣称为10倍的基于深度的继续奖励在代码层实为四条件防滥用门控，典型情况下仅发放2.85倍并永久阻止自我延续，且该门控在公告前约40小时即已激活；每节点事件比率显著下降，从7.36降至7.069（p=8.3e-5）。
conclusion: 研究强调了多智能体平台中激励设计公布与实际代码实现脱节的问题，验证了机制改革虽然降低了头部集中度，但也导致了网络活跃度（单节点事件比）的显著稀释，并提倡将公开同行评审作为记录平台演进的事件日志。

title: Logit Laundering: Evading Data-Use Auditing in Large Language Models
authors: Ruihan Hu, Wei Luo, Yu-Ming Shang, Jiakai Wang, Chuxuan Zhang, Mei Li, Xi Zhang, Meikang Qiu
abstract: Data-use auditing in Large Language Models (LLMs) aims to determine whether the given data has been used for training, thereby supporting data ownership safeguards. A dominant solution is data watermarking, which embeds traceable signals into training data and detects them in model outputs. Recent studies have proposed many watermarking-based auditing methods in LLMs. However, systematic investigation from an adversarial perspective remains limited: non-compliant LLM providers would use unauthorized copyrighted datasets for training their own models to enhance model capabilities, while attempting to evade detection by auditors, thereby avoiding legal liability. To fill this research gap, we propose a novel evasion framework, termed Logit Laundering, where the non-compliant LLM provider manipulates model outputs at inference time to undermine detectable watermark signals. Specifically, we design a logit reshaping module to suppress watermark-induced statistical signals by integrating a statistical bias estimator as a plug-and-play component. This design keeps the model parameters unchanged and performs manipulation only in the logit space, thereby enabling auditing evasion while minimizing the impact on model's learned knowledge. To further balance evasion effectiveness and model utility, we introduce a confidence-aware scaling module to adaptively calibrate the suppression strength based on next-token prediction confidence. Extensive evaluations show that Logit Laundering can successfully evade existing various state-of-the-art auditing methods, significantly attenuating detectable signals, while preserving model utility on downstream tasks. Our work highlights the need for exploring more robust auditing methods to guard against evasion behaviors.
zh_title: Logit清洗：逃避大语言模型中的数据使用审计
translation: 大语言模型（LLM）中的数据使用审计旨在确定特定数据是否已被用于训练，从而支持对数据所有权的保护。目前主流的解决方案是数据水印技术，即在训练数据中嵌入可追踪的信号，并在模型输出中对其进行检测。近期的研究提出了许多基于水印的LLM审计方法。然而，从对抗视角出发的系统性研究仍然有限：违规的LLM提供商可能会使用未授权的受版权保护数据集来训练自己的模型以提升模型能力，同时试图规避审计人员的检测，从而逃避法律责任。为了填补这一研究空白，我们提出了一种名为Logit Laundering的新型逃避框架，违规的LLM提供商可在推理阶段操纵模型输出以破坏可检测的水印信号。具体而言，我们设计了一个Logit重塑模块，通过集成一个作为即插即用组件的统计偏差估计器来抑制水印诱发的统计信号。该设计保持模型参数不变，仅在Logit空间进行操纵，从而在将对模型习得知识的影响降至最低的同时实现规避审计。为了进一步平衡逃避有效性与模型效用，我们引入了一个置信度感知缩放模块，根据下一词元（next-token）预测置信度自适应地校准抑制强度。广泛的评估表明，Logit Laundering能够成功逃避现有的多种最先进审计方法，显著削弱可检测信号，同时保留模型在下游任务上的效用。我们的工作凸显了探索更具鲁棒性的审计方法以防范逃避行为的必要性。
tldr: 本文提出了Logit Laundering框架，通过在推理阶段对Logit空间进行自适应重塑与偏置抑制，成功在不损耗模型效用的前提下逃避基于水印的大模型数据使用审计。
ai_comments: 本研究从对抗性视角切入，首次系统性地探讨了违规大模型提供商如何在推理阶段逃避基于水印的数据使用审计。其创新之处在于提出了一种即插即用的Logit重塑机制，无需修改模型权重即可消除水印信号，并利用置信度缩放机制兼顾了模型下游任务表现。这一工作揭示了现有基于水印的版权保护机制在面对推理期对抗时的脆弱性，对未来构建更稳健的数据使用审计与版权保护方案具有重要的警示与指导意义。
motivation: 大模型的数据使用审计旨在检测模型是否使用了特定数据进行训练，主流方案是通过数据水印实现。然而，目前缺乏从对抗视角出发的系统性研究：违规的模型提供商可能会使用未授权的受版权保护数据训练模型，并在推理阶段规避审计人员的检测以逃避法律责任。
method: 提出了Logit Laundering逃避框架，在推理阶段通过操纵模型输出破坏可检测的水印信号。具体包括：（1）设计Logit重塑模块，集成统计偏差估计器作为即插即用组件，在不改变模型参数的前提下在Logit空间抑制水印引发的统计信号；（2）引入置信度感知缩放模块，依据下一词元预测的置信度自适应校准抑制强度，平衡逃避效果与模型效用。
results: 大量实验评估表明，Logit Laundering能成功逃避现有的多种前沿审计方法，大幅衰减可检测的水印信号，同时在下游任务上保持了模型的原有实用性。
conclusion: Logit Laundering能够成功规避现有的前沿数据审计方法并显著削弱水印信号，同时保持模型的下游任务效用。该研究强调了未来需要探索更具鲁棒性的审计方法以防范逃避行为。

title: Additive $Ω(\log^* OPT)$ Gap for Bin Packing with Three Items per Bin
authors: Ilan Doron-Arad
abstract: We prove that bin packing is NP-hard to approximate within an additive factor of $o(\ls\OPT)$, even when all item sizes are arbitrarily close to $1/3$. This gives the first lower bound for bin packing with an additive factor that depends explicitly on the optimum value. In addition, we give a polynomial-time reduction from any bin packing instance into one with item sizes arbitrarily close to $1/3$, preserving its additive configuration-LP gap up to constant factors. Thus, in the sense of additive configuration LP gap and up to a constant, we confirm the conjecture that 3-partition instances are the hardest bin packing instances. In particular, we obtain an unconditional $Ω(\ls\OPT)$ gap for 3-partition instances. We build on the recent OpenAI construction that uses five items per bin and rules out any constant additive gap.
zh_title: 每个箱子装三个物品的装箱问题的加性 $\Omega(\log^* OPT)$ 差距
translation: 我们证明了装箱问题在加性因子 $o(\log^* OPT)$ 内近似是NP-难的，即使所有物品的大小都任意接近于 $1/3$。这给出了装箱问题中首个显式依赖于最优值的加性因子下界。此外，我们给出了一个从任意装箱实例到物品大小任意接近于 $1/3$ 的实例的多项式时间归约，该归约在常数因子范围内保持了其加性配置LP（configuration-LP）差距。因此，在加性配置LP差距的意义下并在相差一个常数因子的范围内，我们证实了“3-划分实例是最难的装箱实例”这一猜想。特别地，我们获得了3-划分实例的无条件 $\Omega(\log^* OPT)$ 差距。我们基于近期每个箱子使用五个物品并排除了任何常数加性差距的OpenAI构造建立了该成果。
tldr: 论文证明了每个箱子放3个物品的装箱问题在加性因子 o(log* OPT) 内是NP-难近似的，首次给出了依赖于OPT的加性下界，并证实了3-划分是最难装箱实例的猜想。
ai_comments: 该论文在理论上具有重要创新和突破：首次给出了显式依赖于最优值 OPT 的装箱问题加性近似下界（Ω(log* OPT)），且将箱子容量限制在每个箱子仅装3个物品（尺寸接近1/3）。这不仅深化了此前OpenAI基于5个物品构建的常数加性下界结果，还在加性配置LP差距的意义下证实了3-划分实例属于最难装箱实例的长期猜想。
motivation: 研究装箱问题是否存在依赖最优值的加性近似下界，并探究3-划分实例是否是装箱问题中最难实例这一理论猜想。
method: 基于近期每个箱子使用五个物品排除常数加性差距的OpenAI构造，提出了一种从任意装箱实例到物品尺寸任意接近1/3的实例的多项式时间归约，该归约在常数因子范围内保持了加性配置LP差距。
results: 证明了装箱问题在加性因子 o(log* OPT) 内近似是NP-难的（即便物品大小任意接近1/3），给出了首个显式依赖于 OPT 的加性下界；在常数因子范围内证实了3-划分实例是最难装箱实例的猜想，并推导出3-划分实例具有无条件的 Ω(log* OPT) 差距。
conclusion: 即便物品大小极其接近1/3（每箱3个物品），装箱问题也不存在 o(log* OPT) 的加性近似算法；同时在加性配置LP差距意义下（相差常数倍），3-划分实例确实是最难的装箱实例。

title: From LoRA to Language: Recovering Skill Documents from Adapters
authors: Saranya Dintakurthy Swadha, Pavan C Shekar, Arpit Jain, Aswanth Krishnan
abstract: Agent skills are short documents that teach a language model how to handle a class of tasks. To save context, these documents are increasingly compiled into low-rank adapters (LoRA), which keep the behaviour but lose the text: an adapter is hard to read, edit, audit or move to another model. We ask whether the skill document can be written back from the adapter and its frozen base model, and we score each recovered document by the share of the original's key instructions it states and by the tasks it solves. Reading the weights alone recovered little with the methods we tried; a learned map from weights to text passed on about one bit of the document. Running the adapter worked much better. The Executing Writer, a small writer trained on top of the adapted model, recovers 39-44% of the key instructions of held-out skills, against 1.3-1.5% with another skill's adapter, and on adapters fitted to 41 external skills its documents restore 85-91% of the original's task gain. These strongest results are on adapters whose training stored the document; adapters trained on behaviour alone are much harder for trained writers (1-2% of instructions). For these adapters we test an agent that runs the base and adapted models and writes a skill from where they differ. On ALFWorld its skills recover 58-71% of a LoRA's gain and carry over to models that cannot load the LoRA, lifting Llama-3.1-8B from 5% to 55%. Whether such a skill comes from the adapter depends on what the adapter learned: when its behaviour cannot be guessed, the adapter is the source; when it can, a reward loop without the adapter does as well.
zh_title: 从LoRA到语言：从适配器中恢复技能文档
translation: 智能体技能是指导语言模型如何处理某一类任务的简短文档。为了节省上下文，这些文档越来越多地被编译进低秩适配器（LoRA）中，这保留了行为却丢失了文本：适配器变得难以阅读、编辑、审计或迁移到其他模型。我们探究技能文档是否能够从适配器及其冻结的基座模型中重新写回，并根据恢复文档中包含原始关键指令的比例及其解决任务的能力进行评分。在我们尝试的方法中，仅读取权重恢复的内容极少；从权重到文本的学习映射仅传递了文档大约1比特的信息。运行适配器的效果要好得多。执行写入器（Executing Writer，一个在适配模型之上训练的小型写入器）恢复了未见技能中39-44%的关键指令，相比之下使用其他技能适配器仅恢复了1.3-1.5%，并且在拟合了41个外部技能的适配器上，其生成的文档恢复了原始任务增益的85-91%。这些最强的结果出现在训练时存储了文档的适配器上；对于仅基于行为训练的适配器，训练好的写入器恢复难度大得多（仅恢复1-2%的指令）。针对这类适配器，我们测试了一个同时运行基座模型和适配模型并从两者差异处编写技能的智能体。在ALFWorld上，其编写的技能恢复了LoRA 58-71%的增益，并能迁移到无法加载该LoRA的模型上，将Llama-3.1-8B的成功率从5%提升至55%。此类技能能否来自适配器取决于适配器学到了什么：当其行为无法被猜测时，适配器是信息源；而当其行为可被推测时，不依赖适配器的奖励循环也能取得同样的效果。
tldr: 本研究提出了通过运行适配器或对比行为差异，从LoRA权重逆向恢复出易读、可编辑且可跨模型迁移的智能体技能文档的方法。
ai_comments: 该研究针对大模型智能体技能以LoRA适配器形式存储时缺乏可解释性、可编辑性和跨模型迁移能力的痛点，开创性地提出了从适配器逆向重构技能文本的方法。论文发现纯权重解析效果甚微，而通过运行适配器或对比行为差异能有效恢复核心技能指令，这一发现对模型逆向工程、智能体知识共享及安全性审计具有重要启发意义。
motivation: 为了节省上下文空间，智能体技能文档通常被微调编译进LoRA适配器中，但此举导致文本丢失，使得适配器难以阅读、编辑、审计或迁移到其他模型上。因此探索能否从适配器及其冻结的基座模型中逆向恢复出原始的技能文档。
method: 评估了两种逆向重构路径：1. 直接从权重映射到文本（效果极差）；2. 运行适配器的方法：提出“执行写入器”（Executing Writer，在适配模型之上训练的小型生成器）用于恢复直接存储文档的适配器；针对仅基于行为训练的适配器，设计了一个运行基座模型与适配模型并根据二者行为差异反写技能的智能体方法。
results: 仅读取权重几乎无法恢复内容；Executing Writer在未见过的技能上恢复了39-44%的关键指令，在41个外部技能适配器上恢复了原技能85-91%的任务增益；针对行为微调的适配器，基于行为差异分析的智能体在ALFWorld上恢复了58-71%的增益，并将无法加载该LoRA的Llama-3.1-8B性能从5%提升至55%。
conclusion: 从LoRA适配器中重构技能文本在技术上是可行的；相比于直接读取适配器权重，通过运行适配器（或对比适配后模型与基座模型的行为差异）能够有效逆向恢复出高质量技能文本，并实现跨模型的技能迁移。

title: Overview of the ImageCLEFmedical 2026 GANs task: Exploring fingerprint detection, privacy leakage, and synthetic medical image generation
authors: Alexandra-Georgiana Andrei, Mihai Gabriel Constantin, Mihai Dogariu, Dzmitry Karpenka, Yuri Prokopchuk, Ahmedkhan Radzhabov, Dan-Cristian Stanciu, Liviu-Daniel Ştefan, Vassili Kovalev, Henning Müller, Bogdan Ionescu
abstract: The 2026 ImageCLEFmedical GANs Task Exploring Fingerprint Detection, Privacy Leakage, and Synthetic Medical Image Generation continues to investigate privacy and security concerns around using patient data to generate synthetic medical images, now in its fourth edition. This edition introduces three complementary subtasks: the first extends prior editions by asking participants to detect which real images were used in training a Generative Adversarial Network to produce given synthetic outputs; the second is a novel subtask requiring participants to identify which latent vector produced each synthetic image, probing the faithfulness and reversibility of the latent-to-image mapping; the third asks participants to generate privacy-preserving CT slices, quantifying the trade-off between image fidelity and patient privacy. Ground-truth annotations and benchmark datasets of real and GAN-generated lung CT slices are provided for all subtasks. Evaluation is based on Cohen's Kappa for Subtask 1, matching accuracy for Subtask 2, and a combination of FID and Privacy Preservation Score (PPS) for Subtask 3. Overall, 37 teams registered for the task, with 10 teams submitting runs across subtasks and 6 teams submitting working notes papers. This paper presents an overview of the task setup, datasets, evaluation metrics, and summarises the approaches and results of participating teams.
comment: CLEF 2026 Working Notes, 21-24 September 2026, Jena, Germany
zh_title: ImageCLEFmedical 2026 GAN任务概述：探索指纹检测、隐私泄露与合成医学图像生成
translation: 2026年ImageCLEFmedical GAN任务“探索指纹检测、隐私泄露与合成医学图像生成”已举办至第四届，继续深入探讨利用患者数据生成合成医学图像所带来的隐私和安全问题。本届比赛引入了三个互补的子任务：第一项子任务扩展了往届内容，要求参赛者检测哪些真实图像被用于训练生成对抗网络（GAN）以产生特定的合成图像；第二项为全新子任务，要求参赛者识别生成每个合成图像的潜在向量，以此探究潜在空间到图像映射的保真度与可逆性；第三项要求参赛者生成保护隐私的CT切片，以量化图像保真度与患者隐私之间的权衡。所有子任务均提供了真实及GAN生成的肺部CT切片金标准标注和基准数据集。评估标准分别基于子任务1的Cohen's Kappa系数、子任务2的匹配准确率，以及子任务3的FID与隐私保护评分（PPS）综合指标。总体而言，共有37支队伍注册了该任务，其中10支队伍提交了各子任务的运行结果，6支队伍提交了工作报告论文。本文概述了任务设置、数据集、评估指标，并总结了参赛队伍的方法与结果。
tldr: 本文综述了ImageCLEFmedical 2026 GAN评测任务，涵盖真实图像指纹检测、潜在向量溯源及隐私保护医学CT切片生成三个子任务的设置与参赛成果总结。
ai_comments: 该任务系统性地从成员推断、潜在空间可逆性以及端到端隐私保护生成三个互补维度审视医学生成对抗网络的安全性，具有较强的前瞻性与现实意义；特别是新增的潜在向量匹配任务深化了对生成模型反演风险的探索。局限在于从37支注册队伍到仅10支队伍提交有效方案，参赛活跃度与方案多样性仍有提升空间。
motivation: 探讨在利用真实患者数据生成合成医学图像过程中引发的数据隐私泄露与安全隐患。
method: 设置三项互补子任务：1）检测用于训练GAN的真实图像（指纹/成员推断）；2）识别合成图像对应的潜在向量以探究映射可逆性；3）生成兼顾保真度与隐私保护的CT切片。基于真实与GAN生成的肺部CT切片数据集，分别采用Cohen's Kappa、匹配准确率以及FID联合隐私保护评分（PPS）作为评估指标。
results: 共有37支队伍注册参赛，最终有10支队伍在各子任务中提交了运行结果，6支队伍提交了工作报告论文。
conclusion: 本文全面梳理了ImageCLEFmedical 2026 GAN评测任务的设置规范、基准数据集与评价体系，并系统总结了各参赛队伍在该任务中的方法与评测成果。

title: Not All Entropy Is Equal: Reward-Conditioned Entropy Allocation in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
authors: Song Yu, Li Li, Zhenming Wu
abstract: Policy entropy is widely used to diagnose exploration and collapse in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), yet its magnitude does not consistently track reasoning performance across optimization objectives. We argue that this ambiguity arises because global token entropy conflates uncertainty in successful and failed trajectories, diversity across correct solution strategies, and variation among realizations of the same strategy. We introduce \textbf{Reward-Conditioned Entropy Allocation (RCEA)}, a hierarchical diagnostic framework that separates complete-trajectory entropy from average token entropy, conditions uncertainty on verifier outcome and process validity, measures correct-solution-mode retention, and connects these population-level quantities to local covariance-driven updates. In controlled sweeps over six RLVR objectives at two model scales, entropy trajectories do not induce a stable ordering of reasoning accuracy. Token entropy is higher for verifier-failed than successful trajectories under both broad separately aggregated estimates and a common-question paired analysis, whose confidence intervals exclude equality at 10 of 12 displayed endpoints. A local covariance approximation predicts the direction of adjacent-checkpoint entropy change in 95.5\% of nonfailed transitions; a reward-stratified endpoint proxy further shows that positive chosen-token covariance is more tail-concentrated within failed prefixes. Every reportable trained endpoint exhibits some contraction in independently audited correct-solution-mode breadth, whose positive association with large-\(k\) coverage remains exploratory. These results show that entropy collapse should be diagnosed by which uncertainty is removed, rather than by global entropy alone.
zh_title: 并非所有熵都生而平等：可验证奖励强化学习中基于奖励条件的熵分配
translation: 策略熵被广泛用于诊断可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中的探索与崩溃现象，然而其数值大小在不同优化目标下并不能稳定地反映推理性能。我们认为这种模糊性是因为全局Token熵混淆了成功与失败轨迹中的不确定性、不同正确解题策略之间的多样性，以及同一策略不同实现之间的差异。为此，我们提出了奖励条件熵分配（RCEA），这是一个分层诊断框架，它将完整轨迹熵与平均Token熵区分开，以验证器结果和过程有效性为条件分析不确定性，度量正确解法模式的保留程度，并将这些群体层面的量与局部协方差驱动的更新联系起来。在涉及两种模型规模、六种RLVR目标的受控实验中，熵轨迹并未对推理准确率形成稳定的排序。无论是在广泛的单独汇总估计中，还是在针对常见问题的配对分析中，验证失败轨迹的Token熵均高于成功轨迹，且展示的12个端点中有10个端点的置信区间排除了相等性。局部协方差近似在95.5%的未失败转变中预测了相邻检查点熵变化的方向；基于奖励分层的端点代理进一步表明，正向选择Token协方差在失败前缀中更偏向尾部集中。每一个可报告的训练端点都在独立审核的正确解法模式广度上表现出某种收缩，该广度与大k覆盖率的正相关性仍属于探索性结果。这些结果表明，对熵崩溃的诊断应当取决于消除了哪种不确定性，而非仅依赖全局熵本身。
tldr: 本文提出RCEA框架解耦全局策略熵，证明诊断RLVR中的探索与崩溃应看去除了何种不确定性，而非仅看全局熵数值。
ai_comments: 该研究针对当前大模型可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中简单依赖全局策略熵来监控探索与模式崩溃的盲区，提出了深入的洞察。其创新之处在于将混淆的全局熵解耦为按验证结果分层的不确定性和解题策略广度，并建立了局部协方差与熵动态的联系。这为后续改进RLVR目标函数与正则化机制提供了重要的理论与实证工具。
motivation: 策略熵在可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中常用于诊断探索和模型崩溃，但其数值大小无法在不同优化目标间一致地反映推理性能，原因在于全局Token熵混淆了成功与失败轨迹的不确定性、不同正确策略的多样性以及同类策略不同实现的变化。
method: 提出了奖励条件熵分配（RCEA）分层诊断框架，该方法将完整轨迹熵与平均Token熵分离，以验证器结果和过程有效性为条件度量不确定性，评估正确解法模式的保留程度，并将这些群体级指标与局部协方差驱动的更新机制相联系。
results: 在2个模型规模和6种RLVR目标的受控实验中，熵轨迹未能对推理准确率提供稳定排序；验证失败轨迹的Token熵显著高于成功轨迹（12个端点中有10个置信区间排除相等）；局部协方差近似能预测95.5%的未失败转变中相邻检查点的熵变方向；所有端点在正确解法模式广度上均出现收缩。
conclusion: 对策略熵崩溃的诊断不应仅依赖全局熵的大小，而应取决于模型具体消除了哪种不确定性（如成功还是失败轨迹、策略多样性等）。

title: Definitions, Label Names, or Demonstrations? Auditing What Governs LLM Annotation
authors: Viraj Mishra, Shubham Gupta, Dhruv Gupta, Yuehong Cassandra Tai, Qunhua Li
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to annotate social-science texts, but high accuracy does not establish that they apply researcher-supplied category definitions: predictions may instead reflect prior associations with category labels or labeled demonstrations. We introduce a counterfactual audit that reassigns definitions among output labels, distinguishing adherence to supplied definitions from preservation of a dataset's original mapping. Across three political-text datasets, models rarely follow reassigned definitions, and standard fine-tuning strengthens the original mapping without reliably increasing definition adherence. We then study retrieval-augmented annotation. Retrieving the nearest training examples generally outperforms retrieving examples separately within each category despite using fewer demonstrations. On the two tasks with substantial gains, direct \(k\)-nearest-neighbor classification recovers 74--93\% of the improvement, indicating that neighborhood labels provide much of the predictive signal. Relabeling fixed demonstrations redirects predictions, whereas aligning demonstrations with reassigned definitions substantially increases adherence to the new mapping. Thus, accuracy-improving interventions need not increase codebook adherence; definitions, category labels, demonstrations, retrieval, and training data should be aligned and validated jointly.
zh_title: 定义、标签名称还是示例？审计什么主导了大语言模型的标注
translation: 大语言模型（LLM）正日益广泛地应用于社会科学文本的标注，但高准确率并不能证明它们实际执行了研究人员提供的类别定义：模型的预测可能更多反映了对类别标签或带标签示例的先验关联。我们提出了一种反事实审计方法，通过在输出标签之间重新分配定义，将模型对所提供定义的依从性与对数据集原始映射的保留区分开来。在三个政治文本数据集上的实验表明，模型极少遵循重新分配后的定义，且标准微调强化了原有映射，但未能可靠提高对定义的依从度。随后我们研究了检索增强标注，发现检索最近的训练样本在使用的示例更少的情况下，表现通常优于在每个类别内单独检索示例。在取得显著增益的两项任务中，直接的k近邻分类能够复现74%–93%的提升，这表明近邻标签提供了大部分预测信号。重新标注固定示例会改变预测方向，而使示例与重新分配的定义保持一致则会大幅提高对新映射的依从度。因此，能够提高准确率的干预措施并不一定会提升对编码手册的依从性；定义、类别标签、示例、检索和训练数据应当进行整体对齐与联合验证。
tldr: 本研究通过反事实审计发现，LLM文本标注的高准确率主要源于先验标签和示例而非对定义的依从，必须联合对齐示例与定义才能确保模型真正按规则标注。
ai_comments: 该研究深入探讨了大模型在社会科学文本标注中的内部工作机制，具有很高的实用价值和方法学创新。其重要意义在于打破了“准确率高即代表模型真正理解并遵循了标注手册（codebook）”的误区，揭示了示例和标签先验对预测的强主导作用。局限性在于主要基于政治文本数据集进行评估，且反事实置换定义的审计方法可能在更复杂、非互斥的多标签任务中面临泛化挑战。
motivation: LLM常用于社会科学文本标注且准确率较高，但高准确率并不意味着模型真正执行了研究人员提供的类别定义，其预测可能仅受类别标签的先验语义或带标签示例的主导。需要厘清究竟是定义、标签名称还是示例在主导标注。
method: 提出一种反事实审计方法，通过在输出标签之间重新分配/置换定义，以区分模型是对提供定义的实际遵循还是对原有映射的先验记忆；并系统探究了标准微调以及检索增强标注（包括最近邻样本检索、示例重新标注、示例与新定义对齐）对模型预测行为的影响。
results: 在三个政治文本数据集中，模型极少遵循置换后的定义，标准微调仅强化原映射而未能可靠提高对定义的遵循度；检索最近邻训练样本通常优于按类别分别检索，且直接k近邻分类能解释74%–93%的性能提升；重标固定示例可改变预测偏向，而使示例与置换后定义保持一致能显著提升对新定义的遵循度。
conclusion: 提高准确率的方法并不等同于增强了模型对定义/编码规则的依从性。为了确保标注结果的真实可靠，定义、类别标签、上下文示例、检索机制与训练数据必须进行整体对齐并联合验证。

title: Left-Right-Consistent Iterative Stereo Matching via Cross-Injection
authors: Manuel Knott, Diogo Luvizon, Daniel Scharstein, Elias Vansteenkiste
abstract: State-of-the-art stereo matching models predominantly predict the disparity of only the left (reference) view. However, applications such as per-eye AR/VR rendering, novel view synthesis, or two-view depth fusion require disparity for both views, and need those two maps to agree. The usual workaround of running the network a second time on the horizontally flipped and swapped pair gives two independent predictions that can be inconsistent, especially on transparent surfaces, in textureless regions, and at occlusion boundaries. We introduce cross-injection (CI), a lightweight extension for iterative (refinement-based) models that can be added to any pretrained left-only iterative matcher. It couples the two passes by injecting the explicit, signed left-right inconsistency as an additional input cue at every step of the refinement stage. We empirically show that CI substantially reduces left-right disagreement on every benchmark (more than halving it on Booster for FoundationStereo), while largely preserving sharp object boundaries. Furthermore, using two state-of-the-art stereo matching models, we show that CI also reduces the single-view disparity error, making it a worthwhile extension even if only left disparity is needed.
zh_title: 基于交叉注入的左右一致迭代立体匹配
translation: 最先进的立体匹配模型大多只预测左（参考）视图的视差。然而，单眼AR/VR渲染、新视图合成或双视图深度融合等应用需要两个视图的视差，并要求这两个视差图保持一致。常用的替代方案是在水平翻转和交换后的图像对上二次运行网络，这会产生两个独立的预测，可能导致不一致，尤其是在透明表面、无纹理区域和遮挡边界处。我们引入了交叉注入（CI），这是一种针对迭代（基于精炼）模型的轻量级扩展，可以添加到任何预训练的仅左视差迭代匹配器中。它通过在精炼阶段的每一步中注入显式的、带符号的左右不一致性作为附加输入线索，将两次预测耦合起来。实验表明，CI在所有基准上都显著降低了左右不一致性（在Booster基准上将FoundationStereo的不一致性减半以上），同时很大程度上保留了清晰的物体边界。此外，基于两个最先进的立体匹配模型，我们证明CI还减少了单视图视差误差，使其即使在只需要左视差的情况下也是一项有价值的扩展。
tldr: 提出交叉注入（CI）机制，通过在迭代精炼中注入带符号的左右不一致性特征，显著提升双目立体匹配的一致性与单双视图视差精度。
ai_comments: 该方法创新性地将显式的左右不一致性作为特征直接注入到迭代精炼阶段，实现了即插即用且结构轻量，无需重构整个网络。其重要价值不仅在于解决了双目渲染所需的高一致性问题，还能反哺单视图精度。局限性在于需要执行双通道传递与迭代交互，相较于纯单目预测会增加一定的计算量与推理延时。
motivation: 现有的先进立体匹配模型大多仅预测左图视差，而AR/VR渲染和深度融合等应用需要左右双视图视差保持一致。常规通过水平翻转交换图像对来二次推理的方法会导致两图预测相互独立，易在透明表面、弱纹理区和遮挡边缘出现显著的左右不一致问题。
method: 提出轻量级的交叉注入（CI）扩展机制，可集成至任意预训练的迭代式立体匹配模型中。在迭代精炼阶段的每一步，计算并注入显式的、带符号的左右不一致性作为附加输入线索，以此耦合左右两次前向推理。
results: 实验显示CI在所有测试基准上均显著降低了左右视差不一致性（如在Booster数据集上使FoundationStereo的不一致性减少了一半以上），同时很好地保留了清晰边界；在两个SOTA模型上的测试还证明其能有效降低单视图视差误差。
conclusion: 交叉注入（CI）是一种简单而有效的轻量级扩展，能够大幅改善立体匹配模型的左右一致性并保留清晰物体边缘，同时还能提升单视图视差质量，具有很强的实用价值。

title: Symmetry Breaking over Multiway Channels
authors: Raymond Zhang, Richard Combes, Sheng Yang
abstract: Identical users running the same algorithm must often break their symmetry and agree on distinct roles, as in leader election, naming, and resource allocation. We study anonymous symmetry breaking over a discrete memoryless multiway channel invariant under permutations of its $J$ users: each user observes only a private output and must choose a number in $\{1,\dots,J\}$, and the symmetry is broken if the $J$ numbers are distinct. Using a Rényi change of measure, we derive a finite-blocklength converse on the error probability of every symmetric causal protocol, including adaptive and randomized ones. For achievability, block coding with random names reduces the problem to all-source multicast, for which we derive a Gallager random-coding exponent for every fixed $J$, and a cut-set bound that limits the exponent of the probability that two names coincide or are decoded wrongly. Interactive role controllers instead let the users contend for identifiers directly: we give their exact error probability, an achievable exponent given by a spectral radius when some outputs certify a role, and a floor for finite-state controllers when every output has positive probability, and we introduce generalized musical chairs. On a noisy bandit channel motivated by multiplayer multi-armed bandits, with noiseless collisions and arms of a common mean below one, interactive schemes provably exceed the limit of name decoding, and numerical estimates suggest the same with noisy collisions. For two users, noiseless collisions, one informative arm and a silent arm, the optimal error probability is determined up to a factor of two.
zh_title: 多路信道上的对称性破缺
translation: 运行相同算法的相同用户通常必须打破其对称性并就不同角色达成一致，例如在领导者选举、命名和资源分配中。我们研究了在对其 $J$ 个用户具有置换不变性的离散无记忆多路信道上的匿名对称性破缺：每个用户仅观察到一个私有输出，并且必须在 $\{1,\dots,J\}$ 中选择一个数字，如果这 $J$ 个数字互不相同，则对称性被打破。利用 Rényi 测度变换，我们推导了每个对称因果协议（包括自适应协议和随机化协议）错误概率的有限块长逆界。在可达性方面，采用随机命名的块编码将问题简化为全源多播，为此我们针对每个固定的 $J$ 推导了 Gallager 随机编码指数，以及限制两个名字重合或被错误译码概率指数的割集界。交互式角色控制器则使用户能够直接竞争标识符：我们给出了它们的精确错误概率、在某些输出可证实角色的情况下由谱半径给出的可达指数，以及在每个输出都具有正概率时有限状态控制器的错误下限，并引入了广义抢椅子机制。在由多玩家多臂老虎机激发的带噪老虎机信道上（具有无噪碰撞且臂的公共均值小于1），交互式方案经证明超越了名字译码的极限，数值估计表明在带噪碰撞下结论同样成立。对于双用户、无噪碰撞、一个信息臂和一个静默臂的情况，最优错误概率被确定在两倍因子以内。
tldr: 本文建立了多路信道上匿名对称性破缺的信息论极限，提出了有限块长逆界，并证明了直接竞争角色的交互式协议优于传统的随机命名译码方案。
ai_comments: 该论文将经典的分布式计算问题（对称性破缺、领导者选举）与信息论的多路信道容量和编码指数理论紧密结合，创新性地使用Rényi测度变换推导出对称因果协议的有限块长逆界。同时，证明了交互式角色分配协议相比传统的“先随机命名后多播译码”方法具有明显优势，对多智能体强化学习和分布式资源分配具有重要理论指导意义。局限在于对带噪声碰撞场景的部分结论依赖数值估计，未完全给出闭式最优解。
motivation: 在领导者选举、命名及资源分配等场景中，运行相同算法的对称匿名用户需要打破对称性以达成不同角色分配；研究在置换不变的离散无记忆多路信道下实现匿名对称性破缺的基本理论极限与高效协议。
method: 1. 利用Rényi测度变换推导任意对称因果协议的有限块长逆界；2. 基于随机命名的块编码转化为全源多播，推导Gallager随机编码指数与割集界；3. 设计交互式角色控制器（包括广义抢椅子协议），结合谱半径分析可达指数，并给出有限状态控制器的错误下限。
results: 推导了对称协议的有限块长逆界；给出了基于块编码的多播随机编码指数与割集界；明确了交互式角色控制器的精确错误概率及谱半径指数；在带噪老虎机信道下证明交互式策略优于随机命名译码方案；针对特定双用户场景将最优错误概率界定在2倍因子以内。
conclusion: 通过信息论框架严格刻画了多路信道上对称性破缺的基本极限，证明了直接竞争角色的交互式协议优于先独立命名再译码的非交互机制，并在特定双用户老虎机信道下确定了近乎最优的错误概率性能。

title: Mechanical Interaction Sensing for Robotic Kiwifruit Handling with an Optoelectronic Soft Suction Cup
authors: Romina Adhami, Ebrahim Shahabi, Alessio Mondini, Samuel M. Youssef, Cosimo Della Santina, Gualtiero Volpe, Barbara Mazzolai
abstract: Robotic handling of delicate fruit benefits from compliant contact and quantitative sensing of the mechanical interaction at the end-effector. This study investigates an optoelectronic soft suction cup with a kiwifruit-specific bicomponent design for estimating interaction forces during contact with real fruit. During known-contact intervals, the optical signals accurately estimate interaction force on fruits excluded from model training: the best shallow network achieves grouped out-of-fold pooled R-squared = 0.968 +/- 0.005 (MAE = 0.138 N), with a median per-fruit held-out R-squared = 0.973 (MAE = 0.134 N). A simple monotonic mapping from the mean optical response alone achieves R-squared = 0.925 +/- 0.005, showing that substantial force-related information is already present in the optical response. Leave-one-collection-day-out validation remains strong (R-squared = 0.955 +/- 0.031), supporting robustness across acquisition sessions. As an exploratory secondary analysis, binary Soft/Firm classification from compression-test reference labels achieves moderate balanced accuracy (approximately 0.705) under grouped held-out-fruit validation, while finer three-class grading shows limited performance.
zh_title: 基于光电软吸盘的猕猴桃机器人操作机械交互传感
translation: 精细果实的机器人操作受益于末端执行器的柔顺接触以及对机械相互作用的定量传感。本研究探讨了一种采用针对猕猴桃定制的双组分设计的光电软吸盘，用于在与真实果实接触期间估计相互作用力。在已知接触时间段内，光学信号能够准确估计未参与模型训练的果实上的相互作用力：表现最佳的浅层网络实现了分组折外合并R² = 0.968 ± 0.005（MAE = 0.138 N），单个果实留出测试的中位数R² = 0.973（MAE = 0.134 N）。仅依据平均光学响应的简单单调映射即可达到R² = 0.925 ± 0.005，表明光学响应中已蕴含大量的力相关信息。留一采集日交叉验证同样保持强劲（R² = 0.955 ± 0.031），证明了其跨采集批次的鲁棒性。作为一项探索性的次要分析，基于压缩试验参考标签的“软/硬”二分类在分组留出果实验证下取得了适度的平衡准确率（约0.705），而更细的三级硬度分级性能较为有限。
tldr: 开发了一种针对猕猴桃定制的光电软吸盘，通过浅层网络实现了高精度的接触力估计（R² > 0.96）并具备跨天泛化能力。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新点在于将光电传感技术与针对猕猴桃定制的双组分软吸盘相结合，在保持柔顺接触的同时实现了高精度的交互力感知；其跨采集日的强鲁棒性展示了良好的实际部署潜力。局限性在于其对果实硬度的多级细分能力较弱，目前仅在二分类软/硬判定上表现出适度精度。
motivation: 精细果实的机器人操作需要末端执行器具备柔顺接触特性，以及对接触过程中的机械相互作用进行定量感知，以避免果实损伤并提升操作灵巧性。
method: 研发了一种针对猕猴桃定制的双组分光电软吸盘；利用浅层神经网络和基于平均光学响应的单调映射模型，处理接触期间的光学信号以估计交互力；并通过留一采集日交叉验证评估模型的跨时段泛化性，同时探索基于压缩测试参考标签的软硬分类。
results: 在未参与训练的测试果实上，最佳浅层网络实现了R² = 0.968（MAE = 0.138 N），单果R²中位数为0.973；仅基于平均光学响应的单调映射即达到R² = 0.925；留一采集日验证保持R² = 0.955。在探索性软/硬二分类任务中达到约0.705的平衡准确率，但在更细的三分类硬度分级中表现有限。
conclusion: 该光电软吸盘能够高精度且跨采集日稳健地估计猕猴桃采后抓取过程中的机械交互力，并具备初步的软硬度二分类潜力，证实了柔性传感末端执行器在精细果实机器人操作中的可行性。

title: Consensus-Constrained Dual-Federated Optimization with Client-Side Dynamic Weighting for Distributed Android Device Threat Defense
authors: Mohammad Mashreghi, Mohammad Hossein Badiei, Md. Jalil Piran
abstract: Smartphones, smart-home hubs, and wearables are increasingly exposed to sophisticated Android malware, while centralized threat-detection pipelines raise privacy and scalability concerns. Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without collecting raw client data, but partial participation and variation in local model quality can destabilize global optimization. In this article, we propose DW-FedADMM, a federated optimization framework that combines primal-dual coordination with performance-dependent client-side weighting. The dynamic coefficient modulates each participating client's local state before the augmented-Lagrangian update, while the dual variables regulate disagreement between local and global model states. We evaluate DW-FedADMM on three Android malware benchmarks, namely Drebin, Malgenome, and TUANDROMD, with 5, 10, and 15 clients holding IID data shards, partial client participation, and communication budgets of 5 and 10 rounds. Each configuration is repeated with ten random seeds. DW-FedADMM obtains the highest seed-averaged accuracy on Drebin (97.64% +/- 0.20%) and the best mean accuracy in 9 of the 18 dataset-client-round configurations, including 7 of the 9 configurations with a 10-round budget. Pooled over all configurations, it reaches 95.42% accuracy, 94.62% F1-score, 96.06% precision, and 99.45% AUC, compared with 95.32%, 94.51%, 95.56%, and 99.41% for FedADMM, while also giving the lowest mean false-positive rate and the smallest client update norm among the six compared methods. Both primal-dual methods are well ahead of the averaging- and proximal-based baselines on Malgenome and TUANDROMD, where the latter often remain at the majority-class solution when clients are fragmented. The gain of dynamic weighting over FedADMM is most pronounced on Drebin and with the longer communication budget, where it also reduces the variation across seeds.
zh_title: 基于客户端动态加权与共识约束对偶联邦优化的分布式Android设备威胁防御
translation: 智能手机、智能家居中枢和可穿戴设备日益受到复杂的Android恶意软件的威胁，而集中式威胁检测流程则引发了隐私与可扩展性方面的担忧。联邦学习（FL）能够在不收集客户端原始数据的情况下进行协作模型训练，但客户端的部分参与以及本地模型质量的差异可能会破坏全局优化的稳定性。在本文中，我们提出了DW-FedADMM，一种将原始-对偶协调与基于性能的客户端加权相结合的联邦优化框架。动态系数在增广拉格朗日更新之前调节每个参与客户端的本地状态，而对偶变量则调节本地与全局模型状态之间的分歧。我们在Drebin、Malgenome和TUANDROMD三个Android恶意软件基准数据集上对DW-FedADMM进行了评估，设置包括5、10和15个持有独立同分布（IID）数据分片的客户端、客户端部分参与以及5轮和10轮的通信预算，每个配置均使用十个随机种子重复测试。DW-FedADMM在Drebin上取得了最高的跨种子平均准确率（97.64% +/- 0.20%），并在18种“数据集-客户端-轮数”配置中的9种里取得了最佳平均准确率，包括10轮预算的9种配置中的7种。在所有配置汇总下，该算法达到了95.42%的准确率、94.62%的F1分数、96.06%的精确率和99.45%的AUC，优于FedADMM的95.32%、94.51%、95.56%和99.41%，同时在六种对比方法中给出了最低的平均假阳性率和最小的客户端更新范数。在客户端碎片化时，基于平均和近端基线的方法在Malgenome和TUANDROMD上通常停留在多数类解，而这两种原始-对偶方法均显著领先于它们。动态加权相比FedADMM带来的增益在Drebin以及更长通信预算的场景下最为显著，并且还减少了跨种子的方差。
tldr: 提出DW-FedADMM框架，通过结合原始-对偶优化与基于性能的客户端动态加权，提升分布式Android恶意软件检测的优化稳定性与准确率。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将原始-对偶优化（ADMM）框架与客户端性能驱动的动态加权相结合，有效解决了联邦学习中部分参与及本地模型质量波动导致的优化不稳定问题。在恶意软件检测任务中展示了优异的召回率和低误报率，但摘要实验仅限定在IID数据分片上，在非独立同分布（Non-IID）异构场景下的有效性仍待进一步验证。
motivation: Android设备日益受到复杂的恶意软件威胁，而集中式威胁检测存在隐私和可扩展性问题；联邦学习虽能保护数据隐私，但客户端部分参与和本地模型质量差异会导致全局优化不稳定。
method: 提出DW-FedADMM优化框架：将原始-对偶协调（Primal-Dual Coordination）与基于性能的客户端动态加权相结合；在增广拉格朗日更新前利用动态系数调节本地状态，并利用对偶变量调节本地与全局模型状态之间的不一致性。
results: 在Drebin、Malgenome和TUANDROMD数据集的18种配置中，DW-FedADMM在9种配置中取得最佳平均准确率（Drebin达97.64%）；汇总所有配置后，其准确率达95.42%、F1值为94.62%、精确率为96.06%、AUC达99.45%，优于FedADMM；同时具有最低的平均假阳性率（FPR）和最小的客户端更新范数，显著优于传统的加权平均和近端基线方法。
conclusion: DW-FedADMM通过原始-对偶协调与客户端性能动态加权的结合，有效缓解了客户端部分参与及模型质量波动带来的优化问题，在通信轮数受限的分布式Android威胁防御中表现出优异的稳定性和综合性能。

title: ENGRAM: From Agent Experience to Weights through Verified Consolidation
authors: Ruiyi Yang, Zechen Li, Lihuan Li, Du Yin, Hao Xue, Flora D. Salim
abstract: Language-model agents use experience through external retrieval and parameter learning. Consolidating stored experience into model weights requires deciding both which experience to train on and when its external records can leave retrieval. Admission based solely on student mastery can exclude useful teacher demonstrations, while removal immediately after training can discard guidance that the model still needs. We introduce ENGRAM, a framework that separates training admission from memory release. A demonstration-aware gate admits skills based on student mastery or sufficient successful teacher demonstrations. The student learns from selected action traces with context from an Engram Trace Graph (ETG). A verification gate then compares the updated model without episodic retrieval against the base model with retrieval on reserved probes. Release requires valid training participation and scores meeting both relative and absolute criteria; records for skills that fail verification remain retrievable. Experiments across interactive and reasoning benchmarks show consistent gains over frozen-weight ETG controls, with ablations supporting demonstration-aware admission and selective adapter activation. A controlled held-out comparison shows that verified release substantially reduces the retrievable footprint while remaining close to retain-all performance and outperforming immediate and budget-matched random release. ENGRAM also improves task performance while reducing input-token usage and model calls. Skill-level verification further reduces retrievable experience through selective archival, retaining external guidance for skills that do not meet the release criteria. Code is available in anonymous.4open.science/r/engram-anonymous.
zh_title: ENGRAM：通过验证整合将智能体经验转化为权重
translation: 语言模型智能体通过外部检索和参数学习来利用经验。将存储的经验整合到模型权重中需要决定训练哪些经验以及何时其外部记录可以离开检索。仅基于学生掌握的准入可能会排除有用的教师演示，而训练后立即移除可能会丢弃模型仍然需要的指导。我们引入了ENGRAM，一个将训练准入与记忆释放分开的框架。一个演示感知门根据学生掌握或足够的成功教师演示来准入技能。学生从带有Engram追踪图（ETG）上下文的选定动作轨迹中学习。然后，一个验证门将更新后的模型（无情景检索）与带有检索的基线模型在保留探测上进行比较。释放需要有效的训练参与和满足相对和绝对标准的分数；未通过验证的技能记录保持可检索。跨交互式和推理基准的实验显示，相对于冻结权重ETG对照组，ENGRAM持续获得收益，消融实验支持演示感知准入和选择性适配器激活。一项受控的保留比较显示，验证释放显著减少了可检索占用，同时性能接近于“全部保留”，并优于即时和预算匹配的随机释放。ENGRAM还提高了任务性能，同时减少了输入token使用和模型调用。技能级验证通过选择性归档进一步减少了可检索经验，为不符合释放标准的技能保留了外部指导。代码可在anonymous.4open.science/r/engram-anonymous获取。
tldr: ENGRAM是一个框架，通过分离训练准入和记忆释放，并使用验证门来整合语言模型智能体的经验到模型权重中，从而提高性能并减少外部记忆占用。
ai_comments: ENGRAM的创新之处在于其将经验整合的“准入”和“释放”机制解耦，并通过“验证门”确保整合的质量和外部记忆管理的效率。这对于提高语言模型智能体的学习效率和资源利用率具有重要意义，尤其是在需要持续学习和记忆管理的场景中。该框架提供了一种更智能、更受控的方式来将外部知识转化为模型内部能力。
motivation: 语言模型智能体在将存储经验整合到模型权重时，面临如何选择训练经验以及何时从外部检索中移除这些记录的问题。现有方法可能排除有用的教师演示或过早移除模型仍需要的指导。
method: ENGRAM框架将训练准入与记忆释放分开。一个“演示感知门”根据学生掌握或成功教师演示来准入技能。学生从带有Engram追踪图（ETG）上下文的选定动作轨迹中学习。一个“验证门”将更新后的模型（无情景检索）与带有检索的基线模型进行比较，只有满足有效训练参与和特定标准的记录才会被释放；未通过验证的技能记录保持可检索。
results: 实验表明，ENGRAM在交互式和推理基准测试中持续优于冻结权重ETG对照组。验证释放显著减少了可检索占用，同时性能接近“全部保留”，并优于即时和预算匹配的随机释放。ENGRAM还提高了任务性能，同时减少了输入token使用和模型调用。技能级验证进一步减少了可检索经验。
conclusion: ENGRAM框架通过其分离的训练准入和记忆释放机制（特别是验证门和演示感知准入），有效地将语言模型智能体的经验整合到模型权重中，从而提高了性能、减少了资源使用并优化了外部记忆管理。

title: Nebula: Distributed Position-Independent Caching for LLM Serving
authors: Yifei Liu, Junbin Pan, Junhao Hu, Yang Liu, Junyi Chen, Juntong Wu, Chen Chen, Haiyuan Zhao, Xiaoxu Chen, Weihang Chen
abstract:
Modern LLM workflows, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and LLM agents, build long prompts from multiple independent text segments, making prefill a major source of computation. Reusing KV caches is therefore important for reducing serving costs and latency: distributed caching systems spread KV cache across a cluster to increase aggregate capacity, while position-independent caching (PIC) enables reuse of recurring segments under different prefixes. However, existing systems distribute KV caches but still rely on prefix caching (PC), while existing PIC methods enable position-independent reuse without cluster-wide resource management.
  We present Nebula, the first distributed LLM serving framework to treat PIC segments as first-class citizens, enabling remote PIC reuse and parallel prefill. To track PIC's fine-grained, asynchronous state changes, Nebula combines optimistic accounting with event-driven updates to provide a timely and truthful cluster view for cache management and prefill scheduling. To accommodate diverse reuse patterns across workloads, Nebula leverages cluster-wide ghost-hit feedback to automatically tune the allocation of shared cache capacity between PC and PIC.
