Architectural styles, system decomposition, tradeoff analysis, quality-attribute decisions, and stakeholder concerns are often left implicit or handled outside the AI-supported workflow. This creates a missing architectural layer between requirements and code, limiting traceability, validation, and governance in GenAI-enabled software development.
  This paper presents TimeArch, a multi-agent approach that makes this architectural layer explicit. TimeArch structures software architecture design as a governed lifecycle rather than a one-shot generation task. It combines agent-based reasoning with retrieval-augmented grounding to support requirement definition, architecture design, validation and assurance, and delivery and evolution. The approach supports requirement capture, architectural driver identification, design reasoning, validation, and decision documentation within a traceable process.
  We demonstrate TimeArch through a working prototype that operationalizes the proposed approach and assess its feasibility using representative software architecture design cases from multiple domains with heterogeneous inputs. As future work, we plan to conduct comprehensive industrial case studies to evaluate the adoption and use of TimeArch in both new and existing software projects.
  A TimeArch demo is available at: https://sda-assistant.com/.
  Keywords: AI-native software architecture; requirements-driven software architecture; architectural reasoning; architecture traceability; architecture validation
zh_title: TimeArch：一种用于软件架构设计的多智能体方法
translation:
生成式AI使软件实现更快，但不见得架构更好。当前大多数GenAI编码工作流直接从提示词到代码，而本应连接需求、质量属性、利益相关者、设计决策和实现的架构推理却支持薄弱。架构风格、系统分解、权衡分析、质量属性决策和利益相关者关注点往往被隐含或在AI支持的工作流之外处理。这在需求和代码之间造成了缺失的架构层，限制了GenAI软件开发中的可追溯性、验证和治理。
本文提出了TimeArch，一种使该架构层显式化的多智能体方法。TimeArch将软件架构设计组织为受控的生命周期，而非一次性生成任务。它将基于智能体的推理与检索增强接地相结合，支持需求定义、架构设计、验证与保证、以及交付与演进。该方法在可追溯的过程中支持需求捕获、架构驱动因素识别、设计推理、验证和决策文档化。
我们通过一个可运行的原型展示了TimeArch，该原型将所提出的方法付诸实践，并使用来自多个领域、具有异构输入的代表性软件架构设计案例评估了其可行性。作为未来工作，我们计划进行全面的工业案例研究，以评估TimeArch在新软件和现有软件项目中的采用和使用。
tldr: TimeArch是一个多智能体系统，通过显式建模架构推理层，解决生成式AI开发中缺乏架构设计和可追溯性的问题。
ai_comments: TimeArch通过引入多智能体方法填补了生成式AI软件开发中架构层缺失的空白，将传统的“提示词到代码”转变为受控的生命周期管理，显著提升了架构的可追溯性和可验证性。
motivation: 当前的生成式AI编码工作流直接从提示词到代码，缺乏连接需求、质量属性和实现的架构推理层，导致可追溯性、验证和治理受限。
method: 提出TimeArch多智能体方法，将架构设计构造成一个受控的生命周期，结合基于智能体的推理与检索增强接地技术，支持需求定义、架构设计、验证与保证以及交付与演进。
results: 开发了一个可运行的原型，并通过来自多个领域和异构输入的代表性软件架构设计案例评估了其可行性。
conclusion: TimeArch通过多智能体协作和检索增强接地技术，成功实现了软件架构设计的全生命周期管理，填补了生成式AI开发中架构层的缺失。

title: Towards Comprehensive Mobile Application Testing for User-centric Feature Coverage via Simulating Real-World Users with Personas
authors: Ha Min Son, Huan Ren, Huan Song, Zhe Zhao, Xin Liu
abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for black-box mobile application testing, where the ultimate goal is the comprehensive coverage of the features users rely on. However, most existing studies focus on Activity Coverage, which measures the proportion of distinct application screens visited during a test session but does not directly measure whether agents actually test the features users care about. To address this, we focus on (1) how to automatically measure whether a testing framework covers the features users care about, and (2) how to design a framework that achieves more comprehensive feature coverage. To answer (1), we introduce the User-Centric Feature Coverage benchmark, which consists of two components: a manually crafted dataset of 3,012 user-centric target features based on real reviews and app descriptions, and an automated evaluation pipeline that translates agent-generated test cases and target features into a shared semantic space, then uses an LLM-as-a-judge to compute coverage. To answer (2), we introduce ECS (Exploration, Critical User Journeys, and Synthetic Reviews). ECS is a framework that explores the application, then uses an LLM to convert exploration traces into Critical User Journeys (CUJs) to bring the semantic meaning of the trace closer to a distinct feature. Each CUJ consists of an LLM-inferred user intent paired with reproducible test steps. ECS then aggregates multiple CUJs using persona-augmented synthetic reviews to capture more complex features, simulating real users who build knowledge of an application across multiple screens before writing a review. ECS achieves 64.1% feature coverage, a 23.8% gain over the state-of-the-art baseline, and covers 72.5% of features in app descriptions, capturing the most prominent features. Our failure analysis shows statelessness and exploration discoverability as main reasons of failures, providing future directions.
zh_title: 通过模拟具象用户实现以用户为中心特征覆盖的全面移动应用测试
translation: 大语言模型智能体正日益被用于黑盒移动应用测试，其最终目标是全面覆盖用户依赖的功能。然而，大多数现有研究主要关注活动覆盖率，该指标衡量测试会话期间访问的不同应用屏幕的比例，但无法直接衡量智能体是否真正测试了用户关心的功能。为了解决这个问题，我们关注：（1）如何自动测量测试框架是否覆盖了用户关心的功能，以及（2）如何设计一个实现更全面功能覆盖的框架。为了回答（1），我们引入了以用户为中心的特征覆盖基准，它包含两个部分：一个基于真实评论和应用描述手工制作的包含3,012个以用户为中心的目标特征的数据集，以及一个自动评估管道，该管道将智能体生成的测试用例和目标特征转换到共享的语义空间中，然后使用LLM作为裁判来计算覆盖率。为了回答（2），我们引入了ECS（探索、关键用户旅程和合成评论）。ECS是一个探索应用程序的框架，然后使用LLM将探索轨迹转换为关键用户旅程（CUJ），使轨迹的语义含义更接近独特的特征。每个CUJ由一个LLM推断的用户意图与可重现的测试步骤配对组成。然后，ECS使用角色增强的合成评论聚合多个CUJ，以捕获更复杂的特征，模拟在写评论之前跨多个屏幕建立应用知识的真实用户。ECS实现了64.1%的特征覆盖率，比最先进的基线提升了23.8%，并覆盖了应用描述中72.5%的特征，捕获了最突出的特征。我们的失败分析表明，无状态性和探索的可发现性是失败的主要原因，这为未来的研究方向提供了参考。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于用户角色模拟的移动应用测试框架ECS及特征覆盖基准，有效提升了对用户核心功能测试的全面性。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地引入了用户中心特征覆盖（User-Centric Feature Coverage）的概念和基准，打破了传统仅依赖界面（Activity）覆盖率的局限，并提出了ECS框架，通过角色增强的合成评价和关键用户旅程显著提升了移动应用测试的真实性和覆盖率。
motivation: 现有的黑盒移动应用测试主要关注页面（Activity）覆盖率，无法直接衡量代理是否真正测试了用户关心的功能，因此需要一种自动测量用户特征覆盖率的方法以及实现更全面特征覆盖的测试框架。
method: 引入了用户中心特征覆盖基准（包含3,012个用户中心目标特征的数据集和自动化评估管道），并设计了ECS（探索、关键用户旅程和合成评价）框架，结合大语言模型推断用户意图、生成可复现测试步骤，并通过角色增强的合成评价聚合多个关键用户旅程。
results: ECS框架实现了64.1%的特征覆盖率，比最先进的基线提升了23.8%，并覆盖了应用描述中72.5%的特征；失败分析指出无状态性和探索可发现性是主要失败原因。
conclusion: ECS框架通过模拟真实用户行为和需求，有效提升了黑盒移动应用测试的特征覆盖率，为未来的移动应用测试提供了新的方向。

title: A Multi-Modal Robotic Framework for Physical GUI Interaction Testing
authors: Davi Freitas
abstract:
Automated testing of mobile applications remains challenging when realistic user interactions must be reproduced and GUI behavior verified without relying on invasive mechanisms such as instrumentation or ADB-level control. Existing approaches, including DLD and R-DLD, detect data loss triggered by activity restarts but still depend on system-level access, which limits their applicability on real devices.
  This doctoral research proposes RFNIT, a multi-modal, fully non-invasive robotic framework for physical GUI interaction testing on smartphones. RFNIT supports end-to-end automation by perceiving the device state through external sensing and executing physical interactions, enabling human-like actions while preserving reproducibility and execution accuracy.
  The framework integrates a vision-based perception module, an LLM-driven reasoning agent, and a robotic actuator capable of performing touch, swipe, and typing gestures. Multimodal data, including external camera images and OCR-extracted text, are combined to identify GUI elements and guide subsequent testing decisions.
  Preliminary results indicate that RFNIT accurately recognizes buttons, text fields, and virtual keyboards from external camera input, achieving over 85\% visual detection accuracy. Ongoing and future work will focus on improving robustness, repeatability, and coverage of GUI states during long-running testing sessions.
zh_title: 用于物理GUI交互测试的多模态机器人框架
translation:
在必须复现真实用户交互且验证GUI行为时，如果不能依赖仪器化或ADB级控制等侵入式机制，移动应用程序的自动化测试仍然具有挑战性。现有方法（包括DLD和R-DLD）虽然能检测由活动重启触发的数据丢失，但仍依赖于系统级访问，限制了其在真实设备上的适用性。
本博士研究提出了RFNIT，这是一个用于智能手机物理GUI交互测试的多模态、完全无创的机器人框架。RFNIT支持端到端自动化，通过外部传感感知设备状态并执行物理交互，实现类人操作的同时保持可重复性和执行准确性。
该框架集成了基于视觉的感知模块、大语言模型（LLM）驱动的推理智能体，以及能够执行点击、滑动和打字手势的机器人执行器。结合多模态数据（包括外置相机图像和OCR提取的文本），识别GUI元素并指导后续测试决策。
初步结果表明，RFNIT能够从外置相机输入中准确识别按钮、文本框和虚拟键盘，视觉检测准确率超过85%。正在进行和未来的工作将集中于提高长时间测试会话中GUI状态的鲁棒性、可重复性和覆盖率。
tldr: 本文提出了RFNIT，一个无创的多模态机器人框架，通过外部视觉感知、大语言模型和机械手进行智能手机GUI的物理交互测试。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种完全无创的多模态机器人GUI测试框架RFNIT，利用外部视觉感知、LLM推理与机械执行器模拟真实人类交互，克服了传统方法对系统级访问权限的依赖，在移动应用自动化测试领域具有较高的创新性和实际应用价值。
motivation: 现有的移动应用自动化测试方法（如DLD和R-DLD）依赖于系统级访问权限（如ADB控制或仪器化机制），限制了其在真实设备上的广泛应用，因此需要一种不依赖侵入式机制、能复现真实用户交互的无创测试框架。
method: 提出RFNIT框架，整合了基于视觉的感知模块、大语言模型（LLM）驱动的推理智能体，以及能够执行点击、滑动和输入手势的机器人执行器，结合外部相机图像和OCR提取文本来识别GUI元素并指导测试。
results: 初步结果显示RFNIT能够准确从外部相机输入中识别按钮、文本字段和虚拟键盘，视觉检测准确率超过85%。
conclusion: 初步结果表明RFNIT能够准确识别各类GUI元素，未来工作将致力于提高长测过程中的鲁棒性、可重复性和状态覆盖率。

title: Replay Is a Family of Assertions: Fork-Safety in Event-Sourced Agent Runtimes
authors: Yohei Nakajima
abstract:
Event-sourced agent runtimes commonly claim deterministic replay, cheap forking, and lineage. These are families of assertions, not one guarantee. A fixed-log fold may be deterministic while reactive settlement remains schedule-sensitive; a recorded oracle result can enable zero-call replay while the original interaction still changed cost or world state; and a prefix copy cannot undo an action in a discarded suffix.
  We present an executable F# contract that separates facts from effect requests, makes scheduling explicit, and assesses a cut relative to projection, strict execution replay, external continuation, or a declared counterfactual-world observation. Preserved counterexamples show that general settlement is neither terminating nor confluent and that disjoint declared writes do not prevent read/trigger interference. Against 5,540 public runtime logs, all 317,296 projection cuts satisfy the stated observation, while 36,251 cuts split a model request and do not license continuation; another 120,969 are Conditional because a committed oracle result must be served from the record without re-execution. In 121 observed forks, 16,625 retained-prefix events have zero structural mismatches, but none crosses an external-effect boundary. A separate public offline conformance fork crosses a committed, recorded oracle boundary. Its generator observes that the inherited result is served without a second fixture-oracle call; its verifier checks receipt/log consistency and a fork-bound HMAC assertion under a public conformance key. The result reframes cheap forking as a property-indexed semantic contract with explicit evidence and environment preconditions.
comment: 27 pages; executable specification, validation harness, and conformance vectors: https://github.com/yoheinakajima/agent-runtime-laws
zh_title: 重放是一组断言家族：事件溯源智能体运行时中的分叉安全性
translation:
事件溯源智能体运行时通常声称具有确定性重放、廉价分叉和血统等特性。然而，这些是一组断言家族，而非单一的保证。固定的日志折叠可能是确定性的，而反应式结算依然对调度敏感；记录的预言机结果可以实现零调用重放，而原始交互仍会改变成本或世界状态；前缀复制无法撤销被丢弃后缀中的操作。
我们提出了一种可执行的F#契约，它将事实与效果请求分离，使调度显式化，并根据投影、严格执行重放、外部延续或声明的反事实世界观察来评估切片。保留的反例表明，一般的结算既不终止也不汇合，并且不相交的声明写入并不能防止读取/触发干扰。针对5,540个公共运行时日志，所有317,296个投影切片都满足声明的观察，而36,251个切片分割了模型请求且不允许延续；另外120,969个切片是“条件性的”，因为必须从记录中提供已提交的预言机结果而无需重新执行。在121个观察到的分叉中，16,625个保留前缀事件没有结构不匹配，但没有一个跨越外部效应边界。一个独立的公共离线一致性分叉跨越了一个已提交的记录预言机边界。其生成器观察到继承的结果是在没有第二次测试预言机调用的情况下提供的；其验证者在公共一致性密钥下检查接收/日志一致性和分叉绑定HMAC断言。该结果将廉价分叉重新定义为一个具有显式证据和环境前提的属性索引语义契约。
tldr: 本文探讨了事件溯源智能体运行时中的确定性重放与分叉安全，提出了一种基于F#可执行契约的评估方法，将廉价分叉重构为属性索引的语义契约。
ai_comments: 本文通过提出一个可执行的F#契约，深入探讨了事件溯源智能体运行时中确定性重放、廉价分叉和血统等断言的复杂性与局限性。研究具有很强的现实意义，揭示了看似简单的概念背后复杂的语义和约束条件。
motivation: 事件溯源智能体运行时中声称的确定性重放、廉价分叉和血统实际上是一组断言家族而非单一保证，现有系统往往忽视了其中的复杂性、调度敏感性以及外部效应的影响。
method: 提出一个可执行的F#契约，将事实与效果请求分离，使调度显式化，并针对投影、严格执行重放、外部延续或声明的计数反事实世界观察来评估切片。
results: 对5,540个公共运行时日志的测试表明，所有317,296个投影切片满足声明的观察，36,251个切片分割了模型请求且不被允许延续，120,969个切片因为必须从记录中提供已提交的预言机结果而呈条件状态。在121个观察到的分叉中，有16,625个保留前缀事件没有结构不匹配，但没有一个跨越了外部效应边界。
conclusion: 重放和廉价分叉不能被视为单一的保证，而应当被构想为由属性索引的语义契约，必须具备明确的证据和环境前提条件。

title: Beyond the Agent Harness: Boundary Criteria for Software-Factory Orchestration - A Single-Operator Case Study
authors: Lei Hua
abstract: Several recent systems add a layer above the coding-agent harness that organises many agent runs into continuous delivery. The existence of such a layer is not our contribution. What is missing is a rule for deciding which layer a mechanism or a failure belongs to. We propose boundary criteria based on an operational definition of a run. A mechanism confined to one run belongs to the agent harness. One that coordinates runs, hands state from one run to a later one, or is updated from run outcomes belongs to a factory harness. One that must change with the application domain belongs to the domain layer. Two residual tests assign infrastructure and model causes. For failures, we code where the defect originated, which control failed to stop it, and where it was fixed as three separate fields, and we require positive evidence before attributing a failure to the environment. We developed the criteria on documented failures from a single operator's pipeline serving six projects and on 26 components of three published systems. We then froze them and had two model coders of the same family apply them to the same descriptions of 46 held-out units. They agreed on all 26 mechanism layers and on 18-19 of 20 incident fields (kappa 0.86-0.93), but both coders recorded the incident as undetermined or unrecorded in 8-13 of the 20 cases per field, and each flagged half of all units as ambiguous, mostly for missing information. The check exposed conflicts in the rules; a revision that separates mechanism classification from incident attribution resolves them but, in a sensitivity re-coding, agreed less (kappa 0.78-0.93). Agreement here is neither accuracy nor usefulness, and human coders have not yet been tested. Case evidence and seven hypotheses are reported as preliminary.
comment: 37 pages, 3 figures. Ancillary files include E1 data, coding manuals, coded units, and analysis scripts
zh_title: 超越智能体底座：软件工厂编排的边界准则——单操作员案例研究
translation: 最近的几个系统在编码智能体底座之上增加了一层，将许多智能体运行组织成持续交付。这一层的存在并非我们的贡献。所缺少的是一个决定机制或故障属于哪一层的规则。我们基于运行的操作定义提出了边界局限准则。局限于一次运行的机制属于智能体底座。协调运行、将状态从一次运行传递到后续运行、或根据运行结果进行更新的机制属于工厂底座。必须随应用领域而改变的机制属于领域层。两个剩余的测试用于分配基础设施和模型原因。对于故障，我们将缺陷起源、未能阻止它的控制以及修复位置编码为三个独立的字段，并且在将故障归因于环境之前需要确凿的证据。我们在为六个项目服务的单个操作员管道的记录故障以及三个已发布系统的26个组件上开发了这些准则。然后我们将其固定，并让同一系列的两个模型编码器将其应用于46个保留单元的相同描述中。他们就所有26个机制层以及20个事件字段中的18-19个达成了一致（kappa 0.86-0.93），但两个编码器在每个字段的20个案例中有8-13个将事件记录为未确定或未记录，并且每个编码器都将一半的单元标记为模糊，主要是由于信息缺失。该检查暴露了规则中的冲突；分离机制分类和事件归因的修订版解决了这些冲突，但在敏感性重新编码中，一致性较低（kappa 0.78-0.93）。此处的共识既不代表准确性也不代表有用性，人类编码器尚未接受测试。案例证据和七个假设作为初步结果报告。
tldr: 本文提出了明确软件工厂中智能体底座、工厂底座与领域层边界的操作性准则，并通过案例研究验证了其在机制分类和故障归因中的有效性。
ai_comments: 该论文探讨了软件工厂编排中区分智能体底座、工厂底座与领域层的边界准则，通过单操作员案例研究和实证编码验证了准则的可靠性，对多智能体持续交付系统的架构设计具有重要意义。
motivation: 当前缺乏明确的规则来界定某个机制或故障究竟属于智能体底座、工厂底座还是领域层，因此需要建立一套操作性边界准则来规范软件工厂的编排。
method: 基于对单个操作员管道及已发布系统组件的文档化故障，提出操作定义和边界准则，并使用两个同系列模型编码器对保留单元进行盲测与敏感度重新编码验证。
results: 模型编码器在机制层面上完全达成一致，在事件字段上达到了较高的阿肯系数（0.78-0.93），但也暴露出信息缺失导致的模糊性和规则冲突问题。
conclusion: 提出了基于运行操作定义的软件工厂边界准则，并通过实验评估了其在机制分类和故障归因中的应用，指出了当前规则的冲突及改进方向。

title: How Python Audio Libraries Change Across Releases: Module Structure and Documentation
authors: Mateusz Modrzejewski, Michał Rokita, Łukasz Neumann
abstract: Developers who upgrade a Python audio library need to know what changed in the code they import and whether the release notes say so. Release notes and breaking changes have been mined for general software, but the module structure of audio libraries and its documentation have not been studied together. We mine 56 audio repositories used in machine learning workflows: the import graph of 49 packages at 1,395 releases, joined to 20,864 release-note and changelog entries, labeled by three open-weight language models and checked against two human coders. We find that (1) the set of a package's top-level modules is unchanged in 86.1% of consecutive release pairs, while the set of module files is unchanged in 61.4%. (2) A major increment changes the top level 5.2 times as often as another increment, and major and 0.x minor increments together account for 48.7% of the observed changes. (3) When a release removes modules, its notes name 8.9% of the removal units under a lexical match, an estimated 4.3% after a hand check of the matches. (4) Longer notes are more likely to contain an entry labeled as structural, and within each length band this proportion is also higher for releases with module removals. We intend to release the aligned dataset and the pipeline
zh_title: Python音频库随版本变化的演变：模块结构与文档
translation: 开发人员在升级Python音频库时，需要了解他们导入的代码发生了什么变化，以及发行说明中是否对此进行了说明。虽然通用软件的发行说明和破坏性变更已被广泛挖掘，但音频库的模块结构及其文档尚未被结合起来进行研究。我们挖掘了56个用于机器学习工作流的音频代码库：其中包括49个软件包在1,395个版本中的导入图，并与20,864条发行说明和变更日志条目相连接，这些条目由三个开源大语言模型进行标注，并经由两名人工编码员进行检查。我们发现：（1）在连续的版本对中，86.1%的软件包的顶级模块集合保持不变，而61.4%的模块文件集合保持不变。（2）重大版本增量导致顶级模块变更的频率是其他增量的5.2倍，重大版本和0.x次要版本增量共同占观察到变更的48.7%。（3）当一个版本移除模块时，其发行说明在字面匹配下仅记录了8.9%的移除单元，经人工校验后估计这一比例为4.3%。（4）更长的发行说明更有可能包含被标记为结构化的条目，并且在每个长度区间内，包含模块移除的版本中这一比例也更高。我们计划发布对齐的数据集和处理管道。
tldr: Python音频库在版本升级时模块结构频繁变动，但官方发行说明对这些结构变化（特别是模块移除）的记录严重不足。
ai_comments: 该研究首次将Python音频库的模块结构演变与其文档结合进行大规模数据挖掘，揭示了版本升级中接口稳定性的现状以及发行说明与实际代码变更之间的巨大脱节，对依赖机器学习工作流的开发者具有重要警示意义。
motivation: 开发人员在升级Python音频库时需要了解导入的代码发生了哪些变化以及发行说明中是否有记录，然而此前虽然针对通用软件的发行说明和破坏性变更进行过挖掘，但音频库的模块结构及其文档尚未被结合起来进行研究。
method: 通过挖掘56个用于机器学习工作流的Python音频库（包含49个包的1,395个版本中的导入图，以及20,864条发行说明和变更日志），并结合3个开源大语言模型进行标注和2位人工编码员的校验来进行实证分析。
results: 1. 86.1%的连续版本对中顶级模块集合保持不变，61.4%的模块文件集合保持不变；2. 大版本更新对顶级模块的改变频率是其他更新的5.2倍，大版本与0.x小版本共同占观察到变更的48.7%；3. 当版本移除模块时，发行说明仅通过词汇匹配记录了8.9%的移除单元（人工校验后估计为4.3%）；4. 更长的发行说明更可能包含结构化标签，且在相同长度区间内，有模块移除的版本这一比例更高。
conclusion: Python音频库的模块结构在多数常规更新中保持稳定，但在重大版本或0.x次要版本中变更较频繁；同时，官方发行说明对底层模块移除的记录严重不足，开发者升级时不能完全依赖发行说明。

title: KG-AST for Cheaper CI/CD: Budgeted Test Selection and AI Bug Review
authors: Henry Yeung
abstract:
Continuous integration and AI-assisted review spend the same budget on every commit, although few commits introduce bugs. We study KG-AST, which scores each commit risk from git history and code-graph features before heavy tests or AI review run, so the budget goes to the riskiest commits first, and which hands the AI reviewer only a graph slice around the change. On 155 open-source projects in 11 languages, a single cross-language model trained on other projects ranks commits so that heavy testing of the riskiest 20% covers 49-64% of bug-introducing commits depending on the language, against 20% for random selection and 40-55% for testing the biggest change first.
  Every language beats the biggest-change baseline, by 3.8 to 13.2 points. In 20 Java projects the gain at a 20% budget is 15.1 points (64.6% vs 49.5%, 95% interval +11.6 to +18.4), and the model wins in 19 of the 20 projects. About twelve training projects suffice; richer features, tuning and cleaner labels did not help. An AI reviewer that sees only a commit's diff finds 26% of later-fixed defects exactly (32% with graph context), and about half of its findings that did not match a later fix were judged real by independent AI judges. A static call-graph selector runs about 8% of a test suite while including a test written for the fix in 85% of 67 fix commits. The Poincare embedding used in our retrieval work adds nothing measurable here: commit-risk AUC, bug review and severity ranking are unchanged or worse. The labels are noisy and the budget metric assumes a heavy test catches the bug it covers; no CI minutes were measured.
zh_title: KG-AST：实现更低成本的CI/CD：预算化测试选择与AI Bug审查
translation: 持续集成和AI辅助审查对每个提交投入相同的预算，尽管只有少数提交引入了Bug。我们研究了KG-AST，它在运行重度测试或AI审查之前，根据Git历史记录和代码-图特征对每个提交的风险进行评分，从而使预算首先流向风险最高的提交，并向AI审查员仅提供变更周围的图切片。在11种语言的155个开源项目中，在其他项目上训练的单一跨语言模型对提交进行排序，使得对风险最高的20%进行重度测试可以覆盖49-64%引入Bug的提交（取决于语言），而随机选择为20%，测试最大变更优先为40-55%。每种语言都超过了最大变更优先基线，提升了3.8到13.2个百分点。在20个Java项目中，20%预算下的收益增加了15.1个百分点（64.6%对49.5%，95%置信区间+11.6至+18.4），并且该模型在20个项目中的19个中获胜。大约12个训练项目就足够了；更丰富的特征、调优和更干净的标签没有帮助。仅看到提交差异的AI审阅者准确找到了26%后续修复的缺陷（有图上下文时为32%），并且在其未与后续修复匹配的发现中，约有一半被独立AI评判者判断为真实缺陷。静态调用图选择器运行约8%的测试套件，同时在67个修复提交中包含了为修复编写的测试，占85%。我们检索工作中使用的Poincare嵌入在这里没有增加可测量的效果：提交风险AUC、Bug审查和严重性排名保持不变或更差。标签是有噪声的，预算指标假设重度测试捕获了它所涵盖的Bug；未测量CI分钟数。
tldr: KG-AST利用代码图特征和提交风险评分来优化CI/CD中的测试和AI审查预算分配，在多个开源项目测试中表现出远超传统基线的Bug覆盖率和审查效率。
ai_comments: 本文提出了一种创新的KG-AST方法，利用代码图特征和Git历史记录来预测提交风险，从而优化持续集成（CI/CD）中的测试预算分配和AI代码审查。研究跨越155个开源项目和11种语言，展现了极强的泛化能力和显著的性能提升。不过，论文也坦诚了标签噪声及未直接测量CI运行时间等局限性。
motivation: 现有的持续集成（CI/CD）和AI辅助审查对每个提交都花费相同的预算，但实际上只有少数提交会引入Bug，这导致了计算资源的浪费。因此需要一种能够根据提交风险进行预算分配的方法。
method: 提出KG-AST方法，通过Git历史记录和代码图（AST）特征对每个提交的风险进行评分；在进行重度测试或AI审查前，将预算分配给风险最高的提交，并为AI审查器提供变更周围的图切片。跨155个开源项目（11种语言）使用单一跨语言模型进行评估。
results: 在155个项目中，测试前20%的高风险提交可以覆盖49%-64%引入Bug的提交，显著优于随机选择（20%）和最大变更优先策略（40%-55%）。结合图上下文的AI审查将准确率从26%提升至32%，静态调用图选择器运行约8%的测试套件即可包含85%的修复测试。
conclusion: KG-AST方法通过结合代码图特征与提交风险评分，能有效优化CI/CD中的资源分配，将高风险提交优先用于重度测试和AI审查，显著优于传统随机选择和最大变更优先基线。

title: Boundary Projection Acceleration for 2D One-cell Inversions in the Scattering Limit
authors: Joanna Piper Morgan, Todd S. Palmer, Ilham Variansyah, Kyle E. Niemeyer
abstract: Efficient radiation transport on modern high-performance computers requires algorithms that expose spatial parallelism while maintaining robust convergence. One-cell inversion (OCI) replaces the spatially sequential transport sweep of source iteration with a cell-local solve, making discrete ordinates transport space-parallel, but its spectral radius approaches unity in diffusive problems, and existing accelerators such as transport synthetic acceleration reintroduce sweeps. Here we show that projecting the OCI residual onto a low-order angular space on cell boundaries accelerates convergence in scattering-dominated problems without a transport sweep. We implement the projection in a two-dimensional simple-corner-balance discretization with two angular bases: a linear ($P_1$) basis and one augmented with a quadrant moment ($P_1Q$). Fourier analysis of an infinite homogeneous medium shows that both corrections reduce the spectral radius in optically thick, highly scattering regimes, with $P_{1}Q$ being most effective. Across several test problems, including a modified version of the void-duct streaming benchmark, the method accelerates diffusive and scattering cases but does not uniformly improve convergence in streaming dominated problems. We also find that $P_{1}Q$ is a more robust accelerator than $P_1$ in situations where the flux has strong angular variation. Boundary projection substantially improves OCI convergence in diffusive regimes, and these results delimit the regimes that require additional stabilization or richer projection spaces.
zh_title: 散射极限下二维单网格反演的边界投影加速
translation: 现代高性能计算机上的高效辐射输运需要能够暴露出空间并行性同时保持鲁棒收敛性的算法。单网格反演（OCI）用单元局部求解代替了源迭代的空间顺序传输扫描，使得离散纵标输运能够空间并行，但在扩散问题中其谱半径接近于1，且现有的加速器（如输运合成加速）重新引入了扫描。在这里，我们展示了将OCI残差投影到单元边界上的低阶角度空间，无需传输扫描即可加速散射占优问题的收敛。我们在二维简单角平衡离散化中实现了这种投影，并采用了两种角度基底：线性（$P_1$）基和由象限矩增强（$P_1Q$）的基。无限均匀介质的傅里叶分析表明，这两种校正都降低了光学厚、高散射区域的谱半径，其中$P_1Q$最有效。在几个测试问题（包括改进的空洞管道流注基准）中，该方法加速了扩散和散射算例，但并未在流注主导的问题中一致地改善收敛性。我们还发现，在通量具有强烈角度变化的情况下，$P_1Q$比$P_1$是更鲁棒的加速器。边界投影大大改善了扩散区域中的OCI收敛性，这些结果界定了需要额外稳定化或更丰富投影空间的区域。
tldr: 提出了一种用于辐射输运单网格反演的边界投影加速方法，在无需传输扫描的情况下显著提升了散射和扩散问题中的收敛速度。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种针对散射极限下二维单网格反演（OCI）的边界投影加速方法，创新性地通过在单元边界上将OCI残差投影到低阶角度空间，消除了传统加速器所需的传输扫描，显著提高了扩散主导问题中的收敛速度。这为现代高性能计算机上的辐射输运并行算法提供了新思路。
motivation: 传统的单网格反演（OCI）虽然使离散纵标输运实现了空间并行，但在扩散问题中的谱半径接近1，而现有的加速器（如输运合成加速）重新引入了耗时的传输扫描，因此需要一种无需传输扫描且能在散射主导问题中保持鲁棒收敛性的加速方法。
method: 在二维简单角平衡离散化中实现边界投影，采用线性（$P_1）$基和带有象限矩增强（$P_1Q$）的基两种角度基底，并通过无限均匀介质的傅里叶分析以及多个测试问题（包括修改后的空洞管道流注基准）对其性能进行评估。
results: 傅里叶分析和测试问题表明，线性（$P_1$）和增强的象限矩（$P_1Q$）校正均能有效降低光学厚、高散射区域的谱半径，$P_1Q$更有效且在通量具有强角度变化的场景下更为鲁棒，成功加速了扩散和散射算例，但在流注主导问题中未能统一改善收敛性。
conclusion: 边界投影加速技术能够显着改善散射占优和扩散区域中的单网格反演（OCI）收敛性，其中$P_1Q$基表现出更强的鲁棒性，但该方法在流注占优的问题中尚未展现出一致的收敛改进。

title: Recursively Testing and Vibe Debugging a Google AI Studio Generated Vibe-Coded Database Software Application
authors: Christian Mancas, Cristina Mancas
abstract: This research paper proposes a broader definition of vibe coding, extending the original one with non-developers and natural languages other than English, and introduces the notion of vibe debugging, as well as a sound, complete, and optimal algorithmic methodology for testing and vibe debugging vibe-coded software applications. This methodology is illustrated by applying it to a vibe-coded real-world database application of medium complexity generated with Google AI Studio Pro. We prove that even non-developers can obtain a final bug-free and functional satisfactory application version, even in languages other than English. We also prove that, although Google AI Studio Pro has sophisticated built-in engines for both language analysis, software development, and automated testing, it is still making lot of mistakes, so testing and vibe debugging of its generated code is a must.
zh_title: 递归测试与“氛围调试”由Google AI Studio生成的“氛围编码”数据库软件应用
translation: 本研究论文提出了对“vibe coding”（氛围编码）更广泛的定义，将其扩展至非开发人员及英语以外的自然语言，并引入了“vibe debugging”（氛围调试）的概念，以及用于测试和调试氛围编码软件的健全、完整且最优的算法方法。通过将其应用于使用Google AI Studio Pro生成的具有中等复杂度的现实世界数据库应用程序，说明了该方法。我们证明了即使是非开发人员，甚至在使用非英语语言时，也能获得最终无bug且功能满意的应用程序版本。我们还证明了，尽管Google AI Studio Pro拥有用于语言分析、软件开发和自动化测试的复杂内置引擎，但它仍然会犯很多错误，因此对其生成的代码进行测试和氛围调试是必不可少的。
tldr: 本文扩展了“氛围编码”概念并引入“氛围调试”，通过算法方法证明了非英语母语的非开发人员也能成功利用AI生成并修复复杂的数据库软件。
ai_comments: 该论文探讨了“vibe coding”和“vibe debugging”在新兴AI辅助软件开发中的应用，扩展了其定义并引入了严格的算法方法，证明了非开发人员在自然语言编程方面的潜力，同时指出了当前顶尖AI工具（如Google AI Studio Pro）在代码生成上仍存在局限性。
motivation: 扩展原始的“vibe coding”定义（涵盖非开发人员和非英语自然语言），并指出当前先进的AI生成代码工具仍存在大量错误，因此需要系统性的测试和感官调试（vibe debugging）方法。
method: 引入了一个健全、完整且最优的算法方法，用于测试和进行“vibe debugging”，并将其应用于Google AI Studio Pro生成的真实数据库应用中。
results: 证明了即使是非开发人员，使用非英语语言，也能通过所提出的方法获得最终无bug且功能令人满意的应用程序版本；同时也证实了Google AI Studio Pro尽管功能强大，但仍会犯许多错误，测试和vibe调试是必不可少的。
conclusion: 通过引入递归测试和感官调试（vibe debugging）的算法方法，非开发人员能够成功构建并验证由AI生成的中等复杂度数据库应用，证明了AI辅助编程在跨语言和非技术人群中的可行性与必要性。

title: When Does Combining Software-Effort Estimates Help? Evidence from Four Public Project Datasets
authors: Azzeddine Ihsine, Sara Ihsine
abstract: Combining estimates can reduce individual prediction errors, but an ensemble may also dilute an unusually accurate estimator or repeat errors shared by its members. We study these competing effects on four archival software-effort datasets (Kitchenham: 145 projects, Desharnais: 77, China: 499, Maxwell: 63) with 100 repeated 70/30 training and test partitions per dataset. Three conventional models (parametric regression, analogy, and random forest) are combined with each other and, in Kitchenham, with a recorded human estimate. Out-of-fold calibration errors drive five combination rules: equal weighting, inverse-MSE weighting, a nonnegative simplex combination, signed Bates-Granger weighting, and Bates-Granger with covariance shrinkage. All preprocessing is learned within training folds. Model-error correlations range from 0.54 to 0.97. In Kitchenham, the human estimate dominates: equal weighting raises mean test log-MAE from 0.239 to 0.455, a loss that remains significant under a corrected resampled t-test with Holm adjustment, whereas the simplex rule limits the increase to 0.250. In Desharnais, China, and Maxwell, every rule lowers mean log-MAE (by 1.3 to 8.6%) and BG with shrinkage beats the calibration-selected individual on 75, 83, and 83 of 100 splits, but none of these gains is statistically distinguishable from zero once the overlap between repeated splits is accounted for. On a completion-year split of Desharnais, equal weighting becomes slightly worse and inverse-MSE is near the individual baseline, while simplex and shrinkage retain mean gains of about 5%. Combining correlated effort estimates is therefore a conditional decision: the harm of naive pooling next to a dominant source is clear, while the benefit elsewhere is small and uncertain.
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Public aggregate results available on Zenodo: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23913209
zh_title: 软件工作量估算组合何时有益？来自四个公开项目数据集的证据
translation: 组合估算可以减少个体预测误差，但集成也可能稀释异常准确的估计器或重复其成员共有的错误。我们研究了这两种竞争效应在四个档案软件工作量数据集（Kitchenham：145 个项目，Desharnais：77 个，China：499 个，Maxwell：63 个）上的表现，使用了 100 次重复的 70/30 训练和测试分区。三种传统模型（参数回归、类比和随机森林）相互结合，并在 Kitchenham 数据集中与记录的人类估算相结合。样本外校准误差驱动了五种组合规则：等权重、逆 MSE 权重、非负单纯形组合、有符号 Bates-Granger 权重和带协方差收缩的 Bates-Granger 权重。所有预处理都在训练折内学习。模型误差相关性范围为 0.54 至 0.97。在 Kitchenham 数据集中，人类估算占主导地位：等权重将平均测试 log-MAE 从 0.239 增加到 0.455，这种损失在经过修正的重采样 t 检验（带 Holm 调整）下仍然显著，而单纯形规则将增加限制在 0.250。在 Desharnais、China 和 Maxwell 数据集中，所有规则都降低了平均 log-MAE（降低了 1.3% 至 8.6%），并且带收缩的 BG 规则在 100 次分割中的 75 次、83 次和 83 次分割中优于经过校准选择的个体，但一旦考虑了重复分割之间的重叠，这些收益均不具有统计学上的显著性。在 Desharnais 的完成年度分割中，等权重变得略差，逆 MSE 接近个体基线，而单纯形和收缩规则保留了约 5% 的平均增益。因此，组合相关软件工作量估算是一个有条件的决定：在占主导地位的来源旁边进行朴素合并的危害是明确的，而其他地方的好处则很小且不确定。
tldr: 组合软件工作量估算可能有助于也可能有害，具体取决于数据集和所使用的组合方法。在某些情况下，组合可以减少预测误差，而在其他情况下，它可能会稀释准确的估计值或放大共同的错误。
ai_comments: 这项研究为软件项目管理中的估算实践提供了重要的见解。它强调了在应用组合估算技术时需要仔细考虑数据集的特性和潜在的估算源之间的相关性。研究结果表明，并非所有组合方法都适用于所有情况，并且在某些情况下，过于简单化的组合可能会适得其反。未来的研究可以进一步探索更复杂的组合策略，并考虑更多类型的数据集和估算模型。
motivation: 研究组合软件工作量估算以减少个体预测误差的潜在好处，同时考虑可能出现的负面影响，例如稀释准确的估计值或重复共同的错误。
method: 使用四种不同的软件工作量数据集，并结合三种传统的估算模型（参数回归、类比和随机森林）以及人类估算（在其中一个数据集中）。应用了五种组合规则（等权重、逆均方误差权重、非负单纯形组合、有符号 Bates-Granger 权重和带协方差收缩的 Bates-Granger 权重），并使用 100 次重复的 70/30 训练/测试分割进行评估。
results: 在 Kitchenham 数据集中，当与人类估算结合时，简单的组合方法（如等权重）会增加平均测试 log-MAE。然而，单纯形组合规则可以限制这种增加。在 Desharnais、China 和 Maxwell 数据集中，大多数组合规则都能降低平均 log-MAE，其中带收缩的 Bates-Granger 规则在许多分割中优于单个最佳模型，但这些收益在统计上并不显著。在 Desharnais 的完成年度分割中，单纯形和收缩组合规则显示出约 5% 的平均收益。
conclusion: 组合软件工作量估算是一个有条件的决定。当存在一个占主导地位的估算源时，简单的合并可能会产生负面影响。在其他情况下，组合的好处可能很小且不确定，需要仔细选择组合方法。

title: SteelAgent: LLM-Orchestrated, Physics-Informed Steel Property Prediction with Audited Generalization and Calibrated Uncertainty
authors: Aleksandr Volkov, Roman Sultimov, Mikhail Kuzin, Yury Maximov
abstract: Steel property models can perform well on random test splits even when they extrapolate poorly to unfamiliar alloys. SteelAgent couples metallurgical descriptors and machine-learning models with a language-model interface for property prediction, uncertainty reporting and inverse design. We examine how the choice of held-out unit changes the conclusions drawn from SteelBench tensile-strength evaluations. For gradient boosting, pooled out-of-fold $R^2$ fell from 0.859 on a random split to 0.113 when steel families were held out. Empirical coverage of nominal 90% prediction intervals ranged from 91.0% under random splitting to 37.6% on held-out sources. The effect of physics-derived features depended on the evaluation. They increased gradient-boosting $R^2$ by 0.2534 in a 17-family holdout analysis and decreased it by 0.358 in a separate four-grade laboratory analysis. We report group-level errors and a synthetic regression experiment illustrating how calibration can deteriorate on held-out groups. These results motivate reporting the evaluation population alongside a property estimate or compliance score.
comment: 10 pages, 3 tables. A shorter version of this work was published in the Proceedings of the Thirty-Fifth International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI-26), Demonstrations Track, pp. 8547-8550 (2026), doi:10.24963/ijcai.2026/1000. Includes code for the synthetic experiment
zh_title: SteelAgent：大语言模型驱动、融合物理机理的钢材性能预测，具备经审计的泛化能力与校准的不确定性
translation: 钢材性能模型即使在对不熟悉的合金外推效果较差时，在随机测试集上也能表现良好。SteelAgent 将冶金描述符和机器学习模型与语言模型接口相结合，用于性能预测、不确定性报告和逆向设计。我们检查了保留单元的选择如何改变从 SteelBench 抗拉强度评估中得出的结论。对于梯度提升，在保留钢材家族时，合并的折外 $R^2$ 从随机划分时的 0.859 下降到 0.113。名义 90% 预测区间的经验覆盖率在随机划分下为 91.0%，而在保留源上为 37.6%。物理衍生特征的影响取决于评估方式。在一个 17 个家族的保留分析中，它们使梯度提升的 $R^2$ 增加了 0.2534，而在另一个四个等级的实验室分析中将其降低了 0.358。我们报告了群组级误差和一个合成回归实验，说明校准如何在保留群组上恶化。这些结果促使人们在报告性能估计或合规评分时附带评估总体。
tldr: 提出 SteelAgent 框架，利用大语言模型和物理信息预测钢材性能，并揭示了传统随机测试划分掩盖了模型在未知合金上泛化能力差的问题。
ai_comments: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型协同、融合物理机理的钢材性能预测方法 SteelAgent，并深入探讨了模型在不同数据划分方式（如随机划分与留出合金/家族划分）下的泛化能力、不确定性校准以及物理特征的影响，强调了在材料设计中评估总体定义和不确定性审计的重要性。
motivation: 钢材性能模型在随机测试集上表现良好，但在外推到未知的合金时往往泛化能力较差，因此需要更加严格的评估、不确定性校准以及物理机理的引导。
method: 结合冶金描述符与机器学习模型，并通过大语言模型接口进行性能预测、不确定性报告和逆向设计；采用不同的保留单元（如钢材家族、实验室等级）评估泛化性能和不确定性校准。
results: 梯度提升模型的 $R^2$ 在随机划分下为 0.859，但在留出钢材家族时骤降至 0.113；90% 预测区间的经验覆盖率从随机划分的 91.0% 下降到留出源的 37.6%；物理特征对性能的影响因评估方式而异。
conclusion: 研究表明，模型在随机测试集上的良好表现并不能保证其在未知合金上的泛化能力，凸显了在材料性能预测中报告评估群体及校准不确定性的必要性。

title: A Sharp Additive Bound for the Threshold Rule in Repeated Rent-or-Buy
authors: Vasco Schiavo
abstract: Motivated by context management in LLM agents, we study a repeated rent-or-buy model with schedule-independent history growth and a fixed reset price $K$, a discrete form of dynamic TCP acknowledgment: every call pays as rent the history accumulated since the last reset, and a reset clears it. The classical threshold rule is $2$-competitive, and no deterministic rule guarantees a smaller ratio. We show that, measured additively, its loss is governed by the changes in the growth: if the growth is constant on $P$ runs, the threshold rule, knowing neither the runs nor the horizon, pays at most $(2P-1)K$ more than the optimal schedule chosen with hindsight, and the coefficient $2P-1$ is sharp. If the growth is only within a factor $1+\varepsilon$ of $P$ runs, the bound holds up to a factor $1+\varepsilon$ and an extra $\varepsilon K$. The proof is a potential argument built from the relative value functions of the single-rate problems. On two runs no deterministic rule guarantees a loss below $2K$. A rule that also resets when the growth decreases guarantees $2K$, while the threshold rule can lose arbitrarily close to $3K$.
zh_title: 重复买租问题中阈值规则的一个尖锐加法界
translation: 受大语言模型智能体中上下文管理的启发，我们研究了一个具有与调度无关的历史增长和固定重置价格 $K$ 的重复买租模型，这是动态 TCP 确认的一种离散形式：每次调用支付自上次重置以来累积的历史作为租金，而重置则将其清空。经典的阈值规则是 $2$-竞争的，且没有确定性规则能保证更小的比率。我们表明，如果按加法衡量，其损失受增长变化的控制：如果增长在 $P$ 次运行中是恒定的，阈值规则在既不知道运行次数也不知道视野范围的情况下，比事后选择的最优调度最多多支付 $(2P-1)K$，且系数 $2P-1$ 是尖锐的。如果增长在 $P$ 次运行的 $1+\varepsilon$ 倍因子之内，该界在乘以 $1+\varepsilon$ 并加上一个额外的 $\varepsilon K$ 后仍然成立。证明过程是利用单速率问题的相对价值函数构建的势能论证。在两次运行中，没有任何确定性规则能保证损失低于 $2K$。当增长减少时也会重置的规则可以保证 $2K$，而阈值规则的损失可能任意接近 $3K$。
tldr: 本文研究了重复买租模型中经典阈值规则的加法竞争界，证明了当历史增长在 $P$ 次运行中恒定时，阈值规则的附加损失至多为 $(2P-1)K$ 且该界是尖锐的。
ai_comments: 该论文针对大语言模型智能体中的上下文管理问题，对重复买租模型中的经典阈值规则进行了深入的加法界分析，具有较强的理论创新性和实际应用背景。
motivation: 受大语言模型智能体中上下文管理的启发，研究具有历史增长和固定重置价格的重复买租模型，以改进和评估经典阈值规则。
method: 利用单速率问题的相对价值函数构建势能论证方法，分析阈值规则在历史增长不同情况下的性能。
results: 证明了如果增长在 $P$ 次运行中是恒定的，阈值规则的附加损失至多为 $(2P-1)K$，且该系数是尖锐的；对于更一般的情况给出了相应的界，同时分析了增长下降时的规则变体。
conclusion: 通过势能函数法证明了重复买租模型中阈值规则的尖锐加法界，并对不同增长情况下的性能进行了细致的定量刻画。

title: An Integrality-Gap Lower Bound of 1.2325 for Minimum Multiway Cut
authors: Dimitar Chakarov, Yury Makarychev
abstract: We prove that the integrality gap of the Călinescu-Karloff-Rabani relaxation for Minimum Multiway Cut is at least $1.2325$ when the number of terminals is large. By a result of Manokaran, Naor, Raghavendra, and Schwartz (2008), it is therefore NP-hard, under the Unique Games Conjecture, to approximate Minimum Multiway Cut within a factor of $1.2325$. This improves the previously best known lower bound of $1.20016$ due to Bérczi, Chandrasekaran, Király, and Madan (2020).
zh_title: 最小多路割问题的1.2325整性间隙下界
translation: 我们证明，当终端数量较大时，最小多路割（Minimum Multiway Cut）的Călinescu-Karloff-Rabani松弛的整性间隙（integrality gap）至少为1.2325。根据Manokaran、Naor、Raghavendra和Schwartz（2008）的结果，在唯一对策猜想（Unique Games Conjecture）下，以1.2325的因子近似最小多路割是NP难的。这改进了Bérczi、Chandrasekaran、Király和Madan（2020）先前已知的最好下界1.20016。
tldr: 该论文将最小多路割问题的整性间隙下界及基于唯一对策猜想的NP难度近似下界提升至1.2325。
ai_comments: 该论文在图论和近似算法领域取得了重要进展，通过提高Minimum Multiway Cut问题的Călinescu-Karloff-Rabani松弛方法的整性间隙下界，进一步明确了该问题的NP难度。创新点在于构造了更优的下界（1.2325），改进了先前的研究成果。
motivation: 旨在改进Minimum Multiway Cut问题（最小多路割问题）先前已知的整性间隙下界和近似难度下界，以更好地理解其计算复杂性。
method: 通过证明当终端数量较大时，Călinescu-Karloff-Rabani松弛的整性间隙至少为1.2325，并结合Manokaran等人的研究结果推导出NP难度近似下界。
results: 将Minimum Multiway Cut问题的整性间隙下界从先前最好的1.20016提高到了1.2325，这意味着在唯一对策猜想下，以优于1.2325的因子近似该问题是NP难的。
conclusion: 证明了Minimum Multiway Cut问题Călinescu-Karloff-Rabani松弛的整性间隙至少为1.2325，从而在唯一对策猜想下将该问题的近似难度下限提升至1.2325。

title: Certified folding-free deformable image registration: A whole-cell Jacobian certificate and a sequential variational solver
authors: Baihan Zhao, Zicong Zhou, Guojun Liao
abstract: Registration maps propagate labels, measure local volume change, and map results back through their inverses; requiring invertibility. Voxelwise checks can miss folds between grid points. We study the canonical continuous extension of a nodal displacement field by trilinear interpolation and give a test that proves its Jacobian determinant positive in every grid cell or rejects the map. The test is rigorous under IEEE 754 binary64 arithmetic (correct rounding, no contraction). With a fixed boundary, certification implies a bi-Lipschitz homeomorphism of the image domain. We introduce SeqVP, built around this certificate. A proximal Jacobian-determinant-curl formulation yields inner problems whose penalties on changes in the map, Jacobian determinant, and curl vanish to first order at the current iterate. The method decreases a fixed outer energy up to a floating-point resolution guard and certifies every committed iterate. After certified initialization, stopping at any time returns a folding-free map. A Poisson-preconditioned gradient method with Jacobian-aware step prediction and affine-scaling damping, initialized by certified handoff from an uncertified binary32 pre-optimizer, handles a 1 mm brain MRI with about 2e7 unknowns in 90 s on one GPU. On 49 held-out OASIS pairs, SeqVP achieves mean Dice 0.821 over 35 structures and 0.889 over 4 tissue classes, with certified zero folding. Gains are 0.022 and 0.025 over ANTs SyN, and 0.022 and 0.023 over uniGradICON with instance optimization at equal time (paired, Holm-adjusted p < 0.001), but maps are rougher. SeqVP is level with ANTs on LPBA40, behind it on IBSR18, and ahead of all label-free baselines on 20 large-deformation pairs. On fields from nine methods, the certificate finds non-positive-Jacobian cells in every ANTs SyN map (median 10, missed by voxelwise checks) and in maps from NiftyReg, ConvexAdam, uniGradICON, and TransMorph.
zh_title: Certified folding-free deformable image registration: A whole-cell Jacobian certificate and a sequential variational solver
translation: 配准映射传播标签、测量局部体积变化，并通过其逆映射结果；需要可逆性。体素检查可能会遗漏网格点之间的折叠。我们通过三线性插值研究节点位移场的正则连续扩展，并提供一种测试，该测试证明其雅可比行列式在每个网格单元中都为正，或拒绝该映射。该测试在 IEEE 754 binary64 算术（正确舍入，无收缩）下是严格的。对于固定边界，认证意味着图像域的双 Lipschitz 同胚。我们引入了围绕该证书构建的 SeqVP。近雅可比行列式-旋度公式产生了内部问题，其对映射、雅可比行列式和旋度变化的惩罚在当前迭代处一阶消失。该方法将固定外部能量减少到浮点分辨率保护，并认证每个已提交的迭代。在经过认证的初始化后，随时停止都可以得到无折叠的映射。采用泊松预处理梯度方法，具有雅可比感知步长预测和仿射缩放阻尼，并通过未经认证的 binary32 预优化器进行认证的初始处理，在 90 秒内处理了一个具有约 2e7 个未知数的 1 毫米大脑 MRI，运行在一个 GPU 上。在 49 对保留的 OASIS 数据上，SeqVP 在 35 个结构上实现了 0.821 的平均 Dice 系数，在 0.889 个组织类别上实现了 0.889，并经过认证无折叠。与 ANTs SyN 相比，增益分别为 0.022 和 0.025，与具有实例优化的 uniGradICON 相比，在相同时间（配对，Holm 调整的 p < 0.001）下增益分别为 0.022 和 0.023，但映射更粗糙。SeqVP 在 LPBA40 上与 ANTs 水平相当，在 IBSR18 上落后于它，并在 20 对大变形数据上领先于所有无标签基线。在九种方法的场上，该证书在每个 ANTs SyN 映射（中位数为 10，体素检查遗漏）以及 NiftyReg、ConvexAdam、uniGradICON 和 TransMorph 的映射中都发现了非正雅可比单元。
tldr: This paper presents a new method for deformable image registration that guarantees no folding (self-intersection) by using a whole-cell Jacobian determinant certificate and a sequential variational solver (SeqVP). The method is efficient and achieves competitive or superior accuracy compared to existing methods, while also identifying folding in other registration algorithms.
ai_comments: The development of a rigorous, whole-cell Jacobian certificate for deformable image registration is a significant advancement. The integration of this certificate into the SeqVP solver ensures folding-free maps, addressing a critical limitation of current methods. The method's efficiency and competitive performance on various datasets are impressive. A potential limitation, as noted, is that the resulting maps can be rougher than those from some other methods, which might require further post-processing depending on the application. The certificate's ability to detect folding in other algorithms is a valuable contribution for evaluating and improving registration techniques.
motivation: Existing image registration methods can produce folding (self-intersections), which invalidates the registration for applications like volume change measurement. Voxelwise checks are insufficient to detect folding between grid points. Therefore, there is a need for registration methods that can guarantee folding-free results.
method: The paper introduces a novel certification test for the Jacobian determinant of the continuous extension of a nodal displacement field, which rigorously proves positivity within each grid cell. This certificate is integrated into a sequential variational solver called SeqVP. SeqVP uses a proximal formulation that penalizes changes in the map, Jacobian determinant, and curl. It employs a Poisson-preconditioned gradient method with Jacobian-aware step prediction and affine-scaling damping for optimization. An uncertified pre-optimizer is used for initialization, followed by a certified handoff. The method ensures that every committed iterate is certified as folding-free.
results: SeqVP successfully registers a 1 mm brain MRI with approximately 2e7 unknowns in 90 seconds on a single GPU, yielding certified zero folding. On OASIS data, it achieves a mean Dice score of 0.821 for structures and 0.889 for tissue classes, outperforming ANTs SyN and uniGradICON. The certificate developed in this work detects folding in maps generated by several other state-of-the-art methods, including ANTs SyN, which were missed by voxelwise checks.
conclusion: The proposed whole-cell Jacobian certificate and the SeqVP solver provide a rigorous and efficient solution for folding-free deformable image registration. The method guarantees that registration maps are free of self-intersections, a critical requirement for many downstream applications. SeqVP demonstrates competitive accuracy and significant advantages over existing methods by providing certified folding-free results and identifying folding in other algorithms.

title: Formalizing inverse problems in the age of AI: possibilities, pitfalls, and an invitation
authors: Christian Clason, Tapio Helin, Medet Nursultanov, Lauri Oksanen
abstract: Proof assistants such as Lean check mathematical proofs down to the axioms, and AI agents have recently made writing such proofs cheap. We describe AutoIP, a Lean library in which classical linear regularization theory, together with the functional analysis it rests on, has been autoformalized by AI agents. A machine-checked proof certifies only the formal statement it proves, so the remaining human task is to confirm that each formal statement says what was intended. We organize the library around this task: a reviewer compares the formal statements with their natural-language counterparts and never needs to read a proof. Our experience is that the risks lie in the statements rather than in the proofs, and that simple automated tests on the statements can expose problems even in the established literature. We illustrate this with a textbook theorem whose hypothesis is more restrictive than asserted. We invite the inverse problems community to extend and build on the library.
zh_title: 人工智能时代的逆问题形式化：可能性、陷阱与邀请
translation: 像Lean这样的证明助手会对数学证明进行严格的检查，直到公理。最近，AI代理已经能够廉价地编写这类证明。我们描述了AutoIP，这是一个Lean库，其中经典的线性正则化理论及其所依赖的泛函分析已经被AI代理自动形式化。机器检查的证明只能证明其形式化陈述的正确性，因此剩余的人工任务是确认每个形式化陈述都符合预期。我们围绕这个任务组织了这个库：评审者将形式化陈述与其自然语言对应物进行比较，并且永远不需要阅读证明。我们的经验是，风险存在于陈述本身，而不是证明，并且对陈述进行简单的自动化测试可以暴露现有文献中的问题。我们以一个教科书定理为例，该定理的假设比声称的更具限制性。我们邀请逆问题社区扩展和改进这个库。
tldr: AI可以自动形式化数学证明，但仍需人类检查形式化陈述是否符合预期，以避免潜在风险。
ai_comments: 这项工作展示了AI在数学形式化领域的巨大潜力，尤其是在需要严谨性的逆问题领域。通过将AI的证明生成能力与人类的监督相结合，该研究提出了一种高效且可靠的形式化方法。然而，‘风险存在于陈述本身’的观点强调了在依赖AI进行形式化时，人类判断和领域知识的不可替代性。未来的工作可以探索更先进的AI技术来提高陈述的准确性，并开发更智能的自动化测试工具。
motivation: AI能够廉价地编写形式化证明，这为在逆问题领域形式化理论和定理提供了可能性，但需要解决AI生成的陈述可能存在的风险。
method: 利用AI代理和Lean证明助手，自动形式化了线性正则化理论及其泛函分析基础，并组织了一个库（AutoIP），方便评审者检查形式化陈述与自然语言描述的一致性。
results: AI代理成功地自动形式化了线性正则化理论，并发现了一个教科书定理中存在的假设限制比声称的更严格的问题。通过对陈述进行自动化测试，可以暴露已发表文献中的问题。
conclusion: AI在形式化数学证明方面展现出巨大潜力，但人工审查AI生成的陈述至关重要，以确保其准确性并发现潜在错误。作者邀请逆问题社区参与扩展和改进AutoIP库。

title: Operationalizing Responsible AI in MLOps and ML Production: A Systematic Literature Review
authors: Hinduja Nirujan, Siddhartha Paudel, Gouri Ginde
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled systems are increasingly deployed in operational environments where machine learning (ML) models interact with changing data, users, infrastructure, and organizational processes. While Responsible AI principles are widely discussed, less is known about how these principles are translated into concrete mechanisms within Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) and ML production workflows. This paper reports a systematic literature review of studies that operationalize Responsible AI in ML production. The review synthesizes evidence across monitoring and runtime assurance, audit and compliance, ML lifecycle integration, and traceability/provenance/documentation. Across the final study set, the literature shows a shift from abstract ethical principles toward engineering mechanisms such as drift monitoring, runtime checks, audit logs, provenance records, evidence bundles, governance gates, policy-as-code, model passports, and compliance-oriented documentation. However, the evidence base remains uneven: many studies propose architectures or prototypes, while fewer evaluate the mechanisms in realistic production settings, longitudinal operations, or organizational governance workflows. The review identifies a central gap around integrated, evidence-producing Responsible MLOps: current mechanisms often detect, document, or govern isolated parts of the ML lifecycle, but rarely connect runtime signals, ML lifecycle provenance, human accountability, and compliance evidence into closed operational loops. These findings motivate future software engineering research on traceable, evaluable, and operationally integrated Responsible AI support for ML production.
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Systematic literature review of 44 primary studies
zh_title: 在MLOps与机器学习生产中落实负责任人工智能：一项系统性文献综述
translation: 人工智能（AI）赋能的系统正日益部署在运行环境中，其中机器学习（ML）模型与不断变化的数据、用户、基础设施和组织流程进行交互。虽然关于负责任人工智能原则的讨论广泛，但对于这些原则如何在机器学习运维（MLOps）和ML生产工作流中转化为具体机制，我们所知甚少。本文报告了一项关于在ML生产中将负责任AI操作化的研究的系统性文献综述。该综述综合了监控与运行时保障、审计与合规、ML生命周期集成以及可追溯性/溯源/文档方面的证据。在最终的研究集中，文献显示出从抽象的伦理原则向工程机制的转变，例如漂移监控、运行时检查、审计日志、溯源记录、证据包、治理门禁、策略即代码、模型护照和以合规为导向的文档。然而，证据基础仍然很不均衡：许多研究提出了架构或原型，而较少在现实生产环境、纵向操作或组织治理工作流中评估这些机制。该综述指出了围绕集成化、产出证据的负责任MLOps的核心差距：当前的机制通常检测、记录或治理ML生命周期的孤立部分，但很少将运行时信号、ML生命周期溯源、人类问责制和合规证据连接成封闭的操作循环。这些发现推动了未来关于ML生产的可追溯、可评估和操作集成的负责任AI支持的软件工程研究。
tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述，探讨了负责任AI在MLOps和生产环境中的落地现状，指出当前研究正从抽象原则转向具体工程机制，但仍缺乏端到端的集成化闭环解决方案。
ai_comments: 该论文通过系统性文献综述，揭示了负责任人工智能（Responsible AI）从抽象原则向具体工程机制（如监控、合规、全生命周期集成等）转化的现状与不足，指出了未来在集成化、证据导向的Responsible MLOps领域的研究方向，具有重要的学术与工程实践价值。
motivation: 虽然负责任AI（Responsible AI）原则得到了广泛讨论，但关于这些原则如何转化为机器学习运维（MLOps）和机器学习生产工作流中的具体机制，目前了解还不够充分。
method: 系统性文献综述（Systematic Literature Review），对将负责任AI操作化（operationalize）到机器学习生产流程中的相关研究进行了综合分析。
results: 研究表明文献正从抽象的道德原则转向具体的工程机制（如漂移监控、审计日志、模型护照等），但证据基础分布不均，多数研究停留在架构或原型阶段，缺乏在真实生产环境中的评估，且缺乏将运行时信号、生命周期溯源和合规证据连接成闭环的集成化机制。
conclusion: 当前的文献在将负责任AI原则转化为工程机制方面取得了进展，但仍缺乏集成化的、闭环的、贯穿全生命周期的Operational Responsible AI方案，亟需未来在软件工程领域进行深入研究。

title: Octopus: One Brain, Many Branches for Latent-KV Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
authors: Tianming Sha
abstract:
Multi-agent LLM systems explore in parallel by spawning sub-agents with isolated context windows, whereas single-agent systems append every search and verification step into one growing trajectory. However, existing multi-agent frameworks duplicate prefix KV caches across branches, exchange findings by re-prefilling text summaries, and flatten or drop cross-branch dependencies during reinforcement learning (RL).
  We introduce Octopus, a single-model multi-agent RL framework in which all threads share one backbone and coordinate over a GPU-resident directed acyclic graph (DAG) of KV states through five primitives (fork, read_thread, wait_threads, rewind, commit). Octopus combines three co-designed mechanisms: (1) Zero-Copy Radix Forking, which spawns branches as $\mathcal{O}(1)$ cursor views over shared physical KV pages; (2) Attention-Only KV Mounting, which mounts a sibling thread's terminal KV blocks directly into full-attention layers while bypassing linear-recurrent states (Gated DeltaNet / Mamba-2), cutting off-task hijacking by $21\times$ ($57.9\% \to 2.7\%$) while retaining $92.2\%$ of full-text mutual information at zero extra KV allocation; and (3) a Packed DAG-GRPO Trainer, which packs all episode branches into one block-sparse attention pass and assigns counterfactual branch credit via leave-one-branch-out marginal rewards.
  Trained end-to-end with GRPO on Qwen3.5-4B over a sparse BM25 corpus, Octopus reaches $49.6\%$ accuracy on BrowseComp-Plus ($+17.5$ points over single-agent GRPO at 143K context and $+12.5$ points over text-summary multi-agent RL) and $51.2\%$ on OpenResearcher, outperforming dense-retrieval agents up to $250\times$ larger while increasing training throughput $3.3\times$ and cutting peak KV memory $2.8\times$.
zh_title: Octopus：用于潜在KV多智能体强化学习的“一体多枝”架构
translation:
多智能体大语言模型（LLM）系统通过派生具有隔离上下文窗口的子agent来进行并行探索，而单agent系统则将每一个搜索和验证步骤追加到一个不断增长的轨迹中。然而，现有的多智能体框架在分支之间重复复制前缀KV缓存，通过重新预填充文本摘要来交换发现，并在强化学习（RL）过程中扁平化或丢弃跨分支依赖。
我们介绍了Octopus，这是一个单模型多智能体RL框架，其中所有线程共享一个骨干网络，并通过五个原语（fork, read_thread, wait_threads, rewind, commit）在KV状态的GPU驻留有向无环图（DAG）上进行协调。Octopus结合了三个共同设计的机制：（1）零拷贝基数分叉（Zero-Copy Radix Forking），它将分支派生为共享物理KV页面上的$\mathcal{O}(1)$光标视图；（2）纯注意力KV挂载（Attention-Only KV Mounting），它将同级线程的终端KV块直接挂载到全注意力层中，同时绕过线性循环状态（Gated DeltaNet / Mamba-2），在零额外KV分配的情况下，将离题劫持减少了$21\times$（从$57.9\%$降至$2.7\%$），同时保留了$92.2\%$的全文本互信息；以及（3）打包的DAG-GRPO训练器（Packed DAG-GRPO Trainer），它将所有回合分支打包到一个块稀疏注意力传递中，并通过留一分支边际奖励（leave-one-branch-out marginal rewards）分配反事实分支信用。
通过在稀疏BM25语料库上使用GRPO对Qwen3.5-4B进行端到端训练，Octopus在BrowseComp-Plus上达到了$49.6\%$的准确率（比143K上下文的单agent GRPO高出$17.5$个百分点，比文本摘要多agent RL高出$12.5$个百分点），在OpenResearcher上达到了$51.2\%$，性能优于规模大达$250\times$的密集检索agent，同时将训练吞吐量提高了$3.3\times$，峰值KV内存减少了$2.8\times$。
tldr: Octopus通过基于底层KV状态DAG的单模型多智能体强化学习框架，解决了传统多智能体系统内存冗余和通信低效的问题，大幅提升了性能与训练效率。
ai_comments: Octopus创新性地将多智能体协作机制与底层KV缓存管理相结合，通过GPU驻留的DAG结构和零拷贝技术，实现了高效的单模型多智能体强化学习，大幅提升了训练吞吐量并降低了内存开销。
motivation: 现有的多智能体LLM系统存在分支间KV缓存重复、通过文本摘要交换信息效率低下，以及在强化学习过程中丢失或扁平化跨分支依赖的问题。
method: 引入名为Octopus的单模型多智能体RL框架，包含五个底层原语、零拷贝基数分叉（Zero-Copy Radix Forking）、纯注意力KV挂载（Attention-Only KV Mounting）以及打包的DAG-GRPO训练器。
results: 在BrowseComp-Plus上达到49.6%的准确率（比143K上下文的单agent GRPO高17.5个百分点），在OpenResearcher上达到51.2%，训练吞吐量提升3.3倍，峰值KV内存减少2.8倍。
conclusion: Octopus通过共享骨干网络、利用KV状态的DAG图以及创新的训练器，有效解决了传统多智能体LLM系统中KV缓存冗余、文本通信低效和跨分支依赖丢失的问题，在多个基准测试中展现出显著的性能优势。

title: When Can Self-Play Fix a False Belief? Answer Keys, Pass Bands and Replacement Rules in an Execution-Grounded Loop
authors: Nirdesh Chauhan, Dushyant Rajput, Siddharth Kosaraju
abstract: Self-play loops in which a model writes tasks, derives an answer key and trains on its own matching solutions are often called grounded when the key comes from executing code. We ask which false beliefs such a loop removes. We run expert-iteration self-play with Qwen3-4B-Base on output-prediction tasks, vary the source of the answer key, and track natural beliefs about Python semantics and two misreadings of task specifications planted by fine-tuning ("at most n" read as < n; "the k-th smallest" read as 0-indexed). Executing the generator's own code gave a key that encoded the "at most" misreading on every audited task, and training on it never raised the truth rate above 0.03. A key from an implementation by the unplanted model, a teacher without the error, raised it to 0.23-0.58 after three rounds in four runs. A correct key is not sufficient: the pass band, which keeps tasks solved 1-7 times of 8, admits almost no corrective task while a belief is held on nearly every sample. Execution keys sharply reduced both natural runtime beliefs on diagnostic items in both seeds. Corrections came with replacement rules that fail on neighbouring items the old belief got right. The robust case, present in all four spec runs, is that after the "at most" fix the model increasingly counts the nearest value above a limit that is absent from the list (overcount 0.18-0.38 of control samples at round 3), a case our planted generators almost never wrote (4 of 10,924 tasks); diagnostic-only metrics miss it. Asked for those cases, the planted generator wrote none in 2,061 checkable tasks, against 27% for the untrained unplanted model in one round. Both generators often moved the request into the specification instead ("the cap itself does not count"), and a decorrelated key follows the specification.
zh_title: 自-play何时能修复错误信念？执行接地循环中的答案键、通过带与替换规则
translation: 模型编写任务、推导答案键并在自身匹配的解决方案上进行训练的自对弈循环，当答案键来自代码执行时，通常被称为接地气的。我们探讨了这种循环消除了哪些错误信念。我们使用Qwen3-4B-Base在输出预测任务上运行专家迭代自对弈，改变答案键的来源，并追踪关于Python语义的自然信念以及通过微调植入的任务规范的两种误读（“至多n”被读作< n；“第k个最小值”被读作0索引）。执行生成器自己的代码给出的键在每个审核的任务上都编码了“至多”的误读，并且对其进行训练从未将真实率提高到0.03以上。来自未植入模型的实现的键（一个没有错误的教师）在四个运行中的三个轮次后将其提高到0.23-0.58。正确的键是不够的：保持1到7/8次解决的任务的通过带，在保持信念的同时几乎不接受任何纠正任务。执行键在两个种子中都急剧减少了诊断项目上的自然运行时信念。修正带有替换规则，这些规则在旧信念弄对的相邻项目上失败了。所有四个规范运行中都存在的稳健情况是，“至多”修复后，模型越来越多地计算列表中不存在的限制之上的最近值（第3轮对照样本的过度计数为0.18-0.38），这是我们植入的生成器几乎从未写过的（10924个任务中的4个）；仅诊断的指标错过了它。当被问及这些情况时，植入的生成器在2061个可检查的任务中没有写一个，而未训练的未植入模型在一轮中占27%。两个生成器通常将请求移到规范中（“上限本身不算”），并且去相关的键遵循规范。
tldr: 研究表明，大语言模型在自对弈循环中很难仅靠自身执行来修正深层的错误信念，往往需要正确的教师键，且修正过程容易产生新的替代错误。
ai_comments: 该论文通过研究自对弈循环中错误信念的修正机制，揭示了执行接地循环（execution-grounded loop）在处理错误信念和特定任务时的局限性及替代规则，为理解大语言模型自对弈中的信念修正提供了重要的实证视角。
motivation: 探索在基于代码执行的自对弈循环中，模型能够通过自身生成的任务和答案修正哪些类型的错误信念，以及其局限性是什么。
method: 使用Qwen3-4B-Base在输出预测任务上运行专家迭代自对弈，改变答案键的来源，并追踪关于Python语义及植入错误规范的自然信念。
results: 使用生成器自身的代码作为答案键无法纠正“至多n”的误读；而使用未植入错误模型的实现作为答案键则能显著提高真实率；同时，修正往往伴随着在相邻项目上失效的替代规则。
conclusion: 执行接地自对弈无法轻易修正持久的错误信念，通常会伴随替代规则的产生，且正确答案的键并不足以消除错误。

title: Call-Level Revision Contracts for LLM-Authored Workflows
authors: Chenyang Jiang, Benyang Pan, Puqu Wu
abstract: Durable execution engines replay a recorded history and do not compare activity payloads. When a model repairs a workflow that failed partway through, it must either pay again for calls that succeeded or accept a recorded result whose payload changed. We define a revision contract for workflows whose orchestration code is written by a model. Each capability call carries a structural identity built from its callsite, its fanout position, and its occurrence count, and the identity stays stable under rewrites that leave the call in place, so committed identities form a frozen prefix. The frozen unit is the call expression, and the surrounding code stays writable. A static gate rejects a rewrite that would change a committed call before a container starts. A runtime digest stops a changed payload at a committed identity, and an occurrence ledger names a repeated paid payload. Under three assumptions, a candidate the gate accepts replays every committed call it invokes, executes only new work, and reports the identities it skips. No local identity is both relocation-invariant and free of wrong reuse, so callsite identity turns a relocation into a pre-spend stop. On media workflows, 22 gate-passed repairs replay 258 committed identities with no duplicate, and a live six-way fanout makes seven paid calls instead of twelve. A 12-task customer-support study applies the same identity, replay, and boundary checks on two models.
zh_title: 大模型编写工作流的调用级修订契约
translation: 持久化执行引擎会重放记录的历史，但不比较活动载荷。当模型修复中途失败的工作流时，它要么必须为成功的调用再次付费，要么接受载荷发生改变的记录结果。我们为编排代码由模型编写的工作流定义了一种修订契约。每个能力调用都带有由其调用点、扇出位置和出现次数构建的结构化身份，该身份在不改变调用位置的重写下保持稳定，因此已提交的身份构成了冻结的前缀。冻结的单元是调用表达式，周围的代码保持可写。静态门控在容器启动前拒绝会改变已提交调用的重写。运行时摘要在已提交的身份处阻止更改的载荷，而出现账本则命名重复付费的载荷。在三个假设下，门控接受的候选会重放其调用的每个已提交调用，仅执行新工作，并报告其跳过的身份。没有哪个本地身份既具有重定位不变性又没有错误的重用，因此调用点身份将重定位转变为预支出的停止。在媒体工作流上，22个通过门控的修复重放了258个已提交的身份且没有重复，并且实时的六路扇出进行了7次付费调用而不是12次。一项12任务的客户支持研究在两个模型上应用了相同的身份、重放和边界检查。
tldr: 提出了一种针对大模型编写工作流的调用级修订契约，通过结构化身份和门控机制实现了安全高效的工作流重放与修复，减少了重复计费。
ai_comments: 该论文针对大模型编写的工作流提出了调用级别的修订契约（Call-Level Revision Contracts），解决了持久化执行引擎在重放和修复大模型工作流时的冗余计费和状态不一致问题。创新点在于通过结构化身份（结合调用点、扇出位置和出现次数）实现冻结前缀与可写代码的结合，并利用静态门控和运行时摘要有效避免重复计费和错误复用，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 持久化执行引擎在重放和修复由大模型编写的工作流时，往往面临要么为成功调用重复付费、要么接受改变了载荷的记录结果的困境，需要一种机制来安全、高效地重用已提交的调用并执行新工作。
method: 引入了调用级别的修订契约，为每个能力调用赋予由调用点、扇出位置和出现次数构成的结构化身份，形成冻结前缀，并结合静态门控、运行时摘要和出现账本进行控制。
results: 在媒体工作流实验中，22个通过门控的修复重放了258个已提交的身份且无重复，6路扇出测试中仅产生了7次付费调用（原需12次），并在12任务的客户支持研究中验证了该方法的可行性。
conclusion: 调用级别修订契约成功解决了大模型编写工作流中的重放和修复问题，在保证正确性的同时显著减少了重复计费和计算。

title: KDASO: Knowledge-Data Dual-Driven Automated Skill Optimization for Liability Adjudication Tasks
authors: Zi-Jian Cheng, Weiming Wu, Jie Meng, Zhen Peng, Shan Huang, Qun Li, Guobing Wu, Lan-Zhe Guo
abstract: Liability adjudication tasks (e.g., legal charge determination) require analyzing event descriptions against domain-specific skills to determine whether a party should bear liability. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise in this area by leveraging executable skills for interpretable reasoning, existing approaches face three critical limitations: skill libraries become stale as real-world scenarios dynamically evolve, skill descriptions often suffer from a semantic execution gap where LLMs deviate from intended expert logic, and growing skill collections exceed context budgets causing critical skill omission. To address these challenges, we propose Knowledge-Data Dual-Driven Automated Skill Optimization (KDASO), which continuously evolves a skill library through neighborhood-conditioned induction from recent adjudication data, execution-aligned refinement based on LLM trajectory analysis, and context-budgeted routing for scalable skill selection. Experiments across ride-hailing adjudication, legal liability determination, and logical reasoning judgment demonstrate that KDASO significantly outperforms current general-purpose and domain-specific baselines. KDASO further achieves 8.96% improvement when transferring skills to concept-similar scenarios and maintains consistent performance gains through continuous optimization, underscoring the high transferability and stability of generated skills.
zh_title: KDASO：面向责任裁决任务的知识-数据双驱动自动化技能优化
translation: 责任裁决任务（如法律罪名确定）需要分析事件描述与领域特定技能，以判定一方是否应承担责任。尽管大语言模型（LLMs）通过利用可执行技能进行可解释推理在该领域展现出潜力，但现有方法面临三个关键限制：随着现实场景动态演化，技能库变得陈旧；技能描述常遭遇语义执行差距，导致LLMs偏离预期的专家逻辑；不断增长的技能集合超出了上下文预算，导致关键技能被遗漏。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了知识-数据双驱动自动化技能优化（KDASO）方法，它通过基于近期裁决数据的邻域条件归纳、基于LLM轨迹分析的执行对齐细化，以及用于可扩展技能选择的上下文预算路由，持续演化技能库。在网约车裁决、法律责任判定和逻辑推理判断等任务上的实验表明，KDASO显著优于当前的通用和领域特定基准。KDASO在将技能迁移到概念相似的场景时还实现了8.96%的提升，并通过持续优化保持了持续的性能增益，彰显了生成技能的高可迁移性和稳定性。
tldr: 提出了一种名为KDASO的知识-数据双驱动自动化技能优化框架，通过持续演化、逻辑细化和智能路由解决了大模型在责任裁决任务中的技能局限性，大幅提升了准确性与迁移能力。
ai_comments: 本文针对责任裁决任务提出了知识-数据双驱动的自动化技能优化框架（KDASO），创新性地解决了大模型在技能更新、语义执行对齐及上下文预算限制方面的问题，具有很高的实用价值和迁移能力。
motivation: 现有的基于大语言模型的可执行技能推理方法在责任裁决任务中面临三个关键限制：技能库随现实演化而陈旧、语义执行差距导致大模型偏离专家逻辑、技能集增长超出上下文预算导致关键技能被忽略。
method: 提出了KDASO框架，通过基于近期裁决数据的邻域条件归纳持续演化技能库，基于大模型轨迹分析进行执行对齐的细化，以及采用上下文预算路由实现可扩展的技能选择。
results: 实验表明，KDASO在网约车裁决、法律责任判定和逻辑推理判断等任务上显著优于当前的通用和领域特定基准；在向概念相似场景迁移技能时取得了8.96%的性能提升，并通过持续优化保持了稳定的性能增益。
conclusion: KDASO框架通过持续演化技能库、对齐执行逻辑及按上下文预算路由，有效解决了大模型在责任裁决中的局限性，实验证明其在多个基准测试中显著优于现有方法，且具备出色的技能迁移能力和稳定性。

title: Interactive Backdoor Attacks in LLM-Based Proactive Dialogue Systems
authors: Zhiyang Xia, Yuming Shang, Xi Zhang
abstract: LLM-based proactive dialogue systems provide goal-directed support through sustained interaction. Fine-tuning their underlying models on externally supplied dialogue data introduces backdoor risks. Existing LLM backdoor studies primarily focus on eliciting an attacker-specified response upon trigger activation. We present an interactive backdoor attack framework that uses training-data poisoning to steer post-trigger, multi-turn interactions toward an attacker-specified objective. Poisoned fine-tuning dialogues implant a trigger-conditioned guidance-policy bias that ordinary user utterances can activate, without deployment-time prompt modification or further attacker intervention. Specifically, we instantiate three complementary attacks under progressively expanded post-trigger interaction settings: (1) Direct Attack, which targets an immediate response deviation upon trigger activation, retaining the conventional trigger--response setting; (2) Constrained Progressive Attack, which progressively advances the attack objective along a predefined multi-turn trajectory; and (3) Unconstrained Progressive Attack, which extends target-directed steering to open-ended interactions with varied user continuations. Using psychological counseling as a representative setting, experiments on two LLM backbones and two dialogue datasets show that all three attacks effectively achieve their objectives under their respective interaction settings while largely preserving normal utility. Separate defense evaluations show that the tested training-data filters retain nearly all poisoned dialogues, while three post-admission baselines leave substantial residual attack-specific success.
zh_title: 基于大语言模型的主动对话系统中的交互式后门攻击
translation: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的主动对话系统通过持续的交互提供目标导向的支持。对其底层模型进行外部提供的对话数据微调会引入后门风险。现有的LLM后门研究主要集中在触发激活时引发攻击者指定的响应。我们提出了一种交互式后门攻击框架，该框架利用训练数据投毒，将触发后多轮交互引导向攻击者指定的目标。受污染的微调对话植入了触发条件下的引导策略偏差，普通用户言论可以激活该偏差，而无需在部署时修改提示词或攻击者的进一步介入。具体而言，我们在逐步扩展的触发后交互设置下实例化了三种互补的攻击：（1）直接攻击，针对触发激活时的即时响应偏差，保留了传统的触发-响应设置；（2）受限渐进攻击，沿着预定义的多轮轨迹逐步推进攻击目标；（3）无限制渐进攻击，将目标导向的引导扩展到具有不同用户延续的开放式交互中。以心理咨询为代表性设置，在两个LLM主干网和两个对话数据集上的实验表明，这三种攻击在各自的交互设置中都有效地实现了其目标，同时在很大程度上保留了正常的效用。单独的防御评估表明，经过测试的训练数据过滤几乎保留了所有受污染的对话，而三个准入后基线留下了大量的残留攻击成功率。
tldr: 本论文提出了针对大语言模型主动对话系统的交互式后门攻击框架，通过数据投毒实现在多轮对话中隐蔽地引导模型达成攻击目标。
ai_comments: 该论文针对基于大语言模型的自适应对话系统，提出了一种新颖的交互式后门攻击框架，通过训练数据投毒实现多轮交互中的目标引导。这揭示了LLM微调阶段的安全盲区，对未来对话系统的安全防御具有重要警示作用。
motivation: 现有的LLM后门研究主要集中在触发器激活时产生即时攻击者指定的响应，忽略了基于LLM的主动对话系统中持续多轮交互的后门风险。
method: 提出了包含直接攻击、受限渐进攻击和无限制渐进攻击在内的交互式后门攻击框架，通过训练数据投毒植入由触发器条件的引导策略偏差。
results: 在心理咨询设定下的实验表明，三种攻击在各自的交互设置中均能有效达成目标，同时在很大程度上保留了正常效用，且现有防御方法难以有效检测和防御。
conclusion: 论文提出的交互式后门攻击能够在多轮交互中有效达成攻击者的目标，同时保持模型正常功能，且现有的防御方法难以完全消除这种威胁。

title: T$^2$-Splat: Adaptive Topology Mesh Splatting with Texture Residuals
authors: Zhihao Tang, Youjia Zhang, Mingbo Zhao, Wei Yang
abstract: Triangle-based splatting connects novel view synthesis with conventional graphics pipelines, but often requires excessive tessellation to preserve appearance details. We present T$^2$-Splat, which decouples topology adaptation from appearance refinement. Safe Restricted Delaunay Triangulation (Safe RDT) initializes mesh connectivity. Dynamic Topology Evolution (DTE) then adapts triangle allocation through edge collapse and vertex split operations. Residual per-face Mip-textures then refine appearance on the fixed mesh using scale-adaptive filtering. Experiments on Mip-NeRF 360, Tanks & Temples, and DTU demonstrate competitive results with compact meshes. T$^2$-Splat improves PSNR by 0.71dB over MeshSplatting on Mip-NeRF 360. Additional compression experiments demonstrate flexible control of mesh complexity, supporting face budgets as low as 10% of the original face count. Project page: https://t2-splat.github.io/.
zh_title: T$^2$-Splat：具有纹理残差的自适应拓扑网格喷溅法
translation: 基于三角形的喷溅（triangle-based splatting）将新视点合成与传统图形管线连接起来，但通常需要过度的曲面细分来保留外观细节。我们提出了 T$^2$-Splat，它将拓扑适应与外观精细化解耦。安全限制 Delaunay 三角剖分（Safe RDT）初始化网格连通性。然后，动态拓扑演化（DTE）通过边折叠和顶点分裂操作调整三角形分配。接着，残差每面 Mip 纹理使用尺度自适应滤波在固定网格上精细化外观。在 Mip-NeRF 360、Tanks & Temples 和 DTU 上的实验证明了其在紧凑网格下具有竞争力的结果。T$^2$-Splat 在 Mip-NeRF 360 上将 PSNR 提高了 0.71dB（相比 MeshSplatting）。附加的压缩实验证明了对网格复杂度的灵活控制，支持低至原始面数 10% 的面预算。项目网页：https://t2-splat.github.io/。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为T$^2$-Splat的新方法，通过解耦拓扑自适应与外观精细化，在保持高质量新视点合成的同时实现了极高压缩率的紧凑网格渲染。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将拓扑自适应与外观精细化解耦，利用Safe RDT初始化网格，DTE进行动态拓扑演化，并通过残差每面Mip纹理精细化外观，在保持高渲染质量的同时显著压缩了网格复杂度，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 基于三角形的喷溅方法连接了新视点合成与传统图形管线，但为了保留外观细节往往需要过度的曲面细分，因此需要一种更高效的方法来解耦拓扑适应与外观精细化。
method: 使用安全限制Delaunay三角剖分（Safe RDT）初始化网格连通性，通过动态拓扑演化（DTE）进行边折叠和顶点分裂操作以适应三角形分配，并利用残差每面Mip纹理在固定网格上通过尺度自适应滤波细化外观。
results: 在 Mip-NeRF 360、Tanks & Temples 和 DTU 数据集上的实验表明，T$^2$-Splat 在紧凑网格下取得了竞争力的结果，在 Mip-NeRF 360 上比 MeshSplatting 的 PSNR 提高了 0.71dB，并支持低至原始面数 10% 的面预算。
conclusion: T$^2$-Splat通过解耦拓扑适应和外观细化，有效提升了三角形网格渲染的质量和效率，在多个数据集上取得了具有竞争力的结果。

title: DiaHeads: Jointly Generating Coordinated 3D Dialogue Heads with Non-verbal Cues from Dual Audio
authors: Jiahe Wang, Yuxin Wang, Xin Yun, Binyan Chen, Tong Pan, Zhenjie Liu, Shangfei Wang
abstract: Audio-driven 3D head animation has made considerable progress in generation realism, yet generating coordinated behavior for two-person dialogue remains difficult, because current dialogue head generation methods overlook the modeling of non-verbal behavior semantics between the two participants. To address this limitation, we present DiaHeads, a framework that generates the behavior of both participants jointly. The two audio streams are concatenated and decoded together, so each participant's motion is conditioned on the other, which makes the interaction part of the generation itself. We further introduce four discrete non-verbal cues, gaze-on, head shaking, nodding, and smiling, and fuse them with the continuous parameters in a shared latent space through a product-of-experts posterior. These cues carry the interaction semantics and constrain how the continuous motion is generated. A flow-based prior over the shared latent variable replaces the standard Gaussian prior and makes the latent motion temporally dependent. These designs therefore yield coordinated 3D dialogue heads. To support this task we build CANDOR-FG, a dialogue corpus derived from CANDOR and augmented with synchronized FLAME parameters and 3D gaze for both interlocutors. Experiments on CANDOR-FG show that DiaHeads achieves competitive per-participant fidelity and substantial gains in interpersonal coordination over single-speaker and dyadic baselines. In addition, ablations confirm that joint generation, the flow-based prior, and multi-cue supervision are the sources of this coordination. Finally, a user study shows that the advantage of DiaHeads comes from perceived interactional coordination rather than from raw motion fidelity alone.
zh_title: DiaHeads：从双音频联合生成具有非语言线索的协调3D对话头部
translation: 音频驱动的3D头部动画在生成真实感方面取得了相当大的进展，然而为双人对话生成协调行为仍然很困难，因为当前的对话头部生成方法忽视了两名参与者之间非语言行为语义的建模。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了DiaHeads，一个联合生成两名参与者行为的框架。将两个音频流连接并共同解码，使每个参与者的动作都以对方为条件，从而使交互成为生成本身的一部分。我们进一步引入了四种离散的非语言线索：注视、摇头、点头和微笑，并通过专家乘积后验将它们与共享潜空间中的连续参数融合。这些线索承载了交互语义并约束了连续动作的生成方式。共享潜变量上的基于流的先验取代了标准高斯先验，使潜动作具有时间依赖性。因此，这些设计产生了协调的3D对话头部。为了支持这项任务，我们构建了CANDOR-FG，这是一个衍生自CANDOR的对话语料库，并为双方增强了同步的FLAME参数和3D注视。在CANDOR-FG上的实验表明，与单说话人和双人基线相比，DiaHeads实现了具有竞争力的单参与者保真度，并在人际协调方面取得了实质性提升。此外，消融实验证实了联合生成、基于流的先验和多线索协调是这种协调性的来源。最后，用户研究表明，DiaHeads的优势来自于可感知的交互协调，而不仅仅是原始动作的保真度。
tldr: 本文提出了DiaHeads框架，通过联合处理双音频、融合离散非语言线索与流基先验，实现了高度协调的双人3D对话头部动画生成，并构建了配套的CANDOR-FG数据集。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出了基于双音频联合生成的DiaHeads框架，用于解决双人对话中3D头部动画的非语言互动协调问题。通过引入四种离散非语言线索以及基于流的先验，并构建了新的CANDOR-FG数据集，显著提升了对话双方行为的互动性和真实感，对数字人对话及社交交互研究具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的音频驱动3D头部动画在单人生成方面取得了进展，但由于忽视了双人参与者之间的非语言行为语义建模，导致在生成双人对话的协调行为时仍然非常困难。
method: 提出DiaHeads框架，将两个音频流拼接并共同解码，使每个参与者的动作均以对方为条件；引入四种离散非语言线索（注视、摇头、点头、微笑），通过专家乘积后验将其与共享潜空间中的连续参数融合；采用基于流的先验代替标准高斯先验以捕捉动作的时序依赖性。并构建了包含同步FLAME参数和3D注视的CANDOR-FG对话语料库。
results: 在CANDOR-FG数据集上的实验表明，DiaHeads在保持单人动作保真度的同时，在人际协调性方面取得了显著提升；消融实验证实了联合生成、基于流的先验和多线索监督是实现良好协调的关键；用户研究表明其优势主要源于可感知的互动协调性。
conclusion: DiaHeads框架通过联合生成双音频、引入离散非语言线索及流基先验，成功解决了双人对话3D头部动画中的互动协调难题，并在CANDOR-FG数据集上取得了优于现有基线的性能。

title: BlockLock: Reproducible LLM Inference with Fixed Batch Geometry
authors: Xiuyuan Qi, Pedro Reviriego, Javier Conde, Shanshan Liu
abstract: Reproducible LLM inference requires that a request produces the same output regardless of the other requests in the batch. Existing solutions pay for this in different ways: batch-invariant kernels constrain every operator, and isolating prefill with fixed-shape decode ({our CoRun-style baseline}) gives up shared prefill compute and pads decode. We present BlockLock, which keeps shared batched prefill and pins only the numerical path of the protected request: it fixes the geometry that the request sees, with {two modes: BlockLock-Rows uses fixed-width rows and retains batched decode of all requests; BlockLock-Pack uses terminal-anchored packing with an isolated dummy segment, then extracts the protected request's KV state for target-only decode. Under a stated per-deployment contract, both modes preserve the target's output bitwise when its companions change.} Across five {dense} models (Qwen3-8B/14B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and Gemma-3-4B/12B-IT) and three single-GPU deployments (NVIDIA A6000, A100, and H100), we evaluate our approach on both tinyBenchmarks and BFCL{; we also include initial tensor-parallel experiments on two NVIDIA A6000 GPUs. Both modes preserve target sequences and Top20-logit bits in the reported tests.} At equal delivered work, {BlockLock-Rows} reduces latency by 53.5--55.0\% and improves throughput by 115.2--122.2\% relative to vLLM Batch-Invariant; compared with batch-invariant kernels, it needs no custom kernel implementations and constrains only the protected requests.
zh_title: BlockLock：基于固定批几何形状的可复现大语言模型推理
translation: 大语言模型（LLM）推理的可复现性要求一个请求无论批次中的其他请求如何，都能产生相同的输出。现有的解决方案以不同的方式付出了代价：批不变内核约束了每一个算子，而用固定形状解码隔离预填充（我们的 CoRun 风格基线）则放弃了共享的预填充计算并填充了解码。我们提出了 BlockLock，它保持了共享的批处理预填充，并且仅锁定受保护请求的数值路径：它固定了请求所看到的几何形状，具有两种模式：BlockLock-Rows 使用固定宽度行并保留所有请求的批处理解码；BlockLock-Pack 使用带有隔离虚拟段的终端锚定打包，然后提取受保护请求的 KV 状态用于目标专属解码。在既定的每部署契约下，当伴随请求改变时，这两种模式都能在比特级别上保持目标的输出。在五个密集模型（Qwen3-8B/14B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Gemma-3-4B/12B-IT）和三个单 GPU 部署（NVIDIA A6000、A100 和 H100）上，我们在 tinyBenchmarks 和 BFCL 上评估了我们的方法；我们还包括了在两个 NVIDIA A6000 GPU 上的初始张量并行实验。这两种模式在报告的测试中都保留了目标序列和 Top20-logit 比特位。在提供相同工作量的情况下，与 vLLM 批不变（Batch-Invariant）相比，BlockLock-Rows 将延迟降低了 53.5--55.0%，并将吞吐量提高了 115.2--122.2%；与批不变内核相比，它不需要自定义内核实现，并且仅约束受保护的请求。
tldr: BlockLock 提出了一种固定批几何形状的方法，在实现大语言模型推理输出的比特级可复现性的同时，大幅提升了推理吞吐量并降低了延迟。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种名为BlockLock的方法，通过固定批处理几何形状来实现大语言模型（LLM）推理的可复现性，而无需修改所有算子或放弃共享预填充计算。这在保证输出比特级一致性的同时，大幅提升了推理吞吐量并降低了延迟，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 现有的 LLM 推理可复现性解决方案存在缺陷：批不变内核对每个算子都有限制，而隔离预填充和固定形状解码则放弃了共享预填充计算并填充了解码。为了解决这一问题，需要一种既能保持共享批处理预填充又能确保目标请求数值路径不变的方法。
method: 提出 BlockLock 方法，包含两种模式：BlockLock-Rows 使用固定宽度行并保留所有请求的批处理解码；BlockLock-Pack 使用带隔离虚拟段的终端锚定打包，然后提取目标请求的 KV 状态进行目标专属解码。
results: 在同等工作量下，BlockLock-Rows 相比 vLLM Batch-Invariant 将延迟降低了 53.5--55.0%，并将吞吐量提高了 115.2--122.2%；两种模式在所有测试中均能保持目标序列和 Top20-logit 比特位一致。
conclusion: BlockLock 能够有效实现大语言模型推理的比特级可复现性，同时在延迟和吞吐量方面显著优于现有的批不变（batch-invariant）方法，且无需定制内核实现。

title: On the Opportunities and Challenges of Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-Model Transfer
authors: Zhenyi Shen, Junru Lu, Wei Liu, Jiangnan Ye, Jiazheng Li, Di Yin, Xing Sun, Tameem Adel, Yali Du, Lin Gui, Yulan He
abstract: Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-model Transfer (PACT), a form of latent communication between language models, combines a larger model's prompt representations with a smaller model's efficient generation, offering a promising way to balance capability and inference cost. However, existing systems provide limited support for independently evaluating large-small model collaboration, and improved task performance alone does not establish whether the receiver benefits from the sender's information. We introduce PLatour, an open-source PACT framework that connects frozen models through lightweight, zero-initialized linear bridges trained directly with task rewards and supports hybrid-attention architectures. PLatour significantly outperforms open-source baselines on generation tasks and surpasses Mostik's reported results on shared mathematics and coding benchmarks using a substantially smaller sender. However, controlled experiments show that the gains on some tasks can be reproduced by uninformative sender signals, self-communication, or receiver-only training. We find that trainable bridges can act as parameter-efficient adaptation mechanisms without exploiting useful sender information. We therefore propose PACT-Check to quantify how much of a trained PACT system's gain genuinely comes from communication. Finally, we discuss the opportunities and challenges of PACT systems. Code is available at https://github.com/zhenyi4/platour.
zh_title: 论预填充到自回归跨模型转移的机会与挑战
translation: 预填充到自回归跨模型转移（PACT）作为语言模型间的一种潜在通信形式，结合了较大模型的提示表示与较小模型的高效生成，为平衡能力与推理成本提供了一条有前景的途径。然而，现有系统对独立评估大、小模型协作的支持有限，且单纯的任务性能提升并不能证明接收者确实受益于发送者的信息。我们介绍了 PLatour，这是一个开源的 PACT 框架，它通过直接用任务奖励训练的轻量级、零初始化线性桥接器连接冻结模型，并支持混合注意力架构。PLatour 在生成任务上显著优于开源基线，并在使用显著较小的发送者的情况下，超越了 Mostik 在共享数学和编码基准上报告的结果。然而，控制实验表明，某些任务上的收益可以通过无信息发送者信号、自通信或仅接收器训练来复现。我们发现，可训练的桥接器可以充当参数高效的适配机制，而无需利用有用的发送者信息。因此，我们提出了 PACT-Check 来量化训练好的 PACT 系统的收益中有多少真正来自于通信。最后，我们讨论了 PACT 系统的机遇与挑战。代码可在 https://github.com/zhenyi4/platour 获取。
tldr: 本文提出了跨模型协作框架PLatour，并指出其性能提升可能源于适配而非真正的通信，进而开发了定量评估通信效果的工具PACT-Check。
ai_comments: 本文提出了一个新颖且极具潜力的跨模型协作框架，但同时也对当前领域中盲目归因于“模型间通信”的现象进行了深刻反思和严谨的控制实验，具有重要的学术价值和方法论启示。
motivation: 平衡大语言模型的能力与推理成本，通过大模型的提示表示结合小模型的高效生成（PACT）；同时指出并解决现有系统缺乏独立评估协作效果、盲目归因于通信增益的问题。
method: 引入了PLatour（一个开源的PACT框架，通过轻量级、零初始化的线性桥接连接冻结模型，支持混合注意力架构），并提出了PACT-Check来量化真正的通信增益。
results: PLatour在生成任务上显著优于开源基线，并在共享的数学和 coding 基准测试中超越了 Mostik 的结果；然而控制实验表明，部分增益可由无信息信号、自通信或仅接收器训练复现。
conclusion: 虽然PACT系统能够通过跨模型转移提升性能，但很多增益可能来源于参数高效的适配而非真正的通信。引入PACT-Check可以有效量化通信贡献，为未来该领域的研究提供了更严谨的评估标准。

title: Uncertainty calibration in Bayesian M/EEG source imaging
authors: Ismail Huseynov, Mohammad Orabe, Srikantan Nagarajan, Stefan Haufe
abstract: M/EEG source imaging requires accurate localization and reliable uncertainty estimates, yet posterior credible regions are rarely assessed for empirical calibration. We present a simulation-based framework for uncertainty quantification and calibration of empirical Bayesian inverse methods with closed-form conditional Gaussian posterior summaries. We compare Bayesian minimum norm (BMN) with sLORETA depth weighting and sparse Bayesian learning (SBL) with sparse basis field expansions (S-FLEX). S-FLEX allows retained coefficients to contribute nonzero marginal posterior variance at locations where voxel-wise SBL yields degenerate variances. For BMN, we derive joint source- and noise-variance updates through evidence maximization. We test whether adaptive noise learning yields near-calibrated uncertainties. Both methods retain residual miscalibration, motivating post-hoc isotonic recalibration of credible-region levels using empirical coverage. Simulations assess fixed- and free-orientation models across signal-to-noise ratios (SNR), source sparsity levels, and subject-specific head models, using oracle, baseline-estimated, and adaptively learned noise. Before recalibration, SBL+S-FLEX yields lower Wasserstein localization error, smaller posterior uncertainty, and coverage closer to nominal credibility than BMN+sLORETA. Isotonic recalibration improves both methods, with larger gains for conservative BMN+sLORETA posteriors; transfer across mismatched SNR, sparsity, and head models remains condition dependent. Noise specifications yield broadly consistent reconstruction and uncertainty trends within each estimator. In real auditory MEG data, SBL+S-FLEX provides more focal localization and tighter uncertainties than BMN+sLORETA, suggesting greater statistical power for identifying bilateral auditory sources.
zh_title: 贝叶斯M/EEG源成像中的不确定性校准
translation: M/EEG源成像需要精确的定位和可靠的不确定性估计，然而后验可信区域很少进行经验校准。我们提出了一种基于模拟的框架，用于对具有闭式条件高斯后验摘要的经验贝叶斯反演方法进行不确定性量化和校准。我们比较了采用sLORETA深度加权的贝叶斯最小范数（BMN）与采用稀疏基场扩展（S-FLEX）的稀疏贝叶斯学习（SBL）。S-FLEX允许保留的系数在体素级SBL产生简并方差的位置贡献非零的边际后验方差。对于BMN，我们通过证据最大化推导了联合源和噪声方差更新。我们测试了自适应噪声学习是否能产生接近校准的不确定性。这两种方法都保留了残余的错误校准，这促使使用经验覆盖率对可信区域水平进行后验等渗重新校准。模拟评估了跨信噪比（SNR）、源稀疏度水平和特定受试者头部模型的固定和自由方向模型，使用了神谕（oracle）、基线估计和自适应学习的噪声。在重新校准之前，与BMN+sLORETA相比，SBL+S-FLEX产生了更低的Wasserstein定位误差、更小的后验不确定性和更接近标称可信度的覆盖率。等渗重新校准改善了这两种方法，对保守的BMN+sLORETA后验的增益更大；跨不匹配的SNR、稀疏度和头部模型的迁移仍然取决于条件。在每个估计器内，噪声规范产生了广泛一致的重建和不确定性趋势。在真实的听觉MEG数据中，SBL+S-FLEX提供了比BMN+sLORETA更聚焦的定位和更紧密的不确定性，表明具有更大的统计功效来识别双侧听觉源。
tldr: 本文提出了一种评估和校准M/EEG贝叶斯源成像中不确定性的框架，发现SBL+S-FLEX方法在定位和不确定性估计上优于BMN+sLORETA，且后验等渗回归能有效提升校准效果。
ai_comments: 该论文针对脑磁/脑电图（M/EEG）源成像中的不确定性校准问题，提出了一个基于模拟的评估和后处理校准框架，对比了BMN和SBL两类贝叶斯反演方法，具有较强的实用价值和方法论创新。
motivation: M/EEG源成像需要准确的定位和可靠的不确定性估计，然而后验可信区域很少进行经验校准，因此需要建立一个框架来量化和校准经验贝叶斯逆方法的 ไม่确定性。
method: 提出一个基于模拟的不确定性量化与校准框架，对比了带sLORETA深度加权的贝叶斯最小范数（BMN）和带稀疏基场扩展的稀疏贝叶斯学习（SBL+S-FLEX），并采用后验等渗回归对可信区间水平进行经验覆盖校准。
results: 校准前，SBL+S-FLEX比BMN+sLORETA具有更低的Wasserstein定位误差、更小的后验不确定性和更接近标称可信度的覆盖率；等渗回归校准改善了这两种方法；在真实听觉MEG数据中，SBL+S-FLEX提供了更聚焦的定位和更紧密的不确定性。
conclusion: SBL+S-FLEX在M/EEG源成像中表现出优于BMN+sLORETA的定位精度和不确定性估计，通过等渗回归校准能进一步提升方法的可靠性。

title: Resource-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Post-Training through Elastic Expert Parallelism
authors: Jia Wei, Ziyi Qiu, Yi Xu, Xuehai Qian
abstract: Reinforcement learning post-training improves the capabilities of large language models, but generating training responses is a major computational bottleneck. In mixture-of-experts models, workers that finish their assigned responses may remain occupied because their experts are still needed by workers processing longer responses. Consequently, approximately one-third of occupied worker time in the baseline occurs after local response generation finishes. Here we present FlexFloor, a system that enables earlier resource release during synchronous response generation while preserving the expert computation required by ongoing responses. FlexFloor jointly adapts response scheduling and the active group of workers. It uses historical response lengths and memory constraints to guide batching and prompt placement, then progressively releases workers while maintaining expert availability and correct communication. Compared with the verl baseline, FlexFloor generates approximately 65.40% more response tokens per unit of occupied computing time and increases response generation throughput by 52.74%, with little observed variation in rollout reward. By making reinforcement learning post-training more efficient, FlexFloor supports faster development and iterative improvement of large language models and AI agents.
zh_title: 基于弹性专家并行的资源高效强化学习后训练
translation: 强化学习后训练提升了大语言模型的能力，但生成训练响应是一个主要的计算瓶颈。在混合专家模型中，完成指定响应的工作节点可能会继续被占用，因为处理较长响应的其他节点仍然需要它们的专家。因此，基线中约三分之一的已占用工作时间发生在本地响应生成结束之后。在这里，我们提出了FlexFloor，这是一个在同步响应生成期间实现更早资源释放的系统，同时保留了持续响应所需的专家计算。FlexFloor联合调整响应调度和活跃的工作节点组。它使用历史响应长度和内存约束来指导批处理和提示放置，然后逐步释放工作节点，同时保持专家可用性和正确的通信。与verl基线相比，FlexFloor在单位占用的计算时间内生成的响应标记增加了约65.40%，并将响应生成吞吐量提高了52.74%，且观察到的 rollout 奖励变化很小。通过提高强化学习后训练的效率，FlexFloor支持大语言模型和AI代理的更快开发和迭代改进。
tldr: FlexFloor通过弹性专家并行性，解决了大语言模型MoE强化学习后训练中的计算资源浪费问题，显著提升了生成吞吐量和资源效率。
ai_comments: 该论文针对大语言模型强化学习后训练中混合专家模型（MoE）的计算瓶颈，创新性地提出了一种弹性专家并行系统（FlexFloor），在保持专家计算需求的同时大幅提升了资源利用率和吞吐量，具有重要的实际应用价值。
motivation: 在大型语言模型的混合专家模型（MoE）强化学习后训练中，生成训练响应是一个主要的计算瓶颈。由于部分工作节点的专家仍被处理较长响应的其他节点所需，导致约三分之一的已占用工作时间浪费在本地响应生成结束之后，亟需提高资源利用效率。
method: 提出了FlexFloor系统，通过结合历史响应长度和内存约束来指导批处理和提示词放置，并在保持专家可用性和正确通信的前提下，逐步释放已完成局部响应生成的工作节点。
results: 相比于基线系统verl，FlexFloor在单位占用计算时间内多生成了约65.40%的响应Token，并将响应生成吞吐量提高了52.74%，同时 rollout 奖励没有明显变化。
conclusion: FlexFloor通过自适应的响应调度和动态的专家工作节点释放机制，有效解决了MoE模型在强化学习后训练中的计算瓶颈，显著提升了资源效率和生成吞吐量，且不影响模型性能。

title: The Two-Ledger Model: Transaction-Grain Cost Accounting for Multi-Agent AI Systems Across Clouds, Models, and Systems of Record
authors: Vivek Acharya
abstract: Enterprises run business transactions through multi-agent AI systems spanning clouds, large language models (LLMs), orchestration harnesses, and systems of record. Finance receives AI cost only at settlement grain, aggregated by SKU and charge period. The business question (what did this order, claim, or case cost in AI?) cannot be answered from billing data, because providers never see enterprise transaction boundaries. The FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification (FOCUS) gives billing data one schema across providers but remains settlement-grain even as it adds AI token and requester attribution. We formalize this grain mismatch, derive seven requirements, and propose the Two-Ledger Model: a settlement ledger of FOCUS-conformant billing data joined to an attribution ledger of invocation-grain usage records built on OpenTelemetry GenAI telemetry.
