abstract: Pure point spectral convergence is generally unavailable for sparse graph sequences, where Laplacian eigenvalues may remain unstable under graph growth. This poses challenges for analyzing spectral operators underlying many graph-based learning methods, including graph neural networks. We identify a class of sparse bipartite graph sequences for which eigenvalue-level spectral convergence can be recovered. Focusing on graphs with strong degree heterogeneity, we exploit the convergence properties of their line-graph sequences. Using a spectral correspondence between bipartite graph Laplacians and line-graph adjacency operators, we transfer convergence guarantees from dense line-graphs back to the original sparse graphs. This framework yields eigenvalue-level spectral convergence for a class of deterministic sparse graph sequences. We further analyze superlinear preferential attachment trees, establishing convergence to an infinite-dimensional limit operator. Numerical experiments empirically support our spectral convergence results.
zh_title: 稀疏二分图的谱收敛性：通过线图分析
translation: 纯点谱收敛性通常对于稀疏图序列是不可用的，其中拉普拉斯特征值在图增长下可能保持不稳定。这给分析许多基于图的学习方法（包括图神经网络）潜在的谱算子带来了挑战。我们确定了一类稀疏二分图序列，对于这类序列可以恢复特征值级别的谱收敛性。通过关注具有强程度异质性的图，我们利用了它们的线图序列的收敛性质。利用二分图拉普拉斯算子和线图邻接算子之间的谱对应关系，我们将收敛保证从密集线图转移回原始稀疏图。该框架为一类确定性稀疏图序列产生了特征值级别的谱收敛性。我们进一步分析了超线性优先依附树，建立了与无限维极限算子的收敛性。数值实验从经验上支持了我们的谱收敛结果。
tldr: 对于具有高度度异质性的稀疏二分图，可以通过分析其线图序列来恢复特征值级别的谱收敛性，并建立与无限维极限算子的收敛性。
ai_comments: 这项工作解决了稀疏图分析中的一个关键挑战，即谱收敛性的缺乏，这对于图神经网络等应用至关重要。通过巧妙地利用线图的性质，该研究提供了一个有希望的框架来恢复稀疏图的谱收敛性。然而，该方法可能仅限于具有强度异质性的特定类别的稀疏二分图，其普遍性仍有待进一步研究。
motivation: 分析基于图的学习方法（如图神经网络）的谱算子时，稀疏图序列的纯点谱收敛性通常不可用，导致拉普拉斯特征值在图增长时可能不稳定。需要为稀疏图序列恢复谱收敛性。
method: 利用具有强程度异质性的稀疏二分图的线图序列的收敛性质。通过二分图拉普拉斯算子和线图邻接算子之间的谱对应关系，将密集线图的收敛保证转移到原始稀疏图上。
results: 为一类确定性稀疏图序列实现了特征值级别的谱收敛性。分析了超线性优先依附树，并建立了与无限维极限算子的收敛性。
conclusion: 提出了一种通过线图分析来恢复稀疏二分图谱收敛性的框架，该框架适用于具有强度异质性的图，并得到了数值实验的支持。

title: Structured Agentic Learning for Persistent Spatial Acquisition in RDT-TAIS-Assisted Communications
authors: Bin Liu, Wei Ni, Tommy Svensson, Sofie Pollin
abstract: Persistent TAIS operation can reduce repeated radio-information acquisition by reusing environmental knowledge across control intervals. This knowledge changes with radio-environment evolution and current communication task. This paper studies persistent spatial knowledge maintenance for TAIS control and formulates it as a sequential information-acquisition problem that maximizes effective communication performance while accounting for physical-acquisition overhead under an outage-reliability constraint. We develop structured agentic spatial intelligence (ASI), which realizes a communication-oriented agent that maintains persistent spatial knowledge, forms beliefs from radio and context observations, and adapts physical information acquisition through closed-loop interaction with the radio environment. By jointly exploiting radio-consistent context inference, temporal knowledge-sufficiency assessment, graph-structured regional reasoning, and predictive outage-risk feedback, structured ASI determines when additional acquisition is needed, where it is directed, and how much physical information is sufficient before stopping or escalating to full radio-environment reacquisition. Numerical results show that structured ASI improves the effective rate by 2.59% while reducing acquisition overhead by 25.0% at six structural changes per 100 control intervals, and achieves a 2.82% effective-rate gain with a 41.8% overhead reduction over a heterogeneous 400-interval mission.
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to IEEE Conference for possible publication
zh_title: 在RDT-TAIS辅助通信中用于持久空间获取的结构化代理学习
translation: 持久的TAIS操作可以通过跨控制区间重用环境知识来减少重复的无线电信息获取。这些知识会随着无线电环境的演变和当前的通信任务而变化。本文研究了用于TAIS控制的持久空间知识维护问题，并将其构建为一个序列信息获取问题，旨在最大化有效的通信性能，同时在停电可靠性约束下考虑物理获取的开销。我们开发了结构化代理空间智能（ASI），它实现了一个通信导向的代理，能够维护持久的空间知识，从无线电和上下文观测中形成信念，并通过与无线电环境进行闭环交互来调整物理信息获取。通过联合利用无线电一致的上下文推理、时间知识充足性评估、图结构化区域推理和预测性停电风险反馈，结构化ASI能够确定何时需要额外的获取，其方向是什么，以及在停止或升级到完全无线电环境重新获取之前，多少物理信息是足够的。数值结果表明，在每100个控制区间出现六次结构变化的情况下，结构化ASI将有效速率提高了2.59%，同时将获取开销降低了25.0%，并在异构的400个控制区间任务中实现了2.82%的有效速率增益和41.8%的开销降低。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种结构化代理空间智能（ASI）方法，用于在通信任务中维护和更新环境知识，以提高通信性能并减少信息获取开销。
ai_comments: 该研究在动态无线电环境中实现了高效的空间知识获取和维护，提出了一种新颖的结构化代理空间智能（ASI）方法。其创新性在于通过闭环交互和多方面推理来优化信息获取策略，有效平衡了通信性能和资源开销。然而，该方法在复杂或高度动态的环境下的鲁棒性和可扩展性仍有待进一步验证。
motivation: 为了在通信任务中持续有效地获取和维护空间知识，同时在不断变化的无线电环境中考虑信息获取的开销和可靠性约束。
method: 提出结构化ASI，它通过闭环交互与无线电环境进行交互，形成对无线电环境的信念，并根据需要进行物理信息获取。该方法结合了上下文推理、知识充足性评估、区域推理和风险反馈，以确定何时、何地以及获取多少信息。
results: 结构化ASI在六次结构变化/100个控制区间的情况下，有效速率提高了2.59%，获取开销降低了25.0%；在异构的400个控制区间任务中，有效速率提高了2.82%，开销降低了41.8%。
conclusion: 结构化ASI能够有效地在动态环境中维护空间知识，提高通信性能，并显著降低信息获取的开销。

title: Geometry-Aware Channel Aging in MIMO Systems: When Is Kronecker Separability Enough?
authors: Steven Rivetti, Gabor Fodor, Emil Bjornson, Mikael Skoglund
abstract: This letter investigates when Kronecker-separable spatial correlation approximates the covariance of multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) channels. We propose a geometry-aware channel model in which the same propagation environment determines both the Weischelberger spatial coupling matrix and the temporal correlation coefficient. The propagation environment follows a 3GPP-inspired clustered channel model. We consider a MIMO system affected by symbol-level channel aging caused by the user equipment's mobility. We schedule both uplink and downlink pilots, thereby deriving the respective spectral efficiencies (SEs) in the presence of imperfect channel state information. Numerical results show that channel aging's magnitude is strongly geometry-dependent, with diffuse propagation inducing greater temporal decorrelation and SE degradation than concentrated scattering. The results also identify regimes where Kronecker separability can be applied and regimes where geometry-aware Weischelberger coupling is needed.
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to IEEE Wireless Communication Letters
zh_title: MIMO系统中的几何感知信道老化：克罗内克可分离性何时足够？
translation: 这封信函探讨了克罗内克可分离空间相关性何时能近似多输入多输出（MIMO）信道的协方差。我们提出了一个几何感知信道模型，其中相同的传播环境决定了Weischelberger空间耦合矩阵和时间相关系数。传播环境遵循3GPP启发的聚类信道模型。我们考虑了一个受用户设备移动性引起的符号级信道老化影响的MIMO系统。我们调度了上行和下行导频，从而在存在不完美信道状态信息的情况下推导出各自的频谱效率（SE）。数值结果表明，信道老化的程度强烈依赖于几何，其中漫射传播比集中散射导致更大的时间去相关和SE退化。结果还确定了可以应用克罗内克可分离性的范围以及需要几何感知Weischelberger耦合的范围。
tldr: 本文研究了MIMO系统中克罗内克可分离空间相关性何时能近似信道协方差，并提出了一个几何感知信道模型。结果表明信道老化程度与几何密切相关，并确定了何时适用克罗内克可分离性以及何时需要几何感知Weischelberger耦合的条件。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地将几何感知引入MIMO信道老化分析，并探讨了克罗内克可分离性模型的适用边界。这对于理解复杂无线环境下的信道行为和优化MIMO系统设计具有重要意义，尤其是在高移动性场景下信道状态信息获取和利用方面。
motivation: 本文旨在研究克罗内克可分离空间相关性何时能近似多输入多输出（MIMO）信道的协方差。
method: 本文提出了一个几何感知信道模型，其中相同的传播环境决定了Weischelberger空间耦合矩阵和时间相关系数。传播环境遵循3GPP启发的聚类信道模型。研究了受用户设备移动性引起的符号级信道老化影响的MIMO系统，并调度了上行和下行导频，从而在存在不完美信道状态信息的情况下推导出各自的频谱效率（SE）。
results: 数值结果表明，信道老化的程度强烈依赖于几何，其中漫射传播比集中散射导致更大的时间去相关和SE退化。结果还确定了可以应用克罗内克可分离性的范围以及需要几何感知Weischelberger耦合的范围。
conclusion: 信道老化的程度强烈依赖于传播环境的几何特性，漫射传播会引起更显著的时间去相关和频谱效率下降。在某些情况下，克罗内克可分离性足以近似信道协方差，而在其他情况下则需要更精细的几何感知Weischelberger耦合模型。

title: Improving the Clinical Generalizability of Machine Learning-Based Alzheimer's Disease Detection Across Domains and Modalities: A Comprehensive Review
authors: Yingchao Huang, Yuhan Su, Xin Wang, Shanshan Yao
abstract: Objective: This review aims to provide a comprehensive synthesis of domain adaptation (DA) and domain general- ization (DG) strategies for AD detection. It focuses on their potential to improve the robustness, generalizability, and clinical reliability of ML-based diagnostic systems. Methods: We conduct a comprehensive scoping review of existing DA and DG approaches across multiple data modalities. The reviewed studies are organized according to data modality, algorithmic framework, adaptation strat- egy, clinical relevance, and reported cross-domain performance. Key methodological trends, performance gains, limitations, and remaining challenges are analyzed to identify future research directions. Results: DA and DG approaches have demonstrated encouraging improvements in cross-domain performance and model robustness. Emerging modalities, such as speech-based approaches, EEG and eye-tracking data, show great po- tential for early, accessible, and non-invasive cognitive assessments. However, important limitations remain, including insufficient external validation, limited interpretability, computational complexity, privacy concerns, and challenges in scaling to routine clinical practice. Conclusion: DA and DG provide important methodological pathways for developing more generalizable ML-based systems for AD detection. Future research should prioritize explainable, computationally efficient, privacy-preserving, and clinically validated DA/DG techniques. Strengthening these aspects will be essential for translating robust AI- based AD detection tools into clinically deployable solutions.
comment: This paper has been accepted by the Journal of Alzheimer's Disease
zh_title: 跨域跨模态提升基于机器学习的阿尔茨海默病检测临床泛化能力：全面综述
translation: 目标：本综述旨在全面综合阿尔茨海默病（AD）检测中的域适应（DA）与域泛化（DG）策略，重点探讨其在提升基于机器学习（ML）的诊断系统的鲁棒性、泛化能力和临床可靠性方面的潜力。方法：我们对多种数据模态下的现有DA和DG方法进行了全面的范围综述。根据数据模态、算法框架、适应策略、临床相关性和报告的跨域性能对所审查的研究进行了组织。分析了关键的方法论趋势、性能提升、局限性和剩余挑战，以确定未来的研究方向。结果：DA和DG方法在提高跨域性能和模型鲁棒性方面表现出令人鼓舞的改进。新兴模态（如基于语音的方法、EEG和眼动数据）在早期、可及且无创的认知评估中显示出巨大潜力。然而，仍存在重要的局限性，包括外部验证不足、可解释性有限、计算复杂性、隐私问题以及扩展到常规临床实践的挑战。结论：DA和DG为开发更具泛化能力的基于ML的AD检测系统提供了重要的方***途径。未来的研究应优先考虑可解释、计算高效、保护隐私且经过临床验证的DA/DG技术。加强这些方面对于将强大的基于AI的AD检测工具转化为临床可部署的解决方案至关重要。
tldr: 本文综述了域适应和域泛化技术在提升阿尔茨海默病机器学习检测系统跨模态与跨域泛化能力方面的应用、成效与挑战。
ai_comments: 该综述系统地梳理了域适应（DA）和域泛化（DG）在阿尔茨海默病（AD）检测中的应用，重点关注跨模态与跨域的泛化能力，对于推动AI辅助医疗走向临床具有重要意义。
motivation: 旨在解决机器学习驱动的阿尔茨海默病（AD）检测系统在不同领域和模态间缺乏临床泛用性和鲁棒性的问题。
method: 采用全面的范围综述方法，对不同数据模态下的域适应和域泛化方法进行了系统梳理，涵盖算法框架、适应策略、临床相关性及跨域性能。
results: DA和DG方法在提升跨域性能和模型鲁棒性方面表现出显著潜力，新兴模态如语音、脑电图（EEG）和眼动数据在早期无创评估中展现前景，但仍面临外部验证不足、可解释性有限和计算复杂度高等挑战。
conclusion: 域适应和域泛化是提升基于机器学习的AD检测系统临床可靠性的关键途径，未来研究需聚焦于可解释性、计算效率及临床验证。

title: Wireless Link Scheduling with Graph Signal Diffusion
authors: Teresa Shang, Romina Garcia Camargo, Yiğit Berkay Uslu, Alejandro Ribeiro
abstract: We solve long-horizon wireless link scheduling with per-link minimum transmission constraints. Fair distribution of resources across links and time steps requires stochastic scheduling, motivating a diffusion framework. Via imitation learning, we train a diffusion model to sample scheduling decisions, conditioning generation on the network topology and constraint levels. The parameterization is achieved through a U-Graph Neural Network (U-GNN) to leverage the relationship between graphs and wireless networks for learning. Our approach achieves near-optimal performance, maximizing sum rate while distributing allocations across different links over time horizons. The U-GNN-based diffusion model generalizes to requirements and network sizes unseen during training, demonstrating the robustness of the approach.
zh_title: 带图信号扩散的无线链路调度
translation: 我们解决了具有每链路最小传输约束的长期无线链路调度问题。跨链路和时间步长的资源公平分配需要随机调度，这促使了扩散框架的应用。通过模仿学习，我们训练了一个扩散模型来采样调度决策，并将生成过程以网络拓扑和约束级别作为条件。通过U-型图神经网络（U-GNN）实现参数化，以利用图与无线网络的关联性进行学习。我们的方法实现了近乎最优的性能，最大化总速率，同时在时间跨度内跨不同链路分配资源。基于U-GNN的扩散模型能够泛化到训练中未见的约束和网络规模，证明了该方法的鲁棒性。
tldr: 使用基于U-GNN的模仿学习扩散模型来解决无线链路调度问题，该模型能处理长期约束并实现近乎最优的性能。
ai_comments: 该研究将扩散模型和图神经网络相结合，为解决复杂的无线链路调度问题提供了一种新颖有效的方法。其泛化能力是该方法的一个显著优点。
motivation: 为了在长期无线链路调度中公平分配资源，需要随机调度，这促使了扩散框架的应用。
method: 通过模仿学习训练一个扩散模型，并使用U-Graph Neural Network (U-GNN) 进行参数化，以利用图与无线网络的关联性来学习调度决策。
results: 该方法实现了近乎最优的性能，最大化总速率，并在时间跨度内跨不同链路分配资源。模型能泛化到训练中未见的网络需求和规模。
conclusion: 基于U-GNN的扩散模型能够鲁棒地处理具有最小传输约束的长期无线链路调度问题，并实现近乎最优的性能。

title: Electromagnetically Consistent Monostatic ISAC Beamforming: Mutual Coupling, Active Mismatch and Tx-Rx Leakage in Compact Dipole Arrays
authors: Stylianos D. Asimonis, Christos Tselios, Dimitrios Tyrovolas, Ilias Politis, George K. Karagiannidis
abstract: Beamforming for integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) is usually designed on ideal array manifolds with a norm constraint on the transmit signal. In a compact monostatic transceiver this hides three antenna effects: distorted embedded patterns, beam-dependent active mismatch at the power amplifiers, and transmit-to-receive leakage that raises the radar noise floor. We build a multiport scattering model of a shared-aperture dipole array directly from method-of-moments simulations and use it to formulate a Cramer-Rao bound minimizing ISAC beamformer with multiuser SINR constraints, per-port active reflection constraints and a leakage budget, solved as a semidefinite program with a one-dimensional budget search. Full-wave evaluation shows that coupling-unaware designs miss their SINR targets by up to 6.2 dB and drive amplifiers to an equivalent VSWR above 3.3 at small spacings. For spacings from 0.3 to 0.5 wavelengths, the proposed design meets all targets with an equivalent VSWR below 2 and lowers the root Cramer-Rao bound by 32 to 53 percent for 80 dB of self-interference cancellation and by a factor of 3.4 to 5.6 for 70 dB. An independent finite-difference time-domain model of the final layout in openEMS confirms that the leakage null and the ranking of the designs are preserved.
comment: 6 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICC 2027
zh_title: 电磁一致性单基地ISAC波束成形：紧凑型偶极子阵列中的互耦、有源失配与收发泄漏
translation: 集成传感与通信（ISAC）的波束成形通常设计在理想的阵列流形上，并对发射信号施加范数约束。在紧凑的单基地收发机中，这掩盖了三种天线效应：失真的嵌入式方向图、功率放大器处与波束相关的有源失配，以及抬高雷达噪声底限的发射-接收泄漏。我们直接从矩量法仿真中构建了共享孔径偶极子阵列的多端口散射模型，并用其公式化了一个最小化克拉美-罗界的ISAC波束成形器，该波束成形器带有多用户SINR约束、每端口有源反射约束和泄漏预算，并作为带有一次一维预算搜索的半定程序来求解。全波评估表明，不考虑耦合的设计在小间距下错失了高达6.2 dB的SINR目标，并驱动放大器达到3.3以上的等效VSWR。对于0.3到0.5波长的间距，所提出的设计满足了所有目标，等效VSWR低于2，并且在80 dB的自干扰消除下将根克拉美-罗界降低了32%至53%，在70 dB下降低了3.4至5.6倍。在openEMS中对最终布局进行的独立有限差分时域模型证实，泄漏零点和设计的排序得以保留。
tldr: 提出了一种针对紧凑型ISAC阵列的电磁一致性波束成形设计，通过多端口散射模型克服了互耦、有源失配和收发泄漏带来的性能损失，显著提升了通信和雷达感知性能。
ai_comments: 该论文针对紧凑型双基地/单基地ISAC系统中的实际电磁效应（互耦、有源失配和发射-接收泄漏）进行了深入研究，创新性地构建了基于矩量法的多端口散射模型，并提出了考虑这些物理限制的波束成形设计，具有很高的工程实用价值和理论重要性。
motivation: 传统的集成传感与通信（ISAC）波束成形设计通常建立在理想的阵列流形和发射信号范数约束之上，忽略了紧凑单基地收发机中存在的三个关键天线效应：失真的嵌入式方向图、功率放大器处与波束相关的有源失配，以及抬高雷达噪声底限的发射-接收泄漏。这导致传统设计在实际紧凑阵列中性能严重退化。
method: 基于矩量法（MoM）模拟构建了共享孔径偶极子阵列的多端口散射模型，并将其转化为一个求解半定规划（SDP）结合一维预算搜索的最优化问题，以最小化克拉美-罗界（CRB），同时满足多用户SINR约束、有源反射约束和泄漏预算。
results: 全波评估表明，忽略耦合的设计在小间距下会出现高达6.2 dB的SINR目标偏差，并将放大器驱动至高于3.3的等效VSWR。而所提出的设计在0.3到0.5波长的间距下能够满足所有目标，等效VSWR低于2，在80 dB自干扰消除下将根克拉美-罗界降低了32%至53%，在70 dB下降低了3.4至5.6倍。独立的FDTD模型也验证了该设计的有效性。
conclusion: 通过所提出的电磁一致性ISAC波束成形设计，能够有效克服紧凑天线阵列中的天线效应对系统性能的负面影响，在满足通信多用户SINR和功率放大器安全约束的同时，大幅提升了雷达传感性能（降低CRB）。

title: Simulation of Refraction Through Voxel Volumes
authors: Rainier Mobley, Jean Michel Létang, Max Langer
abstract: Ray tracing in X-ray science has typically been limited to descriptions where refraction occurs only at interfaces, ignoring the refraction occurring due to the continuous variations in index of refraction in the bulk of a material, as are common in biological samples like bone. We propose a method to simulate X-ray images directly on voxel grids using curved rays. We first validate this method compared to a model with an analytical solution, and then investigate the effects of voxel size, interpolation choice, and illumination to grid alignment on a few simulated test objects. From these investigations, we make several recommendations to guide simulations using these techniques.
zh_title: 体素体积中的折射模拟
translation: X射线科学中的光线追踪通常仅限于在界面处发生折射的描述，而忽略了在材料本体中由折射率连续变化引起的折射，这种情况在骨骼等生物样本中很常见。我们提出了一种在体素网格上直接使用弯曲光线模拟X射线图像的方法。我们首先将该方法与具有解析解的模型进行比较验证，然后研究了体素大小、插值选择以及照明到网格对齐对几个模拟测试对象的影响。通过这些研究，我们提出了一些建议来指导使用这些技术的模拟。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种在体素网格上直接模拟X射线成像的方法，考虑了材料内部折射率连续变化引起的折射效应，这在生物样本中很常见，并对模拟参数进行了优化和建议。
ai_comments: 这项研究提出了一种在X射线成像模拟中考虑材料内部折射率连续变化引起的折射效应的新颖方法，这对于生物样本等应用具有重要意义。该方法通过在体素网格上使用弯曲光线进行模拟，并进行了详细的参数影响分析和优化建议，为未来的相关研究奠定了基础。然而，模拟的计算效率和在真实复杂场景下的适用性仍有待进一步验证。
motivation: 传统的X射线科学中的光线追踪方法忽略了材料内部折射率连续变化引起的折射效应，而这种效应在生物样本（如骨骼）中很常见。因此，需要一种新的方法来模拟这种效应。
method: 提出了一种在体素网格上直接使用弯曲光线模拟X射线图像的方法。首先与具有解析解的模型进行验证，然后研究了体素大小、插值选择以及照明与网格对齐对模拟测试对象的影响。
results: 通过模拟研究了体素大小、插值选择和照明到网格对齐对X射线成像的影响，并为使用这些技术的模拟提供了指导性建议。
conclusion: 研究提出了一种新的X射线模拟方法，考虑了材料内部折射率的连续变化，并为优化模拟参数提供了指导。

title: Core-Lock Scheduling for 5G NR LDPC Decoders
authors: N. Papageorgiou, V. Paliouras
abstract: Accelerating iterative LDPC decoding while preserving error-correction reliability is a critical challenge in latency-constrained 5G New Radio (NR) and non-terrestrial networks. This paper proposes a hardware-efficient core-lock scheduling mechanism that evaluates the core syndrome weight after each layer update to selectively bypass extension layers. With the selected threshold $θ{=}0.20$, the mechanism reduces decoding latency by up to 31.3\% when integrated with static schedules, and by up to 45.5\% compared to alternative dynamic schemes utilizing the full parity-check matrix, without block error rate (BLER) degradation. Compared with an estimated fully parallel full-matrix checker, the core-only approach yields a 76\% reduction in shifter network area and a 73\% reduction in XOR gate count. For decoders with existing early termination, the proposed mechanism requires only a compact adder tree and a comparator.
comment: 4 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE 33rd International Conference on Electronics, Circuits and Systems (ICECS 2026). \c{opyright} 2026 IEEE
zh_title: 面向5G NR LDPC译码器的核心锁定调度
translation: 加速迭代LDPC译码，同时保持纠错可靠性，是延迟受限的5G新空口（NR）和非地面网络中的一项关键挑战。本文提出了一种硬件高效的核心锁定调度机制，该机制在每次层更新后评估核心校验子权重，以选择性地绕过扩展层。通过选择阈值$\theta=0.20$，与静态调度集成时，该机制可将译码延迟降低达31.3%，与利用完整奇偶校验矩阵的其他动态方案相比可降低达45.5%，且不会导致误块率（BLER）恶化。与估计的完全并行全矩阵检查器相比，纯核心方法使移位器网络面积减少76%，XOR门数量减少73%。对于已具备早期终止功能的译码器，所提出的机制仅需要一个紧凑的加法器树和一个比较器。
tldr: 提出一种面向5G NR LDPC译码器的核心锁定调度机制，在不降低纠错性能的前提下，显著降低了解码延迟并大幅缩减了硬件面积。
ai_comments: 该论文针对5G NR LDPC译码器提出了一种硬件高效的核心锁定调度机制，通过在每次层更新后评估核心校验子权重来选择性地绕过扩展层。该方法在不损失误块率（BLER）的前提下，显著降低了译码延迟，并大幅减少了硬件面积和逻辑门数量，展现出极高的实用价值。
motivation: 加速迭代LDPC译码，同时在受延迟限制的5G新空口（NR）和非地面网络中保持纠错可靠性是一个关键挑战。
method: 提出一种硬件高效的核心锁定调度机制，在每次层更新后评估核心校验子权重，从而选择性地绕过扩展层。
results: 在设定阈值$\theta=0.20$时，该机制在与静态调度结合时可将译码延迟减少高达31.3%，与利用完整校验矩阵的其他动态方案相比可减少高达45.5%，且没有误块率（BLER）恶化；与全并行全矩阵校验器相比，核心专用方法使移位器网络面积减少76%，XOR门数量减少73%。
conclusion: 提出的核心锁定调度机制在不牺牲纠错可靠性的前提下，成功实现了5G NR LDPC译码器的高效加速和硬件面积的大幅缩减。

title: Spectral Regimes of Truncated sinc-Power and Pulse-Train Kernels: Edge Exponents, Per-Edge Plunges, and the Landau-Widom Limit
authors: Unnikrishna Pillai
abstract: A signal band-limited to one rectangular band and observed through a finite window is the classical concentration problem of Slepian, Landau, Pollak, and Widom. The eigenvalues of the operator cluster near one and near zero, separated by a transition called the plunge. The plunge width grows like the logarithm of the window length, with a universal coefficient of one over pi squared set by the band-edge jump. This paper follows the clusters and the plunge as the band is deformed. An elementwise power of the kernel smooths the band edge, and the plunge gives way to a power-law edge with exponent one less than the power. Disjoint copies of the band widen the plunge in proportion to the number of band edges, as the multiple-interval theorem of Landau and Widom implies, so the coefficient is a per-edge constant. Shrinking each band to a line gives the classical finite-rank operator. Overlapping bands give a multilevel staircase, and a self-similar band gives a cluster hierarchy governed by the Cantor dimension. At the smooth edge, rescaled eigenvalues do not collapse onto one curve. The edge descriptor passes from a constant to an exponent to an integer to a fractal dimension. For the single band, classical results place all eigenfilter zeros on the unit circle, with more of them inside the band as the order rises, so the dominant eigenvectors act as lowpass filters.
zh_title: 截断sinc-幂核与脉冲序列核的谱态：边缘指数、单边跃变与Landau-Widom极限
translation: 受限于单个矩形频带并通过有限窗口观测的信号是Slepian、Landau、Pollak和Widom的经典浓度问题。算子的特征值聚集在1和0附近，由称为跃变的过渡区隔开。跃变宽度随窗口长度的对数增长，其通用系数由频带边缘跃变决定的$1/\pi^2$给出。本文研究了当频带变形时，这些团簇和跃变的行为。核的逐元素幂次平滑了频带边缘，使跃变让位于幂律边界，其指数比幂次小一。正如Landau和Widom的多重区间定理所暗示的那样，频带的不相交副本来按频带边缘的数量成比例地扩大跃变，因此该系数是一个每边的常数。将每个频带缩小为一条线就得到了经典的有限秩算子。重叠的频带给出了多级阶梯，自相似的频带给出了由康托维度控制的团簇层次结构。在平滑边缘处，重新缩放的特征值不会崩溃到一条曲线上。边缘描述符从常数过渡到指数、整数再到分形维数。对于单频带，经典结果将所有特征滤波器零点置于单位圆上，随着阶数的增加，更多零点位于频带内部，因此主导特征向量起到低通滤波器的作用。
tldr: 本文探讨了截断sinc-幂核及脉冲序列核在频带变形下的谱行为，揭示了特征值团簇、边界指数和分形结构之间的深层联系。
ai_comments: 该论文深入探讨了截断sinc-幂核与脉冲序列核的谱特性，揭示了边界指数、每边跃变以及Landau-Widom极限下的复杂谱行为，对信号处理和算子理论具有重要贡献。
motivation: 经典浓度问题关注单个矩形频带的带限信号及有限窗口观测，特征值在1和0附近聚集并由跃变区隔开。本论文旨在研究当频带发生变形（如平滑边界、多频带、自相似等）时，这些特征值团簇和跃变区的演化规律。
method: 通过分析截断sinc-幂核与脉冲序列核在不同频带变形（如逐元素幂次、不相交频带、自相似频带等）下的算子特征值行为、跃变区及谱边界特征。
results: 研究发现：元素级幂次平滑了频带边缘并导致幂律边界；不相交频带使跃变宽度与频带边缘数量成正比；自相似频带则产生了由康托维度支配的团簇层次结构；同时，边缘描述符在常数、指数、整数和分形维数之间转换。
conclusion: 通过研究不同频带变形下的算子谱，论文统一并拓展了经典浓度问题的理论，揭示了从平滑边界、多重区间到分形结构的丰富谱相图。

title: When Do Sports Leagues Stop Being Competitive? Bayesian Detection of Competitive-Balance Eras from Match-Level Data
authors: Xinran Li, Maoran Xu, Guanyu Hu
abstract: Competitive balance shapes outcome uncertainty, fan interest, and league regulation, yet standard measures summarize realized standings and cannot separate structural ability differences from match-level randomness. We develop a Bayesian framework that infers structural competitive balance from longitudinal match outcomes. Team abilities are obtained by projecting Gaussian auxiliary variables onto a graph-fused l1 polytope whose radius measures total pairwise ability variation. The projection places positive probability on exact ties, so statistically indistinguishable teams form explicit rank tiers. The radius equals realized ability variation whenever the constraint binds, linking it to parity, detectability, and structural inequality. An adaptive finite-regime model lets competitive eras recur, emerge, and disappear while team hierarchies remain season specific. Simulations show accurate recovery of regimes, radii, abilities, and tiers. Applied to 25 English Premier League seasons, the model identifies a persistent shift to a more stratified league beginning in 2005/06, with 2010/11 the only later return to the compressed regime. It also shows that a close title race can coexist with wide league-wide separation and that head-to-head results can separate clubs level on points. The framework gives leagues a model-based measure of balance to inform debates on revenue sharing and financial regulation.
zh_title: 体育联盟何时失去竞争力？基于比赛数据的竞争平衡纪元贝叶斯检测
translation: 竞争平衡塑造了比赛结果的不确定性、球迷的兴趣以及联赛规则，然而标准的衡量指标总结的是最终积分榜，无法将结构性能力差异与比赛级别的随机性区分开来。我们开发了一个贝叶斯框架，从纵向比赛结果中推断结构性竞争平衡。球队能力是通过将高斯辅助变量投影到一个图融合的l1多面体上获得的，其半径衡量了总体的两两能力变异。该投影对精确平局赋予正概率，因此统计上不可区分的球队形成显式的排名层级。当约束条件受限时，半径等于实现的能力变异，将其与势均力敌、可检测性和结构性不平等联系起来。一个自适应的有限区制模型使得竞争纪元可以循环、出现和消失，同时球队的等级体系保持在赛季特定层面。仿真表明能够准确恢复区制、半径、能力和层级。应用到25个英格兰超级联赛赛季，该模型识别出从2005/06赛季开始向分层程度更高的联赛的持久转变，其中2010/11赛季是后来唯一回到压缩区制的赛季。它还表明，激烈的冠军争夺可以与广泛的联赛整体分离并存，并且直接交锋的结果可以区分积分相同的俱乐部。该框架为各大联赛提供了一个基于模型的平衡度量标准，为关于收益共享和财务监管的讨论提供信息。
tldr: 本文开发了一个贝叶斯框架，利用比赛数据来检测体育联赛中结构性竞争平衡的演变，并成功应用于英超联赛。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的贝叶斯框架，利用比赛级别的数据来推断结构性竞争平衡，突破了传统仅依赖最终积分榜的局限。其创新在于结合图融合L1多面体投影和自适应有限区制模型，能准确识别联赛的竞争纪元，对体育经济学和联赛监管具有重要应用价值。
motivation: 标准的竞争平衡衡量指标通常只总结最终的积分榜，无法将结构性能力差异与比赛级别的随机性区分开来，因此需要一个能从纵向比赛结果中推断结构性竞争平衡的模型。
method: 开发了一个贝叶斯框架，通过将高斯辅助变量投影到图融合的l1多面体上获取球队能力，并利用自适应有限区制模型来捕捉竞争纪元的演变。
results: 仿真实验表明该模型能够准确恢复区制、半径、能力和层级；对英超25个赛季的应用发现，联赛自2005/06赛季起明显向分层化转变，且证明了激烈的争冠并不妨碍整体联赛的分化。
conclusion: 该研究成功开发了一个基于贝叶斯的竞争平衡检测框架，并通过仿真和英超实际数据验证了其有效性，揭示了联赛结构性分层的演变规律，为体育联赛的监管和收益共享提供了科学的决策工具。

title: Stay, Reposition, or Recharge: Battery-Aware Operation of Robotaxi Fleets
authors: Philipp Afèche, Saif Benjaafar, Jiayu, Zhao
abstract: Electric robotaxis are rapidly expanding from pilots to scaled commercial deployment; unlike traditional human-driven ride-hailing vehicles, they require centralized fleet control and careful management of vehicle state of charge (SoC). We study how a fleet manager should jointly make service, empty repositioning, idling, and charging decisions in such systems. We develop a continuous-time fluid model in which vehicles evolve across location-charge states, and identify two forms of charge-aware control that are absent from classic repositioning models: early return-to-depot (RTD) and charge-aware repositioning. In particular, the optimal solution admits simple threshold structures. Each location has a battery threshold such that vehicles should return to the depot to recharge when their SoC is below it and should not do so when their SoC is above it. Vehicles should not reposition below the same threshold either; above it, the choice of destination depends on whether a vehicle's SoC matches the destination's battery sensitivity, a notion we introduce in the paper. We then quantify the value of charge awareness by comparing fully charge-aware policies with charge-oblivious policies that ignore SoC in RTD and repositioning decisions. We show that the performance gap can be unbounded, driven by a dilemma between under-utilizing high-charge vehicles and over-sending low-charge vehicles to locations from which charging is costly. A numerical case study calibrated using 2025 NYC Taxi and Limousine Commission trip records illustrates these thresholds and shows that charge-aware control can generate substantial gains in a realistic urban network. Importantly, simple threshold-based heuristics recover most of the value of the fully charge-aware solution.
zh_title: 停留、重新定位或充电：电池感知型机器人出租车车队运营
translation: 电动机器人出租车正迅速从试点扩展到规模化商业部署；与传统的人力驾驶网约车不同，它们需要集中式车队控制和对车辆电量状态（SoC）的仔细管理。我们研究在这种系统中，车队经理应如何联合制定服务、空车重新定位、怠速和充电决策。我们开发了一个连续时间流体模型，其中车辆在位置-电量状态之间演变，并识别出两种在经典重新定位模型中缺失的电量感知控制形式：提前返回车库（RTD）和电量感知重新定位。特别是，最优解决方案具有简单的阈值结构。每个位置都有一个电池阈值，当车辆的SoC低于该阈值时应返回车库充电，而高于该阈值时不应返回。车辆在该阈值以下也不应重新定位；高于该阈值时，目的地的选择取决于车辆的SoC是否与目的地的电池敏感度（本文中引入的一个概念）匹配。然后，我们通过将完全电量感知策略与在RTD和重新定位决策中忽略SoC的电量无感知策略进行比较，量化了电量感知的价值。我们发现性能差距可能是无限的，这源于高电量车辆利用不足和低电量车辆过度发送到充电成本高昂的位置之间的困境。使用2025年纽约市出租车和豪华轿车委员会行程记录校准的数值案例研究说明了这些阈值，并表明电量感知控制可以在真实的城市网络中产生可观的收益。重要的是，基于简单阈值的启发式方法可以恢复完全电量感知解决方案的大部分价值。
tldr: 本文研究了电动机器人出租车车队如何根据电池电量状态（SoC）进行服务、重新定位、怠速和充电决策。它提出了一个连续时间流体模型，包含电量感知控制（提前返回车库、电量感知重新定位），并采用简单的阈值结构实现最优决策。结果表明，电量感知策略显著优于电量无感知策略，尤其在真实城市环境中，且简单的基于阈值的启发式方法也能获得大部分价值。
ai_comments: 该论文通过将电池电量状态明确整合到决策制定中，为电动机器人出租车车队的运营管理做出了重要贡献。提出的简单阈值结构使最优控制方案具有实用性和可实施性。发现简单启发式方法可以恢复大部分价值，对于实际应用尤其重要，平衡了复杂性与性能。识别出的“无限性能差距”突显了电量感知对于机器人出租车服务经济可行性和效率的关键重要性。
motivation: 电动机器人出租车正迅速扩展，需要集中式车队控制和仔细管理车辆电量状态（SoC）。本文旨在研究车队经理如何在考虑电池电量的情况下，联合制定服务、空车重新定位、怠速和充电决策，因为经典重新定位模型中缺乏电量感知控制。
method: 本文开发了一个连续时间流体模型，其中车辆在位置-电量状态之间演变，并识别出两种电量感知控制形式：提前返回车库（RTD）和电量感知重新定位。最优解决方案具有简单的阈值结构。通过比较完全电量感知策略与电量无感知策略来量化电量感知的价值。使用2025年纽约市出租车和豪华轿车委员会行程记录校准的数值案例研究进行验证。
results: 最优解决方案具有简单的阈值结构，每个位置都有一个电池阈值，用于决定车辆是否返回车库充电或重新定位。电量感知策略与电量无感知策略相比，性能差距可能是无限的，原因在于高电量车辆利用不足和低电量车辆被派往充电成本高昂位置的困境。数值案例研究表明，电量感知控制在真实的城市网络中能带来可观的收益。基于简单阈值的启发式方法可以恢复完全电量感知解决方案的大部分价值。
conclusion: 电量感知控制，特别是采用简单阈值结构，对于电动机器人出租车车队的有效运营至关重要。忽略电池电量状态会导致显著次优的性能，而实用的基于阈值的启发式方法可以实现接近最优的结果。

title: Bayesian Spatio-temporal Modeling of Multi-Site Wastewater Surveillance Data
authors: K. Ken Peng, Chengqian Xian, Charmaine B. Dean, Robert Delatolla, X. Joan Hu, Elizabeth M. Renouf
abstract: Wastewater surveillance provides population-level evidence of infectious disease activity. As surveillance expands across multiple sites, repeated measurements must be analyzed jointly while accounting for differences among sites and the public health regions they represent. We develop a Bayesian spatio-temporal framework that decomposes wastewater measurements into a shared epidemic curve, spatially correlated regional deviations, persistent site effects, and within-site temporal dependence. This hierarchical decomposition accommodates unequal observation windows and sampling schedules, allowing regional trajectories to be compared while preserving site-level heterogeneity. A direct marginal spatial covariance specification further separates the magnitude of regional variation from the strength of association between neighboring regions, providing distinct interpretations of these two sources of spatial variation. We also introduce region-specific time shifts to distinguish regional leads and lags in epidemic timing from differences in signal levels and local fluctuations. Simulation studies demonstrate the recovery of these components and show that omitting true time shifts can lead to increased estimates of residual temporal variation. Application to Ontario SARS-CoV-2 wastewater surveillance data reveals persistent site heterogeneity, within-site temporal dependence, and spatial association among neighboring regions. Regional timing differences are more pronounced during the first year of Omicron than in the XBB-and-later period.
zh_title: 多站点污水监测数据的贝叶斯时空建模
translation: 污水监测提供了传染病活动的群体水平证据。随着监测扩展到多个站点，必须在解释站点及其代表的公共卫生区域之间差异的同时，对重复测量进行联合分析。我们开发了一个贝叶斯时空框架，将污水测量分解为共享的流行曲线、空间相关的区域偏差、持续的站点效应以及站点内的时间依赖性。这种分层分解适应了不相等的观察窗口和采样计划，允许在保持站点水平异质性的同时比较区域轨迹。直接的边际空间协方差规范进一步将区域变异的幅度与相邻区域之间关联的强度分离开来，为这两种空间变异来源提供了不同的解释。我们还引入了区域特定的时间平移，以区分流行病定时中的区域超前和滞后与信号水平及局部波动的差异。模拟研究证明了这些成分的恢复情况，并表明省略真实的时间平移会导致残余时间变异估计值的增加。将其应用于安大略省的SARS-CoV-2污水监测数据，揭示了持续的站点异质性、站点内的时间依赖性以及相邻区域之间的空间关联。在Omicron的第一年，区域时间差异比XBB及之后的时期更为明显。
tldr: 提出了一种用于多站点污水监测数据的贝叶斯时空建模框架，能够有效分解并分析流行曲线、空间区域偏差、站点效应及时间滞后。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种贝叶斯时空建模框架，专门用于处理多点污水监测数据中的空间相关性、站点异质性及时间滞后问题，在流行病监测领域具有很高的实用价值和创新性。
motivation: 随着污水监测扩展到多个站点，需要联合分析重复测量数据，同时考虑站点间差异及其所代表的公共卫生区域的独特性质。
method: 开发了一种贝叶斯时空层次框架，将污水测量分解为共享流行曲线、空间相关区域偏差、持久性站点效应和站点内时间依赖性，并引入了区域特定的时间平移来区分流行时序。
results: 模拟研究验证了该框架对各个成分的恢复能力，且对安大略省SARS-CoV-2污水数据的应用揭示了明显的站点异质性、时间依赖性和空间关联，发现Omicron第一年的区域时间差异比XBB及之后时期更明显。
conclusion: 该贝叶斯时空框架能够有效分解污水监测数据中的多重变异源，为公共卫生决策提供了稳健的区域轨迹比较与流行病学时序分析工具。

title: Resampling-based batch reweighting for ComBat harmonization of MRI radiomic features in a multi-scanner glioma cohort
authors: Rifa Sajda Tasnim, Yushuf Sharker, Md Forhad Hossain, Rakibur Rahman, Enamul Hoque Bhuiyan
abstract: Radiomic features derived from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are sensitive to scanners; therefore, they require harmonization across scanners. In a radiomic feature dataset, some batches may be severely underrepresented compared to the others e.g., the Erasmus Glioma Database, which may provide harmonized features biased towards the larger batches in the dataset. We investigated whether reweighting underrepresented scanner batches before empirical-Bayes ComBat estimation improves feature harmonization and reduces residual scanner association while retaining grade-related information. In this retrospective, the Erasmus Glioma Database included 733 eligible patients acquired at a single center across nine vendor-by-field-strength configurations. Structural MRI acquired at 1 T, 1.5 T, and 3 T; four structural MRI sequences were analyzed. From four structural MRI sequences, 428 features were computed using an IBSI-compliant PyRadiomics implementation. The sample sizes of some scanner batches were very small compared to others, which may produce unequal precision and shrinkage of batch-effect estimates. We proposed a data augmentation approach to overcome the limitation of ComBat. We provided exploratory evidence, along with confirmatory Kruskal-Wallis tests with a Benjamini-Hochberg correction to assess the proposed method. Before harmonization, 392/428 features (91.6%) differed significantly across scanner batches (median eta-squared=0.463). Standard ComBat reduced this to 13/428 (3.0%), whereas batch-augmented ComBat reduced it to 8/428 (1.9%); the median residual effect size was <0.001 for both harmonized conditions. Batch augmentation appeared to be a useful strategy to improve the performance of ComBat for feature harmonization under severe batch-size imbalance.
comment: Original article. Submitted to Journal of Magnetic Resonance Imaging (JMRI)
zh_title: 基于重采样批次加权的胶质瘤多扫描仪队列MRI影像组学特征ComBat和谐化
translation: 磁共振成像（MRI）衍生的影像组学特征对扫描仪敏感；因此，它们需要在不同扫描仪之间进行和谐化。在影像组学特征数据集中，一些批次的代表性可能比其他批次严重不足（例如 Erasmus 胶质瘤数据库），这可能会导致和谐化特征偏向数据集中的较大批次。我们研究了在进行经验贝叶斯 ComBat 估计之前，对代表性不足的扫描仪批次进行重新加权，是否能改善特征和谐化并减少残余扫描仪效应，同时保留与分级相关的信息。在这项回顾性研究中，Erasmus 胶质瘤数据库纳入了在单一中心通过九种厂商与场强配置采集的 733 名符合条件的患者。采集了 1 T、1.5 T 和 3 T 的结构 MRI；分析了四种结构 MRI 序列。从四种结构 MRI 序列中，使用符合 IBSI 标准的 PyRadiomics 实现计算了 428 个特征。一些扫描仪批次的样本量与其他批次相比非常小，这可能会产生不相等的精度和批次效应估计收缩。我们提出了一种数据增强方法来克服 ComBat 的局限性。我们提供了探索性证据，并结合带有 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正的验证性 Kruskal-Wallis 检验来评估所提出的方法。在和谐化之前，392/428个特征（91.6%）在扫描仪批次间存在显著差异（中位 eta 平方=0.463）。标准 ComBat 将其降至 13/428（3.0%），而批次增强型 ComBat 将其降至 8/428（1.9%）；两种和谐化条件下的中位残余效应大小均小于 0.001。在严重的批次大小不平衡情况下，批次增强似乎是提高 ComBat 特征和谐化性能的有用策略。
tldr: 提出了一种基于重采样的批次加权方法，改善了多中心 MRI 影像组学特征在批次样本严重不平衡时的 ComBat 和谐化效果。
ai_comments: 该论文针对多中心、多扫描仪胶质瘤队列中影像组学特征批次大小严重不均衡的问题，提出了基于重采样的批次加权方法（Batch-augmented ComBat），有效提升了ComBat harmonization在处理小样本批次时的性能，减少了残余扫描仪效应。
motivation: 磁共振成像（MRI）提取的影像组学特征对扫描仪敏感，需要进行和谐化处理。然而，在多中心数据集中，某些扫描仪批次样本量严重不足（如 Erasmus 胶质瘤数据库），会导致标准的 ComBat 和谐化产生偏向较大批次的偏差，从而产生不等的精度和批次效应估计收缩。
method: 提出了一种数据 augmentation（基于重采样）方法，在进行经验贝叶斯 ComBat 估计之前对代表性不足的扫描仪批次进行重新加权，并使用带有 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正的 Kruskal-Wallis 检验进行评估。
results: 在和谐化之前，91.6%的特征在扫描仪批次间存在显著差异；标准 ComBat 将其降至 3.0%，而批次增强型 ComBat（Batch-augmented ComBat）进一步将其降至 1.9%，两者的中位残余效应大小均小于 0.001，且能保留与肿瘤分级相关的信息。
conclusion: 基于重采样的批次加权方法是一种在严重批次大小不平衡情况下改善ComBat特征和谐化性能的有效策略。

title: Unobserved Consideration and Consumer Welfare
authors: Debopam Bhattacharya, Ryan J. Martin
abstract: Can welfare effects of price change be identified when consumers' consideration sets are heterogeneous and unobserved? We establish that the welfare distribution is the same functional of structural choice probabilities under stable but limited consideration as under full consideration. The result permits unrestricted income-effects, preference heterogeneity, and dependence between preferences and consideration. Within this class, limited consideration admits a full-consideration representation preserving choice-probabilities and money-metric compensation: consideration/preferences can remain unidentified while demand and welfare are identified. When consideration sets contract as prices rise, the welfare distribution can be bounded using demand and a bound on choice-set attrition.
zh_title: 未观察到的考虑与消费者福利
translation: 当消费者的考虑集是异质且未被观察到时，价格变化的福利效应可以被识别吗？我们确立了在稳定但有限的考虑下，福利分布与在完全考虑下是相同的结构选择概率函数。该结果允许不受限制的收入效应、偏好异质性以及偏好与考虑之间的依赖关系。在此类别中，有限考虑允许一个保留选择概率和货币补偿的完全考虑表示：考虑/偏好可能无法识别，而需求和福利可以识别。当考虑集随价格上涨而收缩时，福利分布可以使用需求和选择集损耗的界限来限定。
tldr: 研究表明，在消费者考虑集异质且未被观察到的情况下，价格变化的福利效应可以被识别，并且福利分布在有限考虑下与在完全考虑下是相同的函数。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过建立一个理论框架，解决了在消费者考虑集不完全或未被观察到的情况下，如何评估价格变化对消费者福利影响的关键问题。其创新之处在于证明了福利分布在有限考虑下与完全考虑下是相同的函数，这极大地简化了福利分析。该方法在允许广泛的异质性和依赖性的同时，仍能识别需求和福利，具有重要的理论和实践意义。
motivation: 论文的动机是解决当消费者的考虑集是异质且未被观察到时，价格变化的福利效应是否可以被识别的问题。
method: 论文通过建立福利分布在稳定但有限考虑下与在完全考虑下是相同的结构选择概率函数来解决这个问题。它允许不受限制的收入效应、偏好异质性以及偏好与考虑之间的依赖关系，并利用一个保留选择概率和货币补偿的“完全考虑表示”来识别需求和福利。当考虑集随价格上涨而收缩时，通过需求和选择集损耗的界限来限定福利分布。
results: 福利分布在稳定但有限考虑下与在完全考虑下是相同的结构选择概率函数。该结果允许不受限制的收入效应、偏好异质性以及偏好与考虑之间的依赖关系。在特定类别中，有限考虑允许一个保留选择概率和货币补偿的完全考虑表示，这意味着考虑/偏好可能无法识别，而需求和福利可以识别。当考虑集随价格上涨而收缩时，福利分布可以使用需求和选择集损耗的界限来限定。
conclusion: 即使消费者考虑集未被观察到且异质，价格变化的福利效应仍可识别，并且福利分布在有限考虑下与完全考虑下有相同的函数形式，从而为在复杂消费者行为下评估福利提供了一种方法。

title: MSR-CP: A Modified Segmented Regression Approach to Change Point Estimation in Rainfall Patterns in West Bengal
authors: Anirban Ghosh, Raju Maiti
abstract: This study presents a methodology for detecting change point in precipitation series using a smooth version of segmented regression model. We examine several existing change point detection methods and identify their limitations in capturing gradual changes commonly observed in climate data. To address these limitations, we discuss an extension of the traditional segmented regression model enabling the detection of gradual shifts in trend. The developed methodology is further extended to accommodate dependent error structures, which are common in time series data. Extensive simulation studies are conducted to evaluate the performance and computational efficiency of the proposed approach relative to existing methods. The methodology is subsequently applied to 60 years of monsoon rainfall data from two districts of West Bengal, India. This approach offers improved insights into evolving rainfall patterns and serves as a useful tool for climate data analysis and long-term forecasting.
zh_title: MSR-CP：西孟加拉邦降雨模式变点估计的改进分段回归方法
translation: 本研究提出了一种使用平滑版分段回归模型检测降水序列变点的方法。我们检查了几种现有的变点检测方法，并指出了它们在捕捉气候数据中常见的渐变时的局限性。为了解决这些局限性，我们探讨了传统分段回归模型的扩展，使其能够检测趋势中的渐变。进一步扩展了所开发的方，以适应时间序列数据中常见的依赖误差结构。进行了广泛的模拟研究，以评估所提方法相对于现有方法的性能和计算效率。随后，该方法被应用于印度西孟加拉邦两个地区60年的季风降雨数据。这种方法为不断演变的降雨模式提供了更好的见解，并作为气候数据分析和长期预测的有用工具。
tldr: 本文提出了一种改进的分段回归方法（MSR-CP），用于准确检测降雨时间序列中的渐变趋势和变点。
ai_comments: 该论文针对传统分段回归模型在捕捉气候数据中渐变趋势的局限性，提出了MSR-CP方法，并能有效处理时间序列中的依赖误差结构，对气候变化分析具有重要应用价值。
motivation: 现有的变点检测方法在捕捉气候数据中常见的渐变趋势时存在局限性，因此需要一种更有效的方法来分析降雨模式。
method: 提出了一种改进的分段回归平滑模型（MSR-CP），用于检测渐变趋势，并扩展至适应时间序列中常见的依赖误差结构。
results: 通过广泛的模拟研究验证了该方法的性能和计算效率，并将其成功应用于印度西孟加拉邦两个地区的60年季风降雨数据中，提供了对不断变化的降雨模式的深入见解。
conclusion: 所提出的MSR-CP方法能有效检测降雨时间序列中的渐变趋势和变点，适用于长期的气候数据分析与预测。

title: Bounded GARCH Processes
authors: Wagner Barreto-Souza
abstract: We propose a novel class of Bounded GARCH (B-GARCH) processes designed to characterise the conditional heteroskedasticity of continuous time series constrained within a compact interval. While standard GARCH specifications are tailored for R-valued data, many empirical series, such as realised correlation, unemployment rates, expenditure shares, and relative humidity, are bounded. Fitting a traditional GARCH model to such data creates a severe support mismatch, frequently generating predictions and density forecasts that breach the natural boundaries of the data (boundary violation). Furthermore, conventional approaches utilising non-linear link transformations onto the real line might induce interpretability issues and estimation biases. To address these limitations, our proposed B-GARCH framework ensures a proper predictive distribution and an equation for the dynamic conditional variance with a parameter constraint that strictly preserves the bounded support of the entire process almost surely. We establish the fundamental probabilistic properties of the process, proving strict stationarity and ergodicity, and address parameter estimation via conditional maximum likelihood. The asymptotic consistency and normality of the estimators are rigorously derived, and their finite-sample performance is validated through Monte Carlo simulations. An empirical application to the monthly realised correlation between the Vanguard Real Estate ETF (VNQ) and the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT) demonstrates that B-GARCH models effectively capture volatility clustering while completely eliminating boundary violation issue that plagues traditional GARCH models.
translation: 我们提出了一类新型的有界GARCH（B-GARCH）过程，旨在刻画被限制在紧区间内的连续时间序列的条件异方差。虽然标准的GARCH模型是为实数域数据设计的，但许多实证序列（如已实现相关性、失业率、支出份额和相对湿度）都是有界的。将传统的GARCH模型拟合到此类数据会产生严重的支撑集不匹配，经常产生违反数据自然边界的预测和密度预测（边界违背）。此外，利用非线性链接变换到实数轴的传统方法可能会引起可解释性问题和估计偏差。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出的B-GARCH框架确保了适当的预测分布以及具有参数约束的动态条件方差方程，该约束几乎必然严格保持整个过程的有界支撑集。我们确立了该过程的基本概率性质，证明了严格平稳性和遍历性，并通过条件最大似然法解决了参数估计问题。严格推导了估计量的渐近一致性和渐近正态性，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证了其有限样本性能。对先锋房地产ETF（VNQ）与iShares 20年期以上国债ETF（TLT）之间月度已实现相关性的实证应用表明，B-GARCH模型有效地捕获了波动率聚集，同时完全消除了困扰传统GARCH模型的边界违背问题。
tldr: 提出了一种新型的有界GARCH（B-GARCH）模型，专门用于处理有界时间序列，彻底解决了传统GARCH模型的边界违背问题。
ai_comments: 该论文针对现实中常见的有界时间序列（如有界波动率、比例等），提出了B-GARCH模型。其创新点在于从理论和模型设计上直接保证了条件方差和预测分布严格处于紧区间内，解决了传统GARCH模型由于支撑集不匹配导致的边界违背问题，具有很强的实用价值和严谨的理论基础。
motivation: 传统的GARCH模型适用于实数域（R）数据，用于有界数据（如已实现相关性、失业率等）时会产生支撑集不匹配问题，导致预测值突破自然边界（边界违背），而现有的非线性变换方法又会导致可解释性问题和估计偏差，因此需要一种能严格保持有界支撑集的新型GARCH模型。
method: 提出了B-GARCH（Bounded GARCH）框架，确保动态条件方差方程和参数约束严格保持过程的有界支撑集；建立了其严格平稳性和遍历性等基本概率性质；采用条件最大似然估计法进行参数估计，并推导了估计量的渐近一致性和渐近正态性。
results: 蒙特卡洛模拟验证了估计器在有限样本下的性能；对VNQ和TLT ETF月度已实现相关性的实证应用表明，B-GARCH模型能有效捕获波动率聚集，同时完全消除了传统GARCH模型的边界违背问题。
conclusion: B-GARCH模型成功解决了有界时间序列的条件异方差建模问题，在理论上证明了其平稳性和渐近性质，并通过模拟和实证分析证明了其优越性。

title: Fast Functional Clustering via Closed-Form Covariance Updates
authors: Yu Wang, Jiaze Guo, Yao Chen, Tianxiang Hao, Rongling Wu
abstract: Functional clustering identifies coordinated molecular profiles, but repeated numerical covariance optimization can make mixture-model fitting computationally demanding. We develop a fast functional clustering procedure for joint analysis across conditions, combining linear mean profiles on a standardized log niche coordinate with first-order structured antedependence (SAD(1)) covariance. Weighted residual statistics yield closed-form conditional covariance updates under four parameter-sharing specifications, while an innovation representation simplifies likelihood evaluation. In same-R comparisons with numerical optimization of identical conditional objectives, the closed-form solver was 91.5--201.4 times as fast, with objective agreement in all 60 targets. Under matched complete mixture fits, it achieved a 1.87--2.37-fold speedup with identical cluster assignments. Recovery simulations showed higher module classification accuracy and lower mean-curve error than $K$-means and a Gaussian mixture with shared full covariance when the mean structure was correctly specified. SAD(1) provided an additional recovery gain under strong residual correlation, whereas curved-mean controls identified the importance of an appropriate mean family. Applications to single-condition gut microbiota, paired leaf--root microbiota and three-visit human gut multi-omics illustrate the framework across different numbers of conditions. Closed-form covariance estimation makes joint functional clustering substantially faster while retaining the fitted model's likelihood and assignments.
zh_title: 快速函数聚类通过闭式协方差更新
translation: 函数聚类识别协调的分子谱，但重复的数值协方差优化会使混合模型拟合在计算上变得要求很高。我们开发了一种快速的函数聚类程序，用于跨条件的联合分析，将标准化对数生态位坐标上的线性均值曲线与一阶结构先验（SAD(1)）协方差相结合。加权残差统计量在四种参数共享规范下产生闭式条件协方差更新，而创新表示简化了似然评估。在与相同条件下的数值优化相同的条件目标进行比较中，闭式求解器速度快了91.5-201.4倍，在所有60个目标中目标值一致。在匹配的完整混合模型拟合下，速度提高了1.87-2.37倍，聚类分配相同。恢复模拟显示，当均值结构被正确指定时，与K-means和具有共享全协方差的高斯混合模型相比，模块分类准确性更高，平均曲线误差更低。SAD(1)在强残差相关性下提供了额外的恢复增益，而曲线均值控制则确定了适当均值族的重要性。将单条件肠道微生物组、配对的叶片-根微生物组和三次访问的人类肠道多组学数据进行应用，说明了该框架在不同条件数量下的应用。闭式协方差估计使得联合函数聚类速度大大加快，同时保留了拟合模型的似然值和分配。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种快速函数聚类方法，通过闭式协方差更新来解决传统方法的计算瓶颈，并在多个数据集上验证了其效率和准确性。
ai_comments: 该研究提出的闭式协方差更新方法在函数聚类领域具有重要意义，显著提高了计算效率，为处理大规模、高维度的数据集提供了有效的解决方案。然而，对于非线性均值结构或更复杂的协方差结构，其适用性有待进一步研究。
motivation: 传统的函数聚类方法在混合模型拟合中需要重复进行数值协方差优化，计算成本高昂。本研究旨在开发一种更快速的函数聚类方法，以实现跨条件的联合分析。
method: 研究结合了标准化对数生态位坐标上的线性均值曲线和一阶结构先验（SAD(1)）协方差。通过加权残差统计量，在四种参数共享规范下实现了闭式条件协方差更新，并利用创新表示简化了似然评估。
results: 与数值优化的相同条件目标相比，闭式求解器速度提高了91.5-201.4倍，且目标值一致。在匹配的完整混合模型拟合下，速度提高了1.87-2.37倍，聚类分配相同。在均值结构正确指定的情况下，该方法在模块分类准确性和平均曲线误差方面优于K-means和具有共享全协方差的高斯混合模型。SAD(1)在残差相关性强的情况下提供了额外的恢复增益，而曲线均值控制则强调了适当均值族的重要性。
conclusion: 闭式协方差估计使得联合函数聚类速度显著加快，同时保持了拟合模型的似然值和聚类分配。

title: Necessary and sufficient conditions for the martingale property of stochastic exponentials driven by multi-dimensional diffusions
authors: Erhan Bayraktar, Hao Xing
abstract: We give necessary and sufficient coefficient conditions for stochastic exponentials driven by multidimensional diffusions to be true martingales. The classical reduction to non-exit of the diffusion with Girsanov-shifted drift separates the analysis into smooth boundary points, infinity, and nonsmooth boundary pieces. On smooth domains, under regularity and non-explosion hypotheses, martingality is equivalent to nonpositivity of the shifted Fichera drift, provided an explicit local condition holds where that drift vanishes and the stochastic integrand is unbounded. At infinity, Feller's test gives exact criteria when a scalar function of the diffusion reduces to a one-dimensional diffusion up to a time change with rate bounded above and away from zero. General radial and projection tests supply sufficient conditions. Applications give explicit necessary and sufficient conditions for inverse-CIR and $4/2$ models with correlated factors and singular stochastic integrands, including critical equality cases. The coupled non-affine examples go beyond direct scalar Feller tests and affine Riccati criteria, and exhibit boundary exits not decided by tests at infinity. Further exact criteria cover logarithmic boundary singularities, weighted distances, and an absorbed factor. The martingale conditions also yield uniqueness criteria for associated valuation equations.
comment: Keywords: Stochastic exponential; true martingale; strict local martingale; multi-dimensional diffusion; Fichera drift; Feller's test; Khasminskii's criterion; stochastic volatility; affine and Wishart processes; uniqueness for degenerate parabolic equations
zh_title: 多维扩散驱动的鞅性质的必要和充分条件
translation: 我们给出了多维扩散驱动的随机指数成为真正鞅的必要和充分系数条件。经典的约化到具有Girsanov移位漂移的扩散的非退出问题，将分析分为光滑边界点、无穷远和非光滑边界块。在光滑域上，在正则性和非爆炸假设下，鞅性质等价于移位后的Fichera漂移的非正性，前提是当该漂移消失且随机被积函数无界时，一个显式的局部条件成立。在无穷远，当扩散的一个标量函数约化为一个一维扩散（经过时间变换，且速率有界且远离零）时，Feller检验给出了精确的标准。一般的径向和投影检验提供了充分条件。应用给出了具有相关因子和奇异随机积分（包括临界等式情况）的逆CIR和4/2模型的显式必要和充分条件。耦合的非仿射例子超出了直接的标量Feller检验和仿射Riccati判据，并表现出无穷远检验无法决定的边界退出。进一步的精确标准涵盖了对数边界奇点、加权距离和一个吸收因子。鞅条件也产生了相关的评估方程的唯一性判据。
tldr: 该论文给出了多维扩散驱动的随机指数成为鞅的系数条件，并将分析分为光滑边界点、无穷远和非光滑边界块。在光滑域上，鞅性质等价于漂移的非正性，在无穷远，鞅性质等价于一维扩散的非退出。论文还提供了逆CIR和4/2模型等应用的显式条件，并讨论了相关因子、奇异随机积分以及临界等式情况。
ai_comments: 该论文在理解多维扩散驱动的随机指数的鞅性质方面取得了重要进展。通过严谨的数学分析，论文不仅给出了理论上的必要和充分条件，还将这些条件应用于具体的金融模型，具有重要的理论和实践意义。然而，论文中涉及的数学概念和推导较为复杂，可能需要专业背景的读者才能完全理解。
motivation: 该论文旨在确定多维扩散驱动的随机指数成为鞅的必要和充分条件。
method: 论文采用Girsanov变换将问题转化为具有漂移的扩散的非退出问题，并将分析分解为光滑边界点、无穷远和非光滑边界块。在光滑域上，通过分析移位后的Fichera漂移的非正性来确定鞅性质。在无穷远，利用Feller检验和径向/投影检验来获得鞅性质的判据。论文还考虑了相关因子、奇异随机积分以及临界等式情况。
results: 论文得出了多维扩散驱动的随机指数成为鞅的必要和充分系数条件。在光滑域上，鞅性质等价于移位Fichera漂移的非正性；在无穷远，鞅性质等价于一维扩散的非退出。论文还为逆CIR和4/2模型等提供了显式条件。
conclusion: 该研究为多维扩散驱动的随机指数的鞅性质提供了全面的必要和充分条件，并将这些条件应用于具体的金融模型，同时还讨论了与相关偏微分方程相关的唯一性判据。

title: Intensity-Based Estimation of Extreme Value Models for Highly Censored Data via a Latent Poisson Process
authors: Eduardo Janotti, Antonio Carlos Pedroso de Lima, Lígia Henriques-Rodrigues
abstract: Extreme value theory provides a natural framework for modelling rare events and extrapolating tail probabilities, but its direct application to survival analysis is complicated by right censoring, heterogeneous follow-up, and the need for coherent inference beyond the range of the observed data. We propose a Bayesian survival model that integrates extreme value theory with a hazard-based formulation built upon the extended generalized Pareto distribution. Rather than separating the bulk and tail of the distribution through an explicit threshold, the proposed model represents the entire hazard function within a unified parametric framework, allowing moderate and extreme survival times to be analysed simultaneously while preserving the asymptotic tail behaviour implied by extreme value theory. Inference is performed through a two-stage procedure. We further develop bias-correction procedures based on latent representative locations and adaptive partition refinement, and establish theoretical results showing the asymptotic consistency of the proposed approximation under standard regularity conditions. Simulation studies demonstrate that the methodology provides reliable uncertainty quantification across a wide range of tail regimes, censoring proportions, and sample sizes, while remaining robust under moderate model misspecification. The practical performance of the approach is illustrated through an analysis of a heart failure cohort, where the proposed model enables inference on long-term survival probabilities and tail behaviour beyond the observed follow-up period. The resulting framework offers a computationally feasible and theoretically grounded alternative for modelling censored survival data when inference on extreme survival times is of primary scientific interest.
zh_title: 通过潜泊松过程基于强度的极值模型估计高度删失数据
translation: 极值理论为建模罕见事件和外推尾部概率提供了一个自然框架，但其直接应用于生存分析时，由于右删失、异质性随访以及在观测数据范围之外进行相干推断的需求而变得复杂。我们提出了一种贝叶斯生存模型，将极值理论与基于扩展广义帕累托分布的风险公式相结合。所提出的模型不是通过显式阈值将分布的主体和尾部分离，而是在统一的参数框架内表示整个风险函数，允许同时分析中度和极端生存时间，同时保留极值理论暗示的渐近尾部行为。推断通过两阶段程序进行。我们进一步开发了基于潜代表位置和自适应划分求精的偏差校正程序，并建立了在标准正则条件下所提近似的渐近一致性的理论结果。模拟研究表明，该方法在广泛的尾部状态、删失比例和样本量下提供可靠的不确定性量化，同时在适度模型误设定下保持稳健。通过对心力衰竭队列的分析说明了该方法的实际性能，其中所提出的模型能够对超越观测随访期的长期生存概率和尾部行为进行推断。当对极端生存时间的推断具有主要的科学兴趣时，由此产生的框架为建模删失生存数据提供了一种计算可行且理论上有根据的替代方案。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的贝叶斯生存模型，结合极值理论和广义帕累托分布，用于对高度删失的生存数据进行可靠的极端生存时间和尾部概率推断。
ai_comments: 该论文将极值理论与基于风险的扩展广义帕累托分布公式相结合，提出了一种统一参数框架下的贝叶斯生存模型，有效应对了高度删失和长尾推断的问题。创新之处在于不需要通过显式阈值分离主体和尾部，且发展了基于潜代表位置和自适应划分的偏差校正程序，具有坚实的理论基础。
motivation: 极值理论为建模罕见事件和外推尾部概率提供了框架，但将其直接应用于生存分析时，面临右删失、异质性随访以及对超越观测数据范围进行相干推断的需求等复杂情况，传统的阈值选择和删失处理存在局限性。
method: 提出一个结合极值理论与扩展广义帕累托分布的贝叶斯生存模型，在统一的参数框架下表示整个风险函数；采用两阶段程序进行推断，并利用潜代表位置和自适应划分开发了偏差校正程序。
results: 理论上证明了该近似在标准正则条件下的渐近一致性；模拟研究表明该方法在各种尾部状态、删失比例和样本量下均能提供可靠的不确定性量化，对模型错误设定具有稳健性；在心脏衰竭队列分析中成功实现了对超长随访期的长期生存概率和尾部行为的推断。
conclusion: 本文提出了一种基于潜泊松过程的强度估计极值模型，能够有效对高度删失的生存数据进行极端生存时间和尾部行为的推断，在模拟研究和实际心脏衰竭队列分析中均表现出良好的性能。

title: On consistency of optimal portfolio choice for state-dependent exponential utilities
authors: Edoardo Berton, Marzia De Donno, Marco Maggis
abstract: In a complete Brownian market, we characterize consistency across investment horizons for state-dependent exponential utilities. We show that consistency is equivalent to an explicit relation between the drift and diffusion of risk tolerance and a deterministic absolutely continuous function. Within this family, the forward performance property selects a unique coefficient. More generally, under the stated admissibility conditions, a forward performance is consistent, whereas consistency alone does not imply the forward performance property.
zh_title: 关于状态依赖指数效用最优投资组合选择的一致性
translation: 在一个完备的布朗市场中，我们刻画了状态依赖指数效用在不同投资期限之间的一致性。我们证明了这种一致性等价于风险容忍度的漂移和扩散与一个确定性绝对连续函数之间的显式关系。在这个函数族中，向前绩效性质选择了一个唯一的系数。更一般地，在规定的允许性条件下，向前绩效是具有一致性的，然而仅有一致性并不能蕴含向前绩效性质。
tldr: 本文研究了状态依赖指数效用下最优投资组合选择的跨期一致性，证明了其与风险容忍度显式关系等价，并厘清了其与向前绩效性质的联系。
ai_comments: 该论文在状态依赖指数效用的框架下，深入探讨了最优投资组合选择在投资期限上的时间一致性问题，通过建立风险容忍度漂移与扩散之间的显式关系，为金融数学中的向前绩效理论（forward performance）提供了重要的理论补充。
motivation: 探究在完备布朗市场中，状态依赖指数效用函数在不同投资期限（investment horizons）下保持最优投资组合选择一致性的充要条件及其与向前绩效（forward performance）之间的内在联系。
method: 在完备布朗市场中，通过数学推导和特征刻画方法，分析状态依赖指数效用在不同投资期限下的持久一致性，并检验其与向前绩效性质的关系。
results: 研究表明，一致性等价于风险容忍度的漂移和扩散与一个确定性绝对连续函数之间的显式关系。在此类函数中，向前绩效性质可唯一确定一个系数；在允许性条件下，向前绩效总是具有一致性，但一致性并不必然蕴含向前绩效性质。
conclusion: 在完备布朗市场中，状态依赖指数效用的投资期限一致性等价于风险容忍度与确定性函数之间的特定显式关系，且向前绩效性质能够唯一确定该系数，但一致性本身并不能反推出向前绩效性质。

title: A Rough Instantaneous Squared VIX Model for Term Structure and Option Pricing
authors: Tianfeng Yang, Wen Su, Blanka Horvath
abstract: The VIX term structure provides forward-looking measures of market uncertainty across horizons, while VIX options allow investors to hedge volatility risk. This paper proposes a rough instantaneous squared VIX (RISVIX) model by introducing fractional memory into the conventional Markovian framework. We derive an explicit representation of the VIX term structure governed by Mittag--Leffler decay and a semi-closed-form pricing formula for VIX options based on an affine Fourier--Laplace transform. These results support a two-step calibration procedure that estimates memory, mean reversion, and date-specific initial states from VIX term-structure indices before calibrating the remaining distributional parameters to VIX option prices. Using daily VIX term-structure indices and VIX option quotes from January 2018 to June 2025, we find that RISVIX improves upon the Markovian benchmark in fitting the VIX term structure, with larger gains during elevated-volatility periods and for its slope and curvature. RISVIX also improves out-of-sample option pricing, reducing MSE and MAE by 13.06\% and 6.33\%, respectively, with larger gains at shorter maturities and in high-VIX states. These findings suggest that the gains from fractional memory are particularly pronounced when volatility is elevated and can be obtained within a tractable direct model of VIX derivatives. Comparisons with additional benchmarks from the recent literature also show improvements to varying degrees in both VIX term-structure fitting and option pricing.
zh_title: 一种用于期限结构和期权定价的粗糙瞬时平方VIX模型
translation: VIX期限结构提供了跨期限的市场不确定性前瞻性度量，而VIX期权则允许投资者对冲波动率风险。本文通过将分数阶记忆引入传统的马尔可夫框架，提出了一种粗糙瞬时平方VIX（RISVIX）模型。我们推导出了由Mittag-Leffler衰减控制的VIX期限结构的显式表示，以及基于仿射傅里叶-拉普拉斯变换的VIX期权半闭式定价公式。这些结果支持了一个两步校准程序，该程序首先从VIX期限结构指数中估计记忆、均值回归和特定日期的初始状态，然后将剩余的分布参数校准到VIX期权价格。使用2018年1月至2025年6日的每日VIX期限结构指数和VIX期权报价，我们发现RISVIX在拟合VIX期限结构方面优于马尔可夫基准模型，在波动率上升期以及期限结构的斜率和曲率上增幅更大。RISVIX还改善了样本外的期权定价，将MSE和MAE分别降低了13.06%和6.33%，其中在较短期限和高VIX状态下的增益更大。这些发现表明，当波动率升高时，分数阶记忆带来的收益尤为明显，并且可以在易处理的VIX衍生品直接模型中获得。与近期文献中其他基准的比较也表明，在VIX期限结构拟合和期权定价方面均有不同程度的改进。
tldr: 本文提出了一种包含分数阶记忆的RISVIX模型，显著提升了VIX期限结构拟合和期权定价（特别是高波动率和短期期权）的准确性。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入分数阶记忆（fractional memory），成功构建了粗糙瞬时平方VIX（RISVIX）模型。这一模型不仅在数学上推导出了优雅的解析/半闭式表达（Mittag-Leffler衰减和仿射傅里叶-拉普拉斯变换），在实证上也显著提升了VIX期限结构拟合和期权定价的精度，特别是在高波动率时期和短期到期日表现突出，具有很高的学术与应用价值。
motivation: 现有的马尔可夫框架在捕捉VIX期限结构和期权定价方面存在局限，为了更好地刻画市场的不确定性和波动率风险，需要引入能够反映粗糙性和记忆性的框架。
method: 提出粗糙瞬时平方VIX（RISVIX）模型，引入分数阶记忆；利用Mittag-Leffler衰减推导VIX期限结构的显式表示；基于仿射傅里叶-拉普拉斯变换推导VIX期权的半闭式定价公式；并设计了两步校准程序。
results: 实证结果表明，与马尔可夫基准模型相比，RISVIX模型能更好地拟合VIX期限结构（尤其在波动率较高时期以及斜率和曲率上表现更优）；在样本外期权定价中，均方误差（MSE）和平均绝对误差（MAE）分别降低了13.06%和6.33%，在短期和高VIX状态下改善更明显。
conclusion: RISVIX模型通过引入分数阶记忆，有效提升了VIX期限结构拟合和期权定价的精度，特别是在高波动率时期和短期期权上表现显著。

title: Why financial prices exhibit Brownian motion despite predictable order flow: An exactly solvable nonlinear price impact model
authors: Yuki Sato, Shunta Fujiwara, Kiyoshi Kanazawa
abstract: In econophysics, there are two enigmatic empirical laws of financial market microstructure: (i) the market-order flow has predictable persistence due to metaorder splitting by institutional investors, as formulated by the Lillo--Mike--Farmer model. However, this phenomenon seems paradoxical given the diffusive and unpredictable price dynamics. (ii) The price impact $I(Q_{\rm tot})$ of a large metaorder $Q_{\rm tot}$ follows the square-root law, $I(Q_{\rm tot})\propto \sqrt{Q_{\rm tot}}$. In this Letter, we reveal why price dynamics follows Brownian motion despite predictable order flow by unifying these enigmas via an exactly solvable model. We generalize the Lillo--Mike--Farmer model to nonlinear price-impact dynamics, which is mapped to a solvable Lévy-walk model. Our exact solution shows that the price dynamics remains diffusive under the square-root law, even under persistent order flow, reflecting the finite variance of metaorder impact; our model is thus a minimal representative of the universality class of nonlinear price-impact models with finite-variance metaorder impact. This work illustrates the crucial role of the square-root law in mitigating price movements by large metaorders, leading to Brownian price dynamics, consistent with the efficient market hypothesis over long timescales.
zh_title: 为什么尽管订单流具有可预测性，金融价格仍表现为布朗运动：一个精确可解的非线性价格冲击模型
translation: 在经济物理学中，金融市场微观结构有两个神秘的经验定律：(i) 由于机构投资者的大单拆分，市场订单流具有可预测的持久性，正如 Lillo-Mike-Farmer 模型所阐述的那样。然而，鉴于扩散且不可预测的价格动态，这种现象似乎是悖论式的。(ii) 一个大单 $Q_{\rm tot}$ 的价格冲击 $I(Q_{\rm tot})$ 遵循平方根律，即 $I(Q_{\rm tot})\propto \sqrt{Q_{\rm tot}}$。在本快报中，我们通过一个精确可解的模型将这些谜题统一起来，揭示了为什么尽管订单流具有可预测性，价格动态仍遵循布朗运动。我们将 Lillo-Mike-Farmer 模型推广到非线性价格冲击动力学，并将其映射到一个可解的 Lévy-walk 模型。我们的精确解表明，在平方根律下，即使在持续的订单流下，价格动力学仍然保持扩散状态，这反映了大单冲击的有限方差；因此，我们的模型是具有有限方差大单冲击的非线性价格冲击模型普适类的极简代表。这项工作阐明了平方根律在减轻由大单引发的价格变动、导致布朗价格动态方面的关键作用，这与长期时间尺度上的有效市场假说相一致。
tldr: 该论文通过构建一个精确可解的模型，证明了大单冲击的平方根律解释了为什么具有可预测持久性的订单流仍能导致布朗运动的价格动态。
ai_comments: 该论文通过一个精确可解的非线性价格冲击模型，成功解释了金融价格呈现布朗运动而订单流具有可预测持久性这一长期存在的金融物理学悖论，揭示了平方根律在维持市场有效性中的关键作用。
motivation: 旨在解决金融市场微观结构中的一个悖论：一方面机构投资者的拆单行为导致市场订单流具有可预测的持久性，另一方面价格动态却表现为扩散且不可预测的布朗运动。
method: 将Lillo--Mike--Farmer模型推广到非线性价格冲击动力学，并将其映射到一个可解的Lévy-walk模型中进行精确求解。
results: 精确解表明，在平方根律（即有限方差的大单冲击）下，即使存在持久的订单流，价格动力学仍然保持扩散状态，与长期有效市场假说一致。
conclusion: 该研究通过将Lillo-Mike-Farmer模型推广并映射到Lévy-walk模型，证明了平方根律导致的有限方差大单冲击是金融价格保持布朗运动的根本原因，从而统一了金融市场微观结构的两个经验定律。

title: VAR-Q: Tuning-free KV Cache Quantization for Visual Autoregressive Image and Video Generation
authors: Boxun Xu, Jiaji Lu, Yuxuan Yin, Zihu Wang, Ziyue Liu, Yu Wang, Zirui Liu, Peng Li
abstract: Visual autoregressive generation spans two dominant paradigms: next-scale prediction for images and video, and next-frame prediction for video. Both decode block-by-block rather than token-by-token, yielding KV caches whose statistics diverge from those of language models. At scale, KV memory exceeds the weights and limits large-scale deployment caused by a large amount of visual tokens. Our analysis of these caches reveals three findings. First, a small set of massive-value channels carries the functional load: ablating these outlier channels collapses generation, whereas ablating a matched set of inlier channels leaves quality intact. Second, the outliers organize along two axes, feature and block, with magnitudes persistent within each cell and shifting across cells. Third, this structure arises from two independent mechanisms: projection bias and RoPE-induced scattering. Guided by these findings, we propose VAR-Q, a tuning-free KV-cache quantization framework that groups along the same two axes. The generation loop provides block boundaries for free, removing the need for outlier detection or calibration. Paired with bit-packing kernels for runtime memory reduction, VAR-Q delivers low-bit quantization across nine models spanning both paradigms, cutting KV memory by up to 78.5% with negligible quality degradation and enabling 6x larger inference batches.
comment: A preliminary version of this work was presented at the ICCV 2025 BiVision Workshop

title: DS@GT ARC at CheckThat! 2026: A Verdict-Anchored Pipeline for Generating Fact-Checking Articles
authors: Hoang Thanh Thanh Truong, Shuyu Tian
abstract: Misinformation spreads faster than professional fact-checkers can manually verify it and write articles explaining their verdicts. This creates a need to automate the production of fact-checking articles. This paper details work done by the DS@GT ARC team for CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Lab Task 3 Fact-Checking Article Generation. We seek to generate a full fact-checking article from a claim, its original verdict, and a set of scraped source documents. Our team built a four-stage pipeline that cleans noisy evidence, retrieves and clusters relevant sources, generates the article by conditioning \texttt{Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct} on the original fact-checker verdict, and recovers inline citations through deterministic post-processing. We achieved a mean score of 0.428 and ranked 3rd out of 9 teams for the CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Lab Task 3, compared to a baseline mean score of 0.272. Our code is available on GitHub at https://github.com/dsgt-arc/checkthat-2026-task3.
comment: CLEF 2026 Working Notes, 21 - 24 September 2026, Jena, Germany

title: Discourse Analysis of Legislative Bill Discussions
authors: Isaac Rudnick, Nipun Das, Foaad Khosmood
abstract: Legislative hearings are distinct communication events with their own human recognizable structure and logic, yet they have been analyzed as distinct phenomena beyond their transcripts. Understanding legislative hearings at a deeper level is a major step in analyzing the work and power relationships within democratic bodies. In this work, we present a novel end-to-end pipeline for parsing rhetorical structures from legislative committee hearings with the goal of improving legislative discourse analysis and democratic accountability. We also propose a rhetorical structure grammar and find that 55.21% of California state bill discussions in our dataset can be parsed with this grammar. We evaluate our pipeline with two utterance section classifiers on a random subset of over 2,000 annotated utterances corresponding to 100 hearings. We find that a logistic regression-based classifier with grammar-based output masking and utterance tag smoothing outperforms more complex models, achieving an F1 score of 52.8% against our ground truth discourse section labels.

title: Human-like cross-language generalisation in deep neural speaker embeddings and its acoustic foundations
authors: Tianze Xu, Xiyang Li, Xiaoming Jiang, Volker Dellwo
abstract: Generalisability is a central question for deep neural networks, including the cross-language generalisation of speaker embeddings. This study examined whether deep neural speaker embeddings generalise across languages and how such generalisation relates to human perception and acoustic structure. Using Cantonese--English bilingual speech presented in within- and cross-language conditions, we derived similarity from 18 state-of-the-art models and compared it with human ratings and acoustic features using linear mixed models and representational similarity analysis. Embeddings exhibited cross-language generalisation that broadly paralleled human behaviour, reflecting accurate identity discrimination and sensitivity to language switching. This generalisation relied on largely shared acoustic cues with language-sensitive weighting, mirroring human patterns. Together, these findings provide converging evidence for human--machine alignment in cross-language voice similarity processing.
comment: This manuscript has been accepted for presentation at Interspeech 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/xiyangg12/wespeaker. The archived release is available on Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20606535

title: CCDWIKI: Decoupling Case Formulation from Response Generation in Longitudinal CBT Dialogue
authors: Mingwen Zhang, Ruiyang Song, Qinying Wang, Yuchen Wang, Changsheng Ma, Minqiang Yang
abstract: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) demands more than empathic validation, requiring instead a structured formulation of the interplay among situations, automatic thoughts, emotions, and behaviors. Therapists formalize this interplay through a Cognitive Conceptualization Diagram, where maintaining longitudinal coherence necessitates continuous evidential adjudication to separate tentative hypotheses from established findings. Current dialogue systems track conversational history via retrieval or static profiles but lack the representational capacity to encode epistemic status. Consequently, provisional interpretations are often prematurely reified as established facts, inadvertently biasing downstream interventions. Addressing this limitation, CCDWiki is introduced as a plug-and-play advisor conceptualizing longitudinal therapy as evidence-grounded hypothesis adjudication. The approach encodes each clinical hypothesis as a mutable entry bound to corroborating and contradicting evidence. Across sessions, accumulating data strengthens supported entries, preserves provisional ones, and retracts contradicted assumptions. The resulting formulation distills into concise guidance for unmodified therapeutic language models. Experiments demonstrate substantial improvements in both conceptualization and intervention quality without requiring backbone retraining.

title: Deterministic Network Interface Naming on Multi-NIC Linux Systems: A Boot-Time Convergence Approach
authors: Chetan Nigudgi
abstract: Network interface naming on multi-NIC Linux systems suffers from a well-documented race condition in systemd-udevd that has remained unsolved since 2017. When multiple network interfaces are present, parallel udev worker threads attempt to rename interfaces simultaneously, causing EEXIST failures when a target name is temporarily occupied by another interface awaiting its own rename. The upstream systemd project has classified this as "not-a-bug" and declines to implement a fix. The problem, previously cosmetic under NetworkManager, has become critical as the industry migrates to systemd-networkd, which matches interfaces by name rather than MAC address, turning a failed rename into a complete loss of network connectivity. This paper presents a boot-time convergence approach that combines systemd .link file declarations with a retry-based init service that detects and recovers from rename failures before dependent services start. Deployed across diverse multi-NIC hardware configurations, the solution achieves 100% deterministic interface naming. The approach is OS-agnostic and applicable to any systemd-based Linux distribution.

title: SRRM: A Retrieval-Reconstruction Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Context Memory in Small Language Models
authors: Christopher Alberto Hamonangan
abstract: Small Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly deployed on consumer-grade hardware, yet their ability to preserve information across progressively longer contexts remains insufficiently understood. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate retrieval-oriented tasks, providing limited insight into whether successful retrieval reflects comprehensive long-context memory preservation. To address this limitation, this paper introduces Simple Retrieval-Reconstruction Memory (SRRM), a lightweight and fully reproducible benchmark that jointly evaluates Targeted Retrieval and Global Information Reconstruction. This study also proposes the Memory Preservation Ratio (MPR), a benchmark-level metric that quantifies the relationship between retrieval and reconstruction performance. SRRM was evaluated using a synthetic dataset on three Qwen2.5 models (0.5B, 1.5B, and 3B parameters) across context loads ranging from 10 to 100 factual statements. Experimental results show that reconstruction performance deteriorated substantially faster than retrieval accuracy as contextual information increased, indicating that retrieval alone is insufficient to characterize long-context memory preservation. Among the evaluated models, Qwen2.5-1.5B achieved the highest retrieval accuracy (86.7%), reconstruction performance (45.7%), and MPR (0.53), outperforming the larger Qwen2.5-3B model (72.2%, 18.5%, and 0.26, respectively). These findings demonstrate that increasing parameter count does not necessarily improve long-context memory preservation. Overall, SRRM provides a reproducible and extensible benchmark for systematically evaluating long-context memory while revealing complementary memory behaviors that remain hidden under retrieval-only evaluation frameworks.

title: Streaming OS Installation from Compressed Partitioned Images on Memory-Constrained Bare-Metal Hosts
authors: Chetan Nigudgi, Chip Cary
abstract: Bare-metal server provisioning systems typically decompress OS images into RAM before writing them to disk. When servers have insufficient RAM to hold the decompressed image (increasingly common as OS images grow due to AI/ML toolkits, GPU drivers, and firmware stacks), provisioning fails entirely. This paper presents a streaming installation technique that combines partial decompression for metadata extraction with pipeline-based disk writing, enabling OS installation on hosts where available RAM is less than the decompressed image size. The method decompresses only the first 30MB of a compressed image to extract the GPT partition table, calculates the target filesystem offset, then streams the full image through a kernel pipe buffer (64KB) directly to disk at the calculated offset, never storing the decompressed data in memory or on disk. Deployed across a production fleet of memory-constrained bare-metal servers, the technique achieves 100% provisioning success where the standard approach fails entirely.

title: AI-Driven SaaS Platform Integration: AI Express for Unified Generative AI Services with Pay-As-You-Go Credit Systems and Scalable Microservice Architecture
authors: Deepit Sapru
abstract: Generative AI is currently fragmented, with separate subscriptions required for text generation, image synthesis, and code assistance, leading to high costs and workflow disruptions. AI Express is a SaaS platform that consolidates these capabilities into a unified pay-as-you-go service. The platform provides a range of AI tools, including a Core Code Reviewer that evaluates GitHub repositories, a Text-to-Website generator that converts text into fully functional websites, script generation, grammar checking, data analysis, and watermark removal, all accessible through a single interface without requiring technical expertise.

title: Who May Overrule the Agent? Evidence-Gated Authority in LLM Review Institutions
authors: Fuad Ali
abstract: Multi-agent language-model systems often add a reviewer to improve an upstream agent's decision. Yet a reviewer can both repair errors and replace decisions that were already correct. We study this as a problem of institutional jurisdiction: conditional on the same proposal, task information, model, and review output, when is the reviewer authorized to make its recommendation binding? We compare broad override authority with an evidence gate that permits replacement only after the reviewer produces a mechanically valid record of a binding-constraint violation and a compliant repair. Across two locally run open-weight models, 96 spatial-policy tasks, and a 96-task portfolio-transfer benchmark, the gate sharply reduces corruption of correct proposals while retaining most repairs of violations. The directions of this tradeoff are partly implied by the rule; its magnitude depends on reviewer transitions and upstream proposal states. A prospective validation then gives the reviewer an explicit choice to retain, replace, or escalate. This eliminates correct-proposal corruption for Qwen, but Mistral still replaces all 48 correct proposals; Qwen also declines every welfare-only repair that Mistral frequently attempts. Thus interface design changes reviewer behavior but is not a model-independent safeguard. The result is not that restricted review is universally better. It is that reviewer competence, action interface, and binding jurisdiction jointly determine both the correction domain and the corruption surface.
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Code, frozen outputs, and reproduction instructions: https://github.com/tofuadmiral/institutional-representation-abm

title: Same Origin, Different Verdicts: Text Production Conditions Confound Machine-Generated Text Detection in Russian
authors: Stanislav Kirichenko
abstract: Automated detection of machine-generated text is applied where the verdict carries a cost for the author, yet origin is a property of the production process, not an observable property of the text. The conditions under which a text is produced push it in the same direction in which a generative model is presumed to push it. This study measures the contribution of these conditions while origin is held fixed. The Russian-language corpus of 1882 documents comprises a machine part, generated by four generation channels (each backed by its own model family) across 45 tasks in three task modes, and an archival human part annotated for source regimentation level before the texts were read. The primary contrast is computed within the machine corpus: both halves of a pair are generated by the same model for the same task and differ only in task wording. Machine-likeness is measured by four operationalisations: an interpretable index with weights fixed before data collection, a trained classifier, a zero-shot metric on an open model, a judge model. The main result is disagreement between procedures: changing the task mode shifted the scores of all four, but three gave a negative shift, the judge a positive one, and none of the four intervals covers zero. The comparison plan and the specifications of procedures 2-4 were fixed after the result of procedure 1, before procedures 2-4 ran; the disagreement survived correction of a corpus defect and of the nested validation. A baseline on the source identifier alone reaches a median AUROC of 1.0000 on the thirteen group splits where it is defined, and removing emphasis markers flipped a confident machine verdict to human without changing the full text by a single character. The scores are properties of a specific measurement system and corpus: they reflect data collection, repetition, formatting, and preprocessing decisions as well as linguistic style.
comment: 65 pages, 6 figures, 24 tables. English translation of the frozen Russian manuscript; the Russian text is the source of record and is available with all data, code and run manifests at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21749574 (v1.0.1)

title: Agent Harness Awareness: Turning Verified Telemetry into Operational Control for Tool-Using Agents
authors: Manu Agrawal, Shrey Nagpal
abstract: Tool descriptions tell an agent what an action can do, but they do not necessarily reveal whether that action is healthy or suitable at the moment of use. Execution harnesses often possess this information through monitors, traces, and recent failures while the model choosing the next action does not. We call this gap operational blindness. We introduce Agent Harness Awareness, a trust-separated design in which the host supplies a small, fresh, verified state snapshot before a consequential action while retaining measurement, enforcement, evaluation, and final dispatch authority. We test its tools-and-network instance with ToolRoute, a controlled isolation benchmark that holds the task and candidate semantics constant and varies the operational information available to the model. In a 216-decision ablation across GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Sonnet 5, and Gemini 3.7 Flash, verified tool-health state reduced mean observable policy regret by 96.9% against a same-shape neutral control (4,252 ms to 131 ms) and raised single-dispatch completion from 69.4% to 95.8%. In a separate 27-decision end-to-end replication with live local TCP/HTTP execution, OpenTelemetry client spans, and Toxiproxy-injected faults, verified state reduced mean regret from 8,956 ms to 0 ms (zero excess observable operational cost) and completed the live action in 9/9 model-by-fault cases versus 5/9 for the neutral control. These studies establish the tools-and-network instance of Agent Harness Awareness: selected host telemetry materially improves pre-dispatch operational choice. Runtime state, hardware pressure, economics, retry-aware recovery, and heterogeneous selection remain open empirical extensions of the same architecture.

title: Uncertainty-Aware Resource Orchestration for Agentic AI Systems
authors: Masoud Shokrnezhad, Tarik Taleb
abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems powered by large language models (LLMs) execute as autonomous multi-step pipelines that dynamically invoke tools, integrate observations into memory, and iterate until a task is resolved or a resource budget is exhausted. Unlike classical workflows with fixed graphs, the aggregate compute, bandwidth, and end-to-end latency demands of such pipelines are unknown at dispatch time: they emerge at runtime from intermediate observations and stochastic token sampling, yielding heavy-tailed, multi-modal random variables. This unpredictability forces infrastructure orchestrators into a dilemma: under-provisioning risks mid-execution throttling and deadline violations, while over-provisioning wastes scarce edge or cloud capacity. Existing schedulers require a fully known pipeline graph, while edge resource-management methods rely on parametric or stationary demand models, and neither fits the unknown, non-stationary profiles of agentic pipelines. We formalize this setting as the uncertainty-aware agentic orchestration problem, where the goal is to reserve, at dispatch time, compute and bandwidth allocations that cover actual pipeline demands, and to verify that the pipeline can meet its deadline, each with a prescribed probability. We then propose Conformal Reservation for Orchestration (CRO), an online algorithm that translates a sliding window of past execution traces into dispatch-time resource allocations with finite-sample, distribution-free coverage guarantees via conformal prediction. Simulations over heterogeneous task mixes with multi-modal and heavy-tailed profiles show that CRO is the only evaluated method that simultaneously satisfies target probabilistic coverage across all risk levels while, among coverage-feasible methods, attaining the lowest over-reservation, roughly halving the resource waste of the Chebyshev-bound baseline.
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to IEEE MECOM 2026, Marrakech, Morocco, 2-4 November 2026

title: Ranking and Unranking Permutations in Heap's Order
authors: Yusheng Hu
abstract: Heap's algorithm is a permutation generation method with very low constant overhead. Its element-interchanging mechanism, however, prevents the standard factorial-base Lehmer code from being applied directly, and to our knowledge no explicit Rank/Unrank algorithm for the Heap order has been published. This paper describes the block structure of Heap's algorithm in terms of rearrangement operators: the net effect of a block-internal traversal is a tail-preserving operator and the block-boundary swap is a top-level swap operator, and together they yield a closed-form recurrence for the block transitions. On this basis a bottom-up Unrank algorithm and a top-down Rank algorithm are built from one and the same closed-form in-block mapping; both run in $O(n^3)$ time and $O(n)$ space and require no factorial-scale precomputed table. The supporting proofs use a synchronized strong induction on the dimension to establish the bijectivity of the trailing-element mapping, closed forms for the final arrangement and for the trailing sequence, the dichotomy of its cycle structure, and the reciprocity of Rank and Unrank. The Heap order is in fact the colex order of the mixed-radix code.

title: A Feasibility Condition for Confidence-Gated Tiered LLM Inference
authors: Sumit P. Ahuja
abstract: Tiered inference distributes large language model computation across a hierarchy of devices, from on-device and edge hardware to the datacenter, and is increasingly offered as the route to cheaper, lower-latency, and more private serving. Most such systems orchestrate frozen model checkpoints, and most decide what to resolve locally and what to escalate using a confidence signal produced by a forward-deployed model. We give a closed-form condition for when no threshold on that signal makes a tiered cascade worthwhile relative to sending every query to the backstop. Modeling the routing decision as a binary test and separating local from escalation cost through an architecture cost ratio $κ$, we derive a feasibility condition bracketed by a signal-free floor, below which a cascade is feasible at any signal quality, and a perfect-signal ceiling, above which none is. Read along the $κ$ axis the condition inverts: where local compute is billed, cost binds, matching a recent empirical finding; where it is sunk, on decentralized hardware, feasibility becomes unconditional and signal quality instead sets what the cascade achieves. We turn the condition into three design requirements that existing trained-in primitives satisfy only in isolation, and we propose, as future work, a co-designed architecture and a protocol to test it. The condition and the inversion hold independently of that architecture; they are the paper's contribution.

title: Challenge-Aware Knowledge Recruitment with Meta-Agent Supervision for Medical Multi-Agent Reasoning
authors: Riccardo Riccio, Haitz Sáez de Ocáriz Borde, Pietro Liò
abstract: Large language models perform strongly on standard medical QA but degrade on harder reasoning tasks, where multi-agent debate often fails to beat strong single-model prompting. We argue that a key limitation is that existing systems select experts and retrieve knowledge from the question alone, rather than from gaps that emerge during reasoning. We propose challenge-aware adaptive recruitment: an external CHALLENGER inspects the evolving reasoning trace and identifies specific factual or expertise gaps. These signals trigger targeted knowledge retrieval or mid-discussion specialist recruitment. On the MEDAGENTSBENCH hard subset (862 questions across nine biomedical datasets), upfront retrieval provides little benefit, while challenge-aware in-between retrieval performs better; on a multi-specialist backbone it improves accuracy on 8 of 9 datasets and adds 6 percentage points over Challenger Only.
