title: Contextful Arrows via Wreath Products
authors: Matteo Capucci, David Jaz Myers
abstract:
We introduce contextads and the Ctx construction, unifying various structures and constructions in category theory dealing with context and contextful arrows---comonads and their Kleisli construction, actegories and their Para construction, adequate triples and their Span construction. Contextads are defined in terms of Lack--Street wreaths, suitably categorified for pseudomonads in a tricategory of spans in a 2-category with display maps. The associated wreath product provides the Ctx construction, and by its universal property we conclude trifunctoriality. This abstract approach lets us work up to structure, and thus swiftly prove that, under very mild assumptions, a contextad equipped colaxly with a 2-algebraic structure produces a similarly structured double category of contextful arrows.
  We also explore the role contextads might play qua dependently graded comonads in organizing contextful computation in functional programming. We show that many side-effects monads can be dually captured by dependently graded comonads, and gesture towards a general result on the `transposability' of parametric right adjoint monads to dependently graded comonads.
comment: 120 pages, used to be titled "Contextads as Wreaths; Kleisli, Para, and Span Constructions as Wreath Products". The page count increased for formatting reasons, content is mostly the same up to some fixes and twiddles
zh_title: 通过圈积实现的上下文箭头
translation:
我们引入了contextads和Ctx构造，统一了范畴论中处理上下文和上下文箭头的各种结构与构造——余子单子及其Kleisli构造、作用范畴（actegories）及其Para构造、充分三元组（adequate triples）及其Span构造。Contextads是通过Lack--Street圈积定义的，并针对带有显示映射的2-范畴中span三范畴中的拟单子进行了适当的范畴化。相关的圈积提供了Ctx构造，根据其泛性质我们得出其具有三函子性（trifunctoriality）。这种抽象方法使我们能够在结构上进行操作，从而迅速证明：在非常温和的假设下，以colax方式配备2-代数结构的contextad会产生一个具有类似结构的上下文箭头的双范畴。
我们还探讨了contextads在函数式编程中组织上下文计算时，作为依赖分级余子单子可能扮演的角色。我们表明，许多副作用单子可以对偶地被依赖分级余子单子捕获，并指向了关于参数化右伴随单子可“转置”为依赖分级余子单子的一般结果。
tldr: 本文利用圈积（wreath products）在范畴论中统一了各种上下文结构，并探讨其在函数式编程上下文计算中的应用。
ai_comments: 该论文通过范畴论中的圈积（wreath products）和Lack-Street圈积，巧妙地统一了多种处理上下文和上下文箭头的结构（如余子单子、Para结构和Span结构），在函数式编程的依赖分级余子单子（dependently graded comonads）应用方面展现了深刻的理论价值和潜力。
motivation: 为了统一范畴论中处理上下文和上下文箭头的各种现存结构与构造（如余子单子、Para、Span），并通过抽象方法在函数式编程中组织上下文计算。
method: 利用Lack-Street圈积、拟单子（pseudomonads）在带显示映射的2-范畴中的span三范畴，以及其泛性质导出了Ctx构造的 trifunctoriality。
results: 证明了在极度温和的假设下，配备了colax 2-代数结构的contextad可以产生具有相似结构的上下文箭头双范畴，并展示了其在函数式编程中对副作用单子的对偶捕获。
conclusion: 引入了contextads和Ctx结构，统一了范畴论中处理上下文的多种结构，并为其在函数式编程中的应用提供了理论基础。

title: Bounded Discrete Bridges
authors: Pierre Nicodeme
abstract: In 2010 Banderier and Nicodeme consider the height of bounded discrete bridges and conclude to a limiting Rayleigh distribution. This result is correct although their proof is partly erroneous. They make asymptotic simplifications based upon dominance properties of the roots of the kernel of the walk within a disk centered at the origin, but these dominance properties apply only upon a positive real segment. However the very good agreement of simulations with their asymptotic expansion of the probability distribution in case of Łukasiewicz bridges let us think that their proof could be corrected. This is the scope of the present article which provides a proof using the dominance property only in its domain of validity. We also consider the case of periodic walks, a topic not considered in Banderier-Nicodeme2010..
comment: 43 pages, 6 figures including 11 PDF files (1 of them Maple worksheet) Introduction (4 pages) added, sections 5.2.1 and 5.2.2, remarks 6 and 7 pushed to appendix
translation: 在2010年，Banderier和Nicodeme研究了有界离散桥的高度，并得出其渐近分布为瑞利分布的结论。这一结论是正确的，尽管他们的证明部分存在错误。他们基于随机游走核的根在原点为中心盘内的显赫（主导）性质做了渐近简化，但这些主导性质仅在正实数段上适用。然而，模拟结果与他们在Łukasiewicz桥情况下概率分布的渐近展开式高度吻合，这让我们认为他们的证明是可以被修正的。本文的范围正是提供一个仅在其有效域内使用主导性质的证明。我们还考虑了周期性随机游走的情况，这是Banderier-Nicodeme（2010）未曾考虑的主题。
tldr: 本文修正了有界离散桥高度渐近分布的一个含有瑕疵的著名证明，并将其推广至周期性随机游走。
ai_comments: 该论文修正了前人在有界离散桥高度渐近分布证明中的瑕疵，严谨地应用了核根的主导性质，并将其拓展到了周期性随机游走，具有很好的理论价值。
motivation: Banderier和Nicodeme（2010）在研究有界离散桥高度时得出了正确的瑞利分布极限，但其证明过程在将根的主导性质应用于整个圆盘时存在错误，本文旨在修正这一证明。
method: 使用核根的主导性质在其严格的有效域内进行渐近分析，并将其推广至周期性随机游走。
results: 在正确使用主导性质的前提下，验证并修正了有界离散桥概率分布的渐近展开式，同时给出了周期性随机游走的新结果。
conclusion: 本文成功修正了Banderier和Nicodeme（2010）关于有界离散桥高度的证明，并在有效区域内应用根的主导性质推导出了渐近分布，同时扩展研究了周期性随机游走。

title: Optimality of the $D_4$ lattice quantizer
authors: Tianle Liu
abstract: We prove that the root lattice $D_4$ uniquely minimizes the normalized second moment among four-dimensional lattices, up to similarity. The minimum is $13/(120\sqrt{2})$. The proof reduces the problem to polynomial inequalities on three secondary cones. We derive the second-moment formulas geometrically and give explicit polynomial certificates that can be checked by coefficient comparison. We also derive a lower bound for lattice quantizers in every dimension at least two from the number of Voronoi facets, using a comparison with circular cones and concavity in the solid angle. This bound strictly improves the sphere bound and recovers the hexagonal value in dimension two.
comment: Simplified the proof of four-dimensional optimality, with explicit polynomial certificates now included in the paper. Main results unchanged

title: Cyclotomic polynomials with trinomial irreducible factors over finite fields
authors: Li Zhu, Hongfeng Wu
abstract: We classify the pairs $(q,n)$, where $q$ is a prime power, $n>1$, and $\gcd(n,q)=1$, for which every irreducible factor of $Φ_n(x)$ over $\F_q$ has exactly three nonzero terms. The positive support exponents of these factors have a common greatest common divisor, which gives a unique reduction by a power substitution. The reduced degree is two in odd characteristic and belongs to $\{2,3,4\}$ in characteristic two; the cubic and quartic cases arise by scalar substitution from the layers of orders $7$ and $15$. This yields necessary and sufficient arithmetic conditions on $(q,n)$ and explicit factorizations. Among the classified families, precisely those arising from quartic bases have a divisor layer containing an irreducible factor with more than three terms.

title: TransfoRhythm: A Transformer Architecture Conductive to Blood Pressure Estimation via Solo PPG Signal Capturing
authors: Amir Arjomand, Amin Boudesh, Farnoush Bayatmakou, Kenneth B. Kent, Arash Mohammadi
abstract: Recent statistics indicate that approximately 1.3 billion individuals worldwide suffer from hypertension, a leading cause of premature death globally. Blood Pressure (BP) serves as a critical health indicator for accurate and timely diagnosis and/or treatment of hypertension. Traditional BP measurement methods rely on cuff-based approaches, which lack real-time, continuous, and reliable BP estimates, crucial for the timely diagnosis/treatment of hypertension. Driven by recent advancements in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), there has been a surge of interest in developing data-driven and cuff-less BP estimation solutions. In this context, current literature predominantly focuses on coupling Electrocardiography (ECG) and Photoplethysmography (PPG) sensors, though this approach is constrained by reliance on multiple sensor types. An alternative, utilizing standalone PPG signals, presents challenges due to the absence of auxiliary sensors (ECG), requiring the use of morphological features while addressing motion artifacts and high-frequency noise. To address these issues, the paper introduces the TransfoRhythm framework, a Transformer-based DNN architecture built upon the recently released physiological database, MIMIC-IV. Leveraging the Multi-Head Attention (MHA) mechanism, TransfoRhythm identifies dependencies and similarities across data segments, forming a robust framework for cuff-less BP estimation solely using PPG signals. To our knowledge, this paper represents the first study to apply the MIMIC IV dataset for cuff-less BP estimation. TransfoRhythm achieves highly accurate results with a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of [2.21, 1.84] and a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of [1.37, 1.06] for systolic and diastolic blood pressures, respectively.
zh_title: TransfoRhythm：一种利用单一PPG信号采集进行血压估计的Transformer架构
translation: 近期统计数据显示，全球约有13亿人患有高血压，这是全球早死的主要原因。血压（BP）是准确及时诊断和/或治疗高血压的关键健康指标。传统的血压测量方法依赖于袖带式方法，缺乏实时、连续且可靠的血压估计，而这对于高血压的及时诊断/治疗至关重要。在人工智能（AI）和深度神经网络（DNNs）近期进展的推动下，开发数据驱动的无袖带血压估计方案引起了人们的极大兴趣。在此背景下，当前文献主要集中于将心电图（ECG）和光电容积脉搏波（PPG）传感器相结合，尽管这种方法受限于对多种传感器类型的依赖。另一种利用独立PPG信号的方法由于缺乏辅助传感器（ECG）而面临挑战，需要利用形态学特征，同时解决运动伪影和高频噪声问题。为了解决这些问题，本文引入了TransfoRhythm框架，这是一个基于Transformer的DNN架构，建立在最近发布的生理数据库MIMIC-IV之上。利用多头注意力（MHA）机制，TransfoRhythm识别数据段之间的依赖关系和相似性，形成一个仅使用PPG信号进行无袖带血压估计的强大框架。据我们所知，本文代表了第一项将MIMIC-IV数据集应用于无袖带血压估计的研究。TransfoRhythm取得了高准确度的结果，收缩压和舒张压的均方根误差（RMSE）分别为[2.21, 1.84]，平均绝对误差（MAE）分别为[1.37, 1.06]。
tldr: 本文提出了TransfoRhythm，首个基于MIMIC-IV数据集的、仅使用单PPG信号进行高精度无袖带血压估计的Transformer框架。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出仅基于单光电容积脉搏波（PPG）信号进行无袖带血压估计的TransfoRhythm框架，并首次将MIMIC-IV数据库应用于该任务中，利用多头注意力机制有效克服了缺乏ECG辅助信号带来的挑战，在精度上取得了优异的成果。
motivation: 传统的基于袖带的血压测量方法无法提供实时、连续和可靠的血压估计。虽然现有的AI无袖带方案多采用ECG和PPG双传感器，但存在局限性；而使用单一PPG信号则面临缺乏辅助传感器、需要处理形态学特征及运动伪影和高频噪声的挑战。因此，需要开发一个仅依赖单PPG信号且高效准确的无袖带血压估计框架。
method: 提出基于Transformer架构的TransfoRhythm框架，利用多头注意力机制（MHA）识别数据段之间的依赖关系和相似性，专门处理来自MIMIC-IV生理数据库的单PPG信号，以实现无袖带血压估计。
results: 在收缩压和舒张压的估计上，TransfoRhythm取得了均方根误差（RMSE）分别为[2.21, 1.84]和平均绝对误差（MAE）分别为[1.37, 1.06]的高准确度结果。
conclusion: TransfoRhythm框架成功实现了仅利用单PPG信号的高精度无袖带血压估计，为实时、连续的血压监测提供了有效且极具潜力的深度学习解决方案。

title: Mission Capability-Aware UAV Swarm Coordination for Autonomous Disaster Response
authors: Mudassar Shakeel, Taha Mahmood, Ahmed Naeem, Muhammad Hamza Jehangir, El Mehdi Amhoud, Syed Ali Hassan
abstract: This paper proposes an artificial intelligence (AI) driven mission capability aware unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarm coordination framework for autonomous post disaster search and rescue. An integrated sensing and communication enabled master high altitude platform station senses the disaster environment, detects victims and hazards, and constructs adaptive rescue regions based on spatially varying mission demands. A mission capability requirement (MCR) quantifies regional capability demand, while a normalized mission capability score (MCS) characterizes the real time capability of individual UAVs. A capability-aware assignment mechanism matches UAV capabilities to regional requirements while minimizing deployment distance. An MCS based reallocation mechanism dynamically transfers UAVs from capability surplus to capability deficient regions while preserving donor sufficiency. A hierarchical deep reinforcement learning framework with proximal policy optimization performs high-level region selection, while MCR MCS matching enables feasible UAV level reallocation. Finally, joint trajectory optimization considers travel time, distance, propulsion energy, operational capability, obstacle avoidance, and inter UAV collision avoidance. Theoretical analysis and simulations demonstrate improved mission capability satisfaction, resource efficiency, and disaster response performance

title: A Neuroprosthetic SoC Featuring Rapid Local Sensory Feedback with On-Chip Unsupervised Multi-Class Spike Sorting
authors: Bowen Liu, Yuhan Hou, Yu Huang, Jianxiong Xu, Hao You, Ashley Hung, Naize Yang, Junyu Ma, Laura Kondrataviciute, Suneil K. Kalia, Andrew G. Richardson, Roman Genov, Xilin Liu
abstract: This letter presents a 65 nm neuroprosthetic system-on-chip (SoC) featuring a rapid feedback pathway from motor recording to sensory stimulation. To enable low-latency sensory mapping modulated by individual-neuron firing rates, the SoC integrates a mixed-signal unsupervised spike-sorting module with stimulation-artifact rejection, a programmable sliding-window firing-rate calculator, and a closed-loop controller for adapting stimulation parameters. The spike-sorting module combines event-driven analog feature extraction with Manhattan-distance-based digital clustering while consuming 1.6 $μ$W/channel. On the Quiroga Difficult-1 benchmark, it achieves 94.58% three-class accuracy, with only a 0.4% reduction when stimulation artifacts are introduced at 20% of the spike count. The closed-loop controller supports polynomial and logarithmic mapping functions and incorporates Mitchell's approximation for power saving. The SoC is fully characterized on the bench and in vivo.
comment: 4 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables. Author's accepted manuscript. Accepted for publication in IEEE Solid-State Circuits Letters

title: Seeing Why: Exact Evidence Maps for Quantum and Optical Image Classifiers
authors: Teerawat Tongloy, Rangsan Jomtarak
abstract: When an image classifier decides, we can usually only estimate why. For quantum and all-optical classifiers that act linearly on amplitude-encoded pictures up to the measurement, with no trained classical network before or after them, each class's Born probability above its no-information share, $P_g - b_g$, splits exactly into contributions of the encoded amplitudes, shown as Born evidence maps (BEM) over the picture. The split itself follows from known results on quadratic forms: with the transmitted light held fixed, it is what Integrated Gradients from a zero baseline and the Shapley value give. What we add is a way to measure it on the hardware that classifies, from class probabilities on a quantum chip or from camera frames on a lens bench, with no gradient circuit and no light sent backwards; a $g\times g$ map takes $1 + 2g^2$ runs. Deleting the 5% of pixels with the highest evidence drops accuracy from 73% to 9%, as occlusion does with 1,024 extra runs per picture, whereas gradient saliency removes much less. The classifiers share one architecture, a Fourier-plane mask followed by a brickwall circuit on qubits or by phase plates on a lens bench, read by a fixed Born headroom readout with no trained parameter; centring each picture on its own mean lets dark features count as much as bright ones. In simulation, four phase plates at a single wavelength reach 72.3% on Caltech-10 colour photographs. On IBM's ibm_kingston, with the mask applied before approximate loading, 300 test pictures were classified at 37.7% against 10% by chance (56.3% in exact simulation), and $2\times2$ maps of ten correctly classified pictures, one per class chosen by a stated rule, measured on the chip, agreed with the exact ones ($r = 0.77$). The maps also revealed a shortcut in the data; as the trim that removed it was chosen on test pictures, the Caltech-10 results are exploratory.
comment: 38 pages, 13 figures, 16 tables. Code, models and IBM job records: https://github.com/stein-research/seeing-why (v1.2, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23984169). v3: chip maps of 30 pictures drawn at random in advance (r = 0.88); a second model, with no mask, on the chip; reviewer checks (nulls, model randomisation, ROAR, calibration), most in a new appendix; corrections (loading circuit 44 CNOTs)

title: Beyond TR 38.811 for 6G NTN Channel Models
authors: Kuan-Po Chiu, Aaron Jacob Buck, Sumit Roy
abstract: As the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) expands 6G non-terrestrial network (NTN) to S, Ku, and Ka bands for integration with existing terrestrial cellular networks, the necessary satellite channel model for link and network performance evaluation remains tied to TR 38.811, last revised in 2020. We identify issues on multiple fronts: inappropriate parameter specifications based on very limited site-specific environments considered, omission of satellite-induced Doppler spread and directional antenna effects and lack of a transparent channel model generation procedure. To address these limitations, we re-derive the channel parameters using ray tracing (RT) over urban and rural environments based on ITU-R building statistics. Our results show that TR 38.811 substantially overestimates the K-factor at low elevations and predicts a decreasing trend with elevation, which is inconsistent with RT. The Ka-band clutter loss (CL) also exceeds the RT estimates by more than 15 dB in urban cases. It also underestimates rural delay spread (DS) at low elevations and predicts an elevation trend inconsistent with RT. We further quantify the previously neglected satellite-induced Doppler spread. Finally, we demonstrate that the conventional TR 38.811 channel generator significantly underestimates the K-factor in the presence of directional antenna (beamforming), while our modified generator substantially reduces this discrepancy.

title: Positioning and Radiation Efficiency Degrees of Freedom in Cascaded Pinching-Antenna Arrays
authors: Ozgur Ergul
abstract: In a pinching-antenna system (PASS), a single source feeds multiple pinches, resulting in a cascade that couples their radiated powers. A shared radiated-power limit, such as the interference power constraint in an underlay cognitive radio network, couples them again. We study such a network where PASS serves the secondary users. First, we formulate the joint optimization problem of the two degrees of freedom (DoF), pinch positions and radiation efficiencies, and characterize the single-link optimum analytically. Then, rather than proposing one method, we present the results for a grid of schemes whose two axes are the two DoF. Under an order-free attribution, positioning is worth 1.34 times radiation efficiency, and the two are near-perfect substitutes. We also show that substitutability is due to the constraint and not the cascade, since relaxing the constraint by 20 dB removes 97% of their interaction. At the joint reference, not knowing the primary receiver (PR) location costs 6.23 bit/s/Hz, more than twice the 2.87 that optimizing both DoF is worth. Instantaneous fading information adds a further 0.29 bit/s/Hz. Allocating efficiencies at equally spaced positions reaches 98% of the joint reference at about three orders of magnitude less computation.
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to the IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications

title: RFShape: An IQ-Pretrained Wireless Foundation Model for Heterogeneous IQ & CIR Representations
authors: Mohammad Cheraghinia, Sebbe Van Der Smissen, Jaron Fontaine, Delia Rico, Eli De Poorter, Adnan Shahid
abstract: In wireless systems, foundation models have been proposed as alternative artificial intelligence models to replace task-specific models with a shared pretrained model that can be reused across many downstream applications (source separation, interference detection, localization, etc.). These wireless foundation models promise to reuse learned representations across diverse tasks, but choosing a foundation model also means choosing its input representation. For example, a model pretrained on spectrograms expects spectrograms, while one pretrained on in-phase/quadrature (IQ) samples expects IQ, limiting which pretrained model can be used for a given downstream problem. To remedy this, we present RFShape, a 7.4 M-parameter foundation model that breaks this coupling by adapting how a signal is presented to a shared pretrained encoder. RFShape is pretrained solely on synthetic IQ waveforms, without real captures, labels, or channel impulse responses (CIRs), and uses deterministic representation operators to support heterogeneous downstream inputs. Across ten tasks and nine datasets unseen during pretraining, the same encoder supports classification, ranging-error regression, and two-dimensional positioning. Representation selection alone increases 23-class radar recognition from 23.0% to 69.5% and short-range technology recognition from 70.8% to 97.1%. RFShape also outperforms CIR-pretrained ultra-wideband baselines by up to 12.7 percentage points for (N)LOS classification despite never observing CIRs during pretraining. These results show that foundation-model reuse need not be limited by the representation or modality seen during pretraining, and adapting how a signal is presented can extend a single pretrained encoder across heterogeneous wireless tasks.

title: GTAC: A Graph-Transformer Actor-Critic for Carrier-Aware MU-MIMO User Grouping
authors: Yan Huang, Charles Santhosam Lourdu Raja, Rajesh Gadiyar
abstract: Achieving higher spectral efficiency (SE) in 5G and future 6G networks requires efficient massive multi-user multiple-input multiple-output (MU-MIMO) grouping under coupled physical-layer constraints and strict scheduling deadlines. Motivated by industry efforts in AI-native RAN, we propose Graph-Transformer Actor-Critic (GTAC), a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) architecture for carrier-aware MU-MIMO user grouping. The objective is to maximize the long-term proportional-fair (PF) utility of the cell subject to constraints from the practical stack protocol. GTAC comprises a shared actor--critic encoder with spatial-edge-biased attention mechanism, a pointer decoder actor that generates grouping decisions, and a multi-stage transformer critic that estimates the carrier-wide state-value during training. Training begins by cloning a teacher policy that cannot meet real-time deployment deadlines, followed by critic warmup and two-stage reinforcement learning using proximal policy optimization (PPO), first on a narrow, power-matched carrier and then on the full carrier with a Kullback--Leibler (KL) policy anchor. After two-stage PPO, the best GTAC policy outperforms the non-real-time teacher by 11.6% in carrier SE, while exceeding its PF utility and preserving the cell-edge throughput. A CUDA implementation of GTAC achieves a 69.6 us inference latency on an RTX PRO 4500 GPU, below the targeted 100 us inference budget in practical systems.

title: Simulation-Driven Approach for Occlusion-Based Non-Line-Of-Sight Detection Using a Low-Cost Flash LiDAR
authors: Peizhao Qiu, Emmanuel A Olowe, Zhenya Zang, Istvan Gyongy, Danial Chitnis
abstract: Non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging aims to sense objects outside the direct line of sight. While most previous work focuses on the canonical around-the-corner configuration, this work considers a more challenging occlusion-based NLOS setting in which targets are hidden by scene geometry. To avoid the challenge of collecting large real-world datasets, we have developed a photon-based Monte Carlo simulator to generate diverse synthetic training data and validate against experimental data. We trained an AI model to identify multi-bounce photon patterns associated with hidden targets. The model achieves an Average Precision (AP) of 0.91 on synthetic test data and, when transferred directly to 180 real measurements acquired with a TMF8829 SPAD flash LiDAR, achieves 86.67% accuracy and an AP of 0.95. These results show that simulated transient data can support hidden-target detection with a low-cost commercial sensor and provide an initial step toward more general occlusion-based NLOS sensing and, ultimately, hidden-scene reconstruction.

title: ELiCv2: Learned LiDAR Geometry Compression under Real-Time Embedded Constraints
authors: Soowoong Kim, Junsik Kim, Gun Bang, Jinsoo Choi
abstract: Improving learned LiDAR compression increasingly relies on heavier inference, making it harder to meet the constraints of real-time embedded systems. We present ELiCv2, which removes two sources of redundant computation in progressive coding. Its discrete entropy interface selects a precomputed integer CDF instead of materializing one from a per-voxel distribution, while its occupancy-driven kernel-map builder derives finer-level sparse-convolution kernel-maps directly from the decoded hierarchy, eliminating coordinate-based neighbor search. ELiCv2 reinvests the recovered computation budget in lightweight ego-motion-aware temporal conditioning that gathers local occupancy context from the aligned previous reconstruction. On four LiDAR datasets and an NVIDIA Jetson Thor, ELiCv2 achieves a mean BD-rate reduction of 30.97% over G-PCC with channel width C=32 while sustaining the 20Hz nuScenes capture rate. Increasing the channel width to C=64 improves the mean reduction to 35.22%.
zh_title: ELiCv2：面向实时嵌入式约束的学习型LiDAR几何压缩
translation: 提高学习型LiDAR压缩的性能越来越依赖于更繁重的推理，这使得满足实时嵌入式系统的约束变得更加困难。我们提出了ELiCv2，它去除了渐进式编码中两个来源的冗余计算。其离散熵接口选择预计算的整数CDF，而不是从每个体素的分布中实时生成；其占用驱动的核映射构建器直接从解码的层级结构派生更细级别的稀疏卷积核映射，消除了基于坐标的邻居搜索。ELiCv2将恢复的计算预算重新投入到轻量级的自身运动感知时间条件中，从对齐的前一个重建中收集局部占用上下文。在四个LiDAR数据集和一个NVIDIA Jetson Thor上，当通道宽度C=32时，ELiCv2相比G-PCC实现了平均30.97%的BD-rate减少，同时维持了nuScenes的20Hz采集帧率。将通道宽度增加到C=64时，平均减少率提高到35.22%。
tldr: ELiCv2通过消除冗余计算和引入轻量级时间条件，在嵌入式系统上实现了高效且满足实时要求的LiDAR点云几何压缩。
ai_comments: 该论文在端侧实时LiDAR几何压缩领域做出了重要改进，通过去除冗余计算（离散熵接口和占用驱动的核映射构建器）并引入轻量级的时间条件机制，在保证嵌入式系统实时性的同时显著提升了压缩性能。
motivation: 现有的学习型LiDAR压缩方法日益依赖繁重的推理，难以满足实时嵌入式系统的约束条件。
method: 提出ELiCv2，移除渐进式编码中的两处冗余计算：使用离散熵接口选择预计算的整数CDF，并采用占用驱动的核映射构建器直接由解码层级推导稀疏卷积核映射；同时引入轻量级的自身运动感知时间条件机制。
results: 在四个LiDAR数据集和NVIDIA Jetson Thor上，通道宽度C=32时相比G-PCC平均BD-rate减少30.97%，通道宽度C=64时平均BD-rate减少提升至35.22%，同时维持了nuScenes的20Hz采集帧率。
conclusion: ELiCv2成功在实时嵌入式系统约束下实现了高效的LiDAR几何压缩，兼顾了低延迟和高性能。

title: Reconfigurable Antenna-Enhanced ISAC: A Unified Perspective on Electromagnetic Adaptation
authors: Peilan Wang, Lei Xie, Meidong Mei, Jun Fang, Yihong Su, Hongbin Li
abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) enables sensing and communication (S&C) functions to share time, frequency, and hardware resources, offering an efficient paradigm for next-generation wireless systems. However, conventional fixed-configuration antenna (FCA) architectures provide limited flexibility in adapting the physical electromagnetic (EM) response of the end-to-end wireless link. This article develops a unified EM-adaptation perspective on reconfigurable antenna (RA)-enhanced ISAC systems. We distinguish transceiver-side (TSc-side) and environment-side (Env-side) RA deployments and identify five fundamental EM reconfiguration dimensions: position, orientation, radiation pattern, polarization, and frequency response. Building on this framework, we examine how these dimensions customize communication channels, actively control target information mapping for sensing, and reshape the interplay between S&C, particularly by improving compatibility between S&C requirements under shared resources. Two case studies illustrate how TSc-side and Env-side EM reconfiguration can improve spatial selectivity and the achievable S&C performance tradeoff. Finally, we discuss several promising directions for advancing RA-enhanced ISAC systems, including fundamental performance limits, low-overhead black-box optimization, and artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled semantic ISAC.
zh_title: 可重构天线增强的集成感知与通信：电磁自适应的统一视角
translation: 集成感知与通信（ISAC）使感知与通信（S&C）功能能够共享时间、频率和硬件资源，为下一代无线系统提供了一种高效的范例。然而，传统的固定配置天线（FCA）架构在适应端到端无线链路的物理电磁响应方面灵活性有限。本文开发了一种面向可重构天线（RA）增强的ISAC系统的统一电磁自适应视角。我们区分了收发端（TSc端）和环境端（Env端）的RA部署，并确定了五个基本的电磁重构维度：位置、方向、辐射方向图、极化和频率响应。在此框架的基础上，我们研究了这些维度如何定制通信信道，主动控制传感器的目标信息映射，并重塑S&C之间的相互作用，特别是通过改善共享资源下S&C需求之间的兼容性。两个案例研究说明了TSc端和Env端的电磁重构如何改善空间选择性以及可实现的S&C性能权衡。最后，我们讨论了RA增强的ISAC系统的几个有前景的发展方向，包括基本性能极限、低开销黑盒优化以及人工智能（AI）赋能的语义ISAC。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的电磁自适应视角，用于增强集成感知与通信（ISAC）系统，通过使用可重构天线（RA）来克服传统固定配置天线（FCA）的局限性。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的电磁自适应视角，用于增强ISAC系统，通过可重构天线（RA）克服了传统固定配置天线（FCA）的局限性。该研究的创新性在于将电磁自适应作为统一框架，并区分了收发端和环境端的RA部署，明确了五个关键的电磁重构维度。这为ISAC系统的设计和优化提供了新的思路和方法。然而，该研究可能在实际部署的复杂性和成本方面存在挑战，并且对AI赋能的语义ISAC的讨论仍处于初步阶段。
motivation: 传统的固定配置天线（FCA）在适应无线链路的物理电磁响应方面灵活性有限，阻碍了ISAC系统的效率。
method: 论文提出了一种统一的电磁自适应视角，用于可重构天线（RA）增强的ISAC系统。区分了收发端（TSc端）和环境端（Env端）的RA部署，并确定了五个基本的电磁重构维度：位置、方向、辐射方向图、极化和频率响应。通过这两个维度来定制通信信道，主动控制传感器的目标信息映射，并重塑S&C之间的相互作用。
results: 通过两个案例研究，说明了TSc端和Env端的电磁重构可以改善空间选择性以及可实现的S&C性能权衡。
conclusion: 可重构天线（RA）通过其电磁自适应能力，为ISAC系统提供了克服传统固定配置天线（FCA）局限性的有效途径，并在通信和传感性能之间取得更好的权衡。未来的研究方向包括基本性能极限、低开销黑盒优化以及人工智能（AI）赋能的语义ISAC。

title: Toward Generalized LEO Channel Prediction: A Rapid Adaptation Time-Frequency Mamba Framework
authors: Yunxin Geng, Yun Zhao, Weiwei Jiang, Shengfeng Wang, Haotian Liu, Zhiqing Wei
abstract: Accurate channel state information (CSI) prediction is pivotal for enhancing system capacity in low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite-terrestrial communications within the sixth-generation vision of global ubiquitous connectivity. However, the extreme mobility of LEO satellites, coupled with significant propagation delays, induces severe channel aging. Existing deep learning (DL) methods often struggle with non-stationary dynamics or generalize poorly across diverse global geographies. To address these challenges, we design the Evo-TFMamba, which is an evolutionary framework integrating time-frequency selective Mamba blocks with meta-learning for generalized CSI prediction. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed Evo-TFMamba performs adaptive prediction according to the geographic coverage of LEO satellites. Meanwhile, it significantly enhances the model's generalization ability, particularly when faced with unseen channel environments in LEO satellite communication.
comment: 6 pages, 7 figures, IEEE Global Communications Conference (GLOBECOM) 2026
zh_title: 迈向广义低地球轨道信道预测：一个快速自适应时频 Mamba 框架
translation: 准确的信道状态信息（CSI）预测对于在第六代全球泛在连接愿景下的低地球轨道（LEO）卫星与地面通信中提高系统容量至关重要。然而，LEO 卫星的极端移动性以及显著的传播延迟会导致严重的信道老化。现有的深度学习（DL）方法在处理非平稳动态或跨越不同全球地理区域的泛化能力方面常常面临挑战。为了应对这些挑战，我们设计了 Evo-TFMamba，这是一个进化框架，集成了时频选择性 Mamba 模块和元学习，用于广义 CSI 预测。实验结果表明，所提出的 Evo-TFMamba 能够根据 LEO 卫星的地理覆盖范围进行自适应预测。同时，它显著提高了模型的泛化能力，特别是在面对 LEO 卫星通信中未知的信道环境时。
tldr: 该研究提出了 Evo-TFMamba 框架，通过结合时频选择性 Mamba 模块和元学习，实现了 LEO 卫星通信中广义 CSI 的快速自适应预测，解决了传统深度学习方法在处理非平稳动态和跨地域泛化能力方面的不足。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的 Evo-TFMamba 框架，将 Mamba 架构与元学习相结合，以解决 LEO 卫星通信中 CSI 预测的泛化能力和自适应性问题。其在处理非平稳动态和跨地域泛化方面的能力值得关注，为未来 LEO 通信系统的设计提供了有价值的见解。
motivation: LEO 卫星通信中，卫星的极高移动性和显著的传播延迟导致严重的信道老化，现有深度学习方法难以处理非平稳动态或跨地域泛化能力差。
method: 设计了一个名为 Evo-TFMamba 的进化框架，该框架集成了时频选择性 Mamba 模块和元学习，用于广义 CSI 预测。
results: 实验结果表明，Evo-TFMamba 能够根据 LEO 卫星的地理覆盖范围进行自适应预测，并显著提高了模型在 LEO 卫星通信中面对未知信道环境时的泛化能力。
conclusion: Evo-TFMamba 框架能够有效地解决 LEO 卫星通信中 CSI 预测的挑战，通过自适应和泛化能力的提升，为实现全球泛在连接提供了支持。

title: Deep Plug-and-Play Proximal Distance Algorithm for Robust Principal Component Analysis
authors: Guanhua Liu, Mingjie Shao, Wenxuan Sun, Zhi Liu, Yanlong Zhao
abstract: Robust Principal Component Analysis (RPCA) is essential in signal processing, with applications in hyperspectral imaging, face recognition, and video background modeling. Traditional RPCA methods often suffer from insufficient utilization of data priors and struggle to capture complex image structures. Conversely, advanced deep denoisers like DnCNN, FFDNet, and DRUNet excel at leveraging image data priors but lack physical model constraints and demonstrate poor robustness against structured noise in RPCA tasks. This paper proposes a novel Plug-and-Play (PnP) method for multi-channel RPCA, integrating both the physical generative model and cutting-edge deep priors. Extensive experiments on RGB and hyperspectral datasets show that PnP-PDA achieves better quantitative performance than conventional RPCA methods and state-of-the-art methods, including deep denoisers and tensor RPCA approaches, while preserving visual details.
zh_title: 面向鲁棒主成分分析的深度即插即用近邻距离算法
translation: 鲁棒主成分分析（RPCA）在信号处理中至关重要，应用于高光谱成像、人脸识别和视频背景建模。传统的RPCA方法往往未能充分利用数据先验，并且难以捕捉复杂的图像结构。相反，像DnCNN、FFDNet和DRUNet这样的先进深度去噪器在利用图像数据先验方面表现出色，但缺乏物理模型约束，并且在RPCA任务中对结构化噪声表现出较差的鲁棒性。本文提出了一种新颖的多通道RPCA即插即用（PnP）方法，该方法集成了物理生成模型和前沿的深度先验。在RGB和高光谱数据集上的大量实验表明，PnP-PDA在定量性能和视觉细节保留方面均优于传统RPCA方法、深度去噪器和张量RPCA方法等最先进的方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的即插即用（PnP）方法，用于多通道鲁棒主成分分析（RPCA），该方法结合了物理生成模型和先进的深度先验知识，并在实验中证明其性能优于现有方法。
ai_comments: 该研究有效地融合了物理模型和深度学习方法，为RPCA领域带来了新的解决方案。其在处理结构化噪声和复杂图像结构方面的优势值得关注，但其在不同类型噪声和数据集上的泛化能力以及计算复杂度仍需进一步研究。
motivation: 传统RPCA方法未能充分利用数据先验并捕捉复杂的图像结构，而先进的深度去噪器虽然擅长利用图像数据先验，但缺乏物理模型约束，在RPCA任务中对结构化噪声的鲁棒性较差。
method: 提出了一种新的多通道RPCA的即插即用（PnP）方法，该方法整合了物理生成模型和先进的深度先验。
results: 在RGB和高光谱数据集上的大量实验表明，PnP-PDA在定量性能和视觉细节保留方面均优于传统RPCA方法、深度去噪器和张量RPCA方法等最先进的方法。
conclusion: 所提出的PnP-PDA方法能够有效地结合物理模型和深度先验，在RPCA任务中实现优越的性能。

title: Directional Statistics in Signal Processing: A Geometry Driven Overview of Models, Learning, and Applications
authors: Anders S. Olsen, Kanti V. Mardia, Dimitri Van De Ville, Morten Mørup
abstract: Many signal-processing objects are defined by periodicity, normalization, sign or global-phase ambiguity, basis invariance, or positive-semidefinite constraints and therefore cannot be modeled faithfully in ordinary Euclidean space. This paper develops a geometry driven framework for directional statistics in signal processing, connecting signal representations to their natural manifolds or quotient spaces and to probability models compatible with their invariances. After reviewing instances of directional statistics in the signal processing literature, we review circular, toroidal, spherical, projective, Stiefel, Grassmann, and covariance-valued distributions, emphasizing their statistical assumptions, computational requirements, and dimensional limitations relevant to signal processing. We describe various modeling and estimation strategies, including analytical and gradient-based maximum likelihood, structured low-rank parameterizations, mixtures and hidden Markov models (HMMs), score-based and contrastive estimation, and geometry-aware K-means. To exemplify the consequences of geometry-aware modeling, we study multivariate phase coherence in synthetic data and functional neuroimaging, comparing toroidal phase vectors to projective, Grassmann, and positive-semidefinite representations. We also study speaker separation in a car environment, showing that directional representations outperform a standard Euclidean model. These examples demonstrate that when the geometric representation, statistical distribution, inference method, and computational regime are considered together, they have the potential to lead to improved models across a broad range of signal processing applications.
zh_title: 信号处理中的定向统计学：模型、学习和应用中的几何驱动概述
translation: 许多信号处理对象由于具有周期性、归一化、符号或全局相位模糊性、基不变性或半正定约束，因此无法在普通的欧几里得空间中进行精确建模。本文为信号处理中的定向统计学开发了一个由几何驱动的框架，将信号表示与其自然流形或商空间以及与其不变性兼容的概率模型联系起来。在回顾了信号处理文献中的定向统计学实例后，我们回顾了圆形、环形、球面、射影、Stiefel、Grassmann 和协方差值的分布，强调了它们与信号处理相关的统计假设、计算要求和维度限制。我们描述了各种建模和估计策略，包括解析和基于梯度的最大似然估计、结构化低秩参数化、混合模型和隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）、基于分数的估计和对比度估计以及几何感知的 K-均值。为了例证几何感知建模的后果，我们研究了合成数据和功能性神经成像中的多变量相位相干性，并将环形相位向量与射影、Grassmann 和半正定表示进行了比较。我们还研究了汽车环境中的声源分离，表明定向表示优于标准的欧几里得模型。这些例子表明，当几何表示、统计分布、推理方法和计算方案一起考虑时，它们有潜力在广泛的信号处理应用中改进模型。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于几何的定向统计框架，用于信号处理，将信号表示与其自然流形或商空间以及兼容的概率模型联系起来。它回顾了各种分布、建模和估计策略，并通过多变量相位相干性和声源分离的例子展示了其在信号处理应用中的优势。
ai_comments: 该论文提供了一个全面的、由几何驱动的框架，用于解决信号处理中许多传统方法难以处理的数据。其优点在于将几何结构、统计模型和计算方法相结合，以实现更优越的性能。然而，该框架的计算复杂性和对领域特定知识的需求可能是其在某些实际应用中的局限性。
motivation: 许多信号处理对象（如具有周期性、归一化、符号或全局相位模糊性、基不变性或半正定约束的对象）无法在普通的欧几里得空间中进行精确建模。
method: 该论文开发了一个基于几何的定向统计框架，将信号表示与其自然流形或商空间以及兼容的概率模型联系起来。它回顾了各种分布（如圆形、环形、球面、射影、Stiefel、Grassmann 和协方差值分布）、建模和估计策略（如最大似然估计、基于梯度的估计、低秩参数化、混合模型、隐马尔可夫模型、基于分数的估计、对比度估计和 K-均值聚类）。论文通过多变量相位相干性和声源分离的例子来展示几何感知建模的优势。
results: 研究表明，将几何表示、统计分布、推理方法和计算方案结合起来，可以改进各种信号处理应用中的模型。具体而言，在多变量相位相干性和声源分离的例子中，基于几何的表示优于标准的欧几里得模型。
conclusion: 当几何表示、统计分布、推理方法和计算方案协同工作时，它们有潜力在广泛的信号处理应用中改进模型。

title: Attendance-guided speaker enrollment across meetings
authors: Minjae Lee, Hee-Soo Heo, Youngki Kwon, Bong-Jin Lee
abstract: Speaker-aware applications rely on enrolled voice profiles, yet collecting enrollment speech from every participant is impractical. Meeting archives provide an alternative source of enrollment speech, comprising recordings of recurring participants paired with expected attendance lists. We investigate whether expected attendance lists can be cross-referenced with diarized anonymous speaker clusters to identify reliable enrollment speech for recurring participants. The resulting task, multi-participant automatic enrollment, must accommodate two types of attendance noise: a listed participant may not speak, and a speaker may be unlisted. To this end, we introduce a benchmark for the task: a synthetic corpus calibrated to an in-house meeting corpus, paired with a contamination-sensitive evaluation protocol. The reference method we introduce scores cross-session cluster chains against expected-attendance patterns and abstains when the evidence is insufficient. We quantify the reference method's benchmark performance as a trade-off between enrollment success and contamination. Applying synthetic-development thresholds unchanged to real meetings exposes a synthetic-to-real gap that remains an open challenge. We will release the benchmark generator and evaluation code.
zh_title: 会议期间的考勤辅助说话人注册
translation: 说话人识别应用依赖于注册的语音配置文件，但从每个参与者那里收集注册语音是不切实际的。会议档案提供了注册语音的替代来源，包括经常出现的参与者的录音以及预期的出勤名单。我们研究了预期的出勤名单是否可以与经过日记化处理的匿名说话人聚类进行交叉引用，以识别经常出现的参与者的可靠注册语音。由此产生的任务，即多参与者自动注册，必须适应两种类型的出勤噪音：列出的参与者可能不会发言，而发言者可能未被列出。为此，我们为该任务引入了一个基准：一个与内部会议语料库校准的合成语料库，以及一个污染敏感的评估协议。我们引入的参考方法将跨会话聚类链与预期出勤模式进行评分，并在证据不足时弃权。我们将参考方法的基准性能量化为注册成功率和污染率之间的权衡。将合成开发阈值不加改变地应用于真实会议会暴露合成到真实的差距，这仍然是一个开放的挑战。我们将发布基准生成器和评估代码。
tldr: 无法为每个与会者收集语音信息，因此研究人员提出一种利用会议记录和出勤名单来识别可靠的注册语音的方法，并构建了一个基准测试集和评估协议来衡量该方法的性能。
ai_comments: 这项研究提出了一个有趣且实用的解决方案，用于解决说话人注册语音获取的实际问题。通过利用现有的会议记录和出勤信息，该研究为说话人识别应用提供了一种更便捷的语音注册方式。然而，合成数据与真实数据之间的差距是一个需要关注的挑战，未来的研究可以进一步探索如何缩小这一差距，例如通过更真实的模拟或迁移学习技术。
motivation: 为需要注册语音配置文件的说话人识别应用收集语音信息不切实际，尤其是在会议场景下。
method: 利用出勤名单交叉引用会议记录中的说话人聚类，以识别可靠的注册语音。提出了一种新的基准测试任务（多参与者自动注册），并构建了一个合成语料库和一个评估协议，以应对出勤噪音（例如，列出的参与者未发言，或有未列出的发言者）。
results: 提出的参考方法在基准测试中的性能表现为注册成功率和错误率之间的权衡。将针对合成数据训练的阈值直接应用于真实会议数据会暴露合成数据与真实数据之间的差距。
conclusion: 虽然提出的方法在基准测试中表现出一定的潜力，但合成数据与真实数据之间的差距仍然是一个需要解决的挑战。研究人员将发布基准生成器和评估代码。

title: Movable Antenna Aided Robust Wireless Transmission: From Model-Based Optimization to Scalable Reinforcement Learning
authors: Jinshuo Zhang, Yafei Wang, Hongwei Hou, Wenjin Wang, Shi Jin, Symeon Chatzinotas, Björn Ottersten
abstract: This paper investigates robust joint antenna positioning and precoding for multiuser movable antenna (MA) systems under imperfect channel state information (CSI). First, we identify the mismatch between the spatial statistics of densely sampled MA channels and the discrete Fourier transform (DFT) basis used for conventional robust precoding. To address this, we develop a novel discrete prolate spheroidal sequence (DPSS)-based a posteriori channel model. By exploiting the spatial covariance structure of MA channels, this model is better suited to modeling MA channel uncertainty. Building on this model, we develop an efficient iterative algorithm for robust joint antenna positioning and precoding to maximize the expected sum rate. By transforming the coupled optimization of antenna positioning and precoding at each iteration into direct comparisons of closed-form scores, we design a low-complexity position replacement scheme that effectively reuses matrix computations across candidate sets. To further improve efficiency and scalability, we exploit the inherent tensor equivariance (TE) of the problem to develop a reinforcement learning framework. To explicitly account for channel uncertainty, we develop novel pairwise user-interaction and CSI-conditioned equivariant attention mechanisms to encode channel statistics and adaptively fuse them with the available CSI. We further introduce distance-biased spatial attention to incorporate the geometry of candidate positions into attention weighting, thereby enhancing spatial feature learning. Simulation results show that the proposed methods improve sum-rate performance while reducing online runtime under imperfect CSI. These methods also achieve near-optimal performance under perfect CSI, closely matching the exhaustive-search method. Moreover, the learning framework generalizes across different numbers of users and MAs without retraining.
