title: GhostPrefix: Synchronization-Free Universal Prefix Attacks for ASR Manipulation
authors: Shengding Liu, Ashwin Innuganti, Qiben Yan
abstract: We present GhostPrefix, the first synchronization-free universal adversarial prefix attack against automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems. Unlike prior audio attacks, which are typically crafted per utterance, require synchronization with the victim waveform, or target narrow objectives, GhostPrefix learns a short, reusable audio segment prepended to arbitrary live speech to exert real-time control over ASR outputs without knowledge of the future utterance or temporal alignment. A key challenge is maintaining stable adversarial effects across unknown, evolving speech contexts. GhostPrefix combines token-level losses with a novel representation-level objective for stable, input-agnostic effects. GhostPrefix supports three attack modes: (i) prompted prefix attacks for semantic steering, (ii) targeted prefix attacks for transcript hijacking, and (iii) untargeted prefix attacks for transcription degradation. To remain perceptually inconspicuous, we regularize prefixes toward benign environmental-sound distributions and improve robustness against over-the-air distortions. We evaluate GhostPrefix across 13 open-source ASR models from four families. In digital settings, it achieves average attack success rates of 97.6% for prompted steering and 93.4% for targeted hijacking, while driving word error rate to 1.18 under untargeted attacks. Over the air, it achieves success rates of 91.5% and 89.5% for prompted and targeted modes, respectively. These manipulations propagate into downstream AI-assisted pipelines, including voice assistants and AI note-taking tools, causing systematic semantic misinterpretations. GhostPrefix exposes synchronization-free universal prefixes as a practical, under-explored threat to real-world ASR and downstream applications. Artifacts and demos are available at https://ghostprefix.github.io/.

title: There Is No Free Loop: When Does Looping a Trained Model Pay for Its Inference Compute?
authors: Rhea Sanjay Sukthanker, Pashmina Cameron
abstract: Looping re-applies a block of layers so that each token passes through the block more than once. Adding a loop to a trained model is attractive because it leaves the parameter count, and hence the disk size, the memory footprint and the training cost unchanged. Unfortunately, every generated token pays for the loop. Re-applying m of N layers makes each token about (N+m)/N times as expensive. Loops that a model learns during large-scale pretraining justify this price, but whether loops added after pretraining justify this cost remains unclear. We compare a looped model with two simple baselines. We first compare it with the same model trained identically without the loop (equal parameters). Secondly, we compare it with the best unlooped use of the same inference floating-point operations (equal FLOPs). Across Qwen3 and Qwen3.5 models from 0.8B to 9B parameters, only the looped 0.8B model beats both baselines. At 4B and 9B, the looped model does not beat the first baseline, i.e. the same model trained without the loop. This is not because the benchmarks are too easy, since on the same benchmarks the unlooped 9B model still scores up to 13 points higher than the 4B model, showing that there is ample room for improvement. Introducing loops in an already pretrained model therefore only pays for small models with a fixed parameter budget.

title: Any Forcing: Any-Step Generality and One-Step Stability for Autoregressive Video Generation
authors: Jiahua Xu, Yijie Fang, Nannan Wang, Xunhao Lin, Li Cao, Lei Hao, Mingrui Zhu, Fei Gao, Xinbo Gao
abstract: Autoregressive video generation enables efficient inference through streaming prediction. However, existing methods are typically restricted to fixed sampling steps, limiting the flexibility to balance generation quality and efficiency, while one-step generation suffers from degraded visual quality and error accumulation over long sequences, leading to content drift and generation collapse. To address these issues, we propose Any Forcing, a unified framework for achieving Any-Step Generality and One-Step Stability. Specifically, we introduce a unified adversarial discriminator that jointly performs real-distribution alignment, inter-step consistency alignment, and first-frame quality enhancement, enabling flexible sampling while preserving one-step generation quality. Furthermore, we propose a training-free adaptive long-term memory selection mechanism that selects historical states based on global semantic relevance and local value contribution, while remapping their temporal positions to preserve temporal relationships within the memory cache, thereby enabling stable one-step long-video generation. Experiments demonstrate that Any Forcing achieves high-quality and stable one-step autoregressive video generation, achieving 20.9 FPS and 24.7 FPS for short and long video generation on a single H100 GPU, respectively.

title: Beyond Smart Homes: Characterizing IoT Vulnerabilities Across Sectors, Vendors, and Products
authors: Tina Rezaei, Suzan Bayhan, Andrea Continella, Jeroen van der Ham-de Vos, Roland van Rijswijk-Deij
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has expanded beyond consumer smart homes to sectors, such as industrial systems, healthcare, and smart cities, broadening the IoT attack surface. Prior empirical work has focused on studying aggregate IoT vulnerability characteristics or specific protocols, so patching is directed by aggregate security guidance. However, if dominant weaknesses differ substantially across sectors or products, such uniform guidance misdirects the remediation effort. To address this gap, we present a fine-grained, data-driven analysis of IoT vulnerabilities using a dataset of more than 15,000 IoT specific CVEs. We design a pipeline to enrich noisy CPE (Common Platform Enumeration) metadata, normalizing vendors and products, then assigning product type and sector labels using lexical matching, fuzzy clustering, and LLM-assisted classification. We find meaningful differences in the weakness profile of IoT sectors. For example, healthcare is dominated by authentication and credential weaknesses, while automotive faces memory issues. More importantly, we find that weakness profiles are more similar across different product types from the same vendor than across the same product type built by different vendors. This suggests vendor-level factors such as shared code and development practices dominate weakness inheritance, making a vendor's disclosure history informative about its other products. Our findings suggest weakness classes should be used to prioritize remediation efforts.
zh_title: 超越智能家居：跨行业、厂商与产品的物联网漏洞特征分析
translation: 物联网（IoT）已从消费级智能家居拓展至工业系统、医疗保健和智慧城市等领域，从而扩大了物联网的攻击面。以往的实证研究主要集中在分析聚合的物联网漏洞特征或特定协议，因此补丁修复受总体安全指南的指导。然而，如果不同行业或产品的主要弱点存在巨大差异，这种统一指南就会误导修复工作。为了解决这一差距，我们利用包含15,000多个物联网特定CVE的数据集，对物联网漏洞进行了细粒度、数据驱动的分析。我们设计了一条流水线来丰富包含噪声的CPE（通用平台枚举）元数据，规范化厂商与产品，并使用词汇匹配、模糊聚类和LLM辅助分类来赋予产品类型和行业标签。我们发现不同物联网行业的弱点分布存在显著差异。例如，医疗行业以身份验证和凭据弱点为主，而汽车行业则面临内存问题。更重要的是，我们发现来自同一厂商的不同产品类型之间的弱点分布相似度，高于不同厂商生产的同类产品。这表明共享代码和开发规范等厂商层面的因素主导了弱点的继承，使得厂商的历史披露信息对其其他产品具有参考价值。我们的研究结果表明，应利用弱点类别来排定修复工作的优先级。
tldr: 通过分析15,000多个IoT CVE发现，各行业弱点特征差异显著，且同一厂商跨产品的弱点相似度高于不同厂商同类产品，表明修复工作应按弱点类别与厂商特性定制，而非依赖笼统的统一指导。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地指出宏观统一的安全修补指导存在误区，首次在大规模实证中揭示了“厂商开发习惯与共享代码对漏洞分布的影响大于产品形态自身”这一重要现象。结合LLM与传统聚类方法清洗CPE元数据也具有很高的实用工程价值。局限在于分析主要依赖公开披露的CVE数据，可能受到各行业披露偏差（disclosure bias）的影响。
motivation: 先前的物联网经验研究多聚焦于聚合漏洞特征或特定协议，导致安全修补依赖笼统统一的指南；若不同行业或产品的主要弱点存在显著差异，这种统一指南将误导修复资源的分配与优先级。
method: 构建基于15,000多条IoT特定CVE的数据集，设计元数据清洗管线丰富CPE信息、归一化厂商与产品，并综合运用词汇匹配、模糊聚类和大语言模型（LLM）辅助分类为产品标注类型与行业标签，进而开展细粒度的数据驱动分析。
results: 不同物联网行业的弱点分布差异明显（如医疗偏向认证与凭据弱点，汽车行业多为内存问题）；同一厂商不同产品间的弱点相似度高于不同厂商同类产品间的相似度。
conclusion: 厂商层面的因素（如共享代码和开发规范）主导了弱点的继承，厂商的漏洞披露历史可为其其他产品提供重要参考；安全修复工作应摒弃一刀切的方式，依据具体的弱点类别来确定优先级。

title: Treedepth is NP-Hard on Planar Graphs of Maximum Degree 3
authors: Kolja Kühn
abstract: Treedepth is an important parameter in algorithmic graph theory. It is known that the problem of computing the treedepth of a graph is NP-hard. It has been an open problem whether treedepth can be computed in polynomial time when the input graph is restricted to be planar, or of bounded degree. Assuming $P \neq NP$, we answer both questions in the negative: Under polynomial-time Turing reductions, it is NP-hard to compute the treedepth of planar graphs with maximum degree 3. This degree bound is best possible, since treedepth can be computed efficiently on graphs of maximum degree 2.
zh_title: 树深度在最大度为3的平面图上是NP难的
translation: 树深度是算法图论中一个重要的参数。已知计算图的树深度问题是NP难的。当输入图限制为平面图或有界度图时，树深度是否能在多项式时间内计算一直是一个开放问题。假设P≠NP，我们对这两个问题都给出了否定的回答：在多项式时间图灵归约下，在最大度为3的平面图上计算树深度是NP难的。这个度数界限是最佳的，因为最大度为2的图的树深度可以高效计算。
tldr: 在最大度为3的平面图上计算树深度是NP难的，解决了开放问题。
ai_comments: 这项研究解决了算法图论中一个长期存在的开放问题，澄清了树深度计算在特定图类上的复杂性。其创新之处在于证明了在非常受限的图类（最大度为3的平面图）上，该问题仍然是NP难的，并且给出了一个紧密的度数界限，这对于理解该问题的计算边界至关重要。
motivation: 计算图的树深度问题已知是NP难的。此前，对于输入图限制为平面图或有界度图时，树深度是否能在多项式时间内计算是一个开放问题。
method: 作者通过多项式时间图灵归约证明，在最大度为3的平面图上计算树深度是NP难的。
results: 在P≠NP的假设下，计算最大度为3的平面图的树深度是NP难的。这个度数界限是最佳的，因为最大度为2的图的树深度可以高效计算。
conclusion: 本文否定地回答了关于平面图或有界度图上树深度计算的开放问题，证明了在最大度为3的平面图上计算树深度是NP难的。

title: Same Question, Different Answers: Auditing Persona-Dependent Variation in Six LLMs on Smoking-Cessation Advice
authors: Artin Yousefi, Aizierjiang Aiersilan, Lorien C Abroms, David A Broniatowski
abstract: Hundreds of millions of people now ask large language model (LLM) chatbots for health advice, which raises a question that is simple to pose and hard to answer: does everyone get the same advice? We audit six widely deployed LLMs from four providers on smoking cessation, a domain with codified clini- cal guidance and substantial public-health stakes, by putting the same four cessation questions to twelve user personas that differ in life stage, self-described expertise, and smoking history, for a total of 2,880 responses. What the models say depends on who appears to be asking. Every model named FDA-approved prescription cessation medications less often to teen personas than to adult personas, by 32 to 67 percentage points, and in five of six models a persona presenting health- care expertise received fewer facts than a persona presenting none. We then evaluate one deployable intervention: a short system prompt specifying a factual floor, the set of core med- ical facts every user should receive when they are relevant, while leaving tone, vocabulary, and framing free to adapt. The prompt narrows persona differences in every model, but its effect on overall fact coverage varies in both magnitude and direction across models, so a prompt validated on one system cannot be assumed to transfer to another. Two cautions frame these results. Equal mention rates are not always the correct clinical target, because prescription cessation pharmacother- apy is not recommended for minors, so a defensible factual floor must be age-aware rather than uniform. And because our personas vary on several attributes at once, we report scenario- level differences rather than isolated effects of age or expertise. We release all 2,880 responses and the analysis code.
zh_title: 同样的问题，不同的答案：审计六款大语言模型在戒烟建议中因人设而异的差异
translation: 如今已有数以亿计的人向大语言模型（LLM）聊天机器人寻求健康建议，这引发了一个提出简单却难以回答的问题：所有人得到的建议都一样吗？我们在戒烟这一拥有明确临床指南和重大公共卫生利益的领域，对来自四个供应商的六种广泛部署的LLM进行了审计。我们针对在人生阶段、自述专业知识和吸烟史方面各不相同的十二种用户人设，提出了相同的四个戒烟问题，共获取2,880条回答。模型的回答取决于提问者的身份。在所有模型中，对青少年人设提及经FDA批准的处方戒烟药物的频率均低于成年人人设（低32到67个百分点）；在六个模型中的五个里，表现出具有医疗专业知识的人设所获得的事实信息少于表现出无专业知识的人设。随后我们评估了一种可部署的干预措施：一段指定“事实底线”（即在相关时每个用户都应收到的核心医学事实集）的简短系统提示词，同时允许语气、词汇和表达框架自由调整。该提示词缩小了每个模型中的人设差异，但其对整体事实覆盖率的影响在不同模型间的幅度和方向上均存在差异，因此在某一系统上验证有效的提示词不能假定可直接迁移到另一系统。有两个注意事项界定了这些结果：相同的提及率并不总是正确的临床目标，因为处方戒烟药物治疗并不推荐给未成年人，因此站得住脚的事实底线必须具备年龄感知能力而非一刀切；此外，由于我们的人设同时在多个属性上存在差异，我们报告的是场景级别的差异，而非年龄或专业知识的孤立影响。我们开源了全部2,880条回答及分析代码。
tldr: 审计发现六款主流LLM对不同人设的戒烟建议差异显著（如对青少年提及药物更少），利用系统提示词设定“事实底线”能缩小差异但难以跨模型直接迁移。
ai_comments: 本研究切中大语言模型在医疗健康咨询领域落地的核心痛点——公平性与一致性。创新性地提出了基于临床指南的“事实底线”（factual floor）提示词干预策略，既保持表达风格灵活性又约束核心医学事实。研究的局限性在于人设变量同时包含多个属性，只能分析场景级差异而未能彻底隔离单一变量（如年龄或专业知识）的独立因果效应，且提示词策略的跨模型迁移性有限。
motivation: 数以亿计的用户向大语言模型寻求健康咨询，但在具有明确临床指南与重大公共卫生意义的戒烟领域，模型是否会对不同背景的用户给出一致、合理的建议尚缺乏系统性审计。
method: 对4家供应商的6种主流LLM进行审计，设置12种涵盖不同人生阶段、自述专业背景及吸烟史的用户人设，针对4个相同的戒烟问题收集共2,880条回答进行评估；随后测试了一种旨在设定“事实底线”的核心医学事实系统提示词干预方法。
results: 所有模型对青少年人设提及FDA批准的戒烟处方药比例比成年人低32%至67%；5个模型对自称有医疗背景的人设提供的医学事实少于普通人人设。引入系统提示词干预后，各模型内的人设差异均有所缩小，但对事实覆盖率的整体影响在不同模型间幅度和方向各异，难以直接通用迁移。
conclusion: 不同用户人设显著影响大模型给出的健康建议，但“绝对相同”并不等同于“临床合理”（例如未成年人需特殊用药考量），因此事实底线须具备年龄感知能力；此外，基于提示词的干预措施在跨模型迁移时效果存在不确定性。

title: Learning Clean Generative Processes from Noisy Measurements
authors: Fabian Kruse, Lorenzo Baldassari, Ivan Dokmanić
abstract: We study how to learn a generative model of clean images using only noisy observations. Diffusion processes and their generalizations to non-Gaussian noise require posterior predictions at every noise level. We first show that it is possible to learn these predictions from independent noisy views using Noise2Noise regression, but only at or above the noise level of the training data. To learn the predictions below that level, needed to generate clean images, we impose consistency: a prediction should equal its expectation after continuing the sampling process. We derive conditions under which consistency uniquely determines the continuation to the clean image distribution and verify them for Poisson, binomial, Gamma, and negative-binomial measurements. Experiments on CIFAR-10, photon-counting microscopy, and synthetic aperture radar show that the required posterior predictions can be learned from noisy views alone and that the consistency relation repairs the continuation beyond the noise level of the data, which severely deteriorates without consistency.
zh_title: 从噪声测量中学习干净的生成过程
translation: 我们研究如何仅使用噪声观测来学习干净图像的生成模型。扩散过程及其对非高斯噪声的推广要求在每个噪声水平进行后验预测。我们首先表明，可以使用Noise2Noise回归从独立的噪声视图中学习这些预测，但仅限于训练数据噪声水平或以上。为了学习低于该水平的预测（这是生成干净图像所必需的），我们施加了一致性：预测应该等于采样过程继续后的期望。我们推导了在何种条件下，一致性可以唯一确定到干净图像分布的延续，并针对泊松、二项式、伽马和负二项式测量进行了验证。在CIFAR-10、光子计数显微镜和合成孔径雷达上的实验表明，所需的后验预测可以仅从噪声视图中学习，并且一致性关系修复了数据噪声水平之外的延续，而没有一致性时，这种延续会严重恶化。
tldr: 本文研究了如何仅使用噪声观测来学习干净图像的生成模型，通过引入一致性条件解决了在训练数据噪声水平以下进行预测的挑战，并在多种噪声类型和数据集上验证了其有效性。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个“一致性”条件来解决从噪声观测中学习干净生成模型在低噪声水平下的挑战。通过结合Noise2Noise和新的理论推导，它提供了一种在非高斯噪声环境下生成高质量图像的有效途径，对于处理真实世界中普遍存在的噪声数据具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的扩散过程及其非高斯噪声泛化方法需要对每个噪声水平进行后验预测，但仅使用噪声观测来学习干净图像的生成模型是一个挑战，特别是在训练数据噪声水平以下进行预测时。
method: 首先使用Noise2Noise回归从独立的噪声视图中学习后验预测，但发现这只在训练数据噪声水平或以上有效。为了学习低于该水平的预测，引入了一致性条件：预测应该等于采样过程继续后的期望。推导了该一致性条件唯一确定到干净图像分布的延续的条件，并针对泊松、二项式、伽马和负二项式测量进行了验证。
results: 实验证明，所需的后验预测可以仅从噪声视图中学习，并且一致性关系修复了数据噪声水平之外的延续，而没有一致性时，这种延续会严重恶化。
conclusion: 本文成功地展示了如何仅使用噪声观测来学习干净图像的生成模型，通过引入一致性条件解决了在训练数据噪声水平以下进行预测的难题，并验证了其在多种噪声类型和实际应用中的有效性。

title: A richness-sensitive Acoustic Biodiversity Index from species-level detections: classifier benchmarking, false-positive control and validation against standard soundscape indices in an African savanna and an urban zoo
authors: Muhammad Saeed, Dmitry Mikhaylov, Mohamed H. Alhosani, Yasser F. Al Wahedi, Rory Pilossof, Ahmed Arabi, Walid Shaaba
abstract: Acoustic indices are widely used as rapid proxies for biodiversity, but they summarise the distribution of sound energy rather than the species producing it and often track richness poorly. We revise and test an Acoustic Biodiversity Index (ABI) built from species-level detections. Its primary form, ABI_E, is Shannon diversity of detections normalised by the regional species pool expected at the site and season (H / ln S_ref); temporal stability T is reported as a separate component. We first benchmarked four classifiers on a strongly labelled tropical dataset (1,216 calls, 24 classes) with recording-grouped cross-validation. BirdNET embeddings + logistic regression performed best (macro-F1 0.750 +/- 0.029), and random frame-level splits inflated accuracy from 0.41 to 0.70. We then applied BirdNET v2.4 with a location and season filter to recordings from a riverine savanna in the Zambezi Valley, Zimbabwe, and from three habitats at Emirates Park Zoo and Resort, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. A stricter post-hoc location filter removed 517 high-confidence detections of 9 implausible species, all at the zoo. After diel-matched rarefaction to equal effort (6 h), the savanna site held 21 species (Hill number 1D = 9.83; ABI_E = 0.38) against 1.3-13 species (ABI_E = 0.03-0.21) at the zoo sites. Across 149 recorded hours, ABI_E correlated strongly with richness (Spearman rho = 0.93), whereas six standard indices did not (best: ACI, rho = 0.48). The stability term was lower at the savanna site (0.39) than at the zoo (0.65-0.67), showing that it penalises the natural diel cycle of bird activity. Species-level indices with explicit false-positive control, a declared regional reference pool and effort standardisation provide a more interpretable biodiversity indicator than energy-based acoustic indices.
comment: 35 pages, 16 figures, 7 tables; supplementary tables and figures included
zh_title: 基于物种水平检测的丰富度敏感声学生物多样性指数：在非洲稀树草原与城市动物园中的分类器基准测试、假阳性控制及与标准声景指数的验证
translation: 声学指数被广泛用作生物多样性的快速代理指标，但它们总结的是声音能量的分布而非产生声音的物种，且通常对物种丰富度的追踪效果较差。我们修正并测试了一种由物种水平检测构建的声学生物多样性指数（ABI）。其主要形式ABI_E是检测结果的香农多样性，并按该位点和季节预期的区域物种库进行标准化（H / ln S_ref）；时间稳定性T作为独立组件报告。我们首先在一个强标签热带数据集（1,216个叫声，24个类别）上对四个分类器进行了基准测试，采用录音分组交叉验证。BirdNET嵌入加逻辑回归表现最好（macro-F1为0.750 ± 0.029），而随机帧级分割将准确率从0.41夸大到0.70。然后，我们将带有位置和季节过滤器的BirdNET v2.4应用于津巴布韦赞比西河谷的河岸稀树草原以及阿拉伯联合酋长国阿布扎比阿联酋公园动物园和度假村三个栖息地的录音。更严格的事后位置过滤器删除了517个高置信度检测结果，涉及9个不合理的物种，全部在动物园发现。在进行等效工作量（6小时）的日周期匹配稀疏化后，稀树草原样地拥有21个物种（Hill数 1D = 9.83；ABI_E = 0.38），而动物园样地为1.3-13个物种（ABI_E = 0.03-0.21）。在149个记录小时中，ABI_E与丰富度呈强相关（Spearman rho = 0.93），而六种标准指数则不然（最高者为ACI，rho = 0.48）。稀树草原样地的稳定性项较低（0.39），动物园为0.65-0.67，这表明它惩罚了鸟类活动的自然日周期。具有显式假阳性控制、申报的区域参考库和工作量标准化的物种水平指数，比基于能量的声学指数提供了更具可解释性的生物多样性指标。
tldr: 提出一种基于物种识别和假阳性控制的新型声学生物多样性指数（ABI），经实测证明其比传统能量声学指数更能有效反映物种丰富度。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种基于物种水平检测的声学生物多样性指数（ABI），并通过结合分类器基准测试、假阳性控制和标准化方法，克服了传统声学指数无法反映物种丰富度的缺点，在非洲稀树草原和城市动物园的验证中表现出优异性能。
motivation: 传统的声学指数主要总结声音能量的分布而非产生声音的物种，通常无法很好地追踪物种丰富度，因此需要开发一种基于物种水平检测的、对丰富度敏感的声学生物多样性指数。
method: 首先对四个分类器进行了基准测试，采用BirdNET提取嵌入特征结合逻辑回归；随后在赞比西河谷稀树草原和阿布扎比动物园的应用中引入位置和季节过滤器进行假阳性控制，利用等工作量稀疏化处理计算出ABI_E指数并与六种传统声学指数进行比较。
results: BirdNET嵌入加逻辑回归表现最佳（macro-F1为0.750）；严格的位置过滤消除了动物园中的不合理物种检测；稀树草原站点的ABI_E（0.38）高于动物园站点（0.03-0.21）；在149小时的录音中，ABI_E与丰富度的相关性极强（Spearman rho = 0.93），而六种标准指数表现较差（最高为ACI的0.48）。
conclusion: 基于物种水平检测并结合假阳性控制与区域参考库的ABI指数，比传统的能量型声学指数能更准确、直观地反映生物多样性和物种丰富度。

title: System-Level Factors Influencing AGC Cyber-Attack Success and RAS Vulnerability in Multi-Area Grids
authors: Abdulmannan Ajabnoor, Zhi Jin Zhang, Maryam Saeedifard, Dominic Groß
abstract: Automatic generation control (AGC) stabilizes frequency and scheduled power exchanges among interconnected areas, yet its reliance on communication networks introduces cyber-vulnerabilities. This work examines coordinated AGC cyber-attacks in the presence of remedial action schemes (RAS) and identifies operating conditions under which an attacker can drive grid frequency beyond safe limits while evading RAS. A feedback-based attack policy is used to manipulate AGC signals and steer system frequency toward unsafe trajectories. Then, a large nested-loop parametric sweep---spanning attacked-area inertia relative to its interconnected neighboring area, AGC capacity versus maximum tie-line transfer, AGC update rate, load damping, and bi-directional power transfers---generates over 1.45 million scenarios. These are classified using a decision tree to establish guidelines to distinguish successful from unsuccessful attacks based on frequency deviations. The resulting vulnerability guidelines are validated on a three-area system using phasor-domain simulations with IEEE 9-bus area models, detailed turbine--governor dynamics, and under/over-frequency load and generation shedding. Results show that specific combinations of AGC capacity, inertia distribution, and pre-attack tie-line loading increase the likelihood of successful attacks, offering operators actionable criteria for identifying vulnerable operating conditions.
zh_title: 多区域电网中影响AGC网络攻击成功率与RAS脆弱性的系统级因素
translation: 自动发电控制（AGC）用于稳定互联区域之间的频率和计划功率交换，然而其对通信网络的依赖引入了网络漏洞。本研究探讨了在纠正动作方案（RAS）存在情况下的协同AGC网络攻击，并识别了攻击者在驱动电网频率超出安全限制同时规避RAS时的运行条件。采用基于反馈的攻击策略来操纵AGC信号，并将系统频率引导向不安全轨迹。随后，通过大规模嵌套循环参数扫描——涵盖受攻击区域相对于邻近区域的惯性、AGC容量与最大联络线传输容量之比、AGC更新速率、负荷阻尼以及双向功率传输——生成了超过145万个场景。这些场景通过决策树进行分类，从而根据频率偏差建立区分成功攻击与不成功攻击的准则。所得出的脆弱性准则在一个包含IEEE 9节点区域模型、详细的汽轮机-调速器动态以及欠/过频负荷与发电切除的三区域系统上进行了相量域仿真验证。结果表明，AGC容量、惯量分布和攻击前联络线负荷的特定组合增加了攻击成功的可能性，为运营商识别脆弱运行条件提供了可操作的标准。
tldr: 本文通过大规模参数扫描和决策树分析，揭示了多区域电网中影响AGC网络攻击成功和规避纠正动作方案（RAS）的关键系统级因素。
ai_comments: 该研究通过大规模参数扫描和决策树分类，揭示了影响多区域电网AGC网络攻击成功率的关键系统级因素，并将研究成果与纠正动作方案（RAS）的脆弱性相结合，对电力系统安全运行具有重要指导意义。
motivation: 自动发电控制（AGC）对维持电网频率和功率交换至关重要，但其对通信网络的依赖引入了网络安全漏洞。本文旨在探究在纠正动作方案（RAS）存在的情况下，协调AGC网络攻击的成功条件，并识别使攻击者能够突破频率安全限制同时规避RAS的系统运行条件。
method: 采用基于反馈的攻击策略来操纵AGC信号，通过跨越多个系统参数的大规模嵌套循环参数扫描生成超过145万个场景，并利用决策树对这些场景进行分类，最后在包含IEEE 9节点区域模型的三区域系统上进行相量域仿真验证。
results: 研究表明，特定的AGC容量、惯量分布和攻击前联络线负荷组合会增加攻击成功的概率，从而为运营商识别脆弱运行条件提供了可操作的准则。
conclusion: 特定系统因素（如AGC容量、惯量分布和联络线负荷）的组合会显著增加AGC网络攻击成功的可能性，该研究提出的准则可为电网运营商识别脆弱运行条件提供可操作的依据。

title: Optimal Online Weighted Connectivity Augmentation
authors: Mohit Garg, Felix Hommelsheim, Alexander Lindermayr
abstract:
In the online Weighted Connectivity Augmentation Problem (WCAP), we are given a $k$-edge-connected graph on $n$ vertices and a set of additional edges, called links, with nonnegative costs. Pairs of vertices arrive one by one, and an online algorithm must immediately and irrevocably buy links so that each pair becomes $(k+1)$-edge-connected. The goal is to minimize the total cost of the purchased links.
  We obtain a deterministic polynomial-time $O(\log n)$-competitive algorithm for WCAP, improving the previous $O(\log^2 n)$ bound (SODA 2026). Our bound is asymptotically optimal, even for randomized algorithms in the random-order model. The general problem reduces to the case where the underlying graph is a cycle, for which link costs in $\{0,1\}$ already yield an $Ω(\log n)$ lower bound. Surprisingly, for unit costs on a cycle, we obtain a deterministic polynomial-time $4$-competitive algorithm, improving the previous $O(\log n)$ bound (SODA 2026), and prove that this ratio is optimal among deterministic algorithms. Thus, with unit costs, cycles are easier than trees, where the optimal competitive ratio is $Θ(\log n)$.
zh_title: 最优在线加权连通性增强
translation:
在在线加权连通性增强问题（WCAP）中，给定一个具有$n$个顶点的$k$边连通图以及一组带有非负成本的附加边（称为连线）。顶点对逐个到达，在线算法必须立即且不可撤销地购买连线，使得每一对顶点变得$(k+1)$边连通。目标是最小化所购连线的总成本。
我们针对WCAP获得了一个确定性的多项式时间$O(\log n)$竞争比算法，改进了先前（SODA 2026）的$O(\log^2 n)$界。我们的界是渐进最优的，即使对于随机顺序模型中的随机化算法也是如此。一般问题可归约到底图为环的情况，对于该情况，即使连线成本仅在$\{0,1\}$中，也已经产生了一个$\Omega(\log n)$的下界。令人惊讶的是，对于环上的单位成本，我们获得了一个确定性的多项式时间4-竞争比算法，改进了先前（SODA 2026）的$O(\log n)$界，并证明了该比例在确定性算法中是最优的。因此，在单位成本下，环比树更容易处理，因为树的最优竞争比为$\Theta(\log n)$。
tldr: 本文针对在线加权连通性增强问题（WCAP），提出了渐进最优的$O(\log n)$竞争比算法，并在单位成本环上取得了最优的4-竞争比。
ai_comments: 该论文在在线加权连通性增强问题（WCAP）上取得了突破性进展，将通用问题的竞争比从$O(\log^2 n)$提升至渐进最优的$O(\log n)$，并在单位成本的环上给出了最优的4-竞争比确定性算法，理论贡献显著。
motivation: 旨在改进现有在线加权连通性增强问题（WCAP）中$O(\log^2 n)$的性能界，并探究其渐进最优界及特定情况下的最优竞争比。
method: 提出了一种确定性多项式时间算法，将一般问题归约到潜在图为环的情况，并在单位成本环上设计了4-竞争比算法。
results: 针对WCAP获得了确定性多项式时间$O(\log n)$竞争比算法（渐进最优），并在单位成本环上得到了最优的4-竞争比确定性算法。
conclusion: 论文成功解决了在线加权连通性增强问题，给出了渐进最优的$O(\log n)$竞争比算法，并揭示了单位成本下环结构特殊的计算性质。

title: Proof-Carrying Evolution: Black-Box Search, White-Box Flight
authors: Amit Jain, Sergio Sanchez-Hurtado, Victor Rodriguez-Fernandez, Richard Linares
abstract: We study whether a language model can help design controllers whose behavior can be formally checked. In proof-carrying evolution (PCE), a search proposes controllers together with their certificates. Their mathematical forms are fixed; a proposer chooses their numerical parameters together. Certificate checks guide selection, and only a certified candidate can be returned. The deployed artifact is a control law and its certificate; the language model is used only during design. We compare four language models with classical search and synthesis on docking under a speed limit, pursuit of a maneuvering target, and attitude control on SO(3), using paired runs and shared proposal allowances. Certificates are checked in exact rational arithmetic during search on the linear problems. On SO(3), the search uses floating-point checks, followed by exact re-verification of every reported champion. The best run of each method also receives Lean 4 proofs of its stated control properties. On the linear problems, the strongest models beat the standard classical baselines on every run, but a classical optimizer that chooses certificates for the same objective closes most of that lead. Among the cited pursuit champions, the ranking does not survive a change from Euler to zero-order-hold dynamics. On SO(3), no model detectably outperforms CMA-ES when mixed with classical mutation. When models write every proposal, one tested model improves on CMA-ES and the other performs worse than its mixed variant. All search medians remain below the hand-tuned law. In a docking control with the objective and mutation operator held fixed, retaining certified candidates yields new certified designs in every run; removing this rule yields none.
zh_title: 携带证明的演化：黑盒搜索，白盒飞行
translation: 我们研究了语言模型是否有助于设计其行为可被形式化检验的控制器。在携带证明的演化（PCE）中，搜索过程同时提出控制器及其证书。它们的数学形式是固定的；提案者共同选择它们的数值参数。证书检验指导选择过程，且最终仅返回已认证的候选解。所部署的成果是控制律及其证书；语言模型仅在设计期间使用。我们通过配对运行和共享提案配额，在限速对接、机动目标追踪以及SO(3)上的姿态控制这三个问题上，将四种语言模型与经典搜索及综合方法进行了比较。在线性问题的搜索过程中，使用精确的有理数算术来检验证书。在SO(3)上，搜索过程使用浮点检验，随后对每个报告的优胜者进行精确的重新验证。每种方法的最佳运行结果还会获得其所述控制属性的 Lean 4 证明。在线性问题中，最强大的模型在每次运行中都击败了标准经典基线，但是一个针对相同目标选择证书的经典优化器缩小了大部分领先差距。在提及的追踪优胜者中，当动力学从欧拉法更改为零阶保持器时，排名未能保持。在SO(3)上，当与经典突变混合时，没有模型能可检测地优于CMA-ES。当模型撰写所有提案时，一个受测模型的表现优于CMA-ES，而另一个模型的表现则劣于其混合变体。所有搜索中位数仍低于人工调优的控制律。在目标和突变算子保持固定的对接控制中，保留已认证的候选解在每次运行中都能产生新的已认证设计；去除这一规则后则完全无法产生。
tldr: 提出携带证明的演化（PCE）方法，利用语言模型在设计阶段联合搜索控制器及其数学证书，仅允许通过形式化检验的候选解被保留与部署。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了“携带证明的演化”（PCE）框架，将语言模型作为黑盒提议器联合搜索控制律及其形式化证书，并引入 Lean 4 进行精确证明，保证了设计产物的形式化安全性。其局限性在于语言模型在复杂非线性系统（如SO(3)）上的表现相较于强经典优化器（如CMA-ES）并无显著优势，最终性能仍落后于人工调优控制律，且模型表现对动力学离散化方式的变动较为敏感。
motivation: 探索语言模型是否能够协助设计出行为可被形式化检验和数学证明的高可靠性控制器。
method: 提出“携带证明的演化”（PCE）方法：在固定数学形式下，利用语言模型或经典搜索算法联合提议控制器及其证书的数值参数；在搜索过程中通过精确有理数算术或浮点检验指导候选解选择，仅保留并最终返回通过形式化验证的候选解；最优秀的设计进一步在 Lean 4 中完成形式化证明。语言模型仅参与离线设计搜索，最终部署的是白盒控制律及证书。
results: 在线性控制问题上，最强语言模型显著优于标准经典基线，但针对同目标优化证书的经典优化器能追平大部分差距；在追踪任务中，动力学模型从欧拉法切换为零阶保持器后优胜者排名发生变动；在SO(3)姿态控制中，语言模型结合经典突变未能明显超越CMA-ES，且所有算法中位数均低于人工调优基线；消融实验显示，只有强制保留已认证候选解才能在每轮搜索中稳定生成新的可验证设计。
conclusion: 语言模型可有效辅助设计具有形式化可验证证书的控制器，但在复杂任务中相较高级经典优化方法提升有限；同时，“仅保留已认证候选解”的筛选机制是成功搜索到安全控制器的关键必要条件。

title: REA: A Routed Embodied Agent Runtime for Asynchronous Brain-Cerebellum Control
authors: Pengfei Zhou, Yixing Ma, Zhengfeiyang Zhang, Haoyuan Chen, Zhenglin Wan, Hexin Wang, Wangbo Zhao, Yang You
abstract: Foundation models are becoming remarkably reliable at high-level reasoning, yet they remain too slow and costly to serve as fine-grained controllers. Conversely, fast policies like VLAs and whole-body controllers offer more efficient reflexes, but struggle to generalize. While pairing a deliberative brain (foundation models) with a reactive cerebellum (fast policies) seems natural for embodied systems, two obstacles remain: methods are built and scored on incompatible stacks, and their asynchronous coordination is difficult. For example, an agent that calls the VLA in the agentic loop can stall the fast execution, while a VLA that calls the agent on errors tends to re-trigger fallbacks repeatedly or completely miss silent failures. To address this, we propose REA (Routed Embodied Agent), a unified runtime where a deliberative System 2, an embodied router System 1 and reactive System 0 policies cooperate under a single golden rule - no running policy waits on the brain. Instead of querying the brain at each failure, REA employs a route memory that stores each policy's measured success ahead of time, a boundary-triggered judge gate that consults the brain on policy execution, and a shared-budget escalation ladder for bounded recovery. Evaluated on 3,000 test episodes across 60 LIBERO-Pro tasks, REA reaches 95.9% success and beats the best single-agent baseline in its own policy pool (94.7%) while reducing control steps by 25% and control time by 17%. In a separate 100-episode RoboTwin 2.0 study, REA achieves 84% success with VLA policies and 86% with VLA+code, compared with 80% for the strongest single VLA baseline MEDex. These results demonstrate learned and programmatic policies operating within the same runtime. REA also transfers to BEHAVIOR-1K and a real Unitree G1 humanoid, achieving the highest observed success among the compared methods.
zh_title: REA：用于异步大脑-小脑控制的路由具身智能体运行时
translation: 基础模型在高级推理方面变得非常可靠，但它们仍然太慢且成本高昂，无法用作细粒度控制器。相反，像 VLA 和全身控制器这样的快速策略可以提供更高效的反射，但很难泛化。虽然将深思熟虑的大脑（基础模型）与反应迅速的小脑（快速策略）配对对于具身系统来说是很自然的，但仍然存在两个障碍：方法是在不兼容的技术栈上构建和评分的，它们的异步协调很困难。例如，在智能体循环中调用 VLA 的智能体可能会阻止快速执行，而在出错时调用智能体的 VLA 倾向于重复触发回退或完全错过静默失败。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 REA（Routed Embodied Agent），这是一种统一的运行时，其中审慎的系统 2、具身的路由器系统 1 和反应式的系统 0 策略在单一黄金法则下合作——没有正在运行的政策等待大脑。REA 没有在每次失败时查询大脑，而是采用路由记忆来提前存储每个策略的测量的成功率、在策略执行时咨询大脑的边界触发判断门，以及用于有界恢复的共享预算升级梯子。在 60 个 LIBERO-Pro 任务的 3,000 个测试集中进行评估，REA 的成功率达到了 95.9%，击败了其自身策略池中的最佳单智能体基线（94.7%），同时将控制步数减少了 25%，控制时间减少了 17%。在单独的 100 集 RoboTwin 2.0 研究中，REA 通过 VLA 策略实现了 84% 的成功率，通过 VLA+代码实现了 86% 的成功率，而最强的单个 VLA 基线 MEDex 的成功率为 80%。这些结果表明，学习策略和程序策略在同一个运行时中运行。REA 还迁移到 BEHAVIOR-1K 和真实的 Unitree G1 人形机器人，实现了比较方法中观察到的最高成功率。
tldr: REA 是一种新型的具身智能体运行时，通过异步连接“大脑”高层推理与“小脑”快速策略，实现了高效、高成功率的机器人控制。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种名为 REA 的具身智能体运行时，模仿生物学中的“大脑-小脑”分层控制结构（系统2、系统1、系统0），巧妙地解决了大模型推理延迟高与快速策略泛化能力差的矛盾。其“绝不让运行中的策略等待大脑”的核心原则以及路由记忆、边界触发判定门和共享预算升级阶梯等设计，为具身智能的高效异步协同提供了强有力的架构支持。
motivation: 基础模型虽然高层推理能力强但速度慢且成本高，而快速策略（如 VLA 和全身控制器）反应敏捷但泛化能力差。将两者结合时面临技术栈不兼容和异步协调困难的问题（如策略阻塞或故障恢复失效），因此需要一个统一的运行时来解决这些痛点。
method: 提出 REA（Routed Embodied Agent）统一运行时，包含负责高层推理的系统2、负责具身路由的系统1以及负责反应式策略的系统0。采用路由记忆存储策略成功率、边界触发判定门咨询大脑策略执行，以及共享预算升级阶梯实现有界恢复。
results: 在 LIBERO-Pro 的 3000 个测试回合中，REA 达到了 95.9% 的成功率，将控制步数减少 25%，控制时间减少 17%；在 RoboTwin 2.0 研究中达到 84%-86% 的成功率；同时成功迁移至 BEHAVIOR-1K 和真实的 Unitree G1 人形机器人。
conclusion: REA 作为一种高效的路由具身智能体运行时，成功实现了大语言模型等高层推理与底层快速策略的异步协同，在多个仿真和真实机器人基准测试中展现出卓越的性能和泛化能力。

title: PersonaChatBench: Evaluating Chat Assistants with Diverse Simulated Users
authors: Zheyuan Deng, Taoran Li, Jingwen Zhang, Yuante Li, Dachuan Zhao, Fulei Zhang, Yunkai Zhang, Zhikun Xu, Yajie Liao, Haichao Zhang, Haodi Hu, Cong Wang, Chen Yang, Siyang Wu, Defu Cao, Xu Hu, Haoming Li, Haixin Wang, Robert George, Weizhi Zhang, Yuchu Wang, Zhejian Peng, Yueying Li, Wanting Jiang, Shushu Liang, Zhiyuan Yu, Yifan Wang, Jintao Huang, Yijun Wang, Yuexing Hao, Xiaomin Li
abstract: Conversational assistants are expected to help people with diverse backgrounds, preferences, and communication styles. Yet evaluations centered on a single cooperative user provide limited insight into how reliably an assistant serves users with different personas. We introduce PersonaChatBench, a framework for evaluating task competence and responsiveness to diverse user needs. PersonaChatBench pairs the same underlying task with multiple simulated users, each guided by a private persona card that specifies distinct needs, preferences, and interaction behaviors. By holding the task fixed while varying the user, the framework examines how assistant performance changes across user conditions. We evaluate 20 language models across six domains, separately assessing native task outcomes, fulfillment of expressed persona needs, and simulator fidelity. Our results show that task performance and need fulfillment vary across personas and domains. Strong task performance does not necessarily translate into satisfying individual needs, and models' relative strengths in meeting those needs are not consistent across domains. PersonaChatBench makes these differences measurable, revealing gaps obscured by aggregate scores and helping identify which users an assistant serves well and where adaptation is needed. It provides a basis for evaluating consistency across users and guiding the development of assistants that better accommodate diverse needs in everyday applications.
zh_title: PersonaChatBench：使用多样化模拟用户评估聊天助手
translation: 对话助手被期望帮助具有不同背景、偏好和沟通风格的人。然而，以单一合作用户为中心的评估只能提供有限的见解，无法了解助手如何可靠地为具有不同角色的用户提供服务。我们介绍了 PersonaChatBench，这是一个用于评估任务能力和对多样化用户需求响应能力的框架。PersonaChatBench 将相同的底层任务与多个模拟用户配对，每个用户都由一个私有角色卡引导，该角色卡指定了不同的需求、偏好和交互行为。通过保持任务固定同时改变用户，该框架检查了助手性能在不同用户条件下的变化。我们评估了 6 个领域的 20 个语言模型，分别评估了原生任务结果、表达的角色需求的满足度以及模拟器的保真度。我们的结果表明，任务性能和需求满足度在不同的角色和领域之间有所不同。强大的任务性能并不一定意味着满足个人需求，并且模型在满足这些需求方面的相对优势在不同领域中并不一致。PersonaChatBench 使这些差异可衡量，揭示了被聚合分数掩盖的差距，并有助于确定助手服务得好的用户以及需要调整的地方。它为评估不同用户之间的一致性提供了基础，并指导开发更好地适应日常应用中多样化需求的助手。
tldr: 本文提出了PersonaChatBench框架，通过使用多维度模拟用户评测对话助手，揭示了现有模型在满足不同用户个性化需求方面的性能差异与不足。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的评测框架PersonaChatBench，通过引入具备不同私有角色卡（persona card）的模拟用户，解决了传统单一合作用户评测无法反映助手适应多样化背景和偏好能力的痛点。研究表明，强大的任务执行能力并不等同于能满足用户的个性化需求，这为未来更具包容性的对话助手开发提供了重要的诊断工具和方向。
motivation: 现有的对话助手评测通常围绕单一的合作用户展开，这无法全面了解助手服务具有不同背景、偏好和沟通风格的用户时的可靠性，因此需要一个能够评估任务能力和对多样化用户需求响应能力的评测框架。
method: 提出PersonaChatBench框架，该框架将相同的底层任务与多个模拟用户进行配对，每个用户由指定不同需求、偏好和交互行为的私有角色卡引导；评估了20个语言模型在6个领域的表现，分别评估原生任务结果、表达需求满足度以及模拟器保真度。
results: 实验结果表明，任务性能和需求满足度在不同的用户和领域之间存在差异；强大的任务性能并不一定转化为满足个人需求，且模型在满足这些需求方面的相对优势在不同领域中并不一致。
conclusion: PersonaChatBench能够有效揭示聚合评分所掩盖的模型性能差异，展示了模型在服务不同用户时的局限性，为构建能够适应多样化需求的日常对话助手奠定了基础。

title: Counting Square Tilings with a Fixed Set of Polyominoes Is #EXP-Complete
authors: Qiuyu Chen, Baao Xie
abstract: The gap between feasibility and exact counting raises a fundamental question about how much information an input must carry to sustain computational hardness. We show that this separation persists even when the geometric rules are fixed and each instance is specified solely by the binary side length of a square. Specifically, there exists a fixed finite family of connected polyominoes whose translation-only square-tiling counting function is #EXP-complete under polynomial-time metric reductions and belongs to #E. Since tileability for any fixed polyomino family is decidable in polynomial time, this result establishes a striking separation between feasibility and exact counting under highly restricted geometric inputs. The proof develops a two-stage numerical isolation technique that recovers accepting-computation counts from a boundary-amplified Wang system and preserves them through a rigid geometric compiler that controls all noncanonical polyomino tilings.
zh_title: 使用固定多格骨牌集合计数正方形平铺是#EXP-complete的
translation: 可行性与精确计数之间的差距引发了一个根本性问题：输入必须携带多少信息才能维持计算难度。我们证明，即使几何规则是固定的且每个实例仅由正方形的二进制边长指定，这种分离仍然存在。具体而言，存在一个固定的有限连通多格骨牌族，其仅支持平移的正方形平铺计数函数在多项式时间度量归约下是#EXP-complete的，且属于#E。由于任何固定多格骨牌族的铺嵌性都可以在多项式时间内判定，这一结果在高度受限的几何输入下，在可行性与精确计数之间建立了一个惊人的分离。该证明开发了一种两阶段数值隔离技术，从边界放大的Wang系统中恢复接受计算的计数，并通过一个控制所有非规范多格骨牌平铺的严格几何编译器将其保持下来。
tldr: 证明了在固定多格骨牌集合下计算正方形平铺数量是#EXP-complete的，揭示了铺嵌可行性与精确计数之间的巨大难度鸿沟。
ai_comments: 该论文在计算复杂性理论和几何铺嵌领域具有重要意义，首次证明了在几何规则固定且输入极度简化的前提下，精确计数问题仍可达到#EXP-complete的极高难度，展现了可行性与精确计数之间的惊人鸿沟。
motivation: 研究可行性与精确计数之间的差距，探讨为了维持计算难度，输入必须携带多少信息，特别是当几何规则固定且每个实例仅由正方形的二进制边长指定时的情况。
method: 开发了一种两阶段数值隔离技术，从边界放大的Wang系统中恢复接受计算的计数，并通过严格的几何编译器进行保持，以控制所有非规范的多格骨牌铺嵌。
results: 存在一个固定的有限连通多格骨牌族，其纯平移正方形平铺计数函数在多项式时间度量归约下是#EXP-complete的，并且属于#E。
conclusion: 固定多格骨牌集合的正方形平铺计数问题是#EXP-complete的，这揭示了几何判定可行性与精确计数复杂性之间鲜明的差距。

title: CRoS: Causality Reward on Scrambled CoTs Improves Accuracy and Reasoning Faithfulness
authors: Xiao Yu, Justin Chih-Yao Chen, Zaid Khan, Hyunji Lee, Mohit Bansal
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become the standard method for training language models to reason. However, RLVR typically relies solely on outcome correctness, which does not guarantee that the CoT causally contributes to the final answer. Without this connection, outcome rewards may fail to reinforce high-quality reasoning. Existing causality metrics assess CoT causality by perturbing the CoT, such as deleting reasoning steps or injecting errors, and measuring changes in the final answer. However, these perturbations inevitably alter information in each step. Consequently, high causality scores may reflect sensitivity to information changes introduced by perturbation rather than true causality. Such confounding effects further induce undesirable reasoning behaviors when these metrics are used as training rewards, including generating less informative CoTs and reducing exploration and self-correction. To address this problem, we propose CRoS (Causality Reward on Scrambled CoTs), a novel CoT causality metric that perturbs the order of reasoning steps without altering content, thereby preserving information within each step. On Reasoning Gym with Gemma-3-4B, CRoS outperforms existing causality and outcome rewards in out-of-domain accuracy, CoT quality, and CoT faithfulness. Specifically, CRoS achieves 46.8% accuracy on five unseen logic and games datasets, outperforming the strongest baseline (43.8%). It also achieves better CoT quality, consistently outperforming baselines in CoT-Pass@K from K=1 to 128, averaging 43.4% vs. 41.4%. For CoT faithfulness, CRoS achieves a hint acknowledgment score of 34.0% vs. 20.2%.
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 14 tables. Project page: https://xxiaoyuuuu.github.io/CRoS-Page
zh_title: CRoS：打乱思维链上的因果奖励提升准确率与推理忠实度
translation: 带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为训练语言模型进行推理的标准方法。然而，RLVR通常仅依赖于结果的正确性，这不能保证思维链（CoT）对最终答案有因果贡献。如果没有这种联系，结果奖励可能无法强化高质量的推理。现有的因果指标通过扰动CoT（如删除推理步骤或注入错误）并测量最终答案的变化来评估CoT的因果性。然而，这些扰动不可避免地会改变每个步骤中的信息。因此，高因果性分数可能反映的是对扰动引入的信息变化的敏感性，而不是真正的因果关系。当这些指标用作训练奖励时，这种混杂效应会进一步引发不良的推理行为，包括生成信息量更少的CoT以及减少探索和自我纠正。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了CRoS（Causality Reward on Scrambled CoTs），这是一种新颖的CoT因果指标，它通过扰动推理步骤的顺序而不改变内容，从而保留了每个步骤中的信息。在Reasoning Gym和Gemma-3-4B上的实验表明，CRoS在域外准确率、CoT质量和CoT忠实度方面均优于现有的因果奖励和结果奖励。具体而言，CRoS在五个未见的逻辑和游戏数据集上达到了46.8%的准确率，优于最强的基线（43.8%）。它还实现了更好的CoT质量，在从K=1到128的CoT-Pass@K中持续优于基线，平均为43.4%对41.4%。对于CoT忠实度，CRoS的提示确认得分为34.0%对20.2%。
tldr: 提出一种名为CRoS的新方法，通过打乱思维链顺序来衡量和奖励因果关系，解决了传统扰动方法的缺陷，显著提升了大模型的推理准确率、思维链质量和忠实度。
ai_comments: 该论文针对传统强化学习验证奖励（RLVR）仅依赖最终结果正确性的缺陷，创新性地提出了基于打乱思维链顺序的因果奖励方法（CRoS），避免了传统扰动方法改变内容带来的混杂效应。该方法有效提升了语言模型的推理准确性、思维链质量和忠实度，在强化大模型逻辑推理能力方面具有重要的实践价值和理论意义。
motivation: 传统的带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）仅依赖结果正确性，无法保证思维链对最终答案的因果贡献；而现有的因果度量方法通过删除步骤或注入错误等会改变内容的扰动来评估因果性，容易引入混杂效应，导致不良的推理行为。
method: 提出CRoS（Causality Reward on Scrambled CoTs），这是一种新的思维链因果度量方法，通过打乱推理步骤的顺序而不是改变其内容，来评估和奖励思维链的因果关系，从而避免信息改变带来的混杂效应。
results: 在Reasoning Gym和Gemma-3-4B上的实验表明，CRoS在域外准确率（46.8%对43.8%）、CoT质量（CoT-Pass@K平均43.4%对41.4%）以及CoT忠实度（提示确认得分34.0%对20.2%）上均优于现有的因果奖励和结果奖励基线。
conclusion: 提出CRoS方法，通过打乱推理步骤顺序评估和奖励思维链因果关系，有效解决了传统因果指标的混杂效应，显著提升了大模型在未见数据集上的泛化能力、推理质量和忠实度。

title: A Hybrid Path Planning Framework for Assistive Wheelchair Navigation in Dynamic Pedestrian Environments
authors: Damla Leblebicioğlu, Rachel Barume, Taşkın Padır
abstract: Autonomous wheelchairs can improve the quality of life for individuals with mobility impairments by providing greater independence. However, reliable navigation especially in human environments is a major challenge due to factors such as dynamic obstacles, unpredictable pedestrian behavior, and the users' need to complete multiple stops along the way before reaching their final destination. This paper presents a hybrid path planning framework for multi-goal navigation in dynamic environments. The framework integrates the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) for global task ordering with the Potential Field (PF) method and heuristic local planners such as Rapidly-exploring Random Tree (RRT) and A-star (A*) to achieve collision-free navigation. Within this hybrid framework, TSP determines the visiting order of intermediate stations, PF transfers global path information, and local planners avoid obstacles while guiding the robot to the stations. The local planners generate feasible paths that allow the robot to follow the global trajectory and reroute to avoid static and dynamic obstacles. For this purpose, two algorithms have been developed: (i) TSP-PF-RRT and (ii) TSP-PF-A*. The performance of the proposed algorithms are evaluated using Monte Carlo simulations in crowded and extra-crowded scenarios that contain heterogeneous dynamic and static obstacles. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed hybrid framework enables efficient multi-goal navigation while maintaining safe operation in dynamic environments with humans, with TSP-PF-RRT achieving fewer or no collisions and shorter travel distances.
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures. Presented as a main-track paper at the International Conference of Social Robotics + ART'26, London, UK, 1-4 July 2026
zh_title: 面向动态行人环境中辅助轮椅导航的混合路径规划框架
translation: 自主轮椅通过提供更大的独立性，可以改善行动不便人士的生活质量。然而，可靠的导航，尤其是在有人类活动的环境中，是一个主要的挑战，因为存在动态障碍物、不可预测的行人行为以及用户在到达最终目的地之前需要沿途完成多个停靠点等因素。本文提出了一种用于动态环境中多目标导航的混合路径规划框架。该框架将用于全局任务排序的旅行商问题（TSP）与势场法（PF）以及诸如快速扩展随机树（RRT）和A-star（A*）等启发式局部规划器相结合，以实现无碰撞导航。在此混合框架中，TSP决定中间站点的访问顺序，PF传递全局路径信息，局部规划器在避开障碍物的同时引导机器人前往站点。局部规划器生成可行的路径，使机器人能够跟随全局轨迹并重新规划路线以避开静态和动态障碍物。为此，开发了两种算法：(i) TSP-PF-RRT 和 (ii) TSP-PF-A*。在包含异构动态和静态障碍物的拥挤和超拥挤场景中，使用蒙特卡洛模拟对所提出算法的性能进行了评估。实验结果表明，所提出的混合框架能够在与人类共存的动态环境中实现高效的多目标导航，同时保持安全运行，其中 TSP-PF-RRT 实现了更少或没有碰撞以及更短的行驶距离。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合TSP、势场法和局部规划器（RRT/A*）的混合路径规划框架，有效解决了辅助轮椅在动态人流环境中的多目标导航与避障问题。
ai_comments: 该论文针对辅助轮椅在动态行人环境中的多目标导航难题，创新性地结合了TSP、势场法以及RRT/A*等经典算法，提出了一个混合路径规划框架。在拥挤和超拥挤场景下的仿真评估证明了其有效性和安全性，具有较高的实际应用价值。
motivation: 自动轮椅可以为行动不便的个人提供独立性，但由于动态障碍物、不可预测的行人行为以及用户在到达最终目的地前多次停留的需求，在人类环境中实现可靠导航是一个重大挑战。
method: 提出一个混合路径规划框架，整合了用于全局任务排序的旅行商问题（TSP）、势场法（PF）以及启发式局部规划器（如RRT和A*），并开发了TSP-PF-RRT和TSP-PF-A*两种算法。
results: 通过在拥挤和超拥挤场景下进行Monte Carlo仿真评估，结果表明该混合框架能够实现高效的多目标导航并在与人类同行的动态环境中安全运行，其中TSP-PF-RRT实现了更少或没有碰撞以及更短的行驶距离。
conclusion: 提出的混合路径规划框架（TSP-PF-RRT和TSP-PF-A*）能够有效解决动态环境下的多目标轮椅导航问题，其中TSP-PF-RRT在减少碰撞和缩短行程距离方面表现更优。

title: Two choices suffice: $k$-out sampling leaves $O(n/k)$ intercomponent edges for $k\geq 2$
authors: Yanyu Chen, Yu Chen
abstract:
Given a simple undirected graph on $n$ vertices, random $k$-out sampling forms a spanning subgraph by having each vertex independently choose $k$ incident edges uniformly with replacement. We prove that, for every integer $k\geq2$, the expected number of original edges joining distinct sampled components is $O(n/k)$.
  This resolves the conjecture of Holm, King, Thorup, Zamir, and Zwick in its full range, improving their logarithmic sampling requirement to the optimal threshold of two choices per vertex. The bound fails for $k=1$, and the dependence $O(n/k)$ is tight up to constant factors. Our result holds with replacement and consequently also without replacement. In particular, this implies that contracting just two independent local choices per vertex suffices to reduce an arbitrary simple graph to a quotient with $O(n)$ edges in expectation, which is crucial in reducing the instance size for many contraction-based algorithms.
  Our proof uses switching arguments to relate intercomponent edges to bridges and a degree-weighted component potential, whose expectation we also bound with a switching argument.

title: RAMA: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Agent Routing with Episodic Memory for LEO Satellite Networks
authors: Xin Ming Li, Peng Hu
abstract: Low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellite networks present a challenging routing environment due to rapidly changing topology, traffic, and link conditions. Existing deep reinforcement learning (DRL) routing methods typically rely on current observations and information encoded in network weights, limiting their ability to exploit successful past experiences. We propose RAMA, a retrieval-augmented multi-agent DRL framework with Approximate Information State (AIS), in which each satellite combines its local observation, recent routing history, neighboring state information, and retrieved entries from a per-satellite episodic memory. Retrieved experiences are integrated through a Transformer-based decision network trained with AIS-based auxiliary objectives. With weights frozen in a 140-satellite Kepler constellation, RAMA reduces mean end-to-end latency by 13.4% and 99th-percentile latency by 66.7% relative to the state-of-theart double deep Q-network (DDQN) routing method, mainly by avoiding long detours. Updated online, RAMA remains stable while DDQN degrades. On the 1,584-satellite Starlink shell 1, the reduction in mean latency grows to 93.2%, and updating RAMA online lowers its mean latency by a further 25.5%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of retrieval-augmented memory for scalable decentralized routing in LEO satellite networks.

title: Implicit Additively Weighted Geodesic Voronoi Diagrams and Applications
authors: Bruce W. Brewer, Haitao Wang
abstract:
Let $P$ be a simple polygon with $m$ vertices. After $O(m)$-time preprocessing of $P$, for any set $S$ of $n$ additively weighted point sites, we compute an implicit additively weighted geodesic Voronoi diagram in $O(n\log n+n\log^2 m)$ time, supporting nearest-neighbor queries in $O(\log(n+m))$ time. In contrast, explicitly constructing the diagram requires $Ω(m)$ time. Our algorithm introduces a new sweep-line paradigm that avoids explicitly constructing the diagram, together with a novel technique for point location in implicit subdivisions.
  As applications, we obtain new dynamic data structures for additively weighted geodesic nearest-neighbor searching and the first efficient algorithms for shortest paths in geodesic disk graphs. After the same $O(m)$-time preprocessing, single-source shortest paths in a geodesic disk graph of $n$ sites can be computed in $O(n\log n+n\log^2 m)$ time in the unweighted case and $O(n^{3/2}(\log n+\log^2 m))$ time in the weighted case. We also extend our techniques to implicit farthest geodesic Voronoi diagrams for unweighted sites, obtaining analogous bounds and dynamic farthest-neighbor data structures.

title: The Knowledge Layer Model (KLM): Evidence-Visible AI Output, Routing Diagnostics, and Negative Results
authors: Omer Asim Ozturk, Cihan Aydiner
abstract: AI answers require more than apparent correctness: reviewers need to inspect their recorded basis. We introduce the Knowledge Layer Model (KLM), an open, implementation-neutral specification for inference records with versioned epistemic assessments, evidence relations, and explicit unknowns. SEDIM, the knowledge and evidence architecture of Nage AI OS, is a reference implementation. We reference KLM v0.3 (repository tag v0.3.0). Empirical material consists of separate internal experiments, not end-to-end validation. A historical platform-domain routing benchmark reports 137/150 classifications across 15 classes (91.3%; nominal 95% Wilson interval 85.7-94.9%); the numerator is recovered from a rounded summary, and historical example membership is unverified. A native-model weight-path configuration yielded 0/15 successful answers in a corrected two-source test. A capacity-growth comparison could not establish a reliable effect because of a defective legacy scorer and missing original outputs. Lexical and scoped diagnostics each yielded AUC 0.008 for silent-versus-contradicted examples, below the registered minimum of 0.65. Legacy packing lost gold-containing text in 118/221 selected cases; repaired packing retained it in 221/221. These measure text presence, not answer quality. Python and TypeScript verifiers reportedly agreed on six checks per synthetic fixture; a separate production disclosure was not accepted. Restoration, re-derivation, human-rubric support, boundary isolation, and bounded-response evaluations remain proposed. Findings are internal and author-reported; historical observations are distinguished from later reproductions. Evidence visibility does not establish correctness, causal reliance, security, or regulatory compliance. Independent replication and a complete public audit package remain future work.
comment: 47 pages, 1 figure, 14 tables. Includes Appendix A
zh_title: 知识层模型 (KLM)：证据可见的 AI 输出、路由诊断和阴性结果
translation: AI 回答需要比表面上的正确性更多：审阅者需要检查其记录的基础。我们引入了知识层模型 (KLM)，一个开放的、不依赖实现的规范，用于推理记录，具有版本化的认知评估、证据关系和明确的未知。SEDIM，Nage AI OS 的知识和证据架构，是一个参考实现。我们引用 KLM v0.3（存储库标签 v0.3.0）。经验材料包括单独的内部实验，而非端到端的验证。一个历史性的平台领域路由基准报告了 15 个类别中的 137/150 次分类（91.3%；标称 95% 威尔逊区间 85.7-94.9%）；分子是从四舍五入的摘要中恢复的，历史示例成员资格未经核实。一个本地模型权重路径配置在纠正后的双源测试中产生了 0/15 的成功回答。由于有缺陷的旧评分器和缺失的原始输出，容量增长比较未能建立可靠的效果。词汇和范围诊断在静默与矛盾示例的 AUC 分别为 0.008，低于注册的最低值 0.65。旧版打包在 221 个选定案例中有 118 个丢失了含金文本；修复后的打包在 221/221 的案例中保留了它。这些衡量的是文本存在性，而不是回答质量。据报道，Python 和 TypeScript 验证器在六个检查/合成夹具上达成一致；一个单独的生产披露未被接受。恢复、重新推导、人工标准支持、边界隔离和有界响应评估仍然是建议。研究结果是内部的，由作者报告；历史观察与后来的复制区分开来。证据可见性并不建立正确性、因果依赖性、安全性或监管合规性。独立复制和完整的公开审计包仍然是未来的工作。
tldr: 该研究提出了知识层模型 (KLM)，一个用于 AI 推理记录的开放规范，具有版本化的认知评估、证据关系和明确的未知。SEDIM 是其参考实现。实验结果显示，该模型在路由诊断方面表现不佳，并且在其他几个评估中也存在问题，例如模型权重路径配置和文本处理。尽管存在局限性，但该模型为 AI 输出的证据可见性提供了一个框架，但需要进一步的独立验证和公开审计。
ai_comments: 该研究提出的知识层模型 (KLM) 旨在解决 AI 输出的透明度和可追溯性问题，这是一个重要且具有挑战性的领域。通过引入版本化的认知评估和证据关系，KLM 为理解 AI 的决策过程提供了一个结构化的方法。然而，论文中报告的实验结果令人担忧，显示出在多个关键评估指标上的不足，包括诊断准确性低和模型配置测试失败。这可能表明当前 KLM 的实现或评估方法存在严重缺陷，或者该模型本身在实际应用中面临巨大挑战。作者坦诚地报告了这些阴性结果和局限性，并指出了未来的工作方向，包括独立复制和公开审计，这是值得肯定的。但总体而言，该研究目前更像是一个初步的探索性工作，其提出的模型在实际应用前的有效性和可靠性仍有待大幅度验证。
motivation: 当前 AI 回答需要超越表面正确性，审查其基础证据。KLM 旨在提供一种开放、不依赖实现的规范，用于记录推理过程，包括版本化的认知评估、证据关系和明确的未知信息，以满足审查需求。
method: 提出知识层模型 (KLM) 规范，并使用 SEDIM 作为参考实现。通过一系列内部实验评估 KLM 在平台领域路由基准测试、模型权重路径配置、文本处理（旧版打包和修复后打包）、以及词汇和范围诊断等方面的表现。结果基于作者报告和历史数据。
results: 在平台领域路由基准测试中，15 个类别中有 137 个分类（91.3%）被正确分类。然而，模型权重路径配置在纠正后的双源测试中，15 个问题中只有 0 个成功回答。词汇和范围诊断的 AUC 仅为 0.008，远低于要求的 0.65。旧版打包在 221 个选定案例中有 118 个丢失了含金文本，修复后打包则成功保留了所有文本。这些结果表明了文本存在性，而非回答质量。
conclusion: KLM 为 AI 输出的证据可见性提供了一个框架，但目前的经验证据（主要来自内部实验）显示在多个评估方面存在显著问题，包括诊断准确性、模型配置和文本处理。证据可见性本身并不能保证正确性、因果依赖性、安全性或合规性。需要进行独立的复制和完整的公开审计。

title: Measurement-Based Assessment of Decadal Inertia and Primary Frequency Response Trends in the US Eastern Interconnection
authors: Saurav Dulal, Mark Baldwin, Narges Ghiasi, Mohammed Olama, Ali R. Ekti, Nils M. Stenvig, Yilu Liu
abstract: Changes in the generation mix of the U.S. Eastern Interconnection (EI) raise questions about long-term frequency performance, particularly inertia and primary frequency response (PFR). This paper jointly examines these characteristics using synchronized FNET/GridEye frequency measurements and confirmed generation-trip events from 2013 to 2025. A representative EI frequency trajectory is constructed using the median of geographically distributed measurements. Effective inertia is estimated quarterly from the early post-disturbance rate of change of frequency (RoCoF), using a 3-second window and least-squares fitting. PFR is evaluated using the beta metric, which measures aggregate frequency response from disturbance size and the A-to-B frequency deviation. Annual beta estimates are obtained after filtering events by starting frequency and disturbance size to improve comparability across years. Results show that EI effective inertia varies seasonally and follows a non-monotonic trend rather than a uniform long-term decline. Over the same period, coal generation decreased while natural gas, wind, and solar generation increased. Changes in synchronous generator commitment and operating conditions may have offset some expected inertia reductions. Filtered beta generally increased from the mid-2010s to the early 2020s, with year-to-year variability thereafter. The different trends show that early inertial behavior and broader aggregate frequency response have not evolved in parallel. Joint analysis of inertia and beta offers a more complete measurement-based assessment of EI frequency performance during the generation transition.

title: RangeSWA: Training-Free Length Extrapolation for Continuous Diffusion Language Models
authors: Guangfu Guo, Xiaoqian Lu, Linsey Pang, Weiran Yao, Haolin Chen, Long Cheng, Kunpeng Liu
abstract: Continuous diffusion language models show promising potential in text generation tasks, but are prone to problems such as text repetition, semantic drift, and generation quality degradation when the generation length exceeds the training length. To address these challenges, we propose RangeSWA, a training-free length extrapolation method. The method combines local sliding-window attention, remote block summaries, and dynamic content retrieval to preserve local details and support long-range context access. In addition, generation degradation caused by length extrapolation is mitigated through positional remapping, conditioning attention correction, and denoising-stage-adaptive window scheduling. We conducted experiments on multiple continuous diffusion language models, and the results show that RangeSWA can effectively reduce generative perplexity and text repetition rates in long-text generation.

title: Think in 360°: Benchmarking and Bootstrapping Panoramic Video Reasoning
authors: Lidong Lu, Lidong Zou, Xinyi Mao, Jiaxin Lv, Zhenquan Li, Liangrui Dong, Tong Lu, Guo Chen
abstract: A panoramic video captures all directions around the camera, but relevant evidence can appear in different directions and at different times. Understanding it requires models to connect observations across the viewing sphere and time. We introduce PanoVideoBench, the first manually annotated benchmark for comprehensive panoramic video understanding. Its 1,000 questions span five categories and 15 question types, with diagnostic annotations for target search and panoramic capabilities. Evaluation of 11 proprietary, open-source, and panoramic-specialized models identifies cross-view tracking and sphere-time evidence integration as their weakest capabilities. To strengthen these capabilities, we construct PanoVideoCoT, the first reasoning dataset grounded in real panoramic video, through sphere-time-grounded synthesis that converts verified panoramic observations and successful agentic explorations into 13,465 QA-CoT pairs. Starting from a general video MLLM, PanoVideoReasoner learns from this corpus through Panoramic CoT SFT and Evidence-Privileged On-Policy Self-Distillation, a panoramic instantiation of Vision-OPD's OPSD in which the teacher uses verified perspective views to guide student-generated trajectories. It reaches 55.7% on PanoVideoBench, improving the backbone by 12.5 points and the previous SOTA by 2.6. The gains concentrate on the same spatial, cross-view, and temporal capabilities exposed by the benchmark, showing that grounded sphere-time supervision can equip a general video MLLM with panoramic reasoning.

title: Cost-Aware Stopping for Freeze-Thaw Bayesian Optimization: When Does One-Step Lookahead Suffice?
authors: Long Vu, Jongseong Brad Choi, Binoy Ravindran, Zhoulai Fu
abstract: Freeze-thaw Bayesian optimization (BO) evaluates candidates in resumable increments but usually stops at a budget or convergence test. We maximize a budget-free utility, the best observed score minus a cost per increment, with a one-step lookahead: advance the candidate with the largest expected improvement (EI) under a fixed surrogate, and stop once no EI exceeds the cost. This rule, EI stopping, never falls below stopping immediately in expected utility, yet it can stop too early. We construct a certificate, a lower bound on the value of two-step lookahead, that proves such a stop premature, and repeating this correction never lowers expected utility under the surrogate. Under the surrogate, EI stops are premature on average at low costs and lose little at high costs. On three hyperparameter optimization benchmarks, a pre-registered test finds EI stopping noninferior to the correction in most high-cost settings, while the correction gains at low costs on two of the three; more information sharing in the surrogate raises EI stopping's utility. On the surrogates of two published methods, EI stopping trades lower scores for fewer training increments. EI stopping is a simple cost-aware reference whose utility depends on the surrogate.

title: Differentially Private Synthetic Data from Sliced Chebyshev Moments
authors: Lucas Rosenblatt, R. Teal Witter, Christopher Musco
abstract:
Research on practical differentially private (DP) synthetic data has largely focused on methods that approximately preserve low-dimensional marginals of a target distribution, and can thus only hope to preserve higher-dimensional, global structure as a lucky by-product. At the same time, existing methods that target global accuracy guarantees pay a price exponential in the data dimension, $d$.
  In this work, we address this ``curse of dimensionality'' by presenting a new DP synthetic data algorithm, SPLICE, that comes with a compelling global distributional guarantee, even in high-dimensions, and moreover, is practically state-of-the-art. Our algorithm is based on measuring noisy sliced Chebyshev polynomial moments of the target distribution and fitting a distribution to match, a twist on recent polynomial methods for 1-D synthetic data.
  We prove that, given a dataset of $n$ examples, SPLICE returns a private distribution with Sliced Wasserstein-1 distance $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$ from the target, for constant privacy parameters. Notably, this bound is independent of the data dimension, $d$. Along the way, we prove a moment matching result of independent interest: for a distribution on the unit ball, matching the first $O(1/α)$ Chebyshev moments along $\tilde{O}(d/α^2)$ random directions guarantees $α$ Sliced Wasserstein error.
  Finally, we provide a practical implementation of the algorithm that borrows tools from the tensor decomposition literature and achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to prior DP synthetic data methods on an extensive benchmark.

title: From Scalar Games to Unconstrained Network Zero-Sum Games: Transfer Principles for Gradient-Based Learning
authors: Gaoqi Xue, James P. Bailey
abstract: We show that, for a broad class of gradient-based learning rules, scalar zero-sum games form a complete test family for convergence in unconstrained network zero-sum games. Specifically, suppose a learning rule achieves last-iterate or time-average convergence on every scalar game of magnitude $a$ whenever $η\leq f(a)$, where $f$ is nonincreasing. Then the same guarantee holds on an arbitrary network zero-sum game with stacked game operator $\mathbf{G}$ whenever $η\leq f(\lVert\mathbf{G}\rVert_2)$. More generally, finite-time rate guarantees transfer mode by mode: the network response is bounded by the largest response of its scalar canonical games, and under compatible linear initialization conventions the worst-case finite-time network response is exactly the largest scalar canonical rate. Thus, understanding the learning dynamics on scalar games is sufficient to characterize universal convergence and worst-case rates over the corresponding class of network games. The result follows from the classical planar decomposition of real skew-symmetric game operators. Related mode-wise reasoning has appeared implicitly in spectral analyses of particular learning algorithms and in prior work using these decompositions for game representation and visualization; here we isolate the resulting transfer principle for gradient-based learning. We discuss implications for simplifying convergence analysis, time-average guarantees, low-dimensional geometric arguments, accelerated-method design, and worst-case numerical testing.

title: A General Theoretical Framework for Transformed Geometric Pattern Matching in Music
authors: David Meredith
abstract: In this paper, we present a framework of concepts, terminology and notation for geometric pattern matching, centred around the idea of a {\em transformation class}. After formally defining the concept of a transformation class, we provide detailed definitions of a number of specific transformation classes that are particularly relevant to pattern matching and pattern discovery in music, which is the primary application domain within which the framework has been developed. We then provide formal definitions of the notions of {\em match}, {\em occurrence}, {\em maximal match\/} and {\em maximal occurrence\/} and prove some results relating to these concepts. We then define and explore in detail the idea of an {\em occurrence set\/} and the more general notion of a {\em heterogeneous occurrence set}. Finally, we explore in detail the concept of {\em transformational equivalence}, including a consideration of {\em transformation groups}, along with the group-theoretic and transformational equivalence properties of selected transformation classes.
comment: 61 pages; 23 figures; draft of second chapter of forthcoming book

title: Rethinking Asymmetry in Self-Supervised 3D Geometry Learning
authors: Gyeongjin Kang, Freeman Cheng, Botao Ye, Weijie Lyu, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Eunbyung Park
abstract: Self-supervised learning relies on asymmetry between what a model observes and what it must explain. Recent methods learn 3D geometry from unposed images by predicting cameras and scene structure, then rendering held-out views. To avoid trivial solutions, they impose this asymmetry in the input space, restricting how views interact through separate branches or masked attention. We revisit this design with geometric accuracy, rather than rendering quality, as the main objective. When a held-out view lies between context views, the context already constrains the geometry it observes. We therefore impose the asymmetry in the 3D representation space, excluding held-out views only from the reconstructed scene while a shared backbone uses all views for correspondence. This improves depth and pose estimation over input-space designs. We further exploit view density: sparse and dense observations depict the same scene but provide different amounts of correspondence. Aligning sparse-context features with dense-context features supplies a geometric training signal alongside rendering, without a pretrained geometric teacher. We additionally align features with a frozen vision foundation model, which brings further gains. None of these signals requires geometric annotation, and the resulting model improves geometry estimation over prior self-supervised methods. Controlled experiments isolate the contribution of each component, and self-supervised pretraining also improves subsequent supervised training.

title: CausalWAM: Learning the Causes of Actions in World Action Models
authors: Juntao Cheng, Jinzhou Tang, Fan Feng, Henrik I. Christensen, Yujia Zheng
abstract: World action models (WAMs) learn latent variables from observations and use these to both predict the evolution of the scene and to generate actions. The prediction has to be of the whole scene, whereas only a portion of the scene causes actions. WAMs fitted to demonstrations do not, in general, guarantee that they will generate actions solely from the latent causes of the demonstrated actions (the action-relevant latent variables), as the model could just as well learn to imitate in this way whilst entangling the action-relevant latent variables with the nuisance variables. We therefore separate out what causes action from what prediction depends on. We prove that under a sparsity constraint the latent variables used to generate actions are an invertible function of the action-relevant latent variables alone and the true structure is identified up to a permutation of the latent variables. This requires neither sufficient temporal dependence nor any assumptions on how the unobserved regimes evolve and holds even when the action-relevant latent variables are statistically dependent on the rest. We therefore propose CWAM (Causal WAM), which incorporates the constraint into a pretrained WAM by adding a sparse routing path to its action head, with the world modeling objective remaining unchanged. Experiments on both synthetic data and real-world robots validate the theory as well as showcase the improved efficiency in closed-loop success.

title: ROOF: Learning Humanoid Fall Recovery under Overhead Constraints
authors: Yidan Lu, Jiayuan Yu, Zongrui Cai, Jingwen Sun, Jinrui Han, Jing Wang, Ping Luo, Peng Lu
abstract: A fallen humanoid beneath an overhead obstacle faces a coupled recovery problem. It must create clearance while organizing support for a stable rise, since attempting to stand before making room can further increase obstruction. We introduce a reinforcement learning method with contact-supported geometric escape guidance, which rewards incremental reduction of robot-obstacle overlap without prescribing an escape path. To achieve this, a learned motion prior, together with posture-dependent support and joint-stall costs, is proposed to shape a single policy that learns when to clear the obstacle, how to establish support, and when to complete the rise, all using proprioception alone. In simulation, it recovers in 88.5% of trials beneath plates that can only be lifted, compared with 18.9% without geometric guidance, and in 98.6% of trials beneath free plates with randomized size, mass and placement. On a Unitree G1, the deployed policy recovered in 95 of 150 attempts across seven real-world obstacle scenes, including furniture and multi-object arrangements absent from training. Project page: https://lu-yidan.github.io/ROOF/

title: Towards Understanding the Impact of Plasticity Loss on Reinforcement Learning in Stochastic Environments
authors: Philipp Bordne, André Biedenkapp
abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful framework for sequential decision-making. Despite many high-profile successes in recent years, deep RL is known to be brittle. An emerging line of research attributes this brittleness to a loss of plasticity in neural networks. However, plasticity loss has so far been understudied in stochastic environments. We study this interplay systematically, training SAC agents on three DeepMind Control tasks augmented with controlled levels of observation and action noise. We find that plasticity-preserving methods increase learning robustness on the two harder tasks, with their advantage growing as observation noise increases, while combining resets with layer normalization underperforms resets alone at every observation noise level tested. Further, stochasticity can accelerate the loss of plasticity in harder environments, whereas in easier settings noise can act as a regularizer that sustains plasticity. Lastly, plasticity loss is most pronounced in the early stages of training. In the most challenging stochastic settings, TD instability rather than gradual plasticity loss becomes the dominant failure mode.
comment: 9 pages main paper, 15 pages references and appendix, 17 figures. Presented at the Nineteenth European Workshop on Reinforcement Learning (EWRL 2026)

title: The Pareto Secretary Problem
authors: Andrés Cristi, Yilin Kong, Jiechen Zhang
abstract: The Pareto secretary problem asks for online selection of a Pareto-maximal observation from an i.i.d. sample: no other observation is at least as good in every coordinate and strictly better in one. For every fixed dimension $d\ge2$ and independent continuous coordinates, the optimal failure probability is of order $1/[(\log n)^{d-1}\log\log n]$, both with full information and with coordinate ranks alone. A deterministic rank rule attains the optimal leading term uniformly over the marginals. For every fixed positive definite Gaussian covariance, the same failure order holds, with a leading constant depending on the correlation matrix, and a rank-based rule attains the optimal leading failure probability without knowing the Gaussian parameters. In both models, we determine the optimal fixed cutoff and its leading failure constant; its failure probability exceeds the unrestricted optimum by a factor $Θ_d((\log\log n)^2)$. Under arbitrary dependence, a fixed joint density with uniform marginals can instead have optimal full-information success tending to approximately $0.58$. The proof uses the scarcity of observations with very small domination probability to bound every stopping rule. A matching rule selects a currently maximal point when this probability is below a threshold that increases as time runs out. Coordinate ranks from an initial sample provide sufficiently accurate estimates to preserve the optimal leading failure probability. For singular Gaussian distributions with known correlations, we characterize the optimal failure asymptotics attainable using ranks. Singular dependence can make every observation acceptable or recover the difficulty of selecting a single best point.
comment: 48 pages, 8 figures. A preliminary version has been accepted to WINE 2026

title: Strategic Tanking in Stable Matching Markets
authors: James P. Bailey
abstract: Motivated by a broad literature in psychology, organizational behavior, and matching markets, we introduce strategic tanking: an agent deliberately makes themselves less attractive to selected potential partners in order to improve their eventual assignment. Unlike traditional manipulation in stable matching, a tanker does not misreport whom they prefer; instead, they influence how others rank them. We show that tanking has a striking connection to classical preference manipulation. Cutoff tanking, in which an agent tanks with every potential partner below a chosen threshold, has exactly the same effect on the stable set as truncating one's own preference list at that threshold. Thus an agent can reproduce the power of a classical truncation while leaving their own preferences unchanged and every match acceptable. Arbitrary tanking, however, can go substantially further: under proposer-deferred acceptance, tanking equilibria can lie outside the sincere stable set. More broadly, whenever the sincere stable set contains multiple matchings, profitable strategic behavior remains available through either traditional preference manipulation or tanking, even when one side is restricted to honestly reporting their own preferences.

title: Hyperbolic Inverse Reinforcement Learning
authors: Iulia Rusu, Anoop Praturu, Sergei Gepshtein, Tatyana Sharpee
abstract: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) seeks to infer the reward function underlying observed behavior, but its predictive accuracy and interpretability depend on how that reward is computed from the underlying features. While prior IRL reward functions have been implemented through a variety of techniques including linear weights, neural networks, or other function approximators, none make assumptions about the geometry of the underlying feature space. Inspired by geometric organization observed in neural circuits, we introduce Hyperbolic inverse reinforcement learning (Hyperbolic IRL), which parameterizes reward as a function of Hyperbolic distance between the feature vector and a learned parameter vector, as well as its Euclidean distance variant. We tested our methods against a range of linear and nonlinear IRL baselines under both deterministic and stochastic policies. Our Hyperbolic approach achieved comparable performance to state-of-the-art models on established benchmarks and excelled in the low data limit and across dense environments. Applied to human navigation among multiple exhibits in a museum room, Hyperbolic IRL reveals reward structure that depends not only on individual exhibit-distance features, but also on non-separable conjunctions between them. Together, these results demonstrate that a Hyperbolic reward parameterization can improve both the predictive accuracy and interpretability of IRL, providing a framework for studying how non-separable, conjunctive structure can begin to explain behavior.

title: Subquadratic Attention with a Hierarchical Tree-Structured Indexer
authors: Leon Lufkin, Cutter Dawes, Alexander Speicher, Kamesh Krishnamurthy, Tomás Figliolia, Beren Millidge
abstract: The quadratic scaling of attention is a fundamental bottleneck limiting the long-context capabilities of large language models (LLMs). A variety of approaches have attempted to circumvent this, but they either fail to match attention's expressiveness (e.g., sliding-window or linear attention variants with fixed-size state) or only achieve constant-factor speedups (e.g., sparse attention methods whose indexers themselves scale quadratically). In this paper, we derive an asymptotically subquadratic sparse attention method based on a hierarchical, tree-structured indexer, which we call Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA). ZHA constructs a tree of recursively compressed key summaries over the KV cache, which future queries traverse from the top down to retrieve a sparse subset of keys. Crucially, by iteratively growing the tree's depth, the total cost including routing and final attention grows sublinearly in sequence length, resulting in overall subquadratic (but superlinear) scaling for attention. We demonstrate that ZHA can be cheaply applied to existing pretrained models with only a short KL distillation training stage over a few billion tokens, and maintains performance on long-context retrieval and challenging reasoning, mathematical, and agentic coding evaluation tasks. Moreover, we show that our method is highly robust to tree geometry including very deep trees of up to 6 levels. Finally, we develop a detailed performance model and show that our approach scales subquadratically, dramatically outperforms competing methods beyond 1 million context, and ultimately has the potential to extend effective context windows to the hundreds of millions or billions of tokens.

title: Fast Privacy Loss Accounting for Random Allocation via Multiscale FFT
authors: Vitaly Feldman, Moshe Shenfeld
abstract: In the random allocation sampling scheme each user's data is used in $k$ steps chosen randomly and uniformly from a sequence of $t$ steps. This scheme is known to improve on Poisson sampling in private optimization and in communication-efficient aggregation. The existing privacy loss distribution (PLD) accountant for this scheme runs in time quadratic in the inverse of the accuracy parameter $α$ (Feldman and Shenfeld, 2026). We give an algorithm, \emph{multiscale FFT}, that represents likelihood ratios on a grid that is uniform within each dyadic interval and computes the exact rounding of every pairwise sum using FFTs within each interval. It keeps the guarantees of the accountant and improves the dependence of its running time on $α$ from $O(α^{-2})$ to $O(α^{-1}\log(1/α))$. In addition, we demonstrate that rounding can be performed via the mean-preserving connect-the-dots projection of (Doroshenko et al., 2026). This reduces the errors that rounding introduces in the mean of the privacy loss and in the $χ^2$ divergence of the computed pair from the order of $α$ to $O(α^2/\log(t))$. In our experiments, our algorithm achieves speedups of several orders of magnitude at high accuracy and gives improved privacy bounds for DP-SGD with PREAMBLE.

title: ACCT: Asymmetric Cross-LLM Context Transfer
authors: Yuzhe Liu, Haolin Tian, Tonghan Wang
abstract: In real-world deployments, large language model (LLM) systems are increasingly evolving from single-model invocation toward heterogeneous deployments in which different models are dynamically invoked for inference. When the same context is reused across models, however, each newly selected target model typically has to process it again, repeatedly incurring substantial computational costs. Therefore, we propose ACCT (Asymmetric Cross-LLM Context Transfer), which targets KV cache transfer between models of different scales within the same model family. ACCT transforms the KV cache produced by a source model into sparse KV states that can be directly consumed by a target model, thereby enabling cross-model reuse of context computation and decoupling context computation from downstream inference. ACCT consists of three lightweight components: the Cartographer identifies query-relevant context tokens for each target layer and KV head; the Allocator determines how many context tokens each target layer and KV head retains under a shared total KV budget; and the Compiler transforms selected source KV into sparse target KV. The target model can therefore perform inference using the transferred KV without reprocessing the original context. We evaluate ACCT in two complementary settings comprising five general-capability benchmarks and six highly context-dependent tasks. Experiments show that ACCT matches or exceeds the target model's original inference performance even when reducing the KV cache size by 75%. At a context length of approximately 19K tokens, ACCT's KV conversion achieves a 6.5-21.2 times speedup over target context prefill. These results demonstrate the feasibility of transferring context computation across models under a limited KV budget.

title: Gradient Descent on Two ReLU Neurons: Global Landscape and Bifurcation Dynamics
authors: Binghua Li, Mengzhe Li, Denny Wu, Tianhao Wang
abstract: Understanding how gradient descent learns features remains a central challenge in neural network theory. We study this question in a minimal multi-index setting that already exhibits rich multi-phase gradient dynamics: a well-specified two-neuron ReLU teacher-student model under isotropic Gaussian inputs, trained by population gradient flow from small initialization. We show that the dynamics are organized by two directions: the "easy" bisector direction, which carries the leading signal, and the "hard" splitting direction, which governs specialization. To characterize the loss structure and learning behavior, we analyze the population squared-loss landscape and show that every critical point with both student weights nonzero is either a global minimum or a saddle. We then track the gradient-flow trajectory, showing that student neurons first collapse toward a bisector saddle before escaping and specializing to teacher neurons. Our results provide both a landscape and dynamics account of the multi-phase symmetry-breaking behavior that arises in a simple multi-index model and under standard algorithmic and architectural choices.

title: Where ADS Crashes Differ: A Harmonized Comparison Against Human Baselines
authors: Doyeon Jang
abstract: Crash-rate comparisons between automated driving systems (ADS) and human drivers require an exposure denominator that only a few operators publish. We instead ask a composition question: given a crash, does the mix of crash types differ between ADS and human-driven vehicles? The question needs no mileage and can therefore cover every ADS operator. We assemble the NHTSA Standing General Order (SGO) ADS incident files across both file generations into 2,450 distinct in-scope incidents (2021-2026), of which 828 fall within the 2021-2024 window covered by the Crash Report Sampling System (CRSS), the national police-reported human comparator. A schema-constrained large language model (LLM) codes each SGO narrative into the CRSS crash-type taxonomy. Because SGO compels reporting far below the police-reporting threshold, we bracket reportability with an objective severity floor and a reasonable-person rubric, and claim a difference only where it survives both. Two composition differences hold under every reportability definition, tow definition and weighting of the human side, and under both definitions of driverless operation: turn-across-path crashes are under-represented among ADS crashes (0.23-0.46x the CRSS share under the primary driverless definition) and so are single-vehicle crashes (0.19-0.56x). In severity-floor rear-end crashes the ADS vehicle is the striking party at a quasi-induced-exposure ratio of 0.121 (95% CI [0.05, 0.23]) against a human baseline of 1.000. If the ADS vehicle is also struck more often than its exposure implies, this ratio overstates the ADS-human difference.
